*********Set directory and load data set entitled "Regression and Event Study Analyses.dta"*********
/*
use "H:\oldTS1desktop\Clean Water and Pasteurized Milk\Replication Files for AEJ Applied\Regression and Event Study Analyses.dta", clear
*/


**********Merge in the data set from Cutler and Miller from appropriate directory***************
/*
merge 1:1 year state_city_id using "H:\oldTS1desktop\Clean Water and Pasteurized Milk\Cutler and Miller\Culter and Miller Data Set for Merge.dta", keepusing(year state_city_id citynum lnmort lninfmrt percfem percblck percorac percfbrn allmort infmort mort0_1 age0_1 per0_1 per1_4 per5_9 per10_14 per15_19 per20_24 per25_34 per35_44 per45_64 per65up lnmlag1 lnmlag2 lnmlag3 lnmlag4 lnmlag5 filter_from_CM chlwater filtxchl lnpop filwin5 chlwin5  treatsew trchlsew nosewout intake pop_from_CM) generate(_merge_CM)
sort state_city_id year
*/

global demographic 	= "percfem percblck percorac percfbrn per0_1 per1_4 per5_9 per10_14 per15_19 per20_24 per25_34 per35_44 per45_64 per65up"
global lagmort 		= "lnmlag1 lnmlag2 lnmlag3 lnmlag4 lnmlag5"

*Re-creating Cutler and Miller's overall mortality rates that use the correct mortality counts
gen allmort_correct = (mortality*100000)/pop_from_CM
gen lnmort_correct = ln(allmort_correct)

*Re-creating Cutler and Miller's overall mortality rates that use correct mortality counts for period post-1909
gen allmort_correct_v2 = allmort
replace allmort_correct_v2 = (mortality*100000)/pop_from_CM if year > 1909
gen lnmort_correct_v2 = ln(allmort_correct_v2)

*Re-creating Cutler and Miller's infant mortality rates that use the correct infant mortality counts
gen infmort_correct = (mortality_under1*100000)/age0_1
gen lninfmrt_correct = ln(infmort_correct)

*Re-creating Cutler and Miller's mortality lags based on natural log of mortality rates that are only corrected for Memphis 1916 error and also creating lags that use the correct mortality counts post-1909
forvalues i = 1/5 {

	gen lnmlag`i'_correct = lnmlag`i'
	replace lnmlag`i'_correct = . if (state_city_id == 4705 & year == 1916 + `i')
	label var lnmlag`i'_correct "mortality lags that correct for Memphis 1916"

	gen lnmlag`i'_correct_v2 = lnmort_correct_v2[_n-`i']
	replace lnmlag`i'_correct_v2 = . if year <= 1899 + `i'
	label var lnmlag`i'_correct_v2 "mortality lags that correct Memphis and use correct mortality counts for post-1909"
	
}

global lagmort_correct = "lnmlag1_correct lnmlag2_correct lnmlag3_correct lnmlag4_correct lnmlag5_correct"
global lagmort_correct_v2 "lnmlag1_correct_v2 lnmlag2_correct_v2 lnmlag3_correct_v2 lnmlag4_correct_v2 lnmlag5_correct_v2"

*Correcting Cutler and Miller's chlorinate- and filter-within-5-years variables based on our dates
gen filwin5_correct = filwin5
*Louisville filtration
replace filwin5_correct = 1 if state_city_id == 2106 & year == 1904
replace filwin5_correct = 0 if state_city_id == 2106 & year == 1909
*Baltimore filtration
replace filwin5_correct = 0 if state_city_id == 2402 & year == 1909
replace filwin5_correct = 1 if state_city_id == 2402 & year == 1914
*Cleveland filtration
replace filwin5_correct = 0 if state_city_id == 3911 & year == 1912
replace filwin5_correct = 1 if state_city_id == 3911 & year == 1917
*Philadelphia filtration
replace filwin5_correct = 1 if state_city_id == 4254 & (year == 1901 | year == 1902)
replace filwin5_correct = 0 if state_city_id == 4254 & (year == 1906 | year == 1907)

gen chlwin5_correct = chlwin5
*Chicago chlorination
replace chlwin5_correct = 1 if state_city_id == 1711 & (year >= 1907 & year <= 1911)
replace chlwin5_correct = 0 if state_city_id == 1711 & year > 1911
*Louisville chlorination
replace chlwin5_correct = 1 if state_city_id == 2106 & (year == 1908 | year == 1909)
replace chlwin5_correct = 0 if state_city_id == 2106 & (year == 1913 | year == 1914)
*St. Louis chlorination
replace chlwin5_correct = 1 if state_city_id == 2913 & (year >= 1908 & year <= 1912)
replace chlwin5_correct = 0 if state_city_id == 2913 & year > 1912
*Philadelphia chlorination
replace chlwin5_correct = 1 if state_city_id == 4254 & (year == 1905 | year == 1906 | year == 1907)
replace chlwin5_correct = 0 if state_city_id == 4254 & year > 1909
*Pittsburgh chlorination
replace chlwin5_correct = 1 if state_city_id == 4256 & year == 1905
replace chlwin5_correct = 0 if state_city_id == 4256 & year == 1910
*Milwaukee chlorination
replace chlwin5_correct = 1 if state_city_id == 5515 & (year >= 1905 & year <= 1909)
replace chlwin5_correct = 0 if state_city_id == 5515 & year > 1909
method: city-panel event study and fixed effects
title: Reexamining the Contribution of Public Health Efforts to the Decline in Urban Mortality

*Philadelphia chlorination
replace chlwin5_correct = 1 if state_city_id == 4254 & (year == 1905 | year == 1906 | year == 1907)

*Milwaukee chlorination

replace chlwin5_correct = 0 if state_city_id == 5515 & year > 1909



*****************************************************************************************************************************************************************
*Table 11. Comparing our Total Mortality Estimates to those of Cutler and Miller (2005)
*****************************************************************************************************************************************************************
*Column (1): Replicating CM's Table 5, Column (2) results 
xi: reg lnmort filter_from_CM chlwater filtxchl lnpop chlwin5 filwin5 $lagmort treatsew trchlsew nosewout intake i.citynum i.year citynum##c.year $demographic, robust
sum allmort if cutler_miller_sample == 1 & (year > 1904 & year < 1937) & allmort != 0

*Column (2): Correct CM's SEs for clustering
xi: reg lnmort filter_from_CM chlwater filtxchl lnpop chlwin5 filwin5 $lagmort treatsew trchlsew nosewout intake i.citynum i.year citynum##c.year $demographic, cluster(citynum)
set seed 93843
boottest {filter_from_CM = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {chlwater = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {filtxchl = 0}, reps(1000)
sum allmort if cutler_miller_sample == 1 & (year > 1904 & year < 1937) & allmort != 0

*Column (3): Correct CM's SEs for clustering + Memphis, TN correction
xi: reg lnmort filter_from_CM chlwater filtxchl lnpop chlwin5 filwin5 $lagmort_correct treatsew trchlsew nosewout intake i.citynum i.year citynum##c.year $demographic if year < 1937, cluster(citynum)
set seed 93843
boottest {filter_from_CM = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {chlwater = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {filtxchl = 0}, reps(1000)
sum allmort if cutler_miller_sample == 1 & (year > 1904 & year < 1937) & allmort != 0 & (lnmlag1_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag2_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag3_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag4_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag5_correct_v2 != .)

*Column (4): Correct CM's SEs for clustering + Memphis, TN correction + 1910-1917 mortality rates calculated based on imputed pop
xi: reg lnmort_correct_v2 filter_from_CM chlwater filtxchl lnpop chlwin5 filwin5 $lagmort_correct_v2 treatsew trchlsew nosewout intake i.citynum i.year citynum##c.year $demographic if year < 1937, cluster(citynum)
set seed 93843
boottest {filter_from_CM = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {chlwater = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {filtxchl = 0}, reps(1000)
sum allmort_correct_v2 if cutler_miller_sample == 1 & (year > 1904 & year < 1937) & allmort != 0 & (lnmlag1_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag2_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag3_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag4_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag5_correct_v2 != .)

*Column (5): Correct CM's SEs for clustering + Memphis, TN correction + 1910-1917 mortality rates calculated based on imputed pop + correct filtration and chlorination dates
xi: reg lnmort_correct_v2 filter chlorination filter_chlorination lnpop chlwin5_correct filwin5_correct $lagmort_correct_v2 treatsew trchlsew nosewout intake i.citynum i.year citynum##c.year $demographic if year < 1937, cluster(citynum)
set seed 93843
boottest {filter = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {chlorination = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {filter_chlorination = 0}, reps(1000)
sum allmort_correct_v2 if cutler_miller_sample == 1 & (year > 1904 & year < 1937) & allmort != 0 & (lnmlag1_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag2_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag3_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag4_correct_v2 != . & lnmlag5_correct_v2 != .)

*Column (6): Our specification limited to C&M city-years
xi: reg ln_mortality_rate filter chlorination filter_chlorination water_project sewage_treat_div TB_test bact_standard percent_female percent_nonwhite percent_foreign percent_age_less15 percent_age_15to44 percent_age_45plus i.year i.state_city_id state_city_id#c.trend [pweight = pop_ave] if cutler_miller_sample == 1 & (year > 1904 & year < 1937), cluster(state_city_id)
set seed 93843
boottest {filter = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {chlorination = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {filter_chlorination = 0}, reps(1000)
sum mortality_rate if cutler_miller_sample == 1 & (year > 1904 & year < 1937)



*****************************************************************************************************************************************************************
*Table 12. Comparing our Infant Mortality Estimates to those of Cutler and Miller (2005)
*****************************************************************************************************************************************************************
*Column (1): Replicating CM's Table 5, Column (3) results 
xi: reg lninfmrt filter_from_CM chlwater filtxchl lnpop chlwin5 filwin5 $lagmort treatsew trchlsew nosewout intake i.citynum i.year citynum##c.year $demographic, robust
sum infmort if cutler_miller_sample == 1 & (year > 1904 & year < 1937) & infmort != 0

*Column (2): Correct CM's SEs for clustering
xi: reg lninfmrt filter_from_CM chlwater filtxchl lnpop chlwin5 filwin5 $lagmort treatsew trchlsew nosewout intake i.citynum i.year citynum##c.year $demographic, cluster(citynum)
set seed 93843
boottest {filter_from_CM = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {chlwater = 0}, reps(1000)
boottest {filtxchl = 0}, reps(1000)
sum infmort if cutler_miller_sample == 1 & (year > 1904 & year < 1937) & infmort != 0

*Column (3): Correct CM's SEs for clustering + Memphis, TN correction
xi: reg lninfmrt filter_from_CM chlwater filtxchl lnpop chlwin5 filwin5 $lagmort_correct treatsew trchlsew nosewout intake i.citynum i.year citynum##c.year $demographic, cluster(citynum)
set seed 93843
boottest {filter_from_CM = 0}, reps(1000)
method: city-panel event study and fixed effects
title: Reexamining the Contribution of Public Health Efforts to the Decline in Urban Mortality

******************************************************************************************************************************************

merge 1:1 year state_city_id using "H:\oldTS1desktop\Clean Water and Pasteurized Milk\Cutler and Miller\Total Mortality Rate from Mortality Statistics 1910-1917.dta"

content:
*********Set directory and load data set entitled "Regression and Event Study Analyses.dta"*********
/*
use "H:\oldTS1desktop\Clean Water and Pasteurized Milk\Replication Files for AEJ Applied\Regression and Event Study Analyses.dta", clear
*/


*Unweighted means
forvalues i = 1900/1940 {

	sum mortality_rate if  year == `i'
	gen mortality_mean_`i' = r(mean) 

	sum mortality_under1_rate if year == `i'
	gen mortality_under1_mean_`i' = r(mean)

	sum typhoid_rate if year == `i'
	gen typhoid_mean_`i' = r(mean)

	sum diarrhea_rate if year == `i'
	gen diarrhea_mean_`i' = r(mean)

	sum diarrhea_under2_rate if year == `i'
	gen diarrhea_under2_mean_`i' = r(mean)
	
	sum nonpul_TB_rate if year == `i'
	gen nonpul_TB_mean_`i' = r(mean)
	
	sum nonpul_TB_under2_rate if year == `i'
	gen nonpul_TB_under2_mean_`i' = r(mean)

}


keep mortality_mean_1900-nonpul_TB_under2_mean_1940

duplicates drop

gen i = 1
order i, before(mortality_mean_1900)

reshape long mortality_mean_ mortality_under1_mean_ typhoid_mean_ diarrhea_mean_ diarrhea_under2_mean_ nonpul_TB_mean_ nonpul_TB_under2_mean_, i(i) j(year)

drop i

rename mortality_mean_ mortality_mean
rename mortality_under1_mean_ mortality_under1_mean
rename typhoid_mean_ typhoid_mean
rename diarrhea_mean_ diarrhea_mean
rename diarrhea_under2_mean_ diarrhea_under2_mean
rename nonpul_TB_mean_ nonpul_TB_mean
rename nonpul_TB_under2_mean_ nonpul_TB_under2_mean


*Figure 2. Total and Infant Mortality Rates, 1900-1940
twoway (line mortality_mean year, sort lcolor(black) lpattern(solid) lwidth(thick)) ///
(line mortality_under1_mean year, sort lcolor(black) lpattern(dash) lwidth(thick) yaxis(2)), ///
title("{bf:Figure 2. Total and Infant Mortality Rates, 1900-1940}", size(vlarge) color(black)) ///
xtitle("") xscale(titlegap(2)) xlabel(1900(10)1940) ///
xsize(8) xlabel(, labsize(large)) ///
yline(1100 1300 1500 1700 1900, lwidth(vvvthin) lpattern(shortdash) lcolor(gs10)) /// 
ylabel(1100(200)1900, labsize(medsmall)) ///
ytitle("Mortality per 100,000 population", size(medlarge) color(black) margin(small)) ///
ytitle("Infant mortality per 100,000 population", size(medlarge) color(black) margin(med) axis(2)) ///
legend(order(1 "Total mortality rate" 2 "Infant mortality rate") size(large) cols(1)) ///
note("Notes: Based on annual data from {it:Mortality Statistics} and {it:Vital Statistics of the United States} for the period 1900-1940," ///
"published by the U.S. Census Bureau.", size(med))  /// 
graphregion(fcolor(white) lcolor(white) lwidth(vvvthin) ifcolor(white) ilcolor(white) ilwidth(vvvthin)) aspect(.3)


*Figure 3. Typhoid Mortality Rates, 1900-1940
twoway (line typhoid_mean year, sort lcolor(black) lpattern(solid) lwidth(thick)), ///
title("{bf:Figure 3. Typhoid Mortality Rates, 1900-1940}", size(vlarge) color(black)) ///

*Appendix Figure 11. Pre- and Post-Milk-Related Intervention Trends in Infant Mortality
******************************************************************************************************************************************
*Bacteriological standard
xtreg ln_mortality_under1_rate bact_standard_lead5plus bact_standard_lead4 bact_standard_lead3 bact_standard_lead2 zero bact_standard_time0 bact_standard_lag1 bact_standard_lag2 bact_standard_lag3 bact_standard_lag4 bact_standard_lag5plus filter chlorination water_project sewage_treat_div TB_test percent_female percent_nonwhite percent_foreign percent_age_less15 percent_age_15to44 percent_age_45plus i.year i.state_city_id#c.trend [pweight = pop_ave], fe i(state_city_id) cluster(state_city_id)

estimates store leads_lags

coefplot leads_lags, omitted keep(bact_standard_lead5plus bact_standard_lead4 bact_standard_lead3 bact_standard_lead2 zero ///
bact_standard_time0 bact_standard_lag1 bact_standard_lag2 bact_standard_lag3 bact_standard_lag4 bact_standard_lag5plus) ///
vertical  title("{bf:Pre- and Post-Bacteriological Standard Trends in Infant Mortality}", color(black) size(medlarge)) ///
xtitle("Years Since Bacteriological Standard Came Into Effect") xscale(titlegap(2))  xline(5, lcolor(black)) xlabel(, labsize(small)) ///
yline(-.1 0 .1 .2, lwidth(vvvthin) lpattern(dash) lcolor(black)) ///
graphregion(fcolor(white) lcolor(white) lwidth(vvvthin) ifcolor(white) ilcolor(white) ilwidth(vvvthin)) ///
ciopts(recast(rcap) lcolor(black)) level(90) mcolor(black) 


*TB Test
xtreg ln_mortality_under1_rate TB_test_lead5plus TB_test_lead4 TB_test_lead3 TB_test_lead2 zero TB_test_time0 TB_test_lag1 TB_test_lag2 TB_test_lag3 TB_test_lag4 TB_test_lag5plus filter chlorination water_project sewage_treat_div bact_standard percent_female percent_nonwhite percent_foreign percent_age_less15 percent_age_15to44 percent_age_45plus i.year i.state_city_id#c.trend [pweight = pop_ave], fe i(state_city_id) cluster(state_city_id)

estimates store leads_lags

coefplot leads_lags, omitted keep(TB_test_lead5plus TB_test_lead4 TB_test_lead3 TB_test_lead2 zero ///
TB_test_time0 TB_test_lag1 TB_test_lag2 TB_test_lag3 TB_test_lag4 TB_test_lag5plus) ///
vertical  title("{bf:Pre- and Post-TB Test Trends in Infant Mortality}", color(black) size(medlarge)) ///
xtitle("Years Since TB Test Came Into Effect") xscale(titlegap(2))  xline(5, lcolor(black)) xlabel(, labsize(small)) ///
yline(-.05 0 .05 .1 .15, lwidth(vvvthin) lpattern(dash) lcolor(black)) ///
graphregion(fcolor(white) lcolor(white) lwidth(vvvthin) ifcolor(white) ilcolor(white) ilwidth(vvvthin)) ///
ciopts(recast(rcap) lcolor(black)) level(90) mcolor(black) 



******************************************************************************************************************************************
*Appendix Figure 14. Pre- and Post-Filtration Trends in Diarrhea/Enteritis Mortality
******************************************************************************************************************************************
xtreg ln_diarrhea_rate filter_lead5plus filter_lead4 filter_lead3 filter_lead2 zero filter_time0 filter_lag1 filter_lag2 filter_lag3 filter_lag4 filter_lag5plus chlorination water_project sewage_treat_div TB_test bact_standard percent_female percent_nonwhite percent_foreign percent_age_less15 percent_age_15to44 percent_age_45plus i.year i.state_city_id#c.trend [pweight = pop_ave], fe i(state_city_id) cluster(state_city_id)

estimates store leads_lags

coefplot leads_lags, omitted keep(filter_lead5plus filter_lead4 filter_lead3 filter_lead2 zero ///
filter_time0 filter_lag1 filter_lag2 filter_lag3 filter_lag4 filter_lag5plus) ///
vertical title("{bf:Appendix Figure 14. Pre- and Post-Filtration Trends in Diarrhea/Enteritis Mortality}", color(black) size(medsmall)) ///
xtitle("Years Since Filtration Came Into Effect") xscale(titlegap(2))  xline(5, lcolor(black)) xlabel(, labsize(small)) ///
yline(-.4 -.2 0 .2, lwidth(vvvthin) lpattern(dash) lcolor(black)) ///
note("Notes: OLS coefficient estimates (and their 90% confidence intervals) are reported, where the omitted category" ///
"is 1 year before treatment. The dependent variable is equal to the natural log of the number of diarrhea/enteritis" ///
"deaths per 100,000 population in city {it:c} and year {it:t}. Controls include the demographic characteristics and" ///
"remaining public health interventions listed in Table 5, city fixed effects, year fixed effects, and city-specific linear" ///
"trends. Regressions are weighted by city population. Standard errors are corrected for clustering at the city level.", margin(small)) ///
graphregion(fcolor(white) lcolor(white) lwidth(vvvthin) ifcolor(white) ilcolor(white) ilwidth(vvvthin)) ///
ciopts(recast(rcap) lcolor(black)) level(90) mcolor(black)

clear all
	version 14.1		 
	set more off
	pause on
	
	global panelclean "X:/Dropbox (IFPRI)/Betting/Data Editor Files/data/Panel Clean.dta"	
	global latex "X:/Dropbox (IFPRI)/Betting/Data Editor Files/out/raw/"	

use "$panelclean", clear	
	
keep if inperson==1								// set correct sample
		
* Trim infeasible rate of return	
	sum bet_ror if srvrd==3, detail				// bet_ror = totwin / totbet
	gen flag = bet_ror > r(p99)
	bys id: egen temp = max(flag)
	replace flag = temp
 	drop if flag==1 
	drop temp* flag

* SAMPLE CONSISTENCY
	drop if sindex==.
	drop if bmom_mean==.
	drop if bmom_variance==.
	drop if bmom_skewness==.
	drop if bmom_kurtosis==.
	drop if betprofile == . | betprop == .  						
					
* Define saving ability heterogeneity
		
	gen lsa = badsindex
	egen lsaxsrvrd = group(lsa srvrd)
	egen lsaxweek = group(lsa week)	
		
* Set primary regression variables 
	
	local incbet "ih_inc betprop"
	local moments = "bmom_mean bmom_mean2 bmom_mean3 bmom_variance bmom_variance2 bmom_variance3 bmom_skewness bmom_skewness2 bmom_skewness3 bmom_kurtosis bmom_kurtosis2 bmom_kurtosis3"
	local othertreats = "tr3_betinfo tr2_bankacct tr3_foodinfo tr1_wallet tr2_savbox"				
	
* Setup controls w/ and w/out heterogeneity	

		foreach v in `moments'{
			gen hdmom1_`v' = `v'
			gen hdmom2_`v' = `v' * lsa
			}		
				
		foreach v in `incbet' `othertreats' nticks nticks2{
			gen hdem1_`v' = `v'
			gen hdem2_`v' = `v' * lsa
			}	
			
		foreach v in ih_inc `othertreats' {						// basic controls without controlling for betting
			gen demx1_`v' = `v'
			gen demx2_`v' = `v' * lsa
			}				
	
	replace winprop = winprop_c5								// set to conditional (on being positive) 5% winsorizations for main results
	replace bigpurchprop = bigpurchprop_c5
	
	tempfile prepdata
	save `prepdata'

**********************************************************************************************************
*									Desired Expenditures and Betting Targets
**********************************************************************************************************
*
	use `prepdata', clear
	
	keep if inperson==1
	
	* Sample consistency
		gen counter = ct_prop!=.				// make sure have at least two obs per individual with the critical independent variable measured.
		bys id: egen ttl = total(counter)	
		drop if ttl <=1							
		
	* Regression covariate setup	
		gen ct = .	
		gen ctxlsa = .
		gen ct0 = ct_prop==0

content:
******************************************************************************************************	

*
	use `prepdata', clear

	replace winprop = winprop_c5 * 100				// set winning variable
	
	local moments = "bmom_mean bmom_mean2 bmom_mean3 bmom_variance bmom_variance2 bmom_variance3 bmom_skewness bmom_skewness2 bmom_skewness3 bmom_kurtosis bmom_kurtosis2 bmom_kurtosis3"
	local incbet "ih_inc betprop"	

	* Generate residuals
	
	reghdfe winprop if inperson==1, absorb(fe_week14=i.wave fe_srvrd14=i.srvrd) vce(cluster id) residuals
	predict winresids0, residuals	
	
	reghdfe winprop `incbet' nticks nticks2 if inperson==1, absorb(fe_week4=i.wave fe_srvrd4=i.srvrd) vce(cluster id) residuals
	predict winresids1, residuals
	
	reghdfe winprop `incbet'   nticks nticks2  `moments' if inperson==1, absorb(fe_week6=i.wave fe_srvrd6=i.srvrd) vce(cluster id) residuals	 
	predict winresids2, residuals
	
	reghdfe winprop `incbet' nticks nticks2  if inperson==1, absorb(fe_week7=i.wave fe_srvrd7=i.srvrd fe_profile7=i.betprofile) vce(cluster id) residuals	
	predict winresids3, residuals		

	gen liqavail_usd = liqavail_bl / 350000			// 100 USD
	local covars = "sa_usd liqavail_usd age livealone hhsize mathscore primary olevel alevel riskaversion_r2 beta_bl delta_bl usl usm ush "
	local treats = "lumpyprime_el tr1_budget tr1_wallet tr3_betinfo tr3_foodinfo"
	replace meaninc = meaninc / 3500

	label var sa_usd "Save Update / Weekly Inc"
			
	matrix balancetable = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]			// match number of regression types

	local t = 1
	foreach v in `covars' {

	* LEVELS
		reghdfe winresids0 `v' if inperson==1, vce(robust) a(week srvrd)
		mat results = r(table)
		local b = results[1,1]
		local s = results[2,1]
		local p = results[4,1]
		local b1 = round(`b', .001)
		local p1 = round(`p', .001)
		local s1 = round(`s', .001)
		
		reghdfe winresids1 `v' if inperson==1, vce(robust) a(week srvrd)
		mat results = r(table)
		local b = results[1,1]
		local s = results[2,1]	
		local p = results[4,1]
		local b2 = round(`b', .001)
		local p2 = round(`p', .001)	
		local s2 = round(`s', .001)	

		reghdfe winresids3 `v' if inperson==1, vce(robust) a(week srvrd)
		mat results = r(table)
		local b = results[1,1]
		local s = results[2,1]
		local p = results[4,1]
		local b3 = round(`b', .001)
		local p3 = round(`p', .001)	
		local s3 = round(`s', .001)	

		reghdfe winresids2 `v' if inperson==1, vce(robust) a(week srvrd)
		mat results = r(table)
		local b = results[1,1]
		local s = results[2,1]
		local p = results[4,1]
		local b4 = round(`b', .001)
		local p4 = round(`p', .001)	
		local s4 = round(`s', .001)		
	
	matrix balancetable = [balancetable \ `b1', `p1', `b2', `p2', `b3', `p3', `b4', `p4' \ `s1', . , `s2',.  , `s3',.  , `s4', . ]	
	local t = `t' + 1
	}
	
	local k = (`t' * 2) -1
	
	matrix balancetable = balancetable[2..`k', .]
method: field experiment and panel treatment-effect regressions with fixed effects and heterogeneity
title: Gambling, Saving, and Lumpy Liquidity Needs

	* Make variables consistent with Mini labeling
		gen betmean_prop = betmean / meaninc

	local primevars = "lmp_purchased lumpy_liqprop lumpy_incprop coinsamt"	
	keep id  si* mini lmp_proptix lmp_maxtix nticks bet2w_numticks age weekinc `primevars' betmean bet_lastweek_tot bet_lastweek_numticks  mm_enrolled sav_lockbox cred_bank savc* liqc* sindex badsindex* savindex  rosca_ever rosca_current tr* sav_acct save_ability_naive wave sav_abil_prop srvrd savconstr hhsize betmean liqavail_raw week lmp_tottix  lumpyprime meaninc betmean_prop liqprop_bl lmp_purchased lumpy_incprop lumpy_liqprop livealone primary olevel alevel mathscore beta delta riskaversion_r2 upsi* si*
	
	append using "$miniclean"

*********************  PREP DATA/Harmonization between panel and mini samples ***********************************

	replace lmp_purchased = 0 if lmp_purchased==.
	replace lumpy_liqprop = 0 if lumpy_liqprop==.
	replace lumpy_incprop = 0 if lumpy_incprop==.
	replace tix_dem = lmp_tottix if mini==0	
	
	gen inc = incnorm
	replace inc = meaninc if mini==0
	replace meaninc = incnorm if mini==1
	
	replace liqprop = liqprop_bl if mini==0
	replace lumpy_liqprop = lumpyprice_prop if mini==1
	replace riskaversion = riskaversion_r2 if mini==0

	gen lumpyxbeta = lumpyprime * beta
	gen lumpyxdelta = lumpyprime * delta
	
 	replace meaninc = meaninc / 3500				// Convert to USD for balance table
		
	foreach v in tr1_budget tr1_wallet tr2_savbox tr2_bankacct tr3_betinfo tr3_foodinfo{
		replace `v' = 0 if `v'==.
		}
	
	gen lumpyxsindex = lumpyprime * sindex
	gen lumpyxbadsindex = lumpyprime * badsindex	

	drop if lmp_proptix==.

	gen lumpyxhet = .

cap drop flag
	
	local bwidth = 1.645										// set confidence interval bandwidth for figure
			
		gen actoverperc_prop = 	actoverperc_usd / (incnorm / 3500)
		gen savxactoperc_prop = saveprime * actoverperc_prop
		
			reg lmp_maxtix lumpyprime saveprime actoverperc_prop `covars', robust		
			predict resids3, residuals
			
			reg savxactoperc_prop lumpyprime saveprime actoverperc_prop `covars', robust	
			predict resids4, residuals
			
			sum resids4 , detail
			drop if resids4 <r(p1) | resids4 > r(p99)
			
			gen pr4 = resids4 > 0
			gen posresids4 = resids4 * pr4
			reg resids3 resids4 posresids4, robust
			
			matrix ests = J(1, 5, .)
			local k = -.25
			while `k' < 0{
				lincom (`k')*(resids4) + _cons
				matrix temp0 = `k'
				matrix temp1 = r(se)
				matrix temp2 = r(estimate) 			
				matrix fulltemp = temp0[1,1], temp1[1,1], temp2[1,1], temp2[1,1] - `bwidth' * temp1[1,1], temp2[1,1] + `bwidth' * temp1[1,1]					
				matrix ests = (ests \ fulltemp)
				local k = `k' + .01
			}
			
				lincom (-.0001)*(resids4) + _cons
				matrix temp0 = -.0001
				matrix temp1 = r(se)
				matrix temp2 = r(estimate) 		
				matrix fulltemp = temp0[1,1], temp1[1,1], temp2[1,1], temp2[1,1] - `bwidth' * temp1[1,1], temp2[1,1] + `bwidth' * temp1[1,1]				
				matrix ests = (ests \ fulltemp)			
			
		
			local k = 0
			while `k' <=.21{
				lincom (`k')*(resids4+posresids4) + _cons
				matrix temp0 = `k'
				matrix temp1 = r(se)
				matrix temp2 = r(estimate)			
				matrix fulltemp = temp0[1,1], temp1[1,1], temp2[1,1], temp2[1,1] - `bwidth' * temp1[1,1], temp2[1,1] + `bwidth' * temp1[1,1]					
				matrix ests = (ests \ fulltemp)
				local k = `k' + .01
			}		
			
			matrix list ests
			
			putexcel set "$latex/lincom_prop.xlsx", replace 
			putexcel A1=("resids4") B1=("ses") C1=("betax") D1=("cimin") E1=("cimax")			
			putexcel A2=matrix(ests)
			
			preserve
			clear all
			import excel "$latex/lincom_prop.xlsx", first
			tempfile lincomfit
			save `lincomfit'
			restore
		
			append using `lincomfit'
			
			reg resids3 resids4, robust
			
			drop if resids4 < -.2 | resids4 > .2			// set range so graph is more intelligible
			
			# delimit ;				
			twoway  (rarea cimin cimax resids4 if resids4, color(gs14)) (line betax resids4 if resids4 , lpattern(dash) lwidth(medthick) color(gs6) xline(0) yline(0)) 
			(lowess resids3 resids4 if resids4, bwidth(.8) lcolor(black) lwidth(thick) astyle(foreground)),
				graphregion(color(white)) bgcolor(white) xtitle(Saving Ability Update / Weekly Income)
				scheme(fb, perm) ytitle(Effect of Update) ylabel( , angle(0)) yscale(titlegap(*-38)) title() xlabel(-.2 -.1 0 .1 .2)
				note(Top and Bottom 1% of x-var and updates trimmed. Update = Assisted - Naive) legend(label(1 "CI-90%") label(2 "Linear Fit") label(3 "Lowess Estimate") );
				graph export "$latex/F3.pdf", replace;
			# delimit cr

	egen amtneeded = rowtotal(lp_need lp2_need lp4_need)
	replace amtneeded = . if lp_need==. & lp2_need==. & lp4_need==.
	replace amtneeded = amtneeded / (incnorm / 1000)
	label var amtneeded "Lumpy Good Price / Weekly Inc"	
	
	gen actualsavetime = lumpyprice / (actualsaveability / 1000)		
	replace sav_29b = . if sav_29b < 0			// 1 observation
	
	gen timeupdate_raw = actualsavetime - believedsavetime 
	sum timeupdate_raw if timeupdate_raw<0, detail
	replace timeupdate_raw = r(p1) if timeupdate_raw < r(p1)
	sum timeupdate_raw if timeupdate_raw>0, detail
	replace timeupdate_raw = r(p99) if timeupdate_raw > r(p99)
	
	gen timeupdate = asinh(timeupdate_raw)
	label var timeupdate "IHST of time update"	

	gen savexpoa_time = saveprime * timeupdate
	gen poa_timexbeta = timeupdate * beta
	gen savexpoa_timexbeta =  saveprime * poa_timexbeta
	
	gen poa_timexdelta = timeupdate * delta
	gen savexpoa_timexdelta = saveprime * poa_timexdelta

	gen actoverperc_full = (actualsaveability - sav_29b) / 1000	
	sum actoverperc_full if actoverperc_full <0, detail												// winsorize 1% of updates
	replace actoverperc_full = r(p1) if actoverperc_full < r(p1) & actoverperc_full !=.
	sum actoverperc_full if actoverperc_full >0, detail
	replace actoverperc_full = r(p99) if actoverperc_full > r(p99) & actoverperc_full!=.	
	label var actoverperc_full "Saving ability update in 1000s UGX"

** Primes and patience
		
	gen lumpyxbeta = lumpyprime * beta	
	gen lumpyxdelta = lumpyprime * delta		
		
	gen lumpyprice_raw = lumpyprice * 1000
	
* HH size
	gen livealone = hh_livewithothers==0	
	replace hh_mbrs = 0 if livealone==1
	gen hhsize = hh_mbrs + 1	
	replace hh_portion = 4 if hhsize==1
	replace hh_portion = 4 if hh_mbrs==0
	replace hh_portion = 4 if livealone==1

* Income
	replace hh_portion = 4 if hh_livewithothers==0
	gen tempxx = 0 if hh_portion==0 & wave==3
	replace tempxx = 25 if hh_portion==1 & wave==3
	replace tempxx = 50 if hh_portion==2 & wave==3
	replace tempxx = 75 if hh_portion==3 & wave==3	
	replace tempxx = 100 if hh_portion==4 & wave==3
	gen hh_propcontrib = tempxx 
	gen hh_income = (incnorm / 3500) * (100 / hh_propcontrib) if hh_propcontrib!=0
	gen hh_incomepc = hh_income / hhsize			

** Betting

	gen betmean_prop = bet_norm / incnorm	

** Sources of likely liquidity for desired expenditure

	tab lgood_s1, g(lgs)
	tab lgood_s1 if lgood_s1 != 1
	
	foreach k in  1 2 3 4 5 6{
		egen lg_`k' = rowmax(lgs`k' lgood_s2_`k')
		}
	
	egen lg_anycred = rowmax(lg_3 lg_4 lg_5)	
	tab lgood_s1, g(lgx)

**Set working directory

			destring final_topdown, replace
			
			tempfile finaltreats
			save `finaltreats'
			sort id
		restore
		
		sort id
		merge m:1 id using `finaltreats'
		drop if _m==2
		drop _m	
		
		replace treat1 = "0" if treat1=="None"
		replace treat1 = "1" if treat1=="Wallet"
		replace treat1 = "2" if treat1=="Budget Paper"
		destring treat1, replace
		
		label var final_treat1 "Treatment Assigment: 0=Control, 1=Wallet, 2=Budget Paper"
		label var final_treat2 "Treatment Assigment: 0=Control, 1=Savings Box, 2=Bank Acct"
		label var final_treat3 "Treatment Assigment: 0=Control, 1=Betting Info, 2=Food Info"
		
		replace final_treat1 = t1 if wave==1				
		replace final_treat2 = t2 if wave==1
		replace final_treat3 = t3 if wave==1

	* Fill in treatments for all time periods
		
		bys id: egen temp = max(final_treat1)
		replace final_treat1 = temp
		drop temp
		
		bys id: egen temp = max(final_treat2)
		replace final_treat2 = temp
		drop temp
				
		bys id: egen temp = max(final_treat3)
		replace final_treat3 = temp
		drop temp		
		
	* TREAT 1: WALLET AND BUDGETING
		
		gen tr1_wallet = (final_treat1==1) & (srvrd>3)
		label var tr1_wallet "Respondent treated with wallet in this period"
		gen tr1_budget = (final_treat1==2) & (srvrd>3)
		replace tr1_budget = . if bet_budget==.
		label var tr1_budget "Respondent treated with budget paper in this period"
		gen tr1_wallet_prebudg = bet_budget * tr1_wallet
		label var tr1_wallet_prebudg "People who budgeted and assiged to wallet"
		gen tr1_budget_prebudg = bet_budget * tr1_budget
		replace t1_1 = 0 if final_treat1!=1
		gen tr1_wallet_treated = t1_1 * (srvrd>3)
		label var tr1_wallet_treated "People who actually tried wallet"

		label var tr1_wallet_prebudg_treated "ppl who budget and tried wallet"
		
	* TREAT 2: SAVINGS
		destring treat2, replace

	* PRIMES
		gen hotvid = t4==2
		gen coldvid = t4==3
		gen anyvid = t4==2 | t4==3

		replace lumpyprime = lprime=="1" if wave==2 & (srvrd==1 | srvrd==3)

		gen lumpyprime_el = lumpyprime * (srvrd==9)
		replace lumpyprime_el = 0 if lumpyprime_el==.
		
	* Coins offered
	
		gen coinsamt = 500 if week < 15
		replace coinsamt = 600 if week > 15 & week < 35		
		gen saveprime = 0

/********************************************************************************************************************
*														WEEKLY INCOME												*	
********************************************************************************************************************/	

	replace intgroup=1 if srvrd==1
	replace intgroup=2 if srvrd==2 | srvrd==3
	replace intgroup=3 if srvrd==4 | srvrd==5
	replace intgroup=4 if srvrd==6 | srvrd==7
	replace intgroup=5 if srvrd==8 | srvrd==9
	
	gen mini=0

	destring inc_profit, replace
	destring inc_1c, replace		
	
	bys id: egen inc_revenue_mean = mean(inc_revenue)
	
	// calculate income for wave 1
	// clean up for enumerators who put investments in the cost category
		gen excesscost = inc_cost - inc_revenue_mean			
		replace excesscost = 0 if excesscost < 0
		replace inc_cost = inc_cost - excesscost						// only positive where costs are higher than mean revenues
		egen inc_investX = rowtotal (inc_job1_invest_tot excesscost)  	// recategorize excess costs as investments and not marginal costs
		replace inc_job1_invest_tot = inc_investX
		drop inc_investX
		gen inc_costminus = -1 * inc_cost
		egen double weekincome_w1 = rowtotal(inc_revenue inc_costminus inc_source2_7days_tot inc2 inc_source3_tot)
		replace weekincome_w1=. if wave==2
	
	// calculate income for wave 2		
		gen pc_inc_cost = inc_cost if inperson==0 & wave==2
		replace pc_inc_cost = pc_inc_cost * -1
		gen pc_inc_rev = inc_revenue if inperson==0 & wave==2
		
		gen temp_inc_cost = inc_cost * -1 if inperson==1 
		gen temp_inc_revenue = inc_revenue if inperson==1
	
		egen ip_incprof = rowtotal(temp_inc_cost temp_inc_revenue inc_source2_7days_tot inc_source3_tot)	
		egen pc_incprof = rowtotal(inc_1c inc2)
		gen weekincome_w2 = ip_incprof if wave==2

		gen temp_inc_cost = inc_cost * -1 if inperson==1 
		gen temp_inc_revenue = inc_revenue if inperson==1
	
		egen ip_incprof = rowtotal(temp_inc_cost temp_inc_revenue inc_source2_7days_tot inc_source3_tot)	
		egen pc_incprof = rowtotal(inc_1c inc2)
		gen weekincome_w2 = ip_incprof if wave==2
		replace weekincome_w2 = pc_incprof if inperson==0 & wave==2
		drop temp*
		
		gen weekinc = weekincome_w1
		replace weekinc = weekincome_w2 if wave==2
		label var weekinc "Weekly income from all sources"	
		
		bys id: egen meaninc = mean(weekinc)
		label var meaninc "Mean income for duration of study"
		bys id: egen temp = mean(weekinc) if srvrd < 4

		// Business costs
		
		bys id intgroup: egen temp1 = mean(inc_1b)
		bys id intgroup: egen temp2 = mean(inc_cost)
		egen buscosts2w_mean = rowmean(temp1 temp2)
		drop temp*
		
		// Last week income
			xtset id srvrd
			gen weekinc_lw = L1.weekinc
				
/////////////////////////////// HH CONTRIBUTION / POVERTY LEVEL //////////
	
	replace hh_mbrs = 0 if hh_livewithothers==0	
	bys id: egen tempa = max(hh_mbrs)				// hh_mbrs is other than yourself
	replace hh_mbrs = tempa 						// include self
	gen hhsize = hh_mbrs + 1
	
	bys id: egen temp = max(hh_livewithothers)
	gen livealone = temp==0		
	drop temp*

	replace hh_portion=4 if hh_contribs==0
	replace hh_portion=4 if hhsize==1
	
	gen temp3 = 1 if hh_portion==4
	replace temp3 = .75 if hh_portion==3
	replace temp3 = .5 if hh_portion==2
	replace temp3 = .25 if hh_portion==1
	replace temp3 = 0 if hh_portion==0
	gen hh_contributor = temp3>0
	
	bys id: egen tempx = max(temp3)
	replace temp3 = tempx
	
	gen temp1 = meaninc / temp3 if temp3!=0
	gen temp2 = temp1 / hhsize

	bys id: egen hh_income = max(temp1)
	bys id: egen hh_propcontrib = max(temp3)
	
	replace hh_income = . if hh_contributor==0
	bys id: egen hh_incomepc = max(temp2)	
	replace hh_incomepc = . if hh_contributor==0
	drop temp*
	
	drop age

	bys id: egen age = max(list_age)
	drop list_age
	
	replace hoh = 1 if hhsize==1

	replace bigfam = . if hhsize==.

content:
drop list_age
	
	replace hoh = 1 if hhsize==1
	gen bigfam = hhsize > 3
	replace bigfam = . if hhsize==.	
	
//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
///////////////////////////////  Betting        //////////////////////////
//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

	* Clean missing values
	replace bet2 = . if bet2==-88
	replace bet_lastweek_tot = . if bet_lastweek_tot==-88
	replace bet_lastweek_medtarget=. if bet_lastweek_medtarget==-88

	* Number of tickets
	gen bet_lastweek_numticks_orig = bet_lastweek_numticks 
	gen blw_num = bet_lastweek_numticks 
	replace blw_num = bet1 if inperson==0
	replace blw_num  = . if blw_num  < 0		// 17 missing/don't know values
	 
	replace blw_num  = . if blw_num  > 100   	// 5 responses 1000 and up that should have been values not # tickets
	replace bet_lastweek_numticks = blw_num
	gen bet = bet_lastweek_tot
	replace bet = bet2 if inperson==0			// different label from phone interviews
	gen blw_tot = bet
	
	gen tempnum = blw_num
	gen temptot = blw_tot
	replace temptot = . if blw_num==.
	replace tempnum = . if temptot==.
	bys id: egen mtempnum = mean(blw_num)
	bys id: egen mtemptot = mean(blw_tot)
	gen mvalue = mtemptot / mtempnum	
		
	* Impute amounts for people missing number or total, but not the other.
	replace blw_tot = mvalue * blw_num	   if blw_tot ==. & blw_num!=.			// 7 changes - Assign total amount for missing values based on individual price per tickets reported
	replace blw_num = blw_tot / mvalue if blw_tot !=. & blw_num==.				// 20 changes - Infer number of tickets from average price reported 
	drop temp* mtempnum mtemptot mvalue 
	
	gen win = bet_lastweek_win_tot
	replace win = bet3 if bet3!=. & win ==.
	replace win = 0 if bet_lastweek_numticks_orig == 0
	replace win = 0 if bet_lastweek_anywin==0
	replace win = 0 if bet_tix ==0
	label var win "Total won in past week from betting"
	
	* Bet aggregates
	bys id: egen totbet = total(bet)
	label var totbet "Total spent on betting for respondent"

label var sindex_c4 "Standardized inverse log hh size for survey group"

		sum savindex, d

////////////////////////////////////////// LUMPY PRIME AND BETTING DEMAND VARIABLES  ///////////////////////////////////////////

	* Lumpy Prime and measured betting demand variables
	
	gen lmp_need = sa5_1e if wave==1
	replace lmp_need = sa5_2e if lmp_need==.
	replace lmp_need = sa1_alt3 if lmp_need==.
	replace lmp_need = sa1b_alt3 if lmp_need==.
	replace lmp_need = sa1_1a if lmp_need==.
	replace lmp_need = sa1b_1a if lmp_need==.
	replace lmp_need = sa1_2a if lmp_need==.

	destring lumpy_cost, replace
	
	gen lmp_temp = liq_need_tot if liq_busopp==1 & wave==2
	replace lmp_temp = liq_hh_tot if liq_hh==1 & wave==2
	replace lmp_temp = liq_personal_tot if liq_personal==1 & wave==2
	replace lmp_temp = lumpy_cost if wave==1
	replace lmp_temp = sa5_1c if wave==1 & sa5_1c != .
	
	replace lmp_need = lmp_temp if (sa1_purchb==1 | sa1b_purchb==1) & wave==2 & lmp_need==.
	replace lmp_need = lmp_temp if (sa5_1e==. | sa5_2e==.) & wave==1 & lmp_need==.
	
	gen lumpy_liqprop = lmp_need / liqavail_bl
	gen lumpy_incprop = lmp_need / meaninc
	
	gen lmp_purchased = sa5_1d if wave==1
	replace lmp_purchased = sa5_2d if wave==1 & lmp_purchased==.

	replace lmp_purchased = sa1b_purch if wave==2 & lmp_purchased==.

	egen lmp_cash = rowtotal(sa5_cash sa1_cash)

	replace lmp_med = sa1_med if wave==2

	replace lmp_tottix = . if lmp_low==. & lmp_med==. & lmp_high==.

/********************************************************************************************************************************
*														 BETTING MOMENTS 													*	
********************************************************************************************************************************/	

		* for each bettor get total tickets - N
		* record total number of wins - K
		* calculate average win amount and average amount spent on ticket
		* from win amount - infer P likelihood of a bet winning
		* calculate likelihood of K wins give binomial distribution [1 - F(k; n, p)] 
		* If [1 - F(k; n, p)] < 0.001 then we should have only seen .5 in total sample of 500

	* calculate mean stake from weekly bet expenditures and number of tickets
		bys id intgroup: egen bet2w_numticks = total(bet_lastweek_numticks)
		gen bet2w_meanstake = bet2w_tot / bet2w_numticks

content:
* for each bettor get total tickets - N
		* record total number of wins - K
		* calculate average win amount and average amount spent on ticket
		* from win amount - infer P likelihood of a bet winning
		* calculate likelihood of K wins give binomial distribution [1 - F(k; n, p)] 
		* If [1 - F(k; n, p)] < 0.001 then we should have only seen .5 in total sample of 500

	* calculate mean stake from weekly bet expenditures and number of tickets
		bys id intgroup: egen bet2w_numticks = total(bet_lastweek_numticks)
		gen bet2w_meanstake = bet2w_tot / bet2w_numticks
		bys id: egen bet_stake_temp = mean(bet2w_meanstake)			// temporary mean stake for individuals for four replacements respondents
		replace bet_lastweek_tot = bet_stake_temp * bet_lastweek_numticks if bet_lastweek_tot==. & (srvrd==3 | srvrd==7) & bet_lastweek_numticks!=0		// fill in a few values for betting and tix where one is known and other is missing
		replace bet_lastweek_numticks = bet_lastweek_tot / bet_stake_temp if bet_lastweek_tot!=. & bet_lastweek_numticks==.
		drop bet_stake_temp									 				

	* Overall stats
		gen bets_lastweek_temp = bet_lastweek_tot					// in calculating these averages avoid asymmetry if one is present and other is missing
		gen bets_tix_temp = bet_lastweek_numticks
		replace bets_lastweek_temp = . if bet_lastweek_numticks==.
		replace bets_tix_temp = . if bet_lastweek_tot==.

		bys id: egen totbet_Rs = total(bets_lastweek_temp)
		bys id: egen tottix_Rs = total(bets_tix_temp)
		gen bet_meanstake_overall = totbet_Rs / tottix_Rs
		bys id: egen bet_meanpayout_allrounds = mean(bet_lastweek_medtarget)
		drop *_Rs

	* now impute number of tickets on PC weeks
		replace bet_lastweek_numticks = bet2 / bet_meanstake_overall if bet_lastweek_numticks==.

	* gen weekly P of winning likelihood imputed from stake and payout - conservative bound from fair odds (higher P than realistic)
		replace bet2w_meanstake = 0 if bet2w_mean ==0
		replace bet2w_meanstake = bet_meanstake_overall if bet2w_meanstake < 500 & bet2w_meanstake > 0
		gen bet_p_week = bet2w_meanstake / (bet_lastweek_medtarget * 1.43)	// This comes from an expected return of ~70% of amount spent			
		replace bet_p_week = . if bet_p_week == 1							// only three cases... its because of some being filled in from averages
		
	* Fill in P for PC rounds
		bys id intgroup: egen bet_p_week2 = mean(bet_p_week)
		replace bet_p_week = bet_p_week2
		drop bet_p_week2
		label var bet_p_week "P of win imputed from reported payouts and mean stake for each week"

	* gen overall P from this same version
		bys id: egen bet_p_all = mean(bet_p_week)
		label var bet_p_all "P of win from reported mean stake and payouts all rounds"
		bys id intgroup: egen bet_p_biweekly = mean(bet_p_week)				// fill in biweekly bet targets with other week where possible first
		replace bet_p_week = bet_p_biweekly if bet_p_week==. & bet_p_week !=.	
		replace bet_p_week = bet_p_all if bet_p_week==. & bet_p_all!=.

	* gen target amount in PC weeks or missing weeks
		replace bet_lastweek_medtarget = . if bet_lastweek_medtarget==0
		bys id intgroup: egen bet_meantarg_2week = mean(bet_lastweek_medtarget)
		replace bet_lastweek_medtarget = bet_meantarg_2week if bet_lastweek_medtarget==. & bet_meantarg_2week!=.		// fill in with two week group
		replace bet_lastweek_medtarget = bet_meanpayout_allrounds if bet_lastweek_medtarget==.
		replace bet_meantarg_2week = bet_meanpayout_allrounds if bet_meantarg_2week==. & bet_meanpayout_allrounds!=.
		replace bet_lastweek_medtarget = . if (bet_lastweek_medtarget < bet2w_meanstake) & (bet_lastweek_medtarget!=.) & (bet2w_meanstake!=.)
		bys id: egen bet_payout_temp = mean(bet_lastweek_medtarget)
		replace bet_meanpayout_allrounds = bet_payout_temp

	* impute number of winning tickets in PC weeks from mean target and amount reported to have won
		replace bet_lastweek_anywin2 = bet3 / bet_meanpayout_allrounds if srvrd==2 | srvrd==4 | srvrd==6 | srvrd==8
		replace bet_lastweek_anywin2 = bet_lastweek_numticks if bet_lastweek_anywin2 > bet_lastweek_numticks & bet_lastweek_numticks!=. 

	* aggregate values
		bys id: egen tottix_all = total(bet_lastweek_numticks)
		bys id: egen totwins_all = total(bet_lastweek_anywin2)
		bys id: egen totwinamt = total(bet_lastweek_win_tot)
		bys id: egen totwintix = total(bet_lastweek_anywin2)
		bys id: egen bet_totalexp = total(bet2w_mean)

		replace totwintix = -1 if totwintix==.						// dancing around people with zero wins in the denominator
		gen bet_meanstake_all = bet_totalexp / totwintix
		replace bet_meanstake_all = . if totwintix== - 1 
		replace totwintix = . if totwintix==.
		replace bet_lastweek_medtarget = bet_meanpayout_allrounds if bet_lastweek_medtarget==. 	// makes 6 changes...

	* Alternative P from reported winnings.
		gen bet_p2_all = bet_meanstake_all / (totwins_all / totwintix) 

	* CALCULATE OTHER MOMENTS OF THE CHOSEN BETS
method: field experiment and panel treatment-effect regressions with fixed effects and heterogeneity

content:
replace totwintix = -1 if totwintix==.						// dancing around people with zero wins in the denominator
		gen bet_meanstake_all = bet_totalexp / totwintix
		replace bet_meanstake_all = . if totwintix== - 1 
		replace totwintix = . if totwintix==.
		replace bet_lastweek_medtarget = bet_meanpayout_allrounds if bet_lastweek_medtarget==. 	// makes 6 changes...

	* Alternative P from reported winnings.
		gen bet_p2_all = bet_meanstake_all / (totwins_all / totwintix) 

	* CALCULATE OTHER MOMENTS OF THE CHOSEN BETS

		* mean = np * payout
		gen bet_moment_mean = bet_lastweek_medtarget * bet_lastweek_numticks * bet_p_week * .85					// deduct 15% for taxes
		label var bet_moment_mean "mean = np * target payout * .85"
		
		* variance = np(1-p) * targeted payout
		gen bet_moment_variance = bet_lastweek_medtarget * bet_lastweek_numticks * bet_p_week * (1 - bet_p_week)
		label var bet_moment_variance " variance = np(1-p) * targeted payout"

		* skewness = (1-2p)/sqrt(np(1-p)) * target
		gen skewness_numerator = (1 - (2 * bet_p_week)) * bet_lastweek_medtarget
		gen skewness_denominator = (bet_lastweek_numticks * bet_p_week * (1 - bet_p_week)) ^ (.5)
		gen bet_moment_skewness = skewness_numerator / skewness_denominator
		replace bet_moment_skewness = 0 if bet_moment_variance==0
		label var bet_moment_skewness "skewness = (1-2p)/sqrt(np(1-p)) * target"

		* kurtosis = (1-6p(1-p)) / (np(1-p))
		gen bet_moment_kurtosis = bet_lastweek_medtarget * ((1 - (6 * bet_p_week * (1 - bet_p_week))) / (bet_lastweek_numticks * bet_p_week * (1 - bet_p_week)))
		replace bet_moment_kurtosis = 0 if bet_moment_variance==0
		label var bet_moment_kurtosis "kurtosis = (1-6p(1-p)) / (np(1-p)) * target" 

		rename bet_moment_* bmom_*
		
		foreach mom in mean variance skewness kurtosis{					// higher order terms
			generate bmom_`mom'2 = bmom_`mom' ^ 2
			generate bmom_`mom'3 = bmom_`mom' ^ 3
		}		
			
	* Create non-parametric betting profile groups
		gen nticks = bet_lastweek_numticks
		
		gen tickgrp = 0 if nticks==0
		sum nticks if nticks>0, detail
		replace tickgrp = 1 if nticks >0 & nticks <r(p25)
		replace tickgrp = 2 if nticks >= r(p25) & nticks <r(p50)
		replace tickgrp = 3 if nticks >= r(p50) & nticks <r(p75)
		replace tickgrp = 4 if nticks >= r(p75) & nticks <r(max)
		replace tickgrp = . if nticks == .	
		
		replace bet_lastweek_medtarget=0 if nticks==0 | nticks==.
		gen base = bet / nticks
		gen prob = base / bet_lastweek_medtarget
		replace prob = 0 if nticks==0
		gen probgrp = 0 if prob == 0
		sum prob if prob>0, detail
		replace probgrp = 1 if prob > 0 & prob<r(p25)
		replace probgrp = 2 if prob >= r(p25) & prob < r(p50)
		replace probgrp = 3 if prob >= r(p50) & prob < r(p75)	
		replace probgrp = 4 if prob >= r(p75) & prob < r(max)
		
		gen targetgrp = 0 if nticks==0
		sum bet_lastweek_medtarget if bet_lastweek_medtarget>0, detail
		replace targetgrp = 1 if bet_lastweek_medtarget > 0 & bet_lastweek_medtarget <= r(p25)
		replace targetgrp = 2 if bet_lastweek_medtarget >= r(p25) & bet_lastweek_medtarget <= r(p50)
		replace targetgrp = 3 if bet_lastweek_medtarget >= r(p50) & bet_lastweek_medtarget <= r(p75)
		replace targetgrp = 4 if bet_lastweek_medtarget >= r(p75) & bet_lastweek_medtarget <= r(max)	
		
		egen betprofile = group(tickgrp probgrp targetgrp)						// non-parametric way of controlling for betting profile
		
		gen ntx = 0 if nticks==0
		replace ntx = 1 if nticks>0 & nticks<=1.5
		replace ntx = 2 if nticks>1.5 & nticks <= 2.5
		replace ntx = 3 if nticks>2.5 & nticks <= 3.5
		replace ntx = 4 if nticks>3.5 & nticks <= 4.5
		replace ntx = 5 if nticks>4.5 & nticks <= 5.5
		replace ntx = 6 if nticks>5.5 & nticks <= 6.5
		replace ntx = 7 if nticks>6.5 & nticks<= 7.5	
		replace ntx = 8 if nticks>7.5 & nticks<= 8.5
		replace ntx = 10 if nticks>8.5 & nticks <= 12.5	
		replace ntx = 15 if nticks>12.5 & nticks <= 17.5

replace W_BdM=W_BdM/4

keep country_i t W_BdM  
save "${tempdata}\BdM_data", replace

****** prepare WB regions **************************************

	import delimited "${inputdata}\WDI_Country.csv", varnames(1) clear
			rename countrycode country_i
			replace country_i="ROU" if country_i=="ROM"
			replace country_i="COD" if country_i=="ZAR"
			replace country_i="AND" if country_i=="ADO"
			replace country_i= "TLS" if country_i=="TMP"

			keep country_i region
			ren region WB_region
			replace WB_region= "Europe & Central Asia" if country_i=="MLT"
			save "${tempdata}\countries_WB_regions", replace

********************************************************************************
**Generate Acemoglu et al. democracy variable 
********************************************************************************

use "${tempdata}\duration.dta", clear
	merge 1:1 t country_i using "${tempdata}\polity_iv.dta", nogen keep(match master)
	merge 1:1 t country_i using "${inputdata}\ethnic.dta", nogen keep(match master)
	merge 1:1 t country_i using "${tempdata}\BdM_data", nogen keep(match master)
	merge 1:1 t country_i using "${tempdata}\democracy.dta", nogen keep(match master)
	merge 1:1 t country_i using "${tempdata}\vdem.dta", nogen keep(match master)
	merge 1:1 t country_i using "${tempdata}\freedomhouse_pl.dta", nogen keep(match master)
	merge 1:1 t country_i using "${tempdata}\freedomhouse_cl.dta", nogen keep(match master)

	gen freedomhouse_democ=(pr+cl)/2
	gen acemoglu_democ=0 if !mi(d)
	replace acemoglu_democ=1 if polity2>0.5 & freedomhouse_democ<=5 & !mi(d)
		replace acemoglu_democ=1 if polity2>0.5 & Democ_dummy==1 & !mi(d)
		replace acemoglu_democ=1 if Democ_dummy==1 & freedomhouse_democ<=5 & !mi(d)
		replace acemoglu_democ=. if mi(polity2) & mi(freedomhouse_democ)  & mi(Democ_dummy)
		
		*Manual recoding according to Acemcoglu footnote 27 page A2
		*Not recoded here , because they already are : Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados,  
		replace acemoglu_democ=1 if country_i=="DEU" & t==1949
		replace acemoglu_democ=1 if country_i=="ISL" & t<1950
		replace acemoglu_democ=1 if country_i=="LUX" & t<1950
		replace acemoglu_democ=0 if country_i=="MDV" & Democ_dummy==0 & !mi(d)
		replace acemoglu_democ=0 if country_i=="TON" & !mi(d)
		replace acemoglu_democ=0 if country_i=="WSM" & Democ_dummy==0 & !mi(d)
		replace acemoglu_democ=0 if country_i=="MYS" & !mi(d)
		replace acemoglu_democ=0 if country_i=="GUY" & t<1991 & !mi(d)
		replace acemoglu_democ=1 if country_i=="GMB" & t<1973 & !mi(d)
		drop if country_i == "AND" | country_i == "GDR" | country_i == "RVN" | country_i == "TLS" | country_i == "TWN" | country_i == "YAR" | country_i == "YPR" | country_i == "ZAN"

		keep country_i t acemoglu_democ
		save "${tempdata}\acemoglu_democ", replace
		save "${outputdata}\acemoglu_democ", replace

********************************************************************************
*** Create dyadic panel for IV *****************************************
********************************************************************************

merge m:1 country_i using "${tempdata}\countries_WB_regions", nogen keep(match master)
merge 1:1 t country_i using "${inputdata}\ethnic.dta", nogen keep(match master)
merge 1:1 t country_i using "${tempdata}\BdM_data", nogen keep(match master)
merge 1:1 t country_i using "${tempdata}\democracy.dta", nogen keep(match master)
merge 1:1 t country_i using "${tempdata}\vdem.dta", nogen keep(match master)

	ren polity2 polity2_k
	ren Democ_dummy Democ_dummy_k

ren Democ_dummy Democ_dummy_k
	ren W_BdM W_BdM_k
	ren W_epr W_epr_k

save "${tempdata}\democracy_country_k", replace

			*** Generat the dataset for all countries in the sample
	import delimited "${inputdata}\WDI_Country.csv", varnames(1) clear
			rename countrycode country_i
			replace country_i="ROU" if country_i=="ROM"
			replace country_i="COD" if country_i=="ZAR"

			keep country_i

			replace id=_n

			quietly sum id
			expand r(max)
			drop id
			bysort country_k: gen id=_n
			save "${tempdata}\countries_k.dta", replace

			drop id
			expand 71
			bysort country_i country_k: gen t=1944+_n

use "${tempdata}\dyadic panel.dta", clear
	merge m:1 country_i using "${tempdata}\countries_WB_regions", nogen keep(match master)

	merge m:1 t country_i using "${tempdata}\vdem.dta", nogen keep(match master)

	merge m:1 country_k t using "${tempdata}\democracy_country_k", nogen keep(match master)
	merge m:1 t country_i using "${tempdata}\duration.dta", nogen keep(match master)
save "${tempdata}\democracy_iv_panel", replace

*** Generate Democracy Instrument
use "${tempdata}\democracy_iv_panel", clear

	* Define peer-group
	drop if country_i==country_k
	keep if WB_region==WB_region_k
	drop if t<1950
	drop if mi(acemoglu_democ)
	sort country_i country_k t
	by country_i country_k: gen keeper=1 if acemoglu_democ==acemoglu_democ_k & _n==1
	keep if keeper==1
	keep country_i country_k keeper
	
	*Merge with democracy panel data
	merge 1:m country_i country_k using "${tempdata}\democracy_iv_panel", keep(match) nogen
	
	**Now panel has only pairs of countries that are peer-group
	**Next calculate instrument
		gen dummy=1
		bysort country_i t: egen count_I_c=total(dummy) if !mi(d) /* generate number of peers in peer group */
		bysort country_i t: egen count_D_c=total(acemoglu_democ_k) if !mi(d) /* number of democracies in peer group */
		gen Z_democracy=count_D_c/count_I_c if !mi(d) /* proportion of democracies in peer group */
		drop count_D_c		
		collapse (first) Z_democracy, by(country_i t)
save "${tempdata}\Z_democracy", replace

** Generating the spatial lags
gen prox= 1/dist   /* generate proximity following PlümperNeumayer 2016 */
** Generate log proximity

** Generate proximity of capitals

gen lgproxcap=log(distcap)   /*generate proximity following Plümper Neumayer 2016 */

capture erase "${basepath}\SL_prox_gdp_final.dta"

*** GDP by democracy peer group

keep rgdpna_percap country_k t

merge 1:m country_k t using "${tempdata}\democracy_iv_panel", nogen keep(2 3)

	* Define peer-group
	drop if country_i==country_k
	keep if WB_region==WB_region_k
	drop if t<1950

	by country_i country_k: gen keeper=1 if acemoglu_democ==acemoglu_democ_k & _n==1
	keep if keeper==1
	keep country_i country_k keeper 

	*Merge with democracy panel data
	merge 1:m country_i country_k using "${tempdata}\democracy_iv_panel", keep(match) nogen
	merge m:1 t country_k using "${tempdata}\pwt_k", keep(1 3) nogen
		bysort country_i t: egen Z_gdp_percap=mean(rgdpna_percap)
		gen Z_lg_gdp_percap=log(Z_gdp_percap)

local vars "r_female r_black r_hispanic r_freelunch r_lep r_sped r_math_std_pre_k r_reading_std_pre_k r_value_added r_vam_missing"
//locals to make the suests and joint ftests easier
local p1_ests ""
local p2_ests ""
local p1_vars ""
local p2_vars ""

foreach r_var in `vars' { 
	
	local var = substr("`r_var'", 3, .) 
	local label : variable label r_`var' 
	file write fh "\hspace{10pt} `label' " 

	*YEAR1 means;
	
	*Write means of control;
	sum `r_var' if control==1 & M_`var' == 0 & year==1
	local mean = round(r(mean), .001) 
	file write fh "& " %4.3f (`mean') 
	
	*Write means of loss ;
	sum `r_var' if loss == 1 & M_`var' == 0 & year==1
	local mean = round(r(mean), .001)

clear
use "$data/analysis.dta", clear


drop if math_std<-12


* Create variables for estimation
*#delimit
gen year2=(year==2)
gen all = 1

 gen school_1 = school_id ==1

//interact variables for test
 foreach var in loss gain year2 {
	foreach school in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 {
	label var school_`school'  "School `school'"
    gen `var'_`school' = `var' *  school_`school' 
 }

}


	
local var_loop "all school_1 school_2 school_3 school_4 school_5 school_6 school_7 school_8 school_9 " 
foreach var in `var_loop'{ 

 local va = "`var'"
 *substr("`var'", 1, 2) 
 
  foreach yr in 0 1 all{ 
  
  	if "`yr'" == "0"{
		local condition "year == 1"
		local yr_fix ""
		local controls "$oldX_vam"
	}
	else if "`yr'" == "1"{
		local condition "year == 2"
		local yr_fix ""
		local controls "$oldX_vam t_gain_y1 t_loss_y1 t_nis_y1 lottery"
	}
	if "`yr'" == "all"{
		local condition "1"
		local yr_fix "i.year"
		local controls "$oldX_vam_pool t_gain_y1 t_loss_y1 t_nis_y1 lottery"
	}
			
	cgmreg math_std loss gain `controls' `yr_fix' if `var' == 1 & `condition', cluster(teacher_id newstudid) 
			local b_l_`va'_`yr' = string(_b[loss], "%4.3f") 
			local se_l_`va'_`yr' = "(" + string(_se[loss], "%4.3f") + ")" 
			local p =  2*ttail(e(df_m),abs(_b[loss]/_se[loss]))
			local b_g_`va'_`yr' = string(_b[gain], "%4.3f") 
			local se_g_`va'_`yr' = "(" + string(_se[gain], "%4.3f") + ")" 
			local p =  2*ttail(e(df_m),abs(_b[gain]/_se[gain]))
	
			local obs_`va'_`yr' = string(e(N), "%4.0f")
			local cl_`va'_`yr' = string(e(N_clust), "%4.0f")	
			
		if "`var'" != "all" {
		cgmreg math_std loss gain `controls' `yr_fix' if `var' != 1 & `condition', cluster(teacher_id newstudid) 
			local b_l_no`va'_`yr' = string(_b[loss], "%4.3f") 
			local se_l_no`va'_`yr' = "(" + string(_se[loss], "%4.3f") + ")" 
			local p =  2*ttail(e(df_m),abs(_b[loss]/_se[loss]))
			local b_g_no`va'_`yr' = string(_b[gain], "%4.3f") 
			local se_g_no`va'_`yr' = "(" + string(_se[gain], "%4.3f") + ")" 
			local p =  2*ttail(e(df_m),abs(_b[gain]/_se[gain]))
	
			local obs_no`va'_`yr' = string(e(N), "%4.0f")
			local cl_no`va'_`yr' = string(e(N_clust), "%4.0f")	
		
		* get pvalues comparing regs
		reg math_std loss gain `controls' `yr_fix' if all == 1  & `condition'

use data_gpr_daily_recent, clear

tsset date
sum GPR if tin(1jan1985,31dec2019)
replace GPR = GPR/r(mean)*100

gen day = day(date)
gen month = month(date)
gen year = year(date)
egen GPR_M = mean(GPR), by(month year)

quietly tssmooth ma GPR_MA30 = GPR, window(29 1 0)

global d1="1jan1985"
global d2="31dec2020"

gen month1=month(date)
gen day1=day(date)

, ///
graphregion(fcolor(white)) name(A1, replace) nodraw

content:
sort area_fips industry_code own_code qtr Month

**CREATE STATE INDUSTRY WEIGHTS
sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code
gen totalstate_emp = month_emplvl_ if industry_code==10 & agglvl_code==50
by area_fips Month, sort: egen totalstate_employ = max(totalstate_emp)

sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code

gen state_industry_emp_private = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==0 & own_code==5

gen state_emp_public = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==0 & own_code==8

gen state_industry_emp_ = state_industry_emp_private 
replace state_industry_emp_ = state_emp_public if state_industry_emp_==.

gen state_industry_emp = state_industry_emp_ 
drop state_industry_emp_

gen weight_state_industry = state_industry_emp/totalstate_employ

**CREATE NATL INDUSTRY WEIGHTS
gen natl_emp = month_emplvl_ if industry_code==10 & agglvl_code==10
by Month, sort: egen totalnatl_employ = max(natl_emp)

gen natl_industry_emp = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==0

sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code

gen natl_industry_emp_private = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==5

gen natl_emp_public = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==8

gen natl_industry_emp_ = natl_industry_emp_private 
replace natl_industry_emp_ = natl_emp_public if natl_industry_emp_==.

replace natl_industry_emp = natl_industry_emp_ if natl_industry_emp==.
drop natl_industry_emp_

gen weight_natl_industry = natl_industry_emp/totalnatl_employ

*ASSIGN WEIGHTS TO APPROPRIATE STATE-LEVEL OBS
sort industry_code own_code Month

by industry_code own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_industry_ = max(weight_natl_industry)

*COMBINE CATEGORIES TO MATCH BLS AGGREGATE INDUSTRY DATA

*Add RETAIL and WHOLESALE TRADE
gen trade_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "trade") & own_code==5

sort area_fips trade_flag own_code Month 

by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_trade = sum(weight_state_industry) if trade_flag==1
by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_trade = sum(weight_natl_industry_) if trade_flag==1

replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_industry_ if weight_natl_industry==.
replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_trade if trade_flag==1
replace weight_state_industry = weight_state_trade if trade_flag==1

*Create Transportation and Utilities category

gen transport_utilities_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "utilities") & own_code==5
*Consolidate trade under one industry code
replace industry_code=42 if industry_code==44

duplicates drop area_fips own_code industry_code Month if own_code==5, force

gen transp_or_trade = 1 if (transport_utilities_flag==1|trade_flag==1) & own_code==5

replace trade_flag=0 if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==.

gsort area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month trade_flag

gen weight_state_ttu = -weight_state_trade
gen weight_natl_ttu = -weight_natl_trade

replace weight_state_ttu = weight_state_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0
replace weight_natl_ttu = weight_natl_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0
method: state-industry panel and correspondence-study regressions with fixed effects and clustered inference
title: Age Discrimination across the Business Cycle

content:
replace trade_flag=0 if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==.

gsort area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month trade_flag

gen weight_state_ttu = -weight_state_trade
gen weight_natl_ttu = -weight_natl_trade

replace weight_state_ttu = weight_state_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0
replace weight_natl_ttu = weight_natl_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0


by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_transp_util = sum(weight_state_ttu)
by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_transp_util = sum(weight_natl_ttu)

replace weight_state_industry=weight_state_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5
replace weight_natl_industry=weight_natl_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5

drop if strpos(industry_title, "Goods")

replace industry_title = "Wholesale and retail trade" if strpos(industry_title, "trade")

*keep only private and public sector weights
keep if own_code==5|own_code==8
browse area_fips own_code industry_title area_title Month weight_natl_industry weight_state_industry 
sort area_fips own_code Month industry_code
keep year area_fips own_code industry_title industry_code area_title Month weight_natl_industry weight_state_industry month_emplvl_

sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code
gen totalstate_emp = month_emplvl_ if industry_code==10 & agglvl_code==50
by area_fips Month, sort: egen totalstate_employ = max(totalstate_emp)

**CREATE NATL INDUSTRY WEIGHTS

by Month, sort: egen totalnatl_employ = max(natl_emp)

replace natl_industry_emp = natl_industry_emp_ if natl_industry_emp==.
drop natl_industry_emp_

gen weight_natl_industry = natl_industry_emp/totalnatl_employ

*ASSIGN WEIGHTS TO APPROPRIATE STATE-LEVEL OBS
sort industry_code own_code Month

by industry_code own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_industry_ = max(weight_natl_industry)

duplicates drop area_fips own_code industry_code Month if own_code==5, force

by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_transp_util = sum(weight_natl_ttu)

replace weight_state_industry=weight_state_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5

drop if strpos(industry_title, "Goods")

*keep only private and public sector weights
keep if own_code==5|own_code==8
browse area_fips own_code industry_title area_title Month weight_natl_industry weight_state_industry

sort industry_code own_code Month

*COMBINE CATEGORIES TO MATCH BLS AGGREGATE INDUSTRY DATA

*Add RETAIL and WHOLESALE TRADE

sort area_fips trade_flag own_code Month 

by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_trade = sum(weight_state_industry) if trade_flag==1

replace weight_state_industry = weight_state_trade if trade_flag==1

*Create Transportation and Utilities category

gen transport_utilities_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "utilities") & own_code==5
*Consolidate trade under one industry code
replace industry_code=42 if industry_code==44

duplicates drop area_fips own_code industry_code Month if own_code==5, force

replace trade_flag=0 if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==.

gen weight_natl_ttu = -weight_natl_trade

replace weight_natl_ttu = weight_natl_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0

by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_transp_util = sum(weight_natl_ttu)

replace weight_state_industry=weight_state_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5
replace weight_natl_industry=weight_natl_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5

drop if strpos(industry_title, "Goods")

replace industry_title = "Wholesale and retail trade" if strpos(industry_title, "trade")

*keep only private and public sector weights
keep if own_code==5|own_code==8
browse area_fips own_code industry_title area_title Month weight_natl_industry weight_state_industry

keep year area_fips own_code industry_title industry_code area_title Month weight_natl_industry weight_state_industry month_emplvl_

sort area_fips industry_code own_code qtr Month

**CREATE STATE INDUSTRY WEIGHTS
sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code
gen totalstate_emp = month_emplvl_ if industry_code==10 & agglvl_code==50
by area_fips Month, sort: egen totalstate_employ = max(totalstate_emp)

sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code

gen state_industry_emp_private = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==0 & own_code==5

gen state_emp_public = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==0 & own_code==8

gen state_industry_emp_ = state_industry_emp_private 
replace state_industry_emp_ = state_emp_public if state_industry_emp_==.

gen state_industry_emp = state_industry_emp_ 
drop state_industry_emp_

gen weight_state_industry = state_industry_emp/totalstate_employ

**CREATE NATL INDUSTRY WEIGHTS
gen natl_emp = month_emplvl_ if industry_code==10 & agglvl_code==10
by Month, sort: egen totalnatl_employ = max(natl_emp)

gen natl_industry_emp = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==0

sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code

gen natl_industry_emp_private = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==5

gen natl_emp_public = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==8

gen natl_industry_emp_ = natl_industry_emp_private 
replace natl_industry_emp_ = natl_emp_public if natl_industry_emp_==.

replace natl_industry_emp = natl_industry_emp_ if natl_industry_emp==.
drop natl_industry_emp_

gen weight_natl_industry = natl_industry_emp/totalnatl_employ

*ASSIGN WEIGHTS TO APPROPRIATE STATE-LEVEL OBS
sort industry_code own_code Month

by industry_code own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_industry_ = max(weight_natl_industry)

*COMBINE CATEGORIES TO MATCH BLS AGGREGATE INDUSTRY DATA

*Add RETAIL and WHOLESALE TRADE
gen trade_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "trade") & own_code==5

sort area_fips trade_flag own_code Month 

by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_trade = sum(weight_state_industry) if trade_flag==1
method: state-industry panel and correspondence-study regressions with fixed effects and clustered inference
title: Age Discrimination across the Business Cycle

content:
by industry_code own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_industry_ = max(weight_natl_industry)

*COMBINE CATEGORIES TO MATCH BLS AGGREGATE INDUSTRY DATA

*Add RETAIL and WHOLESALE TRADE
gen trade_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "trade") & own_code==5

sort area_fips trade_flag own_code Month 

by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_trade = sum(weight_state_industry) if trade_flag==1
by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_trade = sum(weight_natl_industry_) if trade_flag==1

replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_industry_ if weight_natl_industry==.
replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_trade if trade_flag==1
replace weight_state_industry = weight_state_trade if trade_flag==1

*Create Transportation and Utilities category

gen transport_utilities_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "utilities") & own_code==5
*Consolidate trade under one industry code
replace industry_code=42 if industry_code==44

duplicates drop area_fips own_code industry_code Month if own_code==5, force

gen transp_or_trade = 1 if (transport_utilities_flag==1|trade_flag==1) & own_code==5

replace trade_flag=0 if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==.

gsort area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month trade_flag

gen weight_state_ttu = -weight_state_trade
gen weight_natl_ttu = -weight_natl_trade

replace weight_state_ttu = weight_state_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0
replace weight_natl_ttu = weight_natl_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0


by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_transp_util = sum(weight_state_ttu)
by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_transp_util = sum(weight_natl_ttu)

replace weight_state_industry=weight_state_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5
replace weight_natl_industry=weight_natl_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5

drop if strpos(industry_title, "Goods")

replace industry_title = "Wholesale and retail trade" if strpos(industry_title, "trade")

*keep only private and public sector weights
keep if own_code==5|own_code==8
browse area_fips own_code industry_title area_title Month weight_natl_industry weight_state_industry 
sort area_fips own_code Month industry_code
keep year area_fips own_code industry_title industry_code area_title Month weight_natl_industry weight_state_industry month_emplvl_

drop natl_industry_emp_

gen weight_natl_industry = natl_industry_emp/totalnatl_employ

*ASSIGN WEIGHTS TO APPROPRIATE STATE-LEVEL OBS
sort industry_code own_code Month

by industry_code own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_industry_ = max(weight_natl_industry)

*COMBINE CATEGORIES TO MATCH BLS AGGREGATE INDUSTRY DATA

*Add RETAIL and WHOLESALE TRADE

replace weight_state_industry = weight_state_trade if trade_flag==1

*Create Transportation and Utilities category

gen transport_utilities_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "utilities") & own_code==5
*Consolidate trade under one industry code
replace industry_code=42 if industry_code==44

duplicates drop area_fips own_code industry_code Month if own_code==5, force

replace trade_flag=0 if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==.

gsort area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month trade_flag

gen weight_state_ttu = -weight_state_trade
gen weight_natl_ttu = -weight_natl_trade

replace weight_state_ttu = weight_state_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0
replace weight_natl_ttu = weight_natl_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0


by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_transp_util = sum(weight_state_ttu)
by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_transp_util = sum(weight_natl_ttu)

replace weight_state_industry=weight_state_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5
replace weight_natl_industry=weight_natl_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5

drop if strpos(industry_title, "Goods")

replace industry_title = "Wholesale and retail trade" if strpos(industry_title, "trade")

*keep only private and public sector weights
keep if own_code==5|own_code==8
browse area_fips own_code industry_title area_title Month weight_natl_industry weight_state_industry 
sort area_fips own_code Month industry_code
keep year area_fips own_code industry_title industry_code area_title Month weight_natl_industry weight_state_industry month_emplvl_

sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code

gen state_industry_emp_private = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==0 & own_code==5

gen state_emp_public = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==0 & own_code==8

replace state_industry_emp_ = state_emp_public if state_industry_emp_==.

gen state_industry_emp = state_industry_emp_ 
drop state_industry_emp_

gen weight_state_industry = state_industry_emp/totalstate_employ

**CREATE NATL INDUSTRY WEIGHTS
gen natl_emp = month_emplvl_ if industry_code==10 & agglvl_code==10
by Month, sort: egen totalnatl_employ = max(natl_emp)

gen natl_industry_emp = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==0

sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code

gen natl_industry_emp_private = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==5

gen natl_emp_public = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==8

gen natl_industry_emp_ = natl_industry_emp_private 
replace natl_industry_emp_ = natl_emp_public if natl_industry_emp_==.

replace natl_industry_emp = natl_industry_emp_ if natl_industry_emp==.
drop natl_industry_emp_

gen weight_natl_industry = natl_industry_emp/totalnatl_employ

*ASSIGN WEIGHTS TO APPROPRIATE STATE-LEVEL OBS
sort industry_code own_code Month

by industry_code own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_industry_ = max(weight_natl_industry)

*COMBINE CATEGORIES TO MATCH BLS AGGREGATE INDUSTRY DATA

*Add RETAIL and WHOLESALE TRADE

sort area_fips trade_flag own_code Month 

by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_trade = sum(weight_state_industry) if trade_flag==1
by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_trade = sum(weight_natl_industry_) if trade_flag==1

replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_industry_ if weight_natl_industry==.
replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_trade if trade_flag==1
replace weight_state_industry = weight_state_trade if trade_flag==1

*Create Transportation and Utilities category

gen transport_utilities_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "utilities") & own_code==5
*Consolidate trade under one industry code
replace industry_code=42 if industry_code==44

duplicates drop area_fips own_code industry_code Month if own_code==5, force

replace trade_flag=0 if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==.

gsort area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month trade_flag

gen weight_state_ttu = -weight_state_trade
gen weight_natl_ttu = -weight_natl_trade

replace weight_state_ttu = weight_state_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0
replace weight_natl_ttu = weight_natl_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0


by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_transp_util = sum(weight_state_ttu)
by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_transp_util = sum(weight_natl_ttu)

replace weight_state_industry=weight_state_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5
replace weight_natl_industry=weight_natl_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5

sort area_fips industry_code own_code qtr Month

**CREATE STATE INDUSTRY WEIGHTS
sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code
gen totalstate_emp = month_emplvl_ if industry_code==10 & agglvl_code==50
by area_fips Month, sort: egen totalstate_employ = max(totalstate_emp)

sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code

gen state_industry_emp_private = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==0 & own_code==5

gen state_emp_public = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==0 & own_code==8

gen state_industry_emp_ = state_industry_emp_private 
replace state_industry_emp_ = state_emp_public if state_industry_emp_==.

gen state_industry_emp = state_industry_emp_ 
drop state_industry_emp_

gen weight_state_industry = state_industry_emp/totalstate_employ

**CREATE NATL INDUSTRY WEIGHTS
gen natl_emp = month_emplvl_ if industry_code==10 & agglvl_code==10
by Month, sort: egen totalnatl_employ = max(natl_emp)

gen natl_industry_emp = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==0

sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code

gen natl_industry_emp_private = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==5

gen natl_emp_public = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==8

gen natl_industry_emp_ = natl_industry_emp_private 
replace natl_industry_emp_ = natl_emp_public if natl_industry_emp_==.

replace natl_industry_emp = natl_industry_emp_ if natl_industry_emp==.
drop natl_industry_emp_

gen weight_natl_industry = natl_industry_emp/totalnatl_employ

*ASSIGN WEIGHTS TO APPROPRIATE STATE-LEVEL OBS
sort industry_code own_code Month

by industry_code own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_industry_ = max(weight_natl_industry)

*COMBINE CATEGORIES TO MATCH BLS AGGREGATE INDUSTRY DATA

*Add RETAIL and WHOLESALE TRADE
gen trade_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "trade") & own_code==5

sort area_fips trade_flag own_code Month 

by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_trade = sum(weight_state_industry) if trade_flag==1
by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_trade = sum(weight_natl_industry_) if trade_flag==1

replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_industry_ if weight_natl_industry==.
replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_trade if trade_flag==1
replace weight_state_industry = weight_state_trade if trade_flag==1

*Create Transportation and Utilities category

gen transport_utilities_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "utilities") & own_code==5
*Consolidate trade under one industry code
replace industry_code=42 if industry_code==44

duplicates drop area_fips own_code industry_code Month if own_code==5, force

gen transp_or_trade = 1 if (transport_utilities_flag==1|trade_flag==1) & own_code==5

replace trade_flag=0 if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==.

gsort area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month trade_flag

gen weight_state_ttu = -weight_state_trade
gen weight_natl_ttu = -weight_natl_trade

replace weight_state_ttu = weight_state_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0
replace weight_natl_ttu = weight_natl_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0

title: Age Discrimination across the Business Cycle

by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_transp_util = sum(weight_natl_ttu)

**COMBINE ALL 2001 DATASETS
clear

append using "$OUTPUTDATADIR\Wholesale trade_2001.dta"
