append using "$OUTPUTDATADIR\Other services_2001.dta"
append using "$OUTPUTDATADIR\Public administration_2001.dta"

sort area_fips industry_code own_code qtr Month

**CREATE STATE INDUSTRY WEIGHTS
sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code
gen totalstate_emp = month_emplvl_ if industry_code==10 & agglvl_code==50
by area_fips Month, sort: egen totalstate_employ = max(totalstate_emp)

sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code

gen state_industry_emp_private = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==0 & own_code==5

gen state_emp_public = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==0 & own_code==8

gen state_industry_emp_ = state_industry_emp_private 
replace state_industry_emp_ = state_emp_public if state_industry_emp_==.

gen state_industry_emp = state_industry_emp_ 
drop state_industry_emp_

gen weight_state_industry = state_industry_emp/totalstate_employ

**CREATE NATL INDUSTRY WEIGHTS
gen natl_emp = month_emplvl_ if industry_code==10 & agglvl_code==10
by Month, sort: egen totalnatl_employ = max(natl_emp)

gen natl_industry_emp = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==0

sort area_fips Month industry_code own_code

gen natl_industry_emp_private = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==5

gen natl_emp_public = month_emplvl_ if strpos(area_fips, "US")==1 & own_code==8

gen natl_industry_emp_ = natl_industry_emp_private 
replace natl_industry_emp_ = natl_emp_public if natl_industry_emp_==.

replace natl_industry_emp = natl_industry_emp_ if natl_industry_emp==.
drop natl_industry_emp_

gen weight_natl_industry = natl_industry_emp/totalnatl_employ

*ASSIGN WEIGHTS TO APPROPRIATE STATE-LEVEL OBS
sort industry_code own_code Month

by industry_code own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_industry_ = max(weight_natl_industry)

*COMBINE CATEGORIES TO MATCH BLS AGGREGATE INDUSTRY DATA

*Add RETAIL and WHOLESALE TRADE
gen trade_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "trade") & own_code==5

sort area_fips trade_flag own_code Month 

by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_trade = sum(weight_state_industry) if trade_flag==1
by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_trade = sum(weight_natl_industry_) if trade_flag==1

replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_industry_ if weight_natl_industry==.
replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_trade if trade_flag==1
replace weight_state_industry = weight_state_trade if trade_flag==1

*Create Transportation and Utilities category

content:
sort area_fips trade_flag own_code Month 

by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_trade = sum(weight_state_industry) if trade_flag==1
by area_fips trade_flag own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_trade = sum(weight_natl_industry_) if trade_flag==1

replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_industry_ if weight_natl_industry==.
replace weight_natl_industry = weight_natl_trade if trade_flag==1
replace weight_state_industry = weight_state_trade if trade_flag==1

*Create Transportation and Utilities category

gen transport_utilities_flag=1 if strpos(industry_title, "utilities") & own_code==5
*Consolidate trade under one industry code
replace industry_code=42 if industry_code==44

duplicates drop area_fips own_code industry_code Month if own_code==5, force

gen transp_or_trade = 1 if (transport_utilities_flag==1|trade_flag==1) & own_code==5

replace trade_flag=0 if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==.

gsort area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month trade_flag

gen weight_state_ttu = -weight_state_trade
gen weight_natl_ttu = -weight_natl_trade

replace weight_state_ttu = weight_state_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0
replace weight_natl_ttu = weight_natl_industry if transp_or_trade==1&trade_flag==0


by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_state_transp_util = sum(weight_state_ttu)
by area_fips transp_or_trade own_code Month, sort: egen weight_natl_transp_util = sum(weight_natl_ttu)

replace weight_state_industry=weight_state_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5
replace weight_natl_industry=weight_natl_transp_util if industry_code==1021 & own_code==5

drop if strpos(industry_title, "Goods")

replace industry_title = "Wholesale and retail trade" if strpos(industry_title, "trade")

*keep only private and public sector weights
keep if own_code==5|own_code==8
browse area_fips own_code industry_title area_title Month weight_natl_industry weight_state_industry 
sort area_fips own_code Month industry_code
keep year area_fips own_code industry_title industry_code area_title Month weight_natl_industry weight_state_industry month_emplvl_

*************************************************
***** THIS .DO FILE CREATES FIGURE 6, WHICH  ****** 
***** SHOWS A DIFF-IN-DIFF FOR VOLUME, MERIT,******
***** AND UR FOR STATE-INDUSTRIES WITH ABOVE ******
***** VERSUS BELOW-MEDIAN EXPOSURE TO THE GR ******
***** NOTE THAT THIS REQUIRES THE USER TO    ******
***** GAIN ACCESS TO CONFIDENTIAL DATA FROM  ******
***** THE EEOC						 ******
***************************************************


clear
set more off
global filepath "C:\EEOC Data\Charge Data"
global tables "C:\Users\mathk\Dropbox\Summer RA\paper draft\tables_age"


***********************************************************
* EXTRACT RELEVANT INFORMATION ON CHARGE DATES AND CHARGING PARTY*
***********************************************************

use "$filepath\eeoc_all_issues_all_charges_collapsed_indiv_legalcounsel.dta"

*GENERATE DATE ON WHICH CHARGE WAS FILED
gen g = 1
if g == 1 {
	gen Year=substr(date_first_office,-4,4)
	destring Year, replace
	gen Month=substr(date_first_office,1,2)
	destring Month, replace ignore("/")
	gen date = string(Month) + "/" + string(Year)
}

gen mdate = monthly(date,"MY")
format mdate %tm

*GENERATE AGE OF CHARGING PARTY
gen birth_Year = substr(date_of_birth,-4,4)
destring birth_Year, ignore("null") force replace
gen age_cp= Year-birth_Year

*GENERATE SEX OF CHARGING PARTY
gen female=1 if sex_code=="F"
replace female=0 if sex_code=="M"

*GENERATE RACE OF CHARGING PARTY
egen race_ind = group(race_str)

*GENERATE PRIVATE/PUBLIC SECTOR DUMMY FOR RESPONDENT
gen private_firm=1 if strpos(institution_type, "Private")
replace private_firm =0 if strpos(institution_type, "Govt")|strpos(institution_type, "Government")|strpos(institution_type, "Elected")|strpos(institution_type, "Public")

*GENERATE INDUSTRY CODES FOR RESPONDENT
gen naics3 = substr(naics_code, 1,3)
destring naics3, force replace ignore("nul")
gen naics2 = int(naics3/10)
gen naics4 = substr(naics_code, 1,4)
destring naics4, force replace ignore("nul")

*AGGREGATE INDUSTRIES BASED ON CATEGORIES FOR WHICH NATIONAL UNEMPLOYMENT IS TABULATED

gen own_code=5
*AGRICULTURE, FORESTRY, FISHING, AND HUNTING
gen industry_code = 11 if naics2==11
*MINING
replace industry_code = 1011 if naics2==21
*UTILITIES
replace industry_code = 1021 if naics2==22
*CONSTRUCTION
replace industry_code = 1012 if naics2==23
*MANUFACTURING
replace industry_code = 1013 if naics2>=31&naics2<=33
*WHOLESALE AND RETAIL TRADE
replace industry_code = 42 if naics2==42|naics2==44|naics2==45
*TRANSPORTATION AND WAREHOUSING
replace industry_code = 1021 if naics2==48|naics2==49
*INFORMATION
replace industry_code = 1022 if naics2==51
*FINANCE, INSURANCE, AND REAL ESTATE (FIRE)

********************************************

**(2019) JOLE PAPER*************************
********************************************

*LOAD DATA

clear
use "$BASEDIR\data\FSvW_jole.dta"

*RELABEL DATA AS ROUND 5
drop round
gen round=5

*KEEP POSTINGS TO WHICH 4 RESUMES WERE SENT
bys jobid: egen count = count(cback)
keep if count==4

*LABEL OLDER, MIDDLE, AND YOUNGER
gen o = age>=51&age!=.
gen m = age>=33&age<=43
gen y = age<=28 

*COUNT NUMBER OF OLDER APPLICANTS
bys jobid: egen count_o = sum(o)

*ONLY RETAIN POSTINGS WHERE 2-3 APPLICANTS WERE OLDER
drop if count_o==0|count_o==4|count_o==1

*CREATE COUNTS FOR NUMBER OF MIDDLE AND YOUNGER APPLICANTS
bys jobid: egen count_m = sum(m)
bys jobid: egen count_y = sum(y)

*GENERATE AGE TRIPLET OF COMPETING APPLICANTS
gen ooo = count_o==3 & o==0
gen oom = (count_o==2 & count_m==1&y==1)|(count_o==2 & count_m==2&m==1)|(count_o==3 & count_m==1&o==1)
gen ooy = (count_o==2 & count_y==2&y==1)|(count_o==2 & count_y==1&m==1)|(count_o==3 & count_y==1&o==1)
gen omm = (count_o==2 & count_m==2&o==1)
gen oyy = (count_o==2 & count_y==2&o==1)
gen omy = (count_o==2 & count_m==1 & count_y==1&o==1)

*FILL IN CITY NAME

replace city = "Chicago" if city_num==2
replace city = "Omaha" if city_num==4
replace city = "Pittsburgh" if city_num==5
replace city = "Portland" if city_num==6
replace city = "Sacramento" if city_num==7
replace city = "Tampa" if city_num==8

*ADD AVERAGE UNEMPLOYMENT RATE FOR 03/17-08/17 BASED ON BLS LAUS DATA (https://www.bls.gov/lau/#data)

replace unemp = 4.85 if city_num==2
replace unemp = 3.783 if city_num==3
replace unemp = 3.083 if city_num==4
replace unemp = 5.083 if city_num==5
replace unemp = 2.733 if city_num==6
replace unemp = 4.65 if city_num==7
replace unemp = 4.05 if city_num==8

*PREPARE FOR MERGE WITH ROUNDS 1-4
ren cback call_back
ren o old

*CODE BAD JOB AND GOOD JOB TREATMENTS
gen bj_new = interimjob==1 if round==5
gen gj = interimjob==2 if round==5

save "$OUTPUTDATADIR\round5.dta", replace

******************
*CREATE FIGURE 7A*
******************

*THIS GRAPH SHOWS THE DIFFERENCE IN CALLBACK RATES FOR OLD VERSUS YOUNG APPLICANTS AGAINST THE UR IN EACH CITY-ROUND

preserve

reg call_back bj old unemp treat public c.unemp#old c.public#old [iw=ratio] if round<=3, cluster(city_round)

**RESIDUALIZED REGRESSION FOR GRAPHS

*GET RESIDUALS FOR OLDER APPLICANTS
reg call_back public bj treat if old==1&round<=3, cluster(city_round)
predict resid_old, xb

gen regadjustedcb_old = call_back - resid_old if old==1 &round<=3

*GET RESIDUALS FOR YOUNGER APPLICANTS
reg call_back public bj treat if old==0&round<=3, cluster(city_round)
predict resid_young, xb

gen regadjustedcb_young = call_back - resid_young if old==0 &round<=3

************************************************

*************************
*RECRUITER-PRODUCER RATIO
*************************

*STEPS
*1) GET A DATABASE WITH STATE, YEAR, MONTH AND EMPLOYMENT IN 56131
*2) CREATE A DATABASE WITH TOTAL PRIVATE EMPLOYMENT BY STATE

**************************************************
**THIS .DO FILE CREATES STATE X INDUSTRY X MONTH**
**JOB OPENTINGS, LAYOFFS, AND TURNOVERS (JOLTS) **
**USING THE EXPERIMENTAL STATE JOLTS DATA	    **
**************************************************

*IMPORT STATE JOLTS DATA
clear

import excel using "$BASEDIR\data\JOLTS\jlt_statedata_q3_2019.xlsx", firstrow

tostring Period, gen(date_)
gen Year = substr(date_,-6,4)
gen Month = substr(date_,-2,2)

gen state = strtrim(State)

drop Period date
destring Year Month, force replace

sort state Year Month
save "$OUTPUTDATADIR\JOLTS_state_month.dta", replace

*ABBREV CROSSWALK
clear
insheet using "$BASEDIR\data\JOLTS\state_abbrev.csv"
ren v1 state
ren v2 state_code
drop in 1
save "$OUTPUTDATADIR\state_abbrev.dta", replace

clear 
use "$OUTPUTDATADIR\JOLTS_state_month.dta"
sort state 
merge m:1 state using "$OUTPUTDATADIR\state_abbrev.dta"
drop _merge
sort state Year Month
save "$OUTPUTDATADIR\JOLTS_state_month.dta", replace

*********************************************
**BRING IN NATIONAL MONTHLY JOLTS BY INDUSTRY
*********************************************

clear
import excel using "$BASEDIR\data\JOLTS\national_private_JOLTS.xlsx", firstrow

replace naics2 = "48" in 11

	import delimited "$EEOCpath\Charges FY`x'.txt", clear
	keep charge_inquiry_seq involved_institution_seq date_initial_inquiry date_first_office receiving_eeoc_fepa ///
	closure_date total_benefit_people total_benefit_amount

	local stub = substr(y,1,4)
	tempfile charges`stub'
	save `charges`stub''

	OF DISCRIMINATION
	import delimited "$EEOCpath\Allegation FY`x'.txt", clear
	keep charge_inquiry_seq allegation_ind cause_ind statute_code statute ///
	basis_code basis issue_code issue first_alleged_date last_alleged_date

	merge m:1 charge_inquiry_seq using `charges`stub''

	bysort charge_inquiry_seq: gen action_number = _n

	merge 1:m  charge_inquiry_seq using `charges`stub''

	county_number country eeo_company_id_number number_of_employees ///

	if `x' == 2011-2015 {

	merge 1:m charge_inquiry_seq involved_institution_seq using `charges`stub''

global tables "C:\Users\mathk\Dropbox\Summer RA\paper draft\tables_age"


***********************************************************

***********************************************************

use "$filepath\eeoc_all_issues_all_charges_collapsed_indiv_legalcounsel.dta"

*GENERATE DATE ON WHICH CHARGE WAS FILED
gen g = 1
if g == 1 {
	gen Year=substr(date_first_office,-4,4)
	destring Year, replace
	gen Month=substr(date_first_office,1,2)
	destring Month, replace ignore("/")
	gen date = string(Month) + "/" + string(Year)
}

gen mdate = monthly(date,"MY")
format mdate %tm

*GENERATE AGE OF CHARGING PARTY
gen birth_Year = substr(date_of_birth,-4,4)
destring birth_Year, ignore("null") force replace
gen age_cp= Year-birth_Year

*GENERATE SEX OF CHARGING PARTY
gen female=1 if sex_code=="F"
replace female=0 if sex_code=="M"

*GENERATE RACE OF CHARGING PARTY
egen race_ind = group(race_str)

*GENERATE PRIVATE/PUBLIC SECTOR DUMMY FOR RESPONDENT
gen private_firm=1 if strpos(institution_type, "Private")
replace private_firm =0 if strpos(institution_type, "Govt")|strpos(institution_type, "Government")|strpos(institution_type, "Elected")|strpos(institution_type, "Public")

*GENERATE INDUSTRY CODES FOR RESPONDENT
gen naics3 = substr(naics_code, 1,3)
destring naics3, force replace ignore("nul")
gen naics2 = int(naics3/10)
gen naics4 = substr(naics_code, 1,4)
destring naics4, force replace ignore("nul")

*AGGREGATE INDUSTRIES BASED ON CATEGORIES FOR WHICH NATIONAL UNEMPLOYMENT IS TABULATED

gen own_code=5
*AGRICULTURE, FORESTRY, FISHING, AND HUNTING
gen industry_code = 11 if naics2==11
*MINING
replace industry_code = 1011 if naics2==21
*UTILITIES
replace industry_code = 1021 if naics2==22
*CONSTRUCTION
replace industry_code = 1012 if naics2==23
*MANUFACTURING
replace industry_code = 1013 if naics2>=31&naics2<=33
*WHOLESALE AND RETAIL TRADE
replace industry_code = 42 if naics2==42|naics2==44|naics2==45
*TRANSPORTATION AND WAREHOUSING
replace industry_code = 1021 if naics2==48|naics2==49
*INFORMATION
replace industry_code = 1022 if naics2==51
*FINANCE, INSURANCE, AND REAL ESTATE (FIRE)
replace industry_code = 1023 if naics2==52|naics2==53
*PROFESSIONAL AND BUSINESS SERVICES
method: state-industry panel and correspondence-study regressions with fixed effects and clustered inference
title: Age Discrimination across the Business Cycle

********************************************************************************
/*
This program cleans data for subsequent variable construction (2. Variable_Construction.do).


Table of Contents
1. Respondents' Preferences
2. Other Cleaning
*/
********************************************************************************

clear all

********************************************************************************
**# 1. Respondents' Preferences
********************************************************************************

use "${source_data_folder}/indiv_loc_baseline1_pe1_baseline2_pe2_V8.dta", clear
destring num_domicilio_from_loc, replace 


*==============================================================================*
**## 1.1 Reciprocity measures 
*==============================================================================*

*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
** 1.1.1 Hypothetical game (2012)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*

* In this game, the hypothetical first mover was given R$5 and had to decide whether to send nothing, R$2, R$3, or R$4 to the second mover. 
* Whatever he sent was tripled and the second mover could keep or return as much as she wanted. 
* The study participant ("second mover") was asked how much she would return if she received R$6; how much if R$9; and how much if R$12.

foreach sent_amt in 2 3 4 {
	
	* c_reciprocity_r`sent_amt' is the amount of R$ the respondent would return when stranger sent R$`sent_amt'
	
	* Share of R$ the respondent would return when stranger sent R$`sent_amt'. 
	* Note that this amount is tripled by the researchers, so we multiply `sent_amt' by 3
	gen rcpt_share_r`sent_amt'_hyp = c_reciprocity_r`sent_amt' / (`sent_amt' * 3)

}


* Share of R$ the respondent would return on average when they were treated "well" (as defined by Finan and Schecter)
gen hi_avg_share = (rcpt_share_r3_hyp + rcpt_share_r4_hyp) / 2

* Share of R$ the respondent would return on average when they were treated "poorly" (as defined by Finan and Schecter)
gen lo_avg_share = rcpt_share_r2_hyp
			
* Continuous measure of reciprocity (as defined by Finan and Schecter)
* Censor this at 0 because the worst a politican will do is nothing
gen float rcpt_continuous_hyp_1 = (hi_avg_share - lo_avg_share)
replace rcpt_continuous_hyp_1 = 0 if rcpt_continuous_hyp_1 < 0

* Dummy variable for whether the respondent is a high-reciprocity type 
gen int rcpt_high_type_hyp_1 = ceil(rcpt_continuous_hyp_1)
label var rcpt_high_type_hyp_1 "1/0: High Reciprocity Type [Hyp, R1]"


* Drop unneeded variables 
drop hi_avg_share lo_avg_share c_reciprocity_r* rcpt_continuous_hyp_1


*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
** 1.1.2 Incentivized game (2013)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*

* In this game, the first mover was given R$10 and had to decide whether to send nothing, R$2, R$4, R$6, R$8, or R$10 to the second mover. 
* Whatever he sent was tripled and the second mover could keep or return as much as she wanted. 
* Before finding out how much was sent to her, the second mover was asked how much she would return to the first mover if she received R$6, 
* how much if R$12; how much if R$18; how much if R$24; and how much if R$30.

foreach sent_amt in 2 4 6 8 10 {
	
	* e_rcprty_send_r`sent_amt'_ is the amount of R$ the respondent would return when stranger sent R$`sent_amt'
				
	* Share of R$ the respondent would return when stranger sent R$`sent_amt'. 
	* Note that this amount is tripled by the researchers, so we multiply `sent_amt' by 3
	gen rcpt_share_r`sent_amt'_incent = e_rcprty_send_r`sent_amt'_ / (`sent_amt' * 3)

*==============================================================================*
**## 1.2 Altruism measures 
*==============================================================================*

* This uses the same games as the reciprocitiy measures (section 2.1)

*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
** 1.2.1 Hypothetical game (2012)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*

* Following Finan and Schecter, we define the share returned when a P2 is treated poorly as a measure of altruism 
* This is equivalent to the "lo_avg_share" variable under section 2.1.1
gen alt_continuous_hyp_1 = rcpt_share_r2_hyp

* Find median of continuous altruism measure in control clusters 
summarize alt_continuous_hyp_1 if b_cl_assignment == 3, detail
local MEDIAN = r(p50)

* Dummy variable for whether the respondent is a high-altruism type
gen alt_binary_P2_hyp = 0 if alt_continuous_hyp_1 <= `MEDIAN'
replace alt_binary_P2_hyp = 1 if alt_continuous_hyp_1 > `MEDIAN'
replace alt_binary_P2_hyp = . if missing(alt_continuous_hyp_1)

label var alt_binary_P2_hyp "1/0 High Altruism Type [Hyp, R1]"


* Drop unneeded variables 
drop alt_continuous_hyp_1 rcpt_share_*_hyp


*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
** 1.2.2. Incentivized game (2013)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*

* Following Finan and Schecter, we define the share returned when a P2 is treated poorly as a measure of altruism 
* This is equivalent to the "lo_avg_share" variable under section 2.1.2
gen alt_continuous_incent_2 = (rcpt_share_r2_incent + rcpt_share_r4_incent) / 2

* Find median of continuous altruism measure in control clusters 
summarize alt_continuous_incent_2 if b_cl_assignment == 3, detail
local MEDIAN = r(p50)

* Dummy variable for whether the respondent is a high-altruism type

replace alt_binary_P2_incent_2 = 1 if alt_continuous_incent_2 > `MEDIAN'

*==============================================================================*
**## 1.3 Public Goods Contribution (2013)
*==============================================================================*

* In this game, participants are given an endowment of R$5 and are asked how much they would like to contribute to a public good.  
* The total pool of funds contributed to the public good will be doubled and each community member will receive an equal share of the pot 
* (regardless of how much they initially contributed). 
 
gen pub_good_share_contributed = e_rcprty_comm_send_r5_ / 5
label var pub_good_share_contributed "Share of Endowment Given to Public Good [Incent, R2]"


* Drop unneeded variables 
drop e_rcprty_comm*


*==============================================================================*
**## 1.4 Time Preferences
*==============================================================================*

*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
* 1.4.1 Hypothetical game (2012)
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*

* In this game, the respondent is asked to state whether they prefer a R$100 prize tomorrow or a
* guaranteed prize of (variously) R$110; R$150; R$200; R$300; R$500; R$700; R$1,000 in one month.

gen byte time_pref_110_hyp_1 = .
replace time_pref_110_hyp_1 = 0 if !missing(c_wait_for_150r_) 
replace time_pref_110_hyp_1 = 1 if c_wait_for_110r_ == 2
replace time_pref_110_hyp_1 = 0 if c_wait_for_110r_ == 1
				       
gen byte time_pref_150_hyp_1 = .
replace time_pref_150_hyp_1 = 0 if !missing(c_wait_for_200r_)
replace time_pref_150_hyp_1 = 1 if c_wait_for_150r_ == 2
replace time_pref_150_hyp_1 = 1 if time_pref_110_hyp_1 == 1
replace time_pref_150_hyp_1 = 0 if c_wait_for_150r_ == 1
				
gen byte time_pref_200_hyp_1 = . 
replace time_pref_200_hyp_1 = 0 if !missing(c_wait_for_300r_)
replace time_pref_200_hyp_1 = 1 if c_wait_for_200r_ == 2
replace time_pref_200_hyp_1 = 1 if time_pref_150_hyp_1 == 1
replace time_pref_200_hyp_1 = 0 if c_wait_for_200r_ == 1
		        
gen byte time_pref_300_hyp_1 = . 
replace time_pref_300_hyp_1 = 0 if !missing(c_wait_for_500r_) 
replace time_pref_300_hyp_1 = 1 if c_wait_for_300r_ == 2
replace time_pref_300_hyp_1 = 1 if time_pref_200_hyp_1== 1
replace time_pref_300_hyp_1 = 0 if c_wait_for_300r_ == 1

********************************************************************************
/*
This program constructs the final individual-level and household-level datasets for the clientelism analysis:
*    ${final_data_folder}/clientelism_individual_data.dta (individual)
*    ${final_data_folder}/clientelism_household_data.dta (household)

Sections:
0. Setup
1. Rainfall Measures
2. Infrequent Interactor Variables

5. Asking Variables 
6. Other Individual-Level Variables

8. Final datasets

*/
********************************************************************************
**# 0. Setup 
********************************************************************************
clear all

use "${gen_data_folder}/clean_indiv_V6_V16.dta", clear


********************************************************************************
**# 1. Rainfall Measure for 2011-2013
********************************************************************************

*==============================================================================*
**## Rainfall Measure for 2012 and 2013
*==============================================================================*
local months "01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12"
local years "1986 1987 1988 1989 1990 1991 1992 1993 1994 1995 1996 1997 1998 1999 2000 2001 2002 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007 2008 2009 2010 2011"
local study_years "2012 2013"

*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Annual average rainfall for each municipality-month in the period 1986-2011
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
foreach month of local months {
	gen temp_`month' = 0
	
	foreach year of local years {
		replace temp_`month' = temp_`month' + rainfall_`year'_`month'
	}
	
	* Annual average for each month across 26 years
	gen rainfall_long_run_average_`month' = temp_`month' / 26
}


*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Monthly standard deviation of rainfall for each municipality in the period 1986-2011
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
gen temp = 0

foreach year of local years {
	foreach month of local months {
		replace temp = temp + rainfall_`year'_`month'
	}
}

* Monthly average over 312 (26 years x 12 months) months
gen rainfall_long_run_average = temp / 312

gen temp_2 = 0

foreach month of local months {
	foreach year of local years {
	    
		* Municipality-level variance of rainfall for each month-year
		gen temp_`year'_`month' = (rainfall_`year'_`month' - rainfall_long_run_average) ^ 2
		
		* Create sum of variances across all month-years
		replace temp_2 = temp_2 + temp_`year'_`month'
method: randomized intervention and rainfall shocks
title: Vulnerability and Clientelism

gen temp = 0

foreach year of local years2 {
	foreach month of local months2 {
		replace temp = temp + rainfall_`year'_`month'
	}
}

* Monthly average over 300 (25 years x 12 months) months
gen rainfall_long_run_average2 = temp / 300

gen temp_2 = 0

foreach month of local months2 {
	foreach year of local years2 {
	    
		* Municipality-level variance of rainfall for each month-year
		gen temp_`year'_`month' = (rainfall_`year'_`month' - rainfall_long_run_average2) ^ 2
		
		* Create sum of variances across all month-years
		replace temp_2 = temp_2 + temp_`year'_`month'
	}
}

* Municipality-level monthly standard deviation of rainfall
gen rainfall_long_run_sd2 = (temp_2 / 299) ^ 0.5

drop temp*


*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Monthly Standardized Rainfall measure
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
foreach month of local months2 {
	foreach year of local study_years2 {
	    
		* Normalized measure using annual average rainfall for each month
		gen rainfall_diff_`year'_`month' = rainfall_`year'_`month' - rainfall_long_run_average_`month'2
		gen rainfall_std_`year'_`month' = rainfall_diff_`year'_`month' / rainfall_long_run_sd2
	}
}


*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Aggregate rainfall measures : monthly average in 2011
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*

** Standardized measure 
gen rainfall_2011_std = (rainfall_std_2011_01 + rainfall_std_2011_02 + rainfall_std_2011_03 + rainfall_std_2011_04) / 4

/* 
rainfall_2011_std uses only Jan-Apr because we use rainfall measures before we conducted the survey. 
For 2012 and 2013, we conducted the survey >= Oct. For 2011, we conducted the localization survey in May.
*/
label variable rainfall_2011_std "Rainfall 2011: Jan-Apr"
						

*==============================================================================*
**## Final Rainfall Measures
*==============================================================================*

** Original measures (Jan - Apr for 2011; Jan - Sep for 2012 and 2013)
forval year = 2011(1)2013 {
			
	** Normalize standardized rainfall measures to have mean 0 and standard deviation 1
	rename rainfall_`year'_std rainfall_`year'_std_og
	egen rainfall_`year'_std = std(rainfall_`year'_std_og)
}

label var rainfall_2011_std "Rainfall 2011: Jan-Apr (standardized)"

	foreach wave in "b" "d" {
	    replace `wave'_`var' = . if `wave'_`var' == 0 

		** Left-censor at the 5th percentile and right-censor at the 95th percentile
		_pctile `wave'_`var', nq(1000) 			
		replace `wave'_`var' = r(r50) if `wave'_`var' < r(r50) & `wave'_`var' != . 
		replace `wave'_`var' = r(r950) if `wave'_`var' > r(r950) & `wave'_`var' != . 
	}			
} 


*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Generate Wealth Indices
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
				
** Use personal and municipality-level prices to define the value of assets
local livestock "cow steer calve horse donkey fem_goat male_goat sheep adult_sheep pig chicken duck turkey goose rabbit fish animal_other animal_ns animal_nr"

local durables "car truck motorcycle fridge stove wash_mach sew_mach tv dvd cell_phone pc phone satellite good_other good_ns good_nr"


foreach var in `livestock' `durables' {	
    
	foreach wave in "b" "d" {
	    replace `wave'_p_`var' = . if `wave'_p_`var' == 0 

		** Define the municipality-level price of each good as the median of personal prices in that municipality.
		egen `wave'_p_comm_`var' = median(`wave'_p_`var'), by(mun_id) 
		
		** If respondents have at least one of the good, replace missing personal prices with the municipality-level price
		replace `wave'_p_`var' = `wave'_p_comm_`var' if `wave'_num_`var' != 0 & `wave'_p_`var' == . 

		** Value of assets using personal prices: number of assets * personal price of assets
		gen `wave'_val_`var' = `wave'_num_`var' * `wave'_p_`var' 
		
		** Value of assets using municipality-level prices: number of assets * municipality-level price of assets
		gen `wave'_val_comm_`var' = `wave'_num_`var' * `wave'_p_comm_`var' 
	}
} 


** Construct aggregate wealth indices
foreach wave in "b" "d" {
    
	** Value of Durables
	egen `wave'_total_durables = rowtotal(`wave'_val_car `wave'_val_truck `wave'_val_motorcycle `wave'_val_fridge `wave'_val_stove 											`wave'_val_wash_mach `wave'_val_sew_mach `wave'_val_tv `wave'_val_dvd `wave'_val_cell_phone 										 `wave'_val_pc `wave'_val_phone `wave'_val_satellite `wave'_val_good_other `wave'_val_good_ns 										   `wave'_val_good_nr), missing
	
	** Value of Livestock
	egen `wave'_total_livestock = rowtotal(`wave'_val_cow `wave'_val_steer `wave'_val_calve `wave'_val_horse `wave'_val_donkey 											 `wave'_val_fem_goat `wave'_val_male_goat `wave'_val_sheep `wave'_val_adult_sheep `wave'_val_pig 										   `wave'_val_chicken `wave'_val_duck `wave'_val_turkey `wave'_val_goose `wave'_val_rabbit 											 `wave'_val_fish `wave'_val_animal_other `wave'_val_animal_ns `wave'_val_animal_nr), missing
	
	** Value of Property
	egen `wave'_value_tot_property = rowtotal(`wave'_value_house `wave'_value_anoth_plot), missing
	
	
	** Total Wealth = Value of Durables + Value of Livestock + Value of Property + Net Savings
	egen `wave'_tot_Wealth = rowtotal(`wave'_total_durables `wave'_total_livestock `wave'_value_tot_property `wave'_net_savings), missing
}

*==============================================================================*

*==============================================================================*

*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
*	Health Index - Specifically: SRHS
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*

foreach wave in "b" "d" {
    
	** To add the Self Reported Health Status (SRHS), we first remove DK and DA observations:
	replace `wave'_srhs_nm = . if `wave'_srhs_nm == 5 | `wave'_srhs_nm == 6
			
	/* Since SRHS asked respondents how BAD their health is (from 1 to 4, 4 being worst), we take the negative of this.
	   Thus a higher index means better SRHS. */
	gen `wave'_neg_srhs = `wave'_srhs_nm * (-1)	
	
	** Make index strictly positive
	recode `wave'_neg_srhs (-1 = 4) (-2 = 3) (-3 = 2) (-4 = 1), gen(`wave'_Health)
	
	** Normalize new index to create a measure with mean 0 and standard deviation 1
	egen `wave'_Health_norm = std(`wave'_Health)
}


*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
*	Child Food Security Index
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
foreach wave in "b" "d" {	
	foreach var in iac_lack iac_ateless iac_hunger iac_atelessq iac_notvaried iac_limited {
	    
		** Reverse index such that higher values mean more food security
		gen `wave'_neg_`var' = `wave'_`var' * (-1) 
	}
		
	** Aggregate food security index
	egen `wave'_Child_Food_Security = rowtotal(`wave'_neg_iac_lack `wave'_neg_iac_ateless `wave'_neg_iac_hunger 										   	  	`wave'_neg_iac_atelessq `wave'_neg_iac_notvaried `wave'_neg_iac_limited), missing
	
	** Aggregate food security index (standardized)
	egen `wave'_Child_Food_Security_norm = std(`wave'_Child_Food_Security)
}
			

*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
*	Happiness Index
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
foreach wave in "b" "d"	{
    foreach var in sem_animo solitario sem_dormir triste {
	
		** Reverse index such that higher values mean more happiness (less depression)
		recode `wave'_`var' (4 = 1) (3 = 2) (2 = 3) (1 = 4), gen(`wave'_neg_`var')

	** Normalize to create a measure with mean 0 and standard deviation 1
	egen `wave'_Happiness_norm = std(`wave'_Happiness)
}

gen temp_num_dom = num_dom
replace temp_num_dom = . if num_dom == num_dom[_n-1]
egen households_per_cluster = count(temp_num_dom), by(b_clusters) 

*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Define no. of voters in households we did not interview 
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*

* Calculate the number of voters in each household in our sample at the cluster level
gen total_adults_household = total_adults
replace total_adults_household = . if num_dom == num_dom[_n-1]                  // avoid double-counting the total_adults variable at the household level 
egen total_adults_cluster = total(total_adults_household), by(b_clusters)       
replace total_adults_cluster = . if b_clusters == b_clusters[_n-1]


* Define NI_ch_minus as the number of voters who were in households we did not interview. 
* For each cluster, this is defined as the (median number of neighboring households - the number of interviewed households) X median no. of adults per household.
* Define this variable at the cluster level.
gen NI_ch_minus = (median_neighbors_cluster - households_per_cluster) * median_adults_cluster
replace NI_ch_minus = 0 if NI_ch_minus < 0
replace NI_ch_minus = . if b_clusters == b_clusters[_n-1]


* Calculate the sum of both variables at the cluster level 
gen total_voters = total_adults_cluster + NI_ch_minus       


* Define the ratio of total voters to total voters interviewed at the cluster level
gen voters_to_interviewed = total_voters / interviewed_cluster     


*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*
* Final rescaling of regressors
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*

* Calculate the ratio of total voters to total voters interviewed at the aggregate level for the 21 municipalities

}

}

use "$INTERMEDIATE/ACHA_clean.dta" if sample_main==1, clear

global controls i.region age age_sq female i.year_in_school white black hispanic asian indian other_race i.international

foreach i in mh_noserv dep_serv ds {
	if "`i'"=="mh_noserv" {
		local title = "Index Symptoms Poor Mental Health"
	}
	if "`i'"=="dep_serv" {
		local title = "Index Depression Services"
	}
	if "`i'"=="ds" {
		local title = "Index Downstream Effects"
	}
	
	local lasso_type = "mh_risk_quintile"
	local lasso_name = "predictedMH"
	local x_title = "Quintile of Predicted Susceptibility to Mental Illness"

	* Regression
	qui reg eq_index_`i' T#i.`lasso_type' i.`lasso_type' i.uni_id i.survey_wave $controls, vce(cluster uni_id)
		
	* Store coeffs
	capture drop A1-A5
	matrix A = J(5,3,1)
	forval k = 1/5 {
		matrix A[`k', 1] = _b[1.T#`k'.`lasso_type'] 
		matrix A[`k', 2] = _se[1.T#`k'.`lasso_type'] 
		matrix A[`k', 3] = `k'
	}
	svmat A
	gen A4 = A1-1.96*A2
	gen A5 = A1+1.96*A2

	* Plot
	twoway (scatter A1 A3 if A1!=., mc(black)) (rcap A5 A4 A3 if A1!=., lc(black)), /// 
		graphr(c(white)) xtitle("`x_title'", ///
		height(6) size(small)) ytitle("Coefficient", height(6) size(small)) title(`title') ///
		yscale(r(-0.05 0.20)) ytick(-0.05(0.05)0.20) ylabel(-0.05 0 0.05 0.1 0.15 0.20, labsize(small)) ///

	graph save "$TEMP/HTE`lasso_name'_`i'.gph", replace
}

/* SharpenPValues.do */
* This code calculates sharpened FDR-adjusted p-values.
* The code was taken from Michael Anderson's website: https://are.berkeley.edu/~mlanderson/ARE_Website/Research.html

quietly sum pval
local totalpvals = r(N)

* Sort the p-values in ascending order and generate a variable that codes each p-value's rank

quietly gen int original_sorting_order = _n
quietly sort pval
quietly gen int rank = _n if pval!=.

* Set the initial counter to 1

local qval = 1

* Generate the variable that will contain the BKY (2006) sharpened q-values

gen bky06_qval = 1 if pval!=.

* Set up a loop that begins by checking which hypotheses are rejected at q = 1.000, then checks which hypotheses are rejected at q = 0.999, then checks which hypotheses are rejected at q = 0.998, etc.  The loop ends by checking which hypotheses are rejected at q = 0.001.


while `qval' > 0 {
	* First Stage
	* Generate the adjusted first stage q level we are testing: q' = q/1+q
	local qval_adj = `qval'/(1+`qval')
	* Generate value q'*r/M
	gen fdr_temp1 = `qval_adj'*rank/`totalpvals'
	* Generate binary variable checking condition p(r) <= q'*r/M
	gen reject_temp1 = (fdr_temp1>=pval) if pval~=.
	* Generate variable containing p-value ranks for all p-values that meet above condition
	gen reject_rank1 = reject_temp1*rank
	* Record the rank of the largest p-value that meets above condition
	egen total_rejected1 = max(reject_rank1)

	* Second Stage
	* Generate the second stage q level that accounts for hypotheses rejected in first stage: q_2st = q'*(M/m0)
	local qval_2st = `qval_adj'*(`totalpvals'/(`totalpvals'-total_rejected1[1]))
	* Generate value q_2st*r/M
	gen fdr_temp2 = `qval_2st'*rank/`totalpvals'
	* Generate binary variable checking condition p(r) <= q_2st*r/M
	gen reject_temp2 = (fdr_temp2>=pval) if pval~=.
	* Generate variable containing p-value ranks for all p-values that meet above condition
	gen reject_rank2 = reject_temp2*rank
	* Record the rank of the largest p-value that meets above condition
	egen total_rejected2 = max(reject_rank2)

	* A p-value has been rejected at level q if its rank is less than or equal to the rank of the max p-value that meets the above condition
	replace bky06_qval = `qval' if rank <= total_rejected2 & rank~=.
	* Reduce q by 0.001 and repeat loop
	drop fdr_temp* reject_temp* reject_rank* total_rejected*
	local qval = `qval' - .001
}

quietly sort original_sorting_order
method: staggered adoption generalized difference-in-differences

*****************
** FIGURE B.1: Impacts of Principal Entry and Exit on Students' Performance
*****************
{
    
use "Data/clean/panel_VAM_GPA_beforeReg.dta", clear
drop id

* Merge FEs
merge m:1 id_prin using "Data/clean/principal_TwoWay_felsdv_v3.dta"
drop _merge
rename fe_prin_adj fe_prin_2wayfe

* Identify high VA principals
preserve
	keep id_prin fe_prin_2wayfe
	duplicates drop
		
	sum fe_prin_2wayfe, d
	gen top25_fe_prin_2wayfe 	= 1 if fe_prin_2wayfe >= `r(p75)' & fe_prin_2wayfe != .	
	gen bot25_fe_prin_2wayfe 	= 1 if fe_prin_2wayfe <= `r(p25)' & fe_prin_2wayfe != .	
	
	keep id_prin top25_fe_prin_2wayfe bot25_fe_prin_2wayfe 
	
	compress
	tempfile temp
	save `temp'.dta, replace
restore	

merge m:1 id_prin using `temp'.dta
drop _merge

* Identify entry of new principal	
preserve
	keep rbd agno id_prin
	duplicates drop
	xtset rbd agno
	
	bys rbd: gen new_ppal = 1 if id_prin != l.id_prin
	replace new_ppal = . if agno == 2012
	
	bys rbd: gen exit_ppal = 1 if id_prin != f.id_prin
	replace exit_ppal = . if agno == 2015
	
	* Clean for gaps in rbd that appeared as entries
	gen dif = agno - l.agno
	replace new_ppal = . if dif == . & new_ppal == 1
	
	gen dif2 = agno - f.agno
	replace exit_ppal = . if dif2 == . & exit_ppal == 1
	
	keep rbd agno new_ppal exit_ppal
	compress
	tempfile temp
	save `temp'.dta, replace
restore	

merge m:1 rbd agno using `temp'.dta
drop _merge	


** Entry top-principal
	preserve
		gen id_aux = 1 if top25_fe_prin_2wayfe == 1 & new_ppal == 1
		
		egen id=max(id_aux), by(rbd)
		keep if id == 1
		gen agno_switch = agno if new_ppal == 1 & top25_fe_prin_2wayfe == 1
		bys rbd: egen min_agno_switch = min(agno_switch)
		gen rel_agno = agno - min_agno_switch
					
		collapse (mean) gpa min_agno_switch fe_prin_2wayfe matricula_total low_income high_income father_college mother_college Rural_s Public_s, by(rbd rel_agno)
		
		* Balance
		sort rbd rel_agno
		drop if abs(rel_agno)>2 // (-2, 2)
		gen samp_test=(rel_agno==-1|rel_agno==1)
		gen Post=(rel_agno==1) if samp_test==1

		collapse (mean) gpa min_agno_switch fe_prin_2wayfe matricula_total low_income high_income father_college mother_college Rural_s Public_s, by(rbd rel_agno)
		
		* Balance
		sort rbd rel_agno
		drop if abs(rel_agno)>2 // (-2, 2)
		gen samp_test=(rel_agno==-1|rel_agno==1)
		gen Post=(rel_agno==1) if samp_test==1
		
		foreach var in gpa matricula_total low_income high_income father_college mother_college Rural_s Public_s{
		bys rbd (rel_agno): gen delta_`var'=`var'-`var'[_n-1]
		}

		gen T1 = (rel_agno >= 0)

		distinct rbd 
		gen NEvent=r(ndistinct)
		
		reg delta_gpa T1 			     if samp_test==1, r 
		gen Dgpa=_b[T1]
		gen p_1 = (2 * ttail(e(df_r), abs(_b[T1]/_se[T1]))) 
		
		reg fe_prin_2wayfe T1 	if samp_test==1, r 
		gen DFE=_b[T1]
		
		*for test
		expand 2
		bys rbd rel_agno: gen n=_n
		gen d=(n==1)
		
		gen     y=delta_gpa if d==1
		replace y=fe_prin_2wayfe if d==0
		
		gen T1_d = T1*d
		reg y T1 d T1_d if samp_test==1, r 
		gen p_2 = (2 * ttail(e(df_r), abs(_b[T1_d]/_se[T1_d]))) 
		
		drop if d==1
		drop d y
		
		foreach var in Dgpa DFE p_1 p_2 NEvent{
			sum `var'
			global g_`var'=string(`r(mean)', "%9.3f")
		}
			sum NEvent
			global g_NEvent=string(`r(mean)', "%9.0f")
		
		*for graph
		collapse (mean) gpa min_agno_switch (semean) se_gpa=gpa, by(rel_agno)
		keep if rel_agno >= -2 & rel_agno <= 2
		
		g LB = gpa - 1.95*se_gpa
		g UB = gpa + 1.95*se_gpa
	
		two (connect gpa rel_agno, color(navy%90)) ///
			(rcap LB UB rel_agno, color(gs10)), ///
			xlabel(-2(1)2) xtitle("Years since principal entry") ///
			ytitle("Average standardized GPA") xline(-0.5, lc(gs10) lp(dash) ) /// 
			subtitle("  {&Delta}GPA=${g_Dgpa}" "  {&Delta}FE=${g_DFE}" " " "  p[{&Delta}GPA=0]=${g_p_1}" "  p[{&Delta}GPA = {&Delta}FE]=${g_p_2}" " " "  N. of Events=${g_NEvent}", size(small) ring(0) pos(11)) ///
			graphregion(color(white)) /// 
			legend(off) scale(1.2)
		
		graph export "Figures/Figure_B1_D.pdf", replace
	restore

** BUILD panel_school_docentes
*******************************
{
use "Data/clean/panel_employeremployee.dta", clear 

merge 1:1 mrun agno rbd using "Data/clean/EvaluacionDocente_2007_2016.dta", keepusing(instr_pje cce_esc)
rename instr_pje EvalDocente_Score 
rename cce_esc EvalDocente_Class 
decode EvalDocente_Class, gen(EvalDocente_Class_str)
gen EvalDocente=(_merge==3)
drop _merge
method: principal value-added estimation and recruitment difference-in-differences with modern event-study robustness
title: Managers' Productivity and Recruitment in the Public Sector

content:
use "Data/clean/panel_employeremployee.dta", clear 

merge 1:1 mrun agno rbd using "Data/clean/EvaluacionDocente_2007_2016.dta", keepusing(instr_pje cce_esc)
rename instr_pje EvalDocente_Score 
rename cce_esc EvalDocente_Class 
decode EvalDocente_Class, gen(EvalDocente_Class_str)
gen EvalDocente=(_merge==3)
drop _merge


egen teachers=concat(rbd mrun), format(%13.0g)
egen id=group(teachers)
drop teachers

xtset id agno
tsfill, full 

sort id agno
gen emp=(rbd!=.)

bys id (agno): gen fired =(emp==1 & emp[_n+1]==0)
bys id (agno): gen hired =(emp==1 & emp[_n-1]==0)
	
gen aux_New = (SenioritySystem<=8 & agno==2015)
gen aux_Young = (Edad<30 & agno==2015)
gen aux_Bad  = (EvalDocente_Class_str=="I" |EvalDocente_Class_str=="B")
gen aux_Good = (EvalDocente_Class_str=="D" |EvalDocente_Class_str=="C")

bysort clave: egen Young=max(aux_Young)	
bysort clave: egen New=max(aux_New)	
bysort clave: egen Bad=max(aux_Bad)	
bysort clave: egen Good=max(aux_Good)	

bys rbd agno: gen  N_all=_N
bys rbd agno: egen N_sup=total(SupportWorker)
bys rbd agno: egen N_sup_20501=total(SupportWorker_Law20501)
bys rbd agno: egen N_adm=total(Administrative)
bys rbd agno: egen N_teach=total(Teacher)
bys rbd agno: egen N_teach_new=total(Teacher*New)
bys rbd agno: egen N_teach_young=total(Teacher*Young)
bys rbd agno: egen N_teach_bad=total(Teacher*Bad)
bys rbd agno: egen N_teach_good=total(Teacher*Good)

bys rbd agno: egen fired_all=total(fired)
bys rbd agno: egen hired_all=total(hired)

bys rbd agno: egen fired_sup=total(fired*SupportWorker)
bys rbd agno: egen hired_sup=total(hired*SupportWorker)

bys rbd agno: egen fired_sup_20501=total(fired*SupportWorker_Law20501)
bys rbd agno: egen hired_sup_20501=total(hired*SupportWorker_Law20501)

bys rbd agno: egen fired_adm=total(fired*Administrative)
bys rbd agno: egen hired_adm=total(hired*Administrative)

bys rbd agno: egen fired_teach=total(fired*Teacher)
bys rbd agno: egen hired_teach=total(hired*Teacher)

bys rbd agno: egen fired_teach_new=total(fired*Teacher*New)
bys rbd agno: egen hired_teach_new=total(hired*Teacher*New)

bys rbd agno: egen fired_teach_young=total(fired*Teacher*Young)
bys rbd agno: egen hired_teach_young=total(hired*Teacher*Young)	

bys rbd agno: egen fired_teach_bad=total(fired*Teacher*Bad)
bys rbd agno: egen hired_teach_bad=total(hired*Teacher*Bad)	

bys rbd agno: egen fired_teach_good=total(fired*Teacher*Good)
bys rbd agno: egen hired_teach_good=total(hired*Teacher*Good)	

bys rbd agno: egen Seniority=mean(SenioritySystem)
rename SenioritySchool aux
bys rbd agno: egen SenioritySchool=mean(aux)


foreach i in all sup sup_20501 adm teach teach_new teach_young teach_bad teach_good{
	g churn_`i' = (fired_`i' + hired_`i')/N_`i'
}

bys rbd agno: gen n=_n
method: principal value-added estimation and recruitment difference-in-differences with modern event-study robustness
title: Managers' Productivity and Recruitment in the Public Sector

content:
bys rbd agno: egen Seniority=mean(SenioritySystem)
rename SenioritySchool aux
bys rbd agno: egen SenioritySchool=mean(aux)


foreach i in all sup sup_20501 adm teach teach_new teach_young teach_bad teach_good{
	g churn_`i' = (fired_`i' + hired_`i')/N_`i'
}

bys rbd agno: gen n=_n
keep if n==1

keep N_* fired_* hired_* churn_* Seniority SenioritySchool rbd agno

save "Data/clean/panel_school_docentes", replace

}

duplicates tag anio_proceso codigo_carrera, gen(tag_)

drop _merge

  replace `var' = 0 if `var' == .
}

save "Data/temp/psu_formC_weights.dta", replace


use "Data/raw/psu/psu_formA.dta", clear 
rename anio_proceso_psu anio_proceso
drop if anio_proceso < 2010 | anio_proceso > 2017

gen public_hs = (dependencia_psu == 2)

method: principal value-added estimation and recruitment difference-in-differences with modern event-study robustness
title: Managers' Productivity and Recruitment in the Public Sector

content:
save "Data/temp/psu_formC_weights.dta", replace


use "Data/raw/psu/psu_formA.dta", clear 
rename anio_proceso_psu anio_proceso
drop if anio_proceso < 2010 | anio_proceso > 2017

gen public_hs = (dependencia_psu == 2)
gen private_hs = (dependencia_psu == 4)
gen voucher_hs = (dependencia_psu != 2 & dependencia_psu != 4)

drop bea region_psu comuna_psu 

merge 1:m anio_proceso run_falso using "Data/temp/psu_formC_weights.dta"
drop if _merge == 1
drop _merge

foreach var in hycs_actual ciencias_actual hycs_anterior ciencias_anterior ptje_ranking{
  replace `var' = 0 if `var' == .
}

foreach var in lyc mate ciencias hycs {
  replace `var'_actual = `var'_anterior if pond_anio_acad == 2
}

drop if ponderacionnotas == 0 

gen science_history_program = (ponderacionciencias > 0 & ponderacionhistoria > 0)
egen max_hist_science = rowmax(ciencias_actual hycs_actual)

tab ponderacionciencias ponderacionhistoria if science_history_program == 1 

gen score_w = ponderacionnotas*ptje_nem + ponderacionrankingnotas*ptje_ranking + ///
			  ponderacionlenguaje*lyc_actual + ponderacionmatematicas*mate_actual + ///
			  ponderacionhistoria*hycs_actual + ponderacionciencias*ciencias_actual if science_history_program == 0

replace score_w = ponderacionnotas*ptje_nem + ponderacionrankingnotas*ptje_ranking + ///
				  ponderacionlenguaje*lyc_actual + ponderacionmatematicas*mate_actual + ///
				  ponderacionhistoria*max_hist_science if science_history_program == 1

gen dif_score = score_w - puntaje
summ dif_score if estado_preferencia == 24, d
drop dif_score puntaje

order run_falso anio_proceso preferencia codigo_carrera estado_preferencia lugar situacion_postulante score_w codigounico oecdarea
sort run_falso anio_proceso preferencia 

save "Data/temp/psu_formC_weights.dta", replace

rename score_w puntaje

keep if preferencia==1 

foreach var in puntaje ptje_nem mate_actual lyc_actual ciencias_actual hycs_actual ptje_ranking{
replace `var'=. if `var'==0
gen sd_`var'=.
}


forval t=2010(1)2017{
foreach var in puntaje ptje_nem mate_actual lyc_actual ciencias_actual hycs_actual{
sum `var' if year==`t'
replace sd_`var'=(`var'-`r(mean)')/`r(sd)' if year==`t'
}
}

forval t=2013(1)2017{
foreach var in ptje_ranking{
sum `var' if year==`t'
replace sd_`var'=(`var'-`r(mean)')/`r(sd)' if year==`t'
}
}
 
gen accepted_mostpreferred=(estado_preferencia == 24)
	
gen Ncruch=1
method: principal value-added estimation and recruitment difference-in-differences with modern event-study robustness
title: Managers' Productivity and Recruitment in the Public Sector

content:
forval t=2013(1)2017{
foreach var in ptje_ranking{
sum `var' if year==`t'
replace sd_`var'=(`var'-`r(mean)')/`r(sd)' if year==`t'
}
}
 
gen accepted_mostpreferred=(estado_preferencia == 24)
	
gen Ncruch=1

				sd_puntaje sd_ptje_nem sd_mate_actual sd_lyc_actual sd_ciencias_actual sd_hycs_actual sd_ptje_ranking accepted_mostpreferred* (sum) Ncruch, by(rbd_psu year)

	|| DESCRIPCION_CUENTA_PADRE=="ARRIENDOS DE BIENES MUEBLES" || DESCRIPCION_CUENTA_PADRE=="ARRIENDOS DE INMUEBLES" ///
	|| DESCRIPCION_CUENTA_PADRE=="GASTOS EN CONSTRUCCIÓN Y MANTENCIÓN DE INFRAESTRUCTURA" ///

	|| DESCRIPCION_CUENTA_PADRE=="SERVICIOS GENERALES" || DESCRIPCION_CUENTA_PADRE=="GASTOS DE OPERACIÓN"

bysort RBD: egen ga_adm_subve=sum(MONTO_DECLARADO) if gastos_agrupados==6

label var ga_aprend_bienest "Recursos de aprendizaje y bienestar de estudiantes"

{

drop _merge

quietly sum Nclase, d
keep if Nclase>r(p1)&Nclase<r(p99)

foreach var in test_score gpa{
forval t = 2011(1)2016{
sum `var' if agno == `t'
replace `var'=(`var'-r(mean))/r(sd) if agno == `t'
}
}

keep if test_score!=.
keep if grado==4

* Empty datasets
preserve
	clear
	gen agno = .
	gen rbd  = .
	gen beta = .
	gen se_b = .
	save "Data/clean/panel_corr_gpa_test.dta", replace
restore

* Regressions by rbd-year
levelsof rbd, local(levels) 
foreach l of local levels {
    pause 100
	forval t=2011(1)2016{
	
	preserve
		keep if rbd == `l' & agno==`t'
		keep agno rbd test_score gpa
		
		qui: cap reg test_score gpa if rbd == `l' & agno==`t'
		cap g beta = _b[gpa]
		cap g se_b = _se[gpa]

	* Placebo treatment	
	rename PostChangePpal PostChangePpal_pre

	keep if t_pla_pre>=-4 & t_pla_pre <= 3 & year >= 2009 & year <= 2012 & Dmun == 1

	spread min_adp, by(rbd)
	
	keep SDall_fe_prin_2wayfe PostChangePpal_pre rbd year min_adp
	
	twowayfeweights SDall_fe_prin_2wayfe rbd year PostChangePpal_pre,  type(feTR)
	di 192/555
	* Sum of negative weights  -.01237145
		
	local w = 1
	local w1 = 1
	did_multiplegt SDall_fe_prin_2wayfe rbd year PostChangePpal_pre, placebo(`w1') breps(20) robust_dynamic dynamic(`w') cluster(rbd) covariances seed(1111001) average_effect
	
	* Column 2: See R code CallawayAndSantAna.R
	/*

    ATT    Std. Error    
	0.0213        0.1097    
	*/
	
		
	* Column 3	
	****** DATASET: Keep private	
	use "Data/clean/ADPREG_TEMP.dta", clear	
	
	keep if Dmun == 0

	xtset rbd year
	g change_ppal = 1 if id_prin != l.id_prin
	g YearPpalChange = year if change_ppal == 1 & year >= 2012
	bys rbd: egen MinYearPpalChange = min(YearPpalChange)
	spread MinYearPpalChange, by(rbd)
	g t_pla = year - MinYearPpalChange
	
	g EverChange = (MinYearPpalChange != .)
 
	g PostChangePpal = 1 if (year >= MinYearPpalChange) 
	replace PostChangePpal = 0 if PostChangePpal == .
	cap drop t
	g t = year - MinYearPpalChange
	replace t = 0 if EverChange == 0
			
	keep if t>=-4 & t <= 3 & year >= 2009 & year <= 2016 & Dmun == 0
			
	keep SDall_fe_prin_2wayfe PostChangePpal rbd year MinYearPpalChange
	rename MinYearPpalChange min_adp
	replace min_adp = 0 if min_adp == 2017 | min_adp == .
	
	twowayfeweights SDall_fe_prin_2wayfe rbd year PostChangePpal,  type(feTR)
	di 804/ 5195
	* Sum of negative weights  -.0658051
		
	local w = 3
	local w1 = 3	
	did_multiplegt SDall_fe_prin_2wayfe rbd year PostChangePpal, placebo(`w1') breps(20) robust_dynamic dynamic(`w') cluster(rbd)	jointtestplacebo covariances seed(1111001) average_effect
		
	g avg = e(effect_average)
	g se_avg = `e(se_effect_average)'
	g tstat_avg = avg / se_avg
	g pval_pre = `e(p_jointplacebo)'
	sum avg tstat_avg se_avg pval_pre

	/*
		Overall summary of ATT's based on event-study/dynamic aggregation:  
		ATT    Std. Error

clear * 
set more off
adopath ++ "$Rep_information\_packages"

** [1] city people's daily files 
if 1 {
	
	** upzip data
	* unzip "./1_build/peoplesdaily/raw.zip" 
	* after unzipping, the folder structure should look like:
	*	"./1_build/peoplesdaily/raw/.."
	pause on
	pause !!! unzip raw data before proceeding; type q to continue
	pause off
	
	cap mkdir "$Rep_information/1_build/peoplesdaily/tmp"
	
	foreach keyword in smog pollutionregulation {
		
		local files: dir "$Rep_information/1_build/peoplesdaily/raw/city_`keyword'" files "*.xlsx"
		
		* Aggregate news counts for each city
		qui foreach file in `files' {
			import excel using "$Rep_information/1_build/peoplesdaily/raw/city_`keyword'/`file'", clear first
			
			if !(_N==1 & missing(title)) {
				
				* Time
				split date, parse("年")
				split date2, parse("月")
				split date22, parse("日")
				
				destring date1 date21 date221, replace
				keep if inrange(date1,2011,2016)
				
				gen rfrnc_wkos = date1*100+week(mdy(date21,date221,date1))
				
				* nbs code
				gen nbs6 = "`file'"
				replace nbs6 = substr(nbs6,1,6)
				destring nbs6, replace
				
				gen PDnews_`keyword' = 1
				
				* Aggregate to nbs x time
				cap collapse (sum) PDnews_`keyword', by(nbs6 rfrnc_wkos)
				if !_rc {
					lab var nbs6 "6-digit NBS code"
					lab var rfrnc_wkos "Reference week-of-sample"
					lab var PDnews_`keyword' "People's Daily news mentions on topic: `keyword'"
					
					compress
					saveold "$Rep_information/1_build/peoplesdaily/tmp/PDnews_`keyword'_`file'.dta", replace
				}
			}
		}
		
		* Append
		clear
		foreach file in `files' {
			cap append using "$Rep_information/1_build/peoplesdaily/tmp/PDnews_`keyword'_`file'.dta"
			cap erase "$Rep_information/1_build/peoplesdaily/tmp/PDnews_`keyword'_`file'.dta"
		}
		
		compress
		saveold "$Rep_information/1_build/peoplesdaily/tmp/PDnews_`keyword'.dta", replace
		
		* Merge to balanced city x time panel
		clear
		set obs 363
		gen nbs6 = ""
		local i = 0
		foreach file in `files' {
			local i = `i'+1
			replace nbs6 = "`file'" if _n==`i'
		}
		replace nbs6 = substr(nbs6,1,6)
		destring nbs6, replace
		expand 2016-2011+1
		bys nbs6: gen rfrnc_yr = 2011+_n-1

** [10] stata date to dsp date crosswalk file
* 	DSP data has time info up to week level, but DSP week is coded differently from Stata week
* 	DSP week 1 = the seven days since the first Sunday of the year
* 	(Stata week 1 = the seven days since Jan 1st of the year)
if 1 {

	* create day list from 2011-2016
	clear
	set obs 6
	gen rfrnc_yr = 2010+_n
	expand doy(mdy(12,31,rfrnc_yr))
	bys rfrnc_yr: gen rfrnc_doy = _n
	gen rfrnc_dt = mdy(1,1,rfrnc_yr)+rfrnc_doy-1
	format rfrnc_dt %td
	
	* identify each year's weeks, start by the first sunday
	gen rfrnc_dow = dow(rfrnc_dt)
	gen sundaystart = rfrnc_dt-rfrnc_dow
	format sundaystart %td
	
	gen dsp_yr = year(sundaystart)
	forvalues y = 2011/2016 {
		egen dspwk`y' = group(sundaystart) if dsp_yr==`y'
	}
	egen dspwk = rowmax(dspwk*)
	drop dspwk2*
	
	tab dspwk dsp_yr
	gen dsp_wkos = dsp_yr*100+dspwk
	keep rfrnc_dt dsp_yr dsp_wkos
	
	* assign Jan 1, 2011 to the first week of 2011
	replace dsp_wkos = 201101 if rfrnc_dt==18628
	replace dsp_yr = 2011 if rfrnc_dt==18628
	assert !missing(dsp_wkos)
	
	* define DSP month for each day:
	* 	assign (31) 30 days to "Jan" - "Nov" for (2012) 2011, 2013, 2014, 2015, (2016)
	*   "Dec" will have 30-35 days, depending on years
	sort dsp_yr rfrnc_dt
	by dsp_yr: gen dsp_doy = _n
	gen dspmo = .
	
	forvalues dsp_yr = 2011/2016 {
		if (`dsp_yr'==2011|`dsp_yr'==2013|`dsp_yr'==2014|`dsp_yr'==2015) {
			forvalues m = 1/12 {
				replace dspmo = `m' if inrange(dsp_doy,30*`m'-29,30*`m') & dsp_yr==`dsp_yr'
			}
		}
		else if (`dsp_yr'==2012|`dsp_yr'==2016) {
			forvalues m = 1/12 {
				replace dspmo = `m' if inrange(dsp_doy,31*`m'-30,31*`m') & dsp_yr==`dsp_yr'
			}
		}
	}
	assert dsp_doy>30*12 if missing(dspmo)
	replace dspmo = 12 if missing(dspmo)
	gen _dsp_mos = dsp_yr*100+dspmo
	
	* assign DSP week to DSP month
	* 	in cases where a week is linked to multiple month (ie days in a week cross over months), use the month that contain more days of that week
	egen dsp_mos = mode(_dsp_mos), minmode by(dsp_wkos)
	keep rfrnc_dt dsp_yr dsp_wkos dsp_mos
	
	* assign DSP quarter 
	* 	4 DSP months per quarter
	gen dspmo = dsp_mos - dsp_yr*100
	gen dspqtr = 1*inrange(dspmo,1,3)+2*inrange(dspmo,4,6)+3*inrange(dspmo,7,9)+4*inrange(dspmo,10,12)

content:
merge m:1 nbs6 using "$Rep_information\1_build\yearbook\proc\mphone_nbs6_avg_2011_2015.dta", keep(match master) nogen
		
		* region code
		tostring nbs6, gen(nbs2)
		replace nbs2 = substr(nbs2,1,2)
		destring nbs2, replace
		merge m:1 nbs2 using "$Rep_information\1_build\nbs\raw\nbs2_to_region_cw.dta", assert(using match) keep(match) nogen
		
		* event time
		gen d_post = .
		replace d_post = 1 if wave==1 & (dsp_mos > 201212)
		replace d_post = 1 if wave==2 & (dsp_mos > 201310)
		replace d_post = 1 if wave==3 & (dsp_mos > 201411)
		replace d_post = 0 if missing(d_post)
		lab var d_post "=1 if post information disclosure"
	
		egen tmpvar_mos = group(dsp_mos)
		assert dsp_mos==201301 if tmpvar_mos==25
		gen emonth = .
		replace emonth = tmpvar_mos - 25 if wave==1
		replace emonth = tmpvar_mos - 35 if wave==2
		replace emonth = tmpvar_mos - 48 if wave==3
		drop tmpvar_mos
		lab var emonth "Months since information disclosure"

		* fes
		egen fe_regionyr = group(region dsp_yr)
		egen fe_regionwkos = group(region dsp_wkos)
		
		
		* positive-integer event time for regs
		gen emonth25 = emonth
		replace emonth25=-25 if emonth<=-25
		replace emonth25=24 if emonth>=24
		replace emonth25=emonth25+25
		tab emonth25
		
		* event quater
		gen eqtr = .
		forvalues iqtr = -45(3)45 {
			replace eqtr = `iqtr' if (emonth==`iqtr'|emonth==`=`iqtr'+1'|emonth==`=`iqtr'+2') & !missing(emonth)
		}
		replace eqtr=-48 if mi(eqtr)
		gen eqtr25=eqtr
		replace eqtr25=-25 if emonth<=-25
		replace eqtr25=24 if emonth>=24
		replace eqtr25=eqtr25+25
		tab eqtr25
		
		* logs
		gen ln_aod = log(aod)
		gen ln_mort_age100_all_10c=log(mort_age100_all_10c)
		gen ln_mort_age100_cardioresp_10c = log(mort_age100_cardio_10c + mort_age100_resp_10c)
		gen ln_mort_age100_noncardioresp_10c=log(mort_age100_all_10c - mort_age100_cardio_10c - mort_age100_resp_10c)
		gen ln_mort_age100_injury_10c=log(mort_age100_injury_10c)
		gen ln_mort_age0_all_10c=log(mort_age0_all_10c)
		gen ln_mort_age1to14_all_10c=log(mort_age1to14_all_10c)
		gen ln_mort_age15to59_all_10c=log(mort_age15to59_all_10c)
		gen ln_mort_age60plus_all_10c=log(mort_age60plus_all_10c)
		gen ln_mort_age100_cardio_10c = log(mort_age100_cardio_10c)
		gen ln_mort_age100_resp_10c = log(mort_age100_resp_10c)
		
		* linear time trends
		egen tlin=group(dsp_wkos)
		
		* pollution iv variable
		merge 1:1 nbs6 dsp_wkos using "$Rep_information/1_build/iv/iv.dta", keep(match master) nogen keepusing(ivd_cos_aod)
		gen ln_ivd_cos_aod=log(ivd_cos_aod)
		
	compress
	saveold "$Rep_information\1_build\_confidential\regdata\proc\dsp_week.dta", replace

	replace oosample=1 if wave==3 & 201204< _time & _time<=201403

		tw 	scatter pm25_avg aod, msize(1) col(blue) || ///
			lfit pm25_avg aod, col(blue) lp(dot) ///

			xtitle(" ") ytitle(" ") ///
			legend(off) ///
			graphregion(col(white) margin(vsmall)) xsize(4.5) ///

	restore

	preserve
		egen histx_pm25 = cut(pm2_5_actual_new), at(10(5)130)
		gen N=1
		gcollapse (sum) N, by(histx_pm25)
		drop if mi(histx_pm25)

		gen histy_pm25=N/`r(sum)'
		
		tw 	bar histy_pm25 histx_pm25, barw(5) col(white) lcol(black) ///
			ylab(0(50)200, nogrid) xlab(0(0.1)0.1, nogrid) ///
			ytitle("PM{subscript:2.5} concentration (ug/m{superscript:3})") ///
			xtitle("Density") ///
			xsca(reverse) horiz ///
			legend(off) ///
			graphregion(col(white) margin(vsmall)) xsize(4.5) ///
			fxsize(16) saving(hy, replace)
	restore 
	
	* x-histogram: aod nobs by 0.05 bins 
	preserve 
		egen histx_aod = cut(dpblue_aod), at(-0.05(0.05)3)
		gen N=1
		gcollapse (sum) N, by(histx_aod)
		drop if mi(histx_aod)
		summ N 
		gen histy_aod=N/`r(sum)'
		
		tw  bar histy_aod histx_aod, barw(0.05) col(white) lcol(black) ///
			xlab(0(0.5)3) ylab(0(0.1)0.1, nogrid) ///
			xtitle("MODIS Aerosol Optical Depth") ///
			ytitle("Density") ///
			ysca(reverse) ///
			legend(off) ///
			graphregion(col(white) margin(vsmall)) xsize(4.5) ///
			fysize(16) saving(hx, replace)
	restore 
	
	* final chart
	graph 	combine hy.gph yx.gph hx.gph, ///
			hole(3) ///
			imargin(0 0 0 0) graphregion(col(white) margin(vsmall))  xsize(3.5)

	gr export "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_figures/appendix_figure5.pdf", replace

	erase "hx.gph"
	erase "hy.gph"
	erase "yx.gph"

	use "$Rep_information/1_build/appstore/appstore.dta", clear

	sort rfrnc_yr rfrnc_qtr
	gen time =_n
	
	* compute pollution and other category mean
	sort time
	egen Npollution = rowmean(appstore_Nair appstore_Nairquality appstore_Nairpollution appstore_Npm25)
	egen Nothrs = rowmean(appstore_Nstock appstore_Ngame appstore_Nmusic appstore_Nvideo appstore_Nreading appstore_Nnavigation appstore_Nshopping appstore_Nsports appstore_Neducation)

	* plot
	sort rfrnc_yr rfrnc_qtr

	label values time timelb

	drop answercontent
	
	gen year=substr(datetime,1,4)

	gen air =(strpos(content,"雾霾")!=0|strpos(content,"空气污染")!=0|strpos(content,"空气质量)")!=0|strpos(content,"PM2.5")!=0)*_N
	gen water =(strpos(content,"水污染")!=0|strpos(content,"水质量)")!=0)*_N
	
	* collapse to year
	gcollapse (mean) air water, by(year)
	destring year, replace 
	
	* plot

	ingap 1
	replace year=2010 if _n==1 
	replace air=3095.6389367 if _n==1 
	replace water=2283.7709751 if _n==1

// !!! Note: This module requires UnionPay transaction and CDC mortality data.

// 1. build city-year card file 

	use if rfrnc_mos <= 201604 using "$Rep_information/1_build/_confidential/regdata/city_week.dta", clear
	
	collapse (mean) N_card_cityyr aod (sum) cnt_all (first) wave , by(nbs6 rfrnc_yr)
	
	ren rfrnc_yr year 
	merge 1:1 nbs6 year using "$Rep_information/1_build/pollution/acag_nbs6.dta", keep(match master) nogen
	ren year  rfrnc_yr 
	
	gen d_post=.
	replace d_post = 1 if (wave==1 & rfrnc_yr>=2013) 
	replace d_post = 1 if (wave==2 & rfrnc_yr>=2014) 
	replace d_post = 1 if (wave==3 & rfrnc_yr>=2015) 
	replace d_post=0 if mi(d_post)
	
	gen pck_cnt_all = cnt_all*1000/N_card_cityyr
	gen ln_aod = log(aod)
	gen ln_acag_pm25all  = log(acag_pm25all)
	gen ln_acag_pm25site = log(acag_pm25site)
	
	compress 
	saveold "$Rep_information/1_build/_confidential/regdata/city_year.dta", replace 


// 2. build city-year mortality file

	use "$Rep_information/1_build/_confidential/regdata/dsp_week.dta", clear
	gcollapse (rawsum) d_age100_all (mean) mort_age100_all [aw=pop_age100], by(nbs6 dsp_yr)
	tempfile tmp_city_year
	save `tmp_city_year', replace 
	
	use "$Rep_information/1_build/_confidential/regdata/dsp_week.dta", clear
	bys nbs6: egen city_mean_aod=mean(aod)
	replace aod = aod/city_mean_aod
	
	collapse (mean) pop_age100 aod (first) wave , by(nbs6 dsp_yr)
	merge 1:1 nbs6 dsp_yr using `tmp_city_year', assert(match) nogen
	
	ren dsp_yr year 
	merge 1:1 nbs6 year using "$Rep_information/1_build/pollution/acag_nbs6.dta", keep(match master) nogen
	ren year  dsp_yr 
	
	bys nbs6: egen _mean_pm25_nbs6 = mean(acag_pm25site)
	replace acag_pm25site=acag_pm25site/_mean_pm25_nbs6
	drop _mean_pm25_nbs6
	
	bys nbs6: egen _mean_pm25_nbs6 = mean(acag_pm25all)
	replace acag_pm25all=acag_pm25all/_mean_pm25_nbs6
	drop _mean_pm25_nbs6
	
	gen d_post=.
	replace d_post = 1 if (wave==1 & dsp_yr>=2013) 
	replace d_post = 1 if (wave==2 & dsp_yr>=2014) 
	replace d_post = 1 if (wave==3 & dsp_yr>=2015) 
	replace d_post=0 if mi(d_post)
	
	gen ln_aod = log(aod)
	gen ln_acag_pm25all  = log(acag_pm25all)
	gen ln_acag_pm25site = log(acag_pm25site)
	gen ln_mort_age100_all=log(mort_age100_all)	
	
	compress 
	saveold "$Rep_information/1_build/_confidential/regdata/dsp_year.dta", replace

	use  "$Rep_information/1_build/_confidential/regdata/city_year.dta", clear 
		
	* panel a
	reghdfe pck_cnt_all  c.ln_acag_pm25site##c.d_post [aw=N_card_cityyr], a(nbs6 rfrnc_yr) vce(cluster nbs6)
	tempfile panel_a_card

	* population
	merge 1:1 nbs6 using "$Rep_information/1_build/yearbook/population_nbs6_avg_2011_2015.dta", keep(match master) nogen
		
	* so2 emissions
	merge 1:1 nbs6 using "$Rep_information/1_build/pollution/raw/so2_city_2006.dta", keep(match master) nogen
	
	* table data
	forv i=1/3{
		
	// row 1: number of cities
		count if wave==`i'
		local num`i'=`r(N)'

		cap gen _m_city_population= city_population / 1000
		summ _m_city_population if wave == `i'
		local pop_m`i' =string(`r(mean)',"%3.2f")
		local pop_sd`i'=string(`r(sd)',"%3.2f")
	
	// row 3: gdp per cap

		local gdp_m`i' =string(`r(mean)',"%5.0f")
		local gdp_sd`i'=string(`r(sd)',"%5.0f")

		local aod_sd`i'=string(`r(sd)',"%4.3f")

		local pm25_m`i' =string(`r(mean)',"%3.1f")
		local pm25_sd`i'=string(`r(sd)',"%3.1f")

		cap gen _t_emit_so2=emit_so2/1000
		summ _t_emit_so2 if wave==`i'
		local so2_m`i' =string(`r(mean)',"%5.0f")
		local so2_sd`i'=string(`r(sd)',"%5.0f")

		summ temp if wave==`i'
		local temp_m`i' =string(`r(mean)',"%3.1f")
		local temp_sd`i'=string(`r(sd)',"%3.1f")

	}

	clear

		replace `col'="``col'_a'" if _n==1
		replace `col'="``col'_b'" if _n==2
		replace `col'="``col'_c'" if _n==3
		replace `col'="``col'_d'" if _n==4
		replace `col'="``col'_e'" if _n==5
	}

	save `sumstats', replace 
	
	
	use `panel_a1', clear 
	drop if var == "r2"

	drop if strpos(var, "_cons_") > 0
	replace var = "Log(Pollution)" if var =="d_post_coef" 
	
	append using `panel_a2'
	drop if var == "r2"

	bys rfrnc_yr: gen rfrnc_month=_n

	merge 1:1 rfrnc_mos using "$Rep_information/1_build/peoplesdaily/peoplesdaily.dta", assert(match master) nogen
	replace PDnews_smog = 0 if mi(PDnews_smog)
	
	* plot
	sort rfrnc_mos
	gen time = _n
	bys rfrnc_yr: egen ymean_PDnews_smog = mean(PDnews_smog)

		wyoung, cmd("`cmd1'" "`cmd2'" "`cmd3'" "`cmd4'" ) familyp(ln_aodXpost) bootstraps(500) seed(20) cluster(nbs6) replace
		saveold "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/pwyoung_tab3col4.dta", replace 
	restore 

	forv i = 1/4 {
	
		use "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/pwyoung_tab3col`i'.dta", clear 
		
		keep outcome coef stderr p pwyoung
		format coef %5.4f 
		format stderr %6.4f
		format p %6.4f
		format pwyoung %6.4f
		
		ren (coef stderr p pwyoung) (col`i'_1 col`i'_2 col`i'_3 col`i'_4)
		gen id=_n
		reshape long col`i'_, i(id) j(_j)
		ren col`i'_ col`i'
		
		gen p=col`i' if _j==3
		bys id: egen _p=max(p)
		drop p 
		ren _p p
		
		tostring col`i', replace force format(%6.3f)
		replace col`i'="("+col`i'+")" if _j==2
		replace col`i'="["+col`i'+"]" if _j==4
		drop if _j==3
		
		keep i outcome _j col`i'
		
		saveold "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab3col`i'.dta", replace 
	}
	
	use "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab3col1.dta", clear 
	merge 1:1 _j outcome using "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab3col2.dta", assert(match) nogen
	merge 1:1 _j outcome using "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab3col3.dta", assert(match) nogen
	merge 1:1 _j outcome using "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab3col4.dta", assert(match) nogen

	keep if _j==4
	
	gen pwyoung=outcome 
	replace pwyoung="Panel A. General mortality" 						if pwyoung=="ln_mort_age100_all_10c"
	replace pwyoung="Panel B. Causes of death: cadiorespiratory" 		if pwyoung=="ln_mort_age100_cardioresp_10c"
	replace pwyoung="Panel C. Causes of death: non-cadiorespiratory" 	if pwyoung=="ln_mort_age100_noncardioresp_10c"
	replace pwyoung="Panel D. Causes of death: injury" 					if pwyoung=="ln_mort_age100_injury_10c"
	
	list pwyoung col1 col2 col3 col4, sep(0)
	
	* save a dta copy 
	saveold "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/table3westfallyoung.dta", replace
	
	erase "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab3col1.dta"
	erase "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab3col2.dta"
	erase "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab3col3.dta"
	erase "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab3col4.dta"
}

wyoung, cmd("`cmd1'" "`cmd2'" "`cmd3'" "`cmd4'") familyp(ln_aodXpost) bootstraps(500) seed(20) cluster(nbs6) replace
		saveold "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/pwyoung_tab4col3.dta", replace 
	restore 
		
	preserve 
		local cmd1 reghdfe ln_mort_age0_all_10c 			ln_aod d_post ln_aodXpost, a(nbs6 fe_regionwkos i.nbs6##c.tlin) vce(cluster nbs6)
		local cmd2 reghdfe ln_mort_age1to14_all_10c 		ln_aod d_post ln_aodXpost, a(nbs6 fe_regionwkos i.nbs6##c.tlin) vce(cluster nbs6)
		local cmd3 reghdfe ln_mort_age15to59_all_10c 		ln_aod d_post ln_aodXpost, a(nbs6 fe_regionwkos i.nbs6##c.tlin) vce(cluster nbs6)
		local cmd4 reghdfe ln_mort_age60plus_all_10c 		ln_aod d_post ln_aodXpost, a(nbs6 fe_regionwkos i.nbs6##c.tlin) vce(cluster nbs6)
		wyoung, cmd("`cmd1'" "`cmd2'" "`cmd3'" "`cmd4'") familyp(ln_aodXpost) bootstraps(500) seed(20) cluster(nbs6) replace
		saveold "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/pwyoung_tab4col4.dta", replace 
	restore 

	forv i = 1/4 {
	
		use "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/pwyoung_tab4col`i'.dta", clear 
		
		keep outcome coef stderr p pwyoung
		format coef %5.4f 
		format stderr %6.4f
		format p %6.4f
		format pwyoung %6.4f
		
		ren (coef stderr p pwyoung) (col`i'_1 col`i'_2 col`i'_3 col`i'_4)
		gen id=_n
		reshape long col`i'_, i(id) j(_j)
		ren col`i'_ col`i'
		
		gen p=col`i' if _j==3
		bys id: egen _p=max(p)
		drop p 
		ren _p p
		
		tostring col`i', replace force format(%6.3f)
		replace col`i'="("+col`i'+")" if _j==2
		replace col`i'="["+col`i'+"]" if _j==4
		drop if _j==3
		
		keep i outcome _j col`i'
		
		saveold "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab4col`i'.dta", replace 
	}
	
	use "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab4col1.dta", clear 
	merge 1:1 _j outcome using "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab4col2.dta", assert(match) nogen
	merge 1:1 _j outcome using "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab4col3.dta", assert(match) nogen
	merge 1:1 _j outcome using "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab4col4.dta", assert(match) nogen
	sort i _j
	
	keep if _j==4
	
	gen pwyoung=outcome 
	replace pwyoung="Panel A. Age groups: infants" 		if pwyoung=="ln_mort_age0_all_10c"
	replace pwyoung="Panel B. Age groups: 1-14" 		if pwyoung=="ln_mort_age1to14_all_10c"
	replace pwyoung="Panel C. Age groups: 15-59" 		if pwyoung=="ln_mort_age15to59_all_10c"
	replace pwyoung="Panel D. Age groups: 60 and above" if pwyoung=="ln_mort_age60plus_all_10c"
	
	list pwyoung col1 col2 col3 col4, sep(0)
	
	* save a dta copy 
	saveold "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/table4westfallyoung.dta", replace
	
	erase "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab4col1.dta"
	erase "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab4col2.dta"
	erase "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab4col3.dta"
	erase "$Rep_information/2_analysis/output_tables/tmp_pwyoung_tab4col4.dta"
	
}

******************************************************************************************************************************
******************************************************************************************************************************
***
*** Figure 1: 61 Years of RTA Estimates with the Gravity Model of Trade
*** 
******************************************************************************************************************************
******************************************************************************************************************************


*********************
*1. Prepare the data*
*********************
use ${usr_data}\data_sdid_small, clear
*joinby exporter importer year using ${ext_data}\fta_data_main, unmatched(master)
gen interval=1 if year==1980 | year==1985 | year==1990 | year==1995 | year==2000 | year==2005 | year==2010 | year==2015

**************************
*2. `jwdid' specification*
**************************
jwdid trade, ivar(id_ci_cj) tvar(year) gvar(first_treat_3) method(ppmlhdfe) fe(idt_ci idt_cj brdr_time)
keep if e(sample)==1
estat simple, predict(xb)
mat B = [r(b)]
mat V = (r(V))
matrix colnames B = RTA_3
matrix colnames V = RTA_3
matrix rownames V = RTA_3
ereturn post B V
parmest, saving(${usr_data}\est_11, replace) 
save ${usr_data}\rta_did, replace

******************************
*3. Tinbergen's specification*
******************************
use ${usr_data}\rta_did, clear
gen ln_trade=ln(trade)
gen LN_GDP_EXP=ln(gdp_pwt_cur_o)
gen LN_GDP_IMP=ln(gdp_pwt_cur_d)
reg ln_trade RTA_3 DIST LN_GDP_EXP LN_GDP_IMP if exporter!=importer & interval==1, ro
parmest, saving(${usr_data}\est_1, replace) 
estimates store est_1
************************
*4. Additional controls*
************************
reg ln_trade RTA_3 DIST LN_GDP_EXP LN_GDP_IMP CLNY CNTG LANG if exporter!=importer & interval==1, ro
parmest, saving(${usr_data}\est_2, replace) 
estimates store est_2
*****************************
*5. Multilateral resistances*
*****************************
egen exp_time=group(exporter year)
egen imp_time=group(importer year)
reghdfe ln_trade RTA_3 DIST CNTG CLNY LANG if exporter!=importer & interval==1, absorb(idt_ci idt_cj) 
parmest, saving(${usr_data}\est_3, replace) 
estimates store est_3
*******************
*6. PPML estimator*
*******************

******************************************************************************************************************************
******************************************************************************************************************************
***
*** Figure 4: Weights of OLS ETWFE and TWFE estimator
*** 
******************************************************************************************************************************
******************************************************************************************************************************

** 0) open data set
use ${usr_data}\data_sdid_small, clear


** 1) OLS: ETWFE
jwdid lntrade, ivar(id_ci_cj) tvar(year) gvar(first_treat_3) fe(idt_ci idt_cj brdr_time)
gen sample_ETWFE = e(sample)
mat temp = r(table)
scalar dim_B = `=colsof(temp)'-1
mat B=temp[1,1..`=dim_B']
mat index=J(1,`=dim_B',.)
mat year=J(1,`=dim_B',.)
mat first_treat_3=J(1,`=dim_B',.)
local names: colnames B
forval i=1(1)`=dim_B' {
	mat index[1,`i'] = `i'
	local name : word `i' of `names'
	local temp = substr("`name'",1,4)
	mat first_treat_3[1,`i'] = `temp'
	local hash_idx = strpos("`name'","#")
	local temp = substr("`name'",`hash_idx'+1,4)
	mat year[1,`i'] =  `temp'
}


** 2) OLS: TWFE
reghdfe lntrade RTA_3 if sample_ETWFE==1, absorb(idt_ci idt_cj id_ci_cj brdr_time) cluster(id_ci_cj)
mat temp = e(b)
mat B_TWFE = J(1,`=dim_B',.)
mat B_TWFE[1,1] = temp[1,1]


** 3) Compute weights
reghdfe RTA_3 if sample_ETWFE==1, absorb(idt_ci idt_cj id_ci_cj brdr_time) cluster(id_ci_cj) resid

* obtain residuals
predict resid, res
scalar N_all = 0

* initialise matrices
mat eps=J(1,`=dim_B',.)
mat N_treat=J(1,`=dim_B',.)
mat weight=J(1,`=dim_B',.)

* compute epsilon and N
forval i=1(1)`=dim_B' {
	local year = year[1,`i']
	local first_treat_3 = first_treat_3[1,`i']
	qui sum resid if year==`year' & first_treat_3==`first_treat_3', d
	mat eps[1,`i'] = r(mean)
	mat N_treat[1,`i'] = r(N)
	scalar N_all = `=N_all'+r(N)

gen n_certified = cond(determ_code=="D", 0, n_petitions)

replace n_certified = 0 if missing(n_certified)

import delimited "$raw_data/ui/CAINC35__ALL_AREAS_1969_2020.csv", stripquotes(yes) numericcols(_all) clear
drop if missing(geofips) | mod(geofips, 1000) == 0

keep if inlist(linecode,2100,2110,2330,2400)
forvalues i = 9(1)60 {
	replace v`i' = 0 if v`i' == . 
	local stub = `i' + 1960
	rename v`i' v`stub'
}
reshape long v, i(geofips linecode) j(year)

drop if v == 0

reshape wide v, i(geofips year) j(linecode)
rename (geofips v2100 v2110 v2330 v2400) (county retire_di social_security snap_transfer ui)
keep county year retire_di social_security snap_transfer ui
foreach v in retire_di social_security snap_transfer ui {
	gen log_`v' = log(`v')
}
replace county = 12025 if county == 12086
replace county = 46113 if county == 46102

save "$working_data/county_transfer_data.dta", replace

drop czone

rename cty_fips county

	R_a1997_row_90w R_a2001_all_90w R_a2004_all_90w

preserve

	w_wtariff<=`r(p50)' & year == 1990 & w_wtariff!=0, 2, cond( ///
	w_wtariff == 0 & year == 1990, 1,.)))

bysort sic: egen t_category = max(temp_cat)
bysort sic: egen tariff_90 = total(w_wtariff / (year == 1990))

gen log_sic_import_usitc = log(tot_sic4_import_usitc)

gen log_mex_to_row = log(mex_to_row_tot *1000)

keep year sic tot_sic4_import_usitc tot_sic4_import_com row_to_usa_tot mex_to_row_tot t_category ///
	log_sic_import_usitc log_sic_import_com log_mex_to_row log_row_to_usa log_w_wtariff w_wtariff ///

bysort sic: keep if _N == 11

sort year sic 
save "$working_data/imports_sic_year.dta", replace

forval i =1973/1979 {

} 
				
* 1980-1996 have exact month and day

use "$working_data/psid_nokids.dta", clear
format hhmem seq relationhd employment hd_* wf_* %2.0f 

* replace codebook's missing values to be missing (".") 
* month of interview 
*creating a fictitious month=june
recode doim (0=6)
replace doim=6 if missing(doim)& !missing(doiy) //fictitious month for missing  months
recode seq (0 = .)   
recode doby (0 9999 = .) 
* sep is most common birth month, assume that is birth month 
recode dobm (99 = 9) (0 = .)

clonevar rawage=age
recode yrseduc (0 99 98 = .)  
recode hrs hd_hrs wf_hrs (6730 7800 9999 = .)   //9,999 NA, 6,730 Wild code (wf), 7,800 Wild code(hd)
replace employment = . if inlist(employment, 9, 0)  //
recode hd_worked (9 0 =.)     //on year t-1   //9	NA DK, 0 Inap.
recode wf_worked (9 0 =.)     //on year t-1
recode hd_working (9 0 =.)   //on year t
recode wf_working (9 0 =.)   //on year t


*BUILD VARS
