gen spouse = . 
replace spouse = 0 if relationhd == 1 & seq == 1   //1 "Head"
replace spouse = 1 if relationhd == 2 & seq == 2   //2 "Spouse" 

* date of interview 
gen doi = mdy(doim, 15, doiy) 		//ficticious day of int
format doi %td  

* calculate true year & month of birth 
* year of birth 
* set most commonly reported doby to be doby

* month of birth

replace dobm = truedobm 
by id: replace dobm=9 if missing(dobm) & !missing(doby) //0 changes
gen ydobm = ym(doby, dobm) 
format ydobm %tm 
drop true* 
/*note: here we can drop all obs with missing birthdate, we are carrying useless information for generatong new vars*/
bysort id (ydobm): drop if missing(ydobm[1])

* working now 
gen emp_lw = . 
la var emp_lw "In paid work last week"

replace emp_lw = 1 if employment == 1   //1 Working now

content:
drop true* 
/*note: here we can drop all obs with missing birthdate, we are carrying useless information for generatong new vars*/
bysort id (ydobm): drop if missing(ydobm[1])

* working now 
gen emp_lw = . 
la var emp_lw "In paid work last week" 
* use employment status if available 
replace emp_lw = 1 if employment == 1   //1 Working now  
replace emp_lw = 0 if employment > 1 & !missing(employment)  // laid off, unem, retired, student, keeping house, other
* recode as missing if outside of workforce ages 
replace emp_lw = . if !inrange(age, 16, 99) 

*emp_hrs 
gen hdwf_hrs=.
replace hdwf_hrs=1 if hd_hrs>1  & spouse==0 & !missing(hd_hrs)
replace hdwf_hrs=0 if hd_hrs==0 & spouse==0 & !missing(hd_hrs)
replace hdwf_hrs=1 if wf_hrs>1 & spouse==1  & !missing(wf_hrs)
replace hdwf_hrs=0 if wf_hrs==0 & spouse==1  & !missing(wf_hrs)
* recode as missing if outside of workforce ages 
replace hdwf_hrs = . if !inrange(age, 16, 99) 
gen emp_hrs=.
replace emp_hrs=1 if hrs>1  & !missing(hrs)
replace emp_hrs=0 if hrs==0  & !missing(hrs)
replace emp_hrs=. if hd_hrs==. &  wf_hrs==. & !missing(hrs)
replace emp_hrs=hdwf_hrs if missing(emp_hrs) & !missing(hdwf_hrs)
* recode as missing if outside of workforce ages 
replace emp_hrs = . if !inrange(age, 16, 99) 

*employment based on hd and wife 
gen ind_emp=.
replace ind_emp=1 if hd_employment==1 & spouse==0 & !missing(hd_employment)
replace ind_emp=0 if hd_employment>1 & spouse==0 & !missing(hd_employment)
replace ind_emp=1 if wf_employment==1 & spouse==1 & !missing(wf_employment)
replace ind_emp=0 if wf_employment>1 & spouse==1 & !missing(wf_employment)
* recode as missing if outside of workforce ages 
replace ind_emp = . if !inrange(age, 16, 99) 

* in work force 
gen inlf = emp_lw  // 1 working now
	
* use employment status, if available 
* 2 = laid off, 3 = unemployed 
replace inlf = 1 if inlist(employment, 2, 3)
		
* recode as missing if outside of workforce ages 
replace inlf = . if !inrange(age, 16, 99) 

* annual hours worked 
gen annhrs = hrs 

* employment binary from annhrs 
gen hrs_dummy = (annhrs >0) if !missing(annhrs) 

* earnings 
* individual income  
	//fyi: all info refers to t-1 values 
* general assumptions: 
	// negative values -> 1 
	// 0 values are kept only if in the website explicitly mentioned 0 are valid values, otherwise missing
	// maximum values 99999, 999999, or 9999999 are ceils representing values over those values-> missing 	
//range y90-92, y04-y16
replace inc=1 if inc<0
gen income = inc    
* if head use head's income 
//hd_inc: range y67-y16
replace hd_inc=1 if hd_inc<0 
replace income = hd_inc if missing(income) & spouse == 0 

* if wife has main income, use that 
//wf_inc: range y67-y92, wf_inc_ex:y92-y16  , wf_inc_bs:y92-y16 , inc_fm: y92-y16
egen extra_wf_inc=rowtotal(wf_inc_ex  wf_inc_bs inc_fm)   //inc_Fm has negative value 
replace wf_inc = extra_wf_inc if doiy >= 1993 
replace wf_inc=1 if wf_inc<0
replace income = wf_inc if missing(income) & spouse == 1 
* bottom code income 
replace income = 1 if income < 0 
* family income 
* before 1994, no negative amounts were allowed (they were coded at $1) 
replace hh_inc = 1 if hh_inc < 0
method: trade exposure event study
title: Local Economic and Political Effects of Trade Deals: Evidence from NAFTA

content:
//wf_inc: range y67-y92, wf_inc_ex:y92-y16  , wf_inc_bs:y92-y16 , inc_fm: y92-y16
egen extra_wf_inc=rowtotal(wf_inc_ex  wf_inc_bs inc_fm)   //inc_Fm has negative value 
replace wf_inc = extra_wf_inc if doiy >= 1993 
replace wf_inc=1 if wf_inc<0
replace income = wf_inc if missing(income) & spouse == 1 
* bottom code income 
replace income = 1 if income < 0 
* family income 
* before 1994, no negative amounts were allowed (they were coded at $1) 
replace hh_inc = 1 if hh_inc < 0 
* generate adjusted hh income 
gen hh_inc_adj = hh_inc/sqrt(hhsize) 
* spousal income 
* use head's income if person is wife 
gen sp_inc = hd_inc if spouse == 1 
* use head's income if person is head 
replace sp_inc = wf_inc if spouse == 0 & missing(sp_inc) 

* race & ethnicity
/*for head: y68-y84:  1 White, 2 Black, 3 Spanish-American, 7 Other, 9 NA
			y85-y89 : 1 White, 2 Black, 3 American Indian, 4 Asian, Pacific Islander, 7 Other, 8 More than 2 mentions, 9 NA DK
			y90-2003 :1 White, 2 Black, 3 American Indian, 4 Asian, Pacific Islander, 5 Mentions Latino origin or descent, 6 Mentions color other than black or white, 7 Other, 9 NA
			y05-y17  :1 White, 2 Black, 3 American Indian, 4 Asian, 5 Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander, 7 Other, 0 Wild code, 9 NA
	
	for wf: y85-y89 : 1 White, 2 Black, 3 American Indian, 4 Asian, Pacific Islander,7 Other,	8 More than 2 mentions, 9 NA DK, 0 Inap
			y90-03:   1 White, 2 Black, 3 American Indian, 4 Asian, Pacific Islander, 5 Mentions Latino origin or descent, 6 Mentions color other than black or white, 7 Other, 9 NA DK, 0 inap
			y05-y17 : 1 White, 2 Black, 3 American Indian, 4 Asian, 5 Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander, 7 Other, 9 NA, 0 inap
Note: values change across years and they should be considered  in creation of new vars: latino  or homogenization
*/
* head and wife 
gen race = hd_race if spouse == 0 
replace race = wf_race if  spouse == 1 
* others 
* before 1983, we only know if person is child, sibling, etc 
* chlildren 
* if head and wife are same race, assume child is that race 
replace race = hd_race if hhmem == 3 & (hd_race == wf_race)   //hhmem  = 3 Son or daughter
* if head is one race and wife is missing, assume child is that race 
replace race = hd_race if hhmem == 3 & !missing(hd_race) & inlist(wf_race, ., 0) 
* siblings of head, same race as head 
replace race = hd_race if hhmem == 4   //hhem=4 Brother or sister of Head
* after 1983 we have more detail 
// 30 Son or daughter of Reference Person, 40 Brother or sister of Reference Person
* if person is child or sibling of head, assume same race 
replace race = hd_race if inlist(hhmem, 30, 40) & !inlist(hd_race, ., 0)  //
* if person is child or sibling of wife, assume same race 
//33 Stepson or stepdaughter, 5 Son or daughter of Partner but not Hd , 37 Son-in-law or daughter-in-law of hd
// 47 Brother-in-law or sister-in-law of hd, 48 Brother or sister of  hd's cohabitor
replace race = wf_race if inlist(hhmem, 33, 35, 37, 47, 48) & !inlist(wf_race, ., 0) 

* latino indicator 
gen Ilatino =  (race==3 & inrange(year, 1968, 1984)) |(race==5 & inrange(year, 1990,2003)) //applies for hd and wf
replace Ilatino = . if missing(race) 
bys id: egen latino = max(Ilatino) 
* race 
/*Note: we have to be pretty careful here because of variation in values across years*/
recode race (6 7 8 9 = 7) ( 0 = .) 
recode race (3=5) if inrange(year, 1968,1984) //3 Spanish-American
recode race (5=4) if inrange(year, 2005,2017) // 5 pacific islander 
egen racemax = mode(race), by(id) minmode 
bys id: replace race = racemax 
label define raceL 1 "White" 2 "Black" 3 "Native American" 4 "Asian, Pacific Islander" 5 "Latino" 7 "Other, mixed" 
label val race raceL 
drop racemax Ilatino 
	
* fix age variable 
* age is wrong if it decreases instead of increases 
bysort id (doiy): gen wrongage = ((age[_n] < age[_n - 1] & age[_n - 1] != .) | ///
						(age[_n] > age[_n + 1] & age[_n + 1] != .)) & age[_n] != . 
* also wrong if it's more than two years from imputed age 
replace wrongage = 1 if abs(doiy - doby - age) > 2 ///
						& !missing(ydobm) & !missing(age)
* also is simply inteview year < birth year
replace wrongage=1 if doiy<doby
* replace with imputed age if age is wrong or missing 
/*note: here doi is a day-date var and ydobm is a month-date var , so they are not comparable
	It will be correct: floor((doi - ydobm)/12)  -> floor((mofd(doi) - ydobm)/12) */
replace age = floor((mofd(doi) - ydobm)/12) if (wrongage == 1 | missing(age)) ///
				& mofd(doi) > ydobm & !missing(doi) & !missing(ydobm)
method: trade exposure event study
title: Local Economic and Political Effects of Trade Deals: Evidence from NAFTA

gen  ind = hd_ind if spouse == 0

* weights 
/* full ranges: i_weight -> individual sample weights, 1968-1989 // actually goes unitl 1992
				i_c_weight ->combined latino and core weights, 1990-1996
				i_clong_weight -> combined longitudinal weights, 1997-2017

content:
/**********************************************************************/
/*  SECTION: Simulated Vulnerability  			
    Notes: */
/**********************************************************************/
 
/*----------------------------------------------------*/
   /* [>   1. create simulated vulnerability   <] */ 
/*----------------------------------------------------*/

  
set seed $myseed 
use "$working_data/tariff_employment.dta", clear
drop if missing(mex_rca)
bysort sic year : keep if _n == 1
sort sic year 

keep if year==1990 
gen zero_1990=(w_wtariff==0) if w_wtariff<.  
gen pos_1990=w_wtariff>0 if w_wtariff<. 

cumul w_wtariff if pos_1990==1, gen(cumul) 

forval x=1/5 { 
gen cumul_`x'=cumul^`x' 
} 
sort cumul 

reg w_wtariff cumul_1 - cumul_5 if pos_1990==1 
predict predict if pos_1990==1 
matrix coeff=e(b) 
matrix list coeff


line w_wtariff predict cumul if pos==1, lc(red blue) lp(connect shortdash) lw(medium thick) ylabel(0(.1).3) ///
	xti("Cumulative distribution") yti("Value of actual and predicted tariffs") ///
	legend(on ring(0) pos(10) rows(2) label(1 "Value of actual 1990 tariffs") ///
		label(2 "Value of predicted 1990 tariffs")) 
graph export 	"$results/tariff_pdf.pdf", replace 
sort sic 
local reps=1000

forval r=1/`reps' { 

	gen fake_t_`r'=0 if zero_1990==1 
	gen temp=uniform() 
	replace fake_t_`r'= /// 
	temp*coeff[1,1] + temp^2*coeff[1, 2] + temp^3*coeff[1, 3] + temp^4*coeff[1, 4] + temp^5*coeff[1, 5] if pos_1990==1 
	drop temp 
	
	gen fake_t_uni`r'=0 if zero_1990 == 1
	replace fake_t_uni`r' = uniform() * 0.4 if pos_1990 == 1

	gen fake_t_au`r'=uniform() * 0.4 
}

tempfile sim 
save `sim'

use "$working_data/tariff_employment.dta", clear
keep if year == 1990 & !missing(mex_rca)

merge m:1 sic year using `sim'

egen double denom = total(emp * mex_rca), by(county year) 
egen double numer = total(emp * mex_rca * w_wtariff), by(county year) 
gen float county_vul_own = numer/denom

* Generate fake vulnerability in 1990  
forval r=1/`reps' { 
	egen double numer_fake`r' = total(emp * mex_rca * fake_t_`r'), by(county year) 
	gen float county_vul_own_f`r' = numer_fake`r'/denom
	
	egen double numer_fake_uni`r' = total(emp * mex_rca * fake_t_uni`r'), by(county year)
	gen float county_vul_own_funi`r' = numer_fake_uni`r' / denom
	
	egen double numer_fake_au`r' = total(emp * mex_rca * fake_t_au`r'), by(county year)
	gen float county_vul_own_fau`r' = numer_fake_au`r' / denom

}

recode  help_blacks_1992_clean (5 6 7=1) (0 1 2 3 4=0)
recode  role_gov_1992_clean (5 6 7=1) (0 1 2 3 4=0)
recode  abortion_1992_clean (4=1) (0 1 2 3=0)
recode  health_reform_1992_clean (5 6 7=1) (0 1 2 3 4=0)

***Label vars for the table 
label var favor_limits_1992_dk "Favor import limits" 
label var coll_grad_1992 "College grad" 
label var union_hh_1992 "Union household (dummy)" 

gen move_right_92_94_100=move_right_92_94*100 
label var move_right_92_94_100 "Moved right between 1992, 1993 (x 100)" 

*****Paper version (import-limits for main table, NAFTA for appendix table) ;
eststo clear 
eststo: reg move_right_92_94_100 favor_limits_1992_dk `controls_demog' `controls_issues_classic' `controls_issues_recent' [pw = V923008]  if move_right_92_94<.  , robust cluster(fipstate) 
local baseline_beta_limits = _b[favor_limits_1992_dk] 

***Gen South 
destring fipstate, replace 
gen south=inlist(fipstate, 10, 11, 12, 13, 24, 37, 45, 51, 54, 1, 21, 28, 47, 5, 22, 40, 48) 

****Heterogeneity by demographic & other political views ;
****Take the col. (5) spec and split by various political views ;
gen graph_cat=_n  if _n<35 
gen coeff=. 
gen upper=. 
gen lower=. 
local counter=0 
local counter2=0 

foreach cond in "white==1" "white==1 & male==1" "white==1 & coll_grad_1992==0" "south==1" "weekly_relig_1992==1" "abortion_1992_clean==0" "help_blacks_1992_clean==1" "oppose_gays_military_1992==1"  { 
  local counter=`counter' + 1  
  local counter2=30 - 3*`counter' 
  
  reg move_right_92_94_100 favor_limits_1992_dk `controls_demog' `controls_issues_classic' `controls_issues_recent' [pw = V923008] if (`cond'==1), robust cl(fipstate) 
  
  replace coeff=_b[favor_limits_1992_dk] if graph_cat>`counter2' - .001 & graph_cat<`counter2' + .0001 
  replace upper=_b[favor_limits_1992_dk] + 2*_se[favor_limits_1992_dk] if graph_cat>`counter2' - .001 & graph_cat<`counter2' + .0001 
  replace lower=_b[favor_limits_1992_dk] - 2*_se[favor_limits_1992_dk] if graph_cat>`counter2' - .001 & graph_cat<`counter2' + .0001 
  
  reg move_right_92_94_100 favor_limits_1992_dk `controls_demog' `controls_issues_classic' `controls_issues_recent' [pw = V923008] if ~(`cond'==1), robust cl(fipstate) 
  
  replace coeff=_b[favor_limits_1992_dk] if graph_cat>`counter2' - 1 - .001 & graph_cat<`counter2' - 1 + .0001 
  replace upper=_b[favor_limits_1992_dk] + 2*_se[favor_limits_1992_dk] if graph_cat>`counter2' -1 - .001 & graph_cat<`counter2' -1 + .0001 
  replace lower=_b[favor_limits_1992_dk] - 2*_se[favor_limits_1992_dk] if graph_cat>`counter2' -1  - .001 & graph_cat<`counter2' -1 + .0001 
} 

****Label categories ;
label define graph_cat 15 "White men" 14 "Others"  12 "Oppose abortion" 11 "Others" 9 "Gov't sd not help blacks" 8 "Others" 6 "Oppose gays in military" 5 "Others"  

label values graph_cat graph_cat 

#d ;
 twoway 

/**white v others**/
(rcap upper lower graph_cat if graph_cat==27, horizontal color(red) lw(medium)) 
(scatter  graph_cat coeff  if graph_cat==27,  color(red) m(circle_hollow) mlw(medium) msize(small))
(rcap upper lower graph_cat if graph_cat==26, horizontal color(midblue) lw(medium)) 
(scatter  graph_cat coeff  if graph_cat==26,  color(midblue) m(circle_hollow) mlw(medium) msize(small))
  
/**white men v others**/
(rcap upper lower graph_cat if graph_cat==24, horizontal color(red) lw(medium)) 
(scatter  graph_cat coeff  if graph_cat==24,  color(red) m(circle_hollow) mlw(medium) msize(small))
(rcap upper lower graph_cat if graph_cat==23, horizontal color(midblue) lw(medium))

cap program drop quartsty
program define quartsty, rclass

	* Colors
	local c1 "green"
	local c2 "pink" 
	local c3 "midblue" 
	local c4 "black"
	local c5 "maroon" 	
return local q1_sty = "lwidth(medthin) lpattern(dash) lcolor(`c1') msymbol(+) mcolor(`c1') msize(medsmall)"
return local q2_sty = "lwidth(medthin) lpattern(short_dash) lcolor(`c2') msymbol(Dh) mcolor(`c2') msize(medsmall)"
return local q3_sty = "lwidth(medthin) lpattern(longdash_dot) lcolor(`c3') msymbol(T) mcolor(`c3') msize(medsmall)"
return local q4_sty = "lwidth(med) lpattern(solid) lcolor(`c4') msymbol(O) mcolor(`c4') msize(medsmall)"
return local q5_sty = "lwidth(med) lpattern(solid) lcolor(`c5') msymbol(Oh) mcolor(`c5') msize(medsmall)"
end
 
/*----------------------------------------------------*/
   /* [>   Style for Event Study Plots   <] */ 
/*----------------------------------------------------*/

cap program drop essty_main
program define essty_main, rclass
	* Colors
	local c3 "black"
	local c2 "orange" 
	local c1 "midblue" 
	local c4 "green"
	local c5 "maroon" 
/* Scatter */	
return local es_sct1_sty =	"msize(small) mlc(`c1') mfc(white)"
return local es_sct2_sty =	"msize(small) m(diamond) mlw(medthin) mlc(`c2') mfc(white)"
return local es_sct3_sty =	"msize(small) m(+) mlc(`c3') mlw(medthin) mfc(white) "
return local es_sct4_sty =	"msize(medsmall) mlc(`c4') mlw(medthin) mfc(white)"
return local es_sct5_sty =  "msize(medsmall) mlw(medthin) mlc(`c5') mfc(white)"
/* Confidence intervals */
return local es_ci1_sty =	"lc(`c1') lw(medthin)"
return local es_ci2_sty =	"lc(`c2') lw(medthin)"
return local es_ci3_sty =	"lc(`c3') lw(medthin)"
return local es_ci4_sty =   "lc(`c4') lw(medthin)"
return local es_ci5_sty =   "lc(`c5') lw(medthin)"
end

/**********************************************************************/

capture program drop myregress
program define myregress
syntax namelist(min=1) [if] [in], depvar(varname) indvar(varname) version(string) baseyear(integer) ///
	[spec(string)] scaled(string)

if "`scaled'" == "no" replace vul_scale_factor = 1
levelsof year, local(year_list)
foreach year of local year_list {
	if `year' != `baseyear' gen init_vul_`year' = (year == `year') * `indvar'  / vul_scale_factor
}

 
/*----------------------------------------------------*/
   /* [>   'baseline' version    <] */ 
/*----------------------------------------------------*/
if "`version'" == "baseline" {
qui: reghdfe `depvar' init_vul_* [weight = cty_pop_1990], absorb(county year i.fipstate#year ///
	 c.d_tradeotch_pw_lag#i.year c.share_colgrad_1990#i.year c.manu_share_1990#i.year) cluster(fipstate) 
qui: bys county: egen cty_tot = total(e(sample))
qui: unique year if e(sample) == 1 
qui: gen samp = 1 if cty_tot == r(unique)

reghdfe `depvar' init_vul_* [weight=cty_pop_1990] if samp ==1 , absorb(county year) cluster(fipstate)
tempfile did
parmest, saving(`did') format(parm estimate min95 max95)

reghdfe `depvar' init_vul_* [weight=cty_pop_1990] if samp==1, absorb(county year i.fipstate#i.year) cluster(fipstate)
tempfile styr
parmest, saving(`styr') format(parm estimate min95 max95)

reghdfe `depvar' init_vul_* [weight=cty_pop_1990] if samp==1, absorb(county year i.fipstate#i.year c.d_tradeotch_pw_lag#i.year ) cluster(fipstate)
tempfile styr_adhiv
parmest, saving(`styr_adhiv') format(parm estimate min95 max95)

reghdfe `depvar' init_vul_* [weight=cty_pop_1990] if samp==1, absorb(county year i.fipstate#i.year c.manu_share_1990#i.year) cluster(fipstate)
tempfile styr_manushare
parmest, saving(`styr_manushare', replace) format(parm estimate min95 max95)

reghdfe `depvar' init_vul_* [weight=cty_pop_1990] if samp==1, absorb(county year i.fipstate#i.year c.share_colgrad_1990#i.year) cluster(fipstate)
tempfile styr_colgrad
parmest, saving(`styr_colgrad') format(parm estimate min95 max95)

use `did', clear
qui: keep parm estimate min95 max95
qui: rename (estimate min95 max95) (estimate_did min95_did max95_did)
qui: merge 1:1 parm using `styr', keepusing(estimate min95 max95) nogen
qui: rename (estimate min95 max95) ( estimate_styr min95_styr max95_styr)
qui: merge 1:1 parm using `styr_adhiv', keepusing(estimate min95 max95) nogen

qui: merge 1:1 parm using `styr_manushare', keepusing(estimate min95 max95) nogen
qui: rename (estimate min95 max95) (estimate_styr_manushare min95_styr_manushare max95_styr_manushare)
qui: merge 1:1 parm using `styr_colgrad', keepusing(estimate min95 max95) nogen
qui: rename (estimate min95 max95)  (estimate_styr_colgrad min95_styr_colgrad max95_styr_colgrad)

keep if strpos(parm, "init_vul_")>0
gen year = real(substr(parm, -4,.))
drop parm
set obs `=_N+1'
replace year = `baseyear' if missing(year)
foreach v of varlist estimate_* {
	replace `v' = 0 if year == `baseyear'

content:
* Data for Table A.23 Robustness of Spillovers to Related Firms on Energy Use and Energy Effciency: Entropy Matching

************************************************
*  Pre-Treatment of CESD for Entropy Matching
************************************************

*=========================
*  Pre-Treatment of CESD
*=========================

*----------
* Raw Data
*----------

use "$revision/Raw_Data/CESD/CESD.dta", clear

*----------------------------------------
* Drop Electricity-Intensive Industries
*----------------------------------------

merge m:1 ind4 using "$revision/Raw_Data/CESD/Energy_Type.dta"
drop if _merge==1
drop _merge
drop if power_type==0

*----------
* Variable
*----------

gen output=v10
replace output=emi_production_1 if year==2010
gen coal=v15
replace coal=emi_coal if year==2010
gen oil=v19
replace oil=emi_oil if year==2010
gen gas=v23
replace gas=emi_gas if year==2010

replace output=0 if output==.
replace coal=0 if coal==.
replace oil=0 if oil==.
replace gas=0 if gas==.

gen energy=coal*0.9+oil*1.4286+gas*13.3 if power_type==1
replace energy=coal*0.9+oil*1.4286 if power_type==2
replace energy=coal*0.9+oil*1.4286+gas*5 if power_type==3

gen lenergy=ln(energy)
gen loutput=ln(output*10)
gen lefficiency=ln(output*10/energy)

*--------
* Sample
*--------

*Time Period
drop if wrong==1
drop if year<2001

*Drop Fire Power
gen firepower=(ind4==4411)
drop if firepower==1

*Drop Extreme Value
xtset id_in_panel year
gen growth_energy=D.energy/L.energy
bysort id_in_panel: egen total_energy=total(energy) 
bysort id_in_panel: gen mean_energy=(total_energy-energy)/(_N-1)
gen energy_test=energy/mean_energy

gen energy_right=(growth_energy<10 | energy_test<10 )
drop if energy_right==0

gen untreated=(energy>18*10^4 & energy!=. & qianjia_all_dummy==0 & year==2004 )
replace untreated=0 if untreated!=1
gsort id_in_panel -untreated
by id_in_panel: replace untreated=untreated[1]

drop if untreated==1

content:
gen energy_right=(growth_energy<10 | energy_test<10 )
drop if energy_right==0

gen untreated=(energy>18*10^4 & energy!=. & qianjia_all_dummy==0 & year==2004 )
replace untreated=0 if untreated!=1
gsort id_in_panel -untreated
by id_in_panel: replace untreated=untreated[1]

drop if untreated==1

*Yearly Coal Data
sort id_in_panel coal
by id_in_panel: gen coal_min=coal[1]
gsort id_in_panel -coal
by id_in_panel: gen coal_max=coal[1]
gen coal_exist=1 if coal_min>0 & coal_max>0 & coal_min!=. & coal_max!=.
keep if coal_exist==1

*Drop Top1000 Firms
xtset id_in_panel year
replace qianjia_md_dummy=. if qianjia_md_dummy==0
xfill qianjia_md_dummy,i(id_in_panel)
replace qianjia_md_dummy=0 if qianjia_md_dummy==.
drop if qianjia_md_dummy==1

*Drop Sample without Data after Policy
gsort id_in_panel -year
by id_in_panel: gen endyear=year[1]
drop if endyear<=2006
drop endyear

*Drop Sample without 2001-2006 Panel Data
xtset id_in_panel year
forvalues i=2001(1)2006 {
    gen sample`i'=1 if year==`i'
	xfill sample`i',i(id_in_panel)
	drop if sample`i'!=1
	drop sample`i'
	}
	
*Fixed Effects
egen ind2_year=group(ind2 year)

gen province=int(countyid_new_panel/10000)
egen province_year=group(province year)

*--------------------
* Add ASIF Controls
*--------------------

merge m:1 legcode_in_panel year using "$revision/Data/ASIF_Control_Legcode",update
drop if _merge==2
drop _merge

merge m:1 name year using "$revision/Data/ASIF_Control_Name",update
drop if _merge==2
drop _merge

xtset id_in_panel year
replace soe=l.soe  if year==2010
replace roa=l.roa if year==2010
replace age=l.age+1 if year==2010
replace exp=l.exp if year==2010

*----------
*  Label
*----------

keep id_in_panel name legcode_in_panel year ind4 ind2 province lenergy lefficiency soe roa age exp ind2_year province_year

xtset id_in_panel year
egen firmid=group(id_in_panel)
drop id_in_panel

order firmid name legcode_in_panel year ind4 ind2 province lenergy lefficiency soe roa age exp ind2_year province_year

ren legcode_in_panel legcode

label variable firmid "Firm ID"
method: difference-in-differences and industry equilibrium model
title: Regulating Conglomerates: Evidence from an Energy Conservation Program in China

local alpha_l_p50_all=r(p50)

*Figure 7: Welfare Effects of Alternative Policies 

****** Import results from matlab model solution 
clear
import delimited "$revision/Structural_Analysis/Counterfactual Baseline/results.txt", delimiter("   ", asstring) 
****** Clean data and make it into percentage changes
drop v1
rename v2 phi 
rename v3 xi 

foreach var in v4 v5 v6 v7 v8 v9 v10 v11 v12 v13 v14 v15  { 
	replace `var'=-ln(`var')*100
} 

****** Some computations 
** Recall overall emissions in China 6.38 billion tons of carbon 
** And national income ($2.752 trillion, USD)

** Determine Break even Kappa
local kb = -v4[10]/v5[10] 
di `kb'
local kb = `kb'/(1+`kb')
di `kb'
** GWTP for Top 1,000 program 
local kb = round(`kb'/(  6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25  ) ,1)
di `kb'


***** Aggregate savings 
* aggregate energy use in industry 
di 670/.56
* aggregate saving from Top 1000 
di 670/.56*v5[10]/100
* aggregate saving from conglomerate level regulation at same price increase 
di 670/.56*(-v4[10])/(100*.8)


local kappa1 = 51*6.38/(2.725*1000)*1.25
local kappa2 = 125*6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25
local kappa3 = `kb'*6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25
local kappa4 = 210*6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25
di `kappa1'

** 151 number from universal energy tax 
di .8/(1+.8)/(6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25)


*------------------
* Panel A: Output
*------------------

* 4 Or vary both   with double labels 
twoway  (function y = -(`kappa1'/(1-`kappa1'))*x, range(0 7) lcolor(black) ) ///
	(function y = -(`kappa2'/(1-`kappa2'))*x, range(0 7) lcolor(black) ) ///
	(function y = -(`kappa3'/(1-`kappa3'))*x, range(0 7) lcolor(black) ) ///
	(function y = -(`kappa4'/(1-`kappa4'))*x, range(0 3.75) lcolor(black) ) ///
	(scatter v4 v5 if inrange(xi,.78,.82), connect(line) msize(large) mcolor(navy) lcolor(navy) lwidth(thick)) ///
	(scatter v4 v5 if inrange(phi,9.3,9.4), connect(line) msize(large) msym(square) mcolor(maroon) lcolor(maroon) lpattern(dash) lwidth(medthick)) ///

	, ytitle("Welfare Cost of Price Increase" "-ln(P/P{sup:*})") ///
	xtitle("Reduction in Energy Use" "ln(E/E{sup:*})") ///
	legend(pos(6) order(5 "Varying Regulation" "Threshold {&phi}{sup:{&sim}}" ///
	6 "Varying Regulation" "Intensity {&xi}" ) ///
	cols(2) region(col(white))  ) ///
	graphregion(fcolor(white)) graphregion(color(white)) ///
	plotregion(fcolor(white) lcolor(white)) ///
	text(-.9 6.65 "GWTP=$51") text(-3.25 6.65 "GWTP=$125") text(-5.1 6.65 "GWTP=$161") text(-6 4.3 "GWTP=$210") ///
	text(-3.5 3.25 "Top 1,000{&rarr}") xlab(0(2)7) ///
	text(-3.8 3.75 "20%")  text(-5.275 5.2 "30%")  text(-1.15 1 "5%") ///
	text(-3.15 4.1 "56%")  text(-3.8 4.76 "60%")  text(-2.7 3.55 "50%")
	
graph export "$revision/Figure/Figure7_A.pdf", replace

content:
*Figure A.8:  Effects of the Top 1,000 Program on Regulated Firms: Robustness to Different Samples

use "$revision/Data/TableA8.dta",clear

*===============
* Data Cleaning
*===============

*-------------------------------------------------------
* Drop Firms That Do Not Report Energy Data After 2006
*-------------------------------------------------------

* Drop Firms That Never Report Energy Data 

gen energy_data=1 if coal!=0 | oil!=0 | gas!=0
xfill energy_data
drop if energy_data==.

* Drop Firepower Firms (Firepower firms are separated from the CESD data after 2006)

gen firepower=(ind4==4411)
drop if firepower==1

*---------------------------------
* Drop Missing and Extreme Values
*---------------------------------

* Missing Energy Type

drop if power_type==.
drop if electricity50==.

* Untreated

gen untreated=(energy>18*10^4 & energy!=. & top1000==0 & year==2004)
gsort firmid -untreated
by firmid: replace untreated=untreated[1]
drop if untreated==1

* Comparable Energy and Output

replace loutput=. if lenergy==.

* Extreme Values

xtset firmid year
gen growth_energy=D.energy/L.energy
bysort firmid:egen total_energy=total(energy) 
bysort firmid:gen mean_energy=(total_energy-energy)/(_N-1)
gen energy_level=energy/mean_energy
gen energy_right=(growth_energy<10 | energy_level<10 )

drop if energy_right==0 & top1000!=1

*----------------------------------------------------
* Drop Firms That Did Not Report Coal Data Annually
*----------------------------------------------------

sort firmid coal
by firmid: egen missing=count(firmid) if coal==0

xtset firmid year
xfill missing, i(firmid)
replace missing=0 if missing==.

drop if missing>0 & top1000!=1

* Dynamics
*==========

*All Sample

tab year, gen(ydummy)
forvalues i=1(1)10 {
     local j=2000+`i'
     gen treat_year`j'=ydummy`i'*top1000
     }

********************************************************************************
*                          Replicate Scalars
********************************************************************************

clear all

global output "./" 
sysuse auto , clear 

capture: program drop jc_stat_out0
program jc_stat_out
syntax , number(real) name(string) replace(real) deci(real) figs(real)

if `replace' == 1 {
file open myfile using "$revision/Table/scalars.txt", write replace
file write myfile "\newcommand{\" "`name'" "}[1]{" %`figs'.`deci'fc (`number') "}" _n
file close myfile
}

if `replace' != 1 {
file open myfile using "$revision/Table/scalars.txt", write append
file write myfile "\newcommand{\" "`name'" "}[1]{" %`figs'.`deci'fc (`number') "}" _n
file close myfile
}
end

****************************************************
*  Output Share of Related Firms to Top1000 Firms
****************************************************

use "$revision/Data/Scalars.dta",clear

keep if year==2006
keep if output!=0

sum output if top1000==1
local a=r(mean)

sum output if top1000_related==1
local b=r(mean)

local resultI = `b'/`a'
dis `resultI'
jc_stat_out, number(`resultI') name("RESULTnumI") replace(1) deci(3) figs(6)

* Table A.2 Heterogeneous Spillover Effects by Local Pollution and Density

*-----------------------------------------------
*  Compare Density between Top1000 & Related
*-----------------------------------------------

* Define Pollution Density

use "$revision/Data/TableA2_1.dta",clear

gen top1000_pollution=top1000_so2_density*top1000_population
gen related_pollution=related_so2_density*related_population

egen related_id=group(related)
sort related_id
by related_id: egen top1000_pollution_mean=mean(top1000_pollution)

keep related top1000_pollution_mean related_pollution

duplicates drop related,force

* Define Pollution Density Transfer

gen diff_pollution=(related_pollution-top1000_pollution_mean)/top1000_pollution_mean

gen pollution=1 if diff_pollution>0.1 & diff_pollution!=.
replace pollution=-1 if diff_pollution<-0.1 & diff_pollution!=. 
replace pollution=0 if diff_pollution>=-0.1 & diff_pollution<=0.1 & diff_pollution!=. 

keep related pollution
gen same_ind4=1
ren related name
order name same_ind4 pollution
save "$revision/Data/Related_Density_Name.dta",replace

merge 1:1 name using "$revision/Data/TableA2_3.dta"
keep if _merge==3
drop if legcode==""
gen legcodelength=length(legcode)
keep if legcodelength==9
keep legcode same_ind4 pollution
order legcode same_ind4 pollution

sort firmid pollution

* TableA28. Heterogeneous Spillover Effects on Output by Related Firm Size

*-------------------
*  Treat & Control
*-------------------

use "$revision/Data/Table2_1.dta",clear

merge m:1 firmid using "$revision/Data/Distance_Matching/Distance_Matching_Output_Related.dta"
drop if _merge==2

merge m:1 firmid using "$revision/Data/Distance_Matching/Distance_Matching_Output_Control.dta",update

keep if related==1 | control==1
replace related=0 if related==.
replace control=0 if control==.

gen related_post=1 if related==1 & year>=2007
replace related_post=0 if related_post==.
label variable related_post "Related*Post"

*----------------------
* Drop Extreme Values
*----------------------

replace year=2010 if year==2011
xtset firmid year
gen growth=(output-l.output)/l.output
gen growth_raw=growth
winsor2 growth, trim replace
drop if growth==. & growth_raw!=.
drop growth growth_raw
replace year=2011 if year==2010
xtset firmid year

*------------
*  Quantile
*------------

gen exist=1 if year==2006
xtset firmid year
xfill exist,i(firmid)
drop if exist!=1

duplicates tag ind4 if related==1 & year==2006, gen(frequency)
replace frequency=frequency+1 if frequency!=.
replace frequency=0 if frequency==.

gsort ind4 -frequency
by ind4: replace frequency=frequency[1]
keep if frequency>=3

forvalues i=1(1)3 {
       gen group`i'=0
       }

foreach num of numlist 3111 4411 4420 610 3230 2621 2614 2221 710 2511 2520 2612 3240 2661 3210 3351 2651 2671 3141 3311 4430 2619 2631 3121 3124 3220 3316 {
	   _pctile output if year==2006 & related==1 & ind4==`num', percentiles(30,60)
       local n30_`num'=r(r1)
       local n60_`num'=r(r2)
       replace group1=1 if year==2006 & related==1 & ind4==`num' & output<=`n30_`num'' & output!=.
       replace group2=1 if year==2006 & related==1 & ind4==`num' & output>`n30_`num'' & output<=`n60_`num'' & output!=.
       replace group3=1 if year==2006 & related==1 & ind4==`num' & output>`n60_`num'' & output!=.
	   }

forvalues i=1(1)3 { 
     xtset firmid year

content:
* Data for Table 2. Spillover Effects on the Related Firms

*************************************************
*  Pre-Treatment of ASIF for Distance Matching
*************************************************

*------------
*  Raw Data 
*------------

use "$revision/Raw_Data/ASIF/ASIF.dta",clear

*----------
*  Sample 
*----------

*Time Period: 2001-2011
keep if year>2000 & year<2012

*Drop Top1000 Firms
xtset id_in_panel year
replace qianjia_md_dummy=. if qianjia_md_dummy==0
xfill qianjia_md_dummy,i(id_in_panel)
replace qianjia_md_dummy=0 if qianjia_md_dummy==.
drop if qianjia_md_dummy==1

*Drop Sample after Policy
sort id_in_panel year
by id_in_panel: gen startyear=year[1]
drop if startyear>=2007
drop startyear

*Drop Sample before Policy
gsort id_in_panel -year
by id_in_panel: gen endyear=year[1]
drop if endyear<=2006
drop endyear

*Drop if Only One Sample before Policy
duplicates tag id_in_panel if year<=2006,gen(num_before)
xtset id_in_panel year
xfill num_before,i(id_in_panel)
drop if num_before==0
drop num_before

*-----------------------
*  Industry Adjustment
*-----------------------

gen ind4=cic03
duplicates tag id_in_panel ind4,gen(du_ind4)
gsort id_in_panel -du_ind4 -year
by id_in_panel: replace ind4=ind4[1]
drop du_ind4
drop if ind4==.

*-------------
*  Variables
*-------------

*Output
replace giovpp=0 if giovpp==.
gen loutput=ln(giovpp)

*SOE
drop soe
gen ownership=rtype
replace ownership=. if ownership<100 | ownership>390
gen soe=1 if ownership==110 | ownership==141 | ownership==143 | ownership==151
replace soe=0 if soe==. & ownership!=.

*ROA
gen roa=oprofit/tasset
winsor2 roa,trim replace

* Data for Table A.23 Robustness of Spillovers to Related Firms on Energy Use and Energy Effciency: Entropy Matching

************************************************
*  Pre-Treatment of CESD for Entropy Matching
************************************************

*-------------
* Import Data
*-------------

use "$revision/Raw_Data/CESD/CESD.dta", clear

*----------------------------------------
* Drop Electricity-Intensive Industries
*----------------------------------------

merge m:1 ind4 using "$revision/Raw_Data/CESD/Energy_Type.dta"
drop if _merge==1
drop _merge
drop if power_type==0

*--------------------
* Energy and Output
*--------------------

gen output=v10
replace output=emi_production_1 if year==2010
gen coal=v15
replace coal=emi_coal if year==2010
gen oil=v19
replace oil=emi_oil if year==2010
gen gas=v23
replace gas=emi_gas if year==2010

replace output=0 if output==.
replace coal=0 if coal==.
replace oil=0 if oil==.
replace gas=0 if gas==.

gen energy=coal*0.9+oil*1.4286+gas*13.3 if power_type==1
replace energy=coal*0.9+oil*1.4286 if power_type==2
replace energy=coal*0.9+oil*1.4286+gas*5 if power_type==3

gen lenergy=ln(energy)
gen loutput=ln(output*10)
gen lefficiency=ln(output*10/energy)

*--------
* Sample
*--------

*Data Cleaning
drop if wrong==1

*Time Period
drop if year<2001

*Drop Fire Power
gen firepower=(ind4==4411)
drop if firepower==1

*Drop Extreme Values
xtset id_in_panel year
gen growth_energy=D.energy/L.energy
bysort id_in_panel: egen total_energy=total(energy) 
bysort id_in_panel: gen mean_energy=(total_energy-energy)/(_N-1)
gen energy_test=energy/mean_energy
gen energy_right=(growth_energy<10 | energy_test<10 )
drop if energy_right==0

gen untreated=(energy>18*10^4 & energy!=. & qianjia_all_dummy==0 & year==2004 )
replace untreated=0 if untreated!=1
gsort id_in_panel -untreated
by id_in_panel: replace untreated=untreated[1]
drop if untreated==1

*Annual Coal Data
sort id_in_panel coal
by id_in_panel: gen coal_min=coal[1]

sort output

egen output_total3=total(output) if output>=1

egen num_total2=count(firmid) if output<1 & output>=0.2
egen num_total3=count(firmid) if output>=1

	sort num_total`j'

	}
	
keep output_total* num_total*
gen number=0
duplicates drop number,force
order number

      egen output_total3=total(output) if output>=1

      egen num_total3=count(firmid) if output>=1

*Figure 7: Welfare Effects of Alternative Policies 

****** Import results from matlab model solution 
clear
import delimited "$revision/Structural_Analysis/Counterfactual Baseline/results.txt", delimiter("   ", asstring) 

****** Clean data and make it into percentage changes
drop v1
rename v2 phi 
rename v3 xi 

foreach var in v4 v5 v6 v7 v8 v9 v10 v11 v12 v13 v14 v15  { 
	replace `var'=-ln(`var')*100
} 

****** Some computations 
** Recall overall emissions in China 6.38 billion tons of carbon 
** And national income ($2.752 trillion, USD)

** Determine Break Even Kappa
local kb = -v4[10]/v5[10] 
di `kb'
local kb = `kb'/(1+`kb')
di `kb'

** GWTP for Top 1,000 program 
local kb = round(`kb'/(  6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25  ) ,1)
di `kb'


***** Aggregate savings 

* aggregate energy use in industry 
di 670/.56
* aggregate saving from Top 1000 
di 670/.56*v5[10]/100
* aggregate saving from conglomerate level regulation at same price increase 
di 670/.56*(-v4[10])/(100*.8)

local kappa1 = 51*6.38/(2.725*1000)*1.25
local kappa2 = 125*6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25
local kappa3 = `kb'*6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25
local kappa4 = 210*6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25
di `kappa1'

di .8/(1+.8)/(6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25)

* Panel A: Output
*------------------

twoway  (function y = -(`kappa1'/(1-`kappa1'))*x, range(0 7) lcolor(black) ) ///

	(function y = -(`kappa3'/(1-`kappa3'))*x, range(0 7) lcolor(black) ) ///
	(function y = -(`kappa4'/(1-`kappa4'))*x, range(0 3.75) lcolor(black) ) ///

	, ytitle("Welfare Cost of Price Increase" "-ln(P/P{sup:*})") ///
	xtitle("Reduction in Energy Use" "ln(E/E{sup:*})") ///
	legend(pos(6) order(5 "Varying Regulation" "Threshold {&phi}{sup:{&sim}}" ///
	6 "Varying Regulation" "Intensity {&xi}" ) ///
	cols(2) region(col(white))  ) ///
	graphregion(fcolor(white)) graphregion(color(white)) ///
	plotregion(fcolor(white) lcolor(white)) ///
	text(-.9 6.65 "GWTP=$51") text(-3.25 6.65 "GWTP=$125") text(-5.1 6.65 "GWTP=$161") text(-6 4.3 "GWTP=$210") ///
	text(-3.5 3.25 "Top 1,000{&rarr}") xlab(0(2)7) ///
	text(-3.8 3.75 "20%")  text(-5.275 5.2 "30%")  text(-1.15 1 "5%") ///
	text(-3.15 4.1 "56%")  text(-3.8 4.76 "60%")  text(-2.7 3.55 "50%")

* Figure A.10 Effects of the Top 1,000 Program on Regulated Firms: Robustness to Trimming Sample Using an Estimated Propensity of Treatment

use "$revision/Data/Table1.dta",clear

* Estimate Propensity Score

preserve 
keep if inrange(year,2003,2005) 
collapse (mean) loutput (max) ind2 (max) province (max) top1000, by(firmid)
logit top1000 i.ind2 i.province c.loutput#i.ind2

predict pscore
keep firmid pscore  
tempfile temp 
save `temp'
restore 

* Merge propensity score 

merge m:1 firmid using `temp'
drop _merge 

centile pscore if top1000 == 0, c(20,40,60) 
local perc1 = r(c_1)
local perc2 = r(c_2)
local perc3 = r(c_3)

centile pscore if top1000 == 1, c(80,60,40)
local perc4 = r(c_1)
local perc5 = r(c_2)
local perc6 = r(c_3)

*Figure

tab year, gen(ydummy)
forvalues i=1(1)10 {
      local j=2000+`i'
      gen treat_year`j'=ydummy`i'*top1000
      }

local treat_yeardummy "treat_year2001-treat_year2005 treat_year2007-treat_year2010"
local absorb3 "firmid ind2_year province_year"
local cluster "firmid"

reghdfe loutput  `treat_yeardummy' , absorb(`absorb3') cluster(`cluster') 
parmest,saving("$revision/Appendix_Figure/dta/PSM_Output_0.dta",replace)
reghdfe lenergy  `treat_yeardummy', absorb(`absorb3') cluster(`cluster') 
parmest,saving("$revision/Appendix_Figure/dta/PSM_Energy_0.dta",replace)

forvalues i=1(1)3 {
	reghdfe loutput  `treat_yeardummy' if (pscore>`perc`i'' & top1000==0) | top1000==1, absorb(`absorb3') cluster(`cluster') 
	parmest,saving("$revision/Appendix_Figure/dta/PSM_Output_`i'.dta",replace)
	reghdfe lenergy  `treat_yeardummy' if (pscore>`perc`i'' & top1000==0) | top1000==1, absorb(`absorb3') cluster(`cluster') 
	parmest,saving("$revision/Appendix_Figure/dta/PSM_Energy_`i'.dta",replace)
}

forvalues i=4(1)6 {
	reghdfe loutput  `treat_yeardummy' if  top1000==0 | (top1000==1 & pscore<`perc`i''), absorb(`absorb3') cluster(`cluster') 
	parmest,saving("$revision/Appendix_Figure/dta/PSM_Output_`i'.dta",replace)
	reghdfe lenergy  `treat_yeardummy' if  top1000==0 | (top1000==1 & pscore<`perc`i''), absorb(`absorb3') cluster(`cluster') 
	parmest,saving("$revision/Appendix_Figure/dta/PSM_Energy_`i'.dta",replace)
}

forvalues i=7(1)9 {
	local j=`i'-6
	local k=`i'-3
	reghdfe loutput  `treat_yeardummy' if  (pscore>`perc`j'' & top1000==0) | (top1000==1 & pscore<`perc`k''), absorb(`absorb3') cluster(`cluster') 
	parmest,saving("$revision/Appendix_Figure/dta/PSM_Output_`i'.dta",replace)
	reghdfe lenergy  `treat_yeardummy' if  (pscore>`perc`j'' & top1000==0) | (top1000==1 & pscore<`perc`k''), absorb(`absorb3') cluster(`cluster') 
	parmest,saving("$revision/Appendix_Figure/dta/PSM_Energy_`i'.dta",replace)
}

use "$revision/Appendix_Figure/dta/PSM_Output_0.dta",clear
gen x=length(parm)
keep if x==14
gen year=substr(parm,11,.)
destring year,replace
keep year estimate min95 max95
set obs 10
method: difference-in-differences and industry equilibrium model
title: Regulating Conglomerates: Evidence from an Energy Conservation Program in China

content:
* Figure A.12 Lack of Entry Effect

*------------------------------------------
* Panel A: Relative Size of New Affiliates
*------------------------------------------

use "$revision/Data/FigureA12_A.dta",clear

* Total Capital

egen capital1=total(capital) if (startyear<=2006 & type=="Related") | type=="Top1000"
egen capital2=total(capital) if startyear>2006 & type=="Related"

gen totalcapital=capital1 if startyear<=2006
replace totalcapital=capital2 if startyear>2006

duplicates drop totalcapital,force

gen type1="Registered Capital Before Policy" if startyear<=2006
replace type1="Registered Capital After Policy"  if startyear>2006

* Figure

graph pie totalcapital, over(type1) sort descending ///
pie(1,color("118 152 160")) pie(2,color("231 222 212")) ///
plabel(_all percent, color(navy) size(small) format(%2.0f) gap(5)) ///
legend(r(1) pos(6) color(navy) region(lcolor(white)) bmargin(medium)) ///
graphregion(fcolor(white)) 
graph export "$revision/Appendix_Figure/FigureA12_A.pdf", replace

*----------------------------------
* Panel B: New Affiliates by Year
*----------------------------------

use "$revision/Data/FigureA12_B.dta",clear

graph bar top1000_num top10000_num, over(startyear) ///
ytitle("Number of New Firms",size(medium small) margin(small)) ///
blabel(bar, position(outside) color(black)) ///
ylabel(0(50)200,nogrid) graphregion(color(white)) ///
legend(r(1) pos(6) label(1 "Top1,000 Related") label(2 "Top10,000 Related"))

graph export "$revision/Appendix_Figure/FigureA12_B.pdf", replace

*----------------------------------
* Panel C: Entry Rate Event Study
*----------------------------------

use "$revision/Data/FigureA12_C.dta",clear

tab startyear, gen(ydummy)

*Figure A.2 : Welfare Effects of Alternative Policies 

*------------------
* Panel A: Output
*------------------

****** Import results from matlab model solution 
clear
import delimited "$revision/Structural_Analysis/Energy Efficiency/results.txt", delimiter("   ", asstring) 

****** Clean data and make it into percentage changes
drop v1
rename v2 gamma 

foreach var in v3 v4  { 
	replace `var'=-ln(`var')*100
} 
foreach var in v5 v6 { 
	replace `var' = `var'*100
}

gen SCC = round((-v3/v4)/(1+-v3/v4)*.8*(2.752*1000)/6.38)
gen kappa = v3/v4

twoway  (function y = kappa[6]*x, range(0 6.75) lcolor(black)) /// 
	(function y = kappa[4]*x, range(0 9.9) lcolor(gs11)) /// 	
	(function y = kappa[3]*x, range(0 12) lcolor(gs11)) /// 	
	(scatter v3 v4 in 6  , msize(large)  msym(diamond) mcolor(red)  ) ///
	(scatter v3 v4 if gamma > 3 & _n < 5 , msize(large)  msym(T) mcolor(navy)  ) ///
	, ytitle("Welfare Cost of Price Increase" "-ln(P/P{sup:*})") ///
	xtitle("Reduction in Energy Use" "ln(E/E{sup:*})") ///
	legend(off)  ///
	graphregion(fcolor(white)) graphregion(color(white)) ///
	plotregion(fcolor(white) lcolor(white)) ///
	xlab(0(2)12) ylab(-6(2)0) ///

append using `R4'

append using `R6'

foreach var in v4 v5 v6 v7 v8 v9 v10 v11 v12 v13 v14 v15  { 
	replace `var'=-ln(`var')*100
} 

** Generate breakeven kappa 
gen kb = -v4/v5
gen kb2 = kb
replace kb = kb/(1+kb)
gen ssc = round(kb/(6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25 ))

drop  if inrange(share_reg,.84,.87)

keep if inrange(xi,.78,.81)

bys alpha rho: egen min_phi=min(phi)
bys alpha rho: egen max_phi=max(phi)

drop if phi == min_phi | phi == max_phi 

gen agg_e = 670/.56*v5/100
gen agg_e_cr = 670/.56*(-v4)/(100*(alpha-.1))

order ssc alpha rho agg*


gen rho_in = 1 if inrange(alpha,0.89,.91) & rho <.75
replace rho_in = 2 if inrange(alpha,0.89,.91) & rho >.74 & rho <.76
replace rho_in = 3 if inrange(alpha,0.89,.91) & rho >.76


gen alpha_in = 4 if inrange(rho,0.74,.76) & alpha <.9
replace alpha_in = 5 if inrange(rho,0.74,.76) & alpha >.89 & alpha <.91
replace alpha_in = 6 if inrange(rho,0.74,.76) & alpha >.91


****** Some computations 
** Recall overall emissions in China 6.38 billion tons of carbon 
** And national income ($2.752 trillion, USD)

sort ssc 

local kappa1 = ssc[1]*6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25
local kappa2 = ssc[3]*6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25
local kappa3 = ssc[7]*6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25
local kappa_AdjK = ssc[8]*6.38/(2.752*1000)*1.25
di `kappa3'


twoway  (function y = -(`kappa1'/(1-`kappa1'))*x, range(0 7) lcolor(gs11) ) ///
	(function y = -(`kappa2'/(1-`kappa2'))*x, range(0 7) lcolor(black) ) ///
	(function y = -(`kappa3'/(1-`kappa3'))*x, range(0 7) lcolor(gs11) ) ///
	(function y = -(`kappa_AdjK'/(1-`kappa_AdjK'))*x, range(0 7) lcolor(gs11) ) ///	
	(scatter v4 v5 if inrange(alpha,.89,.91) & inrange(rho,.74,.76) & rho_c == . & adj_K == . & nocong == ., msize(large)  msym(Dh) mcolor(red) ) ///
	(scatter v4 v5 if inrange(alpha,.89,.91) & ~inrange(rho,.74,.76) & adj_K == ., msize(large)  msym(Oh) mcolor(dkgreen) ) ///
	(scatter v4 v5 if inrange(rho,.74,.76) & ~inrange(alpha,.89,.91) & adj_K == .  , msize(large)  msym(Th) mcolor(navy) ) ///
	(scatter v4 v5 if rho_c != .  , msize(large)  msym(Sh) mcolor(black) ) ///
	(scatter v4 v5 if adj_K == 1 , msize(large)  msym(X) ) ///
	(scatter v4 v5 if nocong == 1 , msize(large)  msym(+)  mcolor(red)  ) ///
	, ytitle("Welfare Cost of Price Increase" "-ln(P/P{sup:*})") ///
	xtitle("Reduction in Energy Use" "ln(E/E{sup:*})") ///
	legend(pos(6) order(5 "Baseline {&alpha}=0.9, {&rho}=0.75               " ///
	6  "Vary {&rho}{&isin}{0.7,0.9}       " ///
	7  "Vary {&alpha}{&isin}{0.85,0.95}" ///
	8 "{&rho}{sub:C}=0.9" ///
	9 "K not fixed" ///
	10 "No Conglomerates" ///
	) rows(3)  region(col(white)))   ///
	graphregion(fcolor(white)) graphregion(color(white)) ///
	plotregion(fcolor(white) lcolor(white)) ///
	xlab(0(2)7) ylab(-6(2)0) ///
	xlab(0(2)7) ///
	 text(-6.4 5.9 "GWTP=$170{&rarr}") text(-5.85 5.55 "GWTP=$167{&rarr}") text(-5.25 5.3 "GWTP=$161{&rarr}") text(-4.7 6.5 "{&larr}GWTP=$156") ///
	text(-3.2 3 "{&alpha}=0.95") text(-3.5 4.8 "{&alpha}=0.85") text(-4.5 4.6 "{&rho}{sub:C}=0.9") ///
	text(-2.6 2.2 "K not" "fixed")  text(-5.7 6.75 "No" "Cong")

*===============

*-------------------------------------------------------

content:
********************************************************************************
*                          Replicate Scalars
********************************************************************************

clear all

global output "./" 
sysuse auto , clear 

capture: program drop jc_stat_out0
program jc_stat_out
syntax , number(real) name(string) replace(real) deci(real) figs(real)

if `replace' == 1 {
file open myfile using "$revision/Table/scalars.txt", write replace
file write myfile "\newcommand{\" "`name'" "}[1]{" %`figs'.`deci'fc (`number') "}" _n
file close myfile
}

if `replace' != 1 {
file open myfile using "$revision/Table/scalars.txt", write append
file write myfile "\newcommand{\" "`name'" "}[1]{" %`figs'.`deci'fc (`number') "}" _n
file close myfile
}
end

****************************************************
*  Output Share of Related Firms to Top1000 Firms
****************************************************

use "$revision/Data/Scalars.dta",clear

keep if year==2006
keep if output!=0

sum output if top1000==1
local a=r(mean)

sum output if top1000_related==1
local b=r(mean)

local resultI = `b'/`a'
dis `resultI'
jc_stat_out, number(`resultI') name("RESULTnumI") replace(1) deci(3) figs(6)

content:
*Table 2: Spillover Effects on the Related Firms

********************************************************
*  Panel A. Spillover Effects on Related Firms: Output
********************************************************

*=================
*  Pre-Treatment 
*=================

*--------
*  Data 
*--------

use "$revision/Data/Table2_1.dta",clear

*--------------------------
*  Identify Related Firms
*--------------------------

merge m:1 legcode using "$revision/Data/TableA7_2.dta"
drop if _merge==2
drop _merge

merge m:1 name using "$revision/Data/TableA7_1.dta",update
drop if _merge==2
drop _merge

replace same_ind4=. if same_ind4==0
xtset firmid year
xfill same_ind4,i(firmid)
replace same_ind4=0 if same_ind4==.

*------------------
*  Keep Variables 
*------------------

keep firmid year output same_ind4 ind4
keep if year<=2006
ren same_ind4 treat
gen exist=1

*--------------
*  Panel Data
*--------------

xtset firmid year
tsfill,full
xfill ind4,i(firmid)
xfill treat,i(firmid)
replace output=-1 if exist!=1
ren output y

keep firmid year treat ind4 y
order firmid year treat ind4 y
sum firmid year treat ind4 y

*------------
*  Reshape
*------------

reshape wide y,i(firmid) j(year)

*-----------------------
*  Drop Useless Sample
*-----------------------

drop if (y2001==0 | y2001==-1) & (y2002==0 | y2002==-1) & (y2003==0 | y2003==-1) ///
& (y2004==0 | y2004==-1) & (y2005==0 | y2005==-1) & (y2006==0 | y2006==-1)

*-------------------------

*-----------------------------------------------
*  Compare Density between Top1000 & Related
*-----------------------------------------------

* Define Pollution Density

use "$revision/Data/TableA2_1.dta",clear

gen top1000_pollution=top1000_so2_density*top1000_population
gen related_pollution=related_so2_density*related_population

egen related_id=group(related)
sort related_id
by related_id: egen top1000_pollution_mean=mean(top1000_pollution)

keep related top1000_pollution_mean related_pollution

duplicates drop related,force

* Define Pollution Density Transfer

gen diff_pollution=(related_pollution-top1000_pollution_mean)/top1000_pollution_mean

replace pollution=-1 if diff_pollution<-0.1 & diff_pollution!=.

gen same_ind4=1

gen bp=1 if year==2009

gsort firmid year

xtset firmid rank
gen diff=(output-l.output)/l.output if bp==1

xtset firmid year
xfill diff,i(firmid)

drop if (diff>9 | diff<-0.9) & diff!=. & year>=2009 & year<=2010

*Industry & Province Adjustment

drop ind2_year province_year

duplicates tag firmid ind2,gen(du_ind2)
gsort firmid -du_ind2 year

drop du_ind2

duplicates tag firmid province,gen(du_province)

drop du_province

egen province_year=group(province year)

*------------

gen exist=1 if year==2006
xtset firmid year
xfill exist,i(firmid)
drop if exist!=1

duplicates tag ind4 if related==1 & year==2006, gen(frequency)
replace frequency=frequency+1 if frequency!=.
replace frequency=0 if frequency==.

gsort ind4 -frequency
by ind4: replace frequency=frequency[1]
keep if frequency>=3

forvalues i=1(1)3 {
       gen group`i'=0
       }

foreach num of numlist 3111 4411 4420 610 3230 2621 2614 2221 710 2511 2520 2612 3240 2661 3210 3351 2651 2671 3141 3311 4430 2619 2631 3121 3124 3220 3316 {
	   _pctile output if year==2006 & related==1 & ind4==`num', percentiles(30,60)
       local n30_`num'=r(r1)
       local n60_`num'=r(r2)
       replace group1=1 if year==2006 & related==1 & ind4==`num' & output<=`n30_`num'' & output!=.
       replace group2=1 if year==2006 & related==1 & ind4==`num' & output>`n30_`num'' & output<=`n60_`num'' & output!=.
       replace group3=1 if year==2006 & related==1 & ind4==`num' & output>`n60_`num'' & output!=.
	   }

forvalues i=1(1)3 { 
     xtset firmid year
	 replace group`i'=. if group`i'==0
	 xfill group`i',i(firmid)
	 replace group`i'=0 if group`i'==.
	 }

/*
 This creates a data set of block level shocks to the #of GPs in the block. 
	This gets merged in with create_village_level_analysis. Note that
	it will always be necessary to cluster SEs at the block level as a result of 
	this data structure
 */
	
*use "$intdata/jal_jeevan/jj2011_villagedirectory_crosswalk.dta", clear
use "$intdata/villagedirectory/village_analysis_cleaned.dta", clear
set seed 1234
gen rand = runiform()

*calculate the total # of GPs in the block 
bysort pc91_district_id pc91_block_id gp_code_jj11 (rand): gen n = _n if !missing(gp_code_jj11)
bysort pc91_district_id pc91_block_id n (rand): gen total_gp95 = _N if n == 1 
bysort pc91_district_id pc91_block_id (n rand): replace total_gp95 = total_gp95[1]
drop n

bysort districtcode_lgd21 blockcode_lgd21 gp_code_lgd21 (rand): gen n = _n
bysort districtcode_lgd21 blockcode_lgd21 n (rand): gen total_gp15 = _N if n == 1
bysort districtcode_lgd21 blockcode_lgd21 (n rand): replace total_gp15 = total_gp15[1]
drop n

bysort pc91_district_id pc91_block_id (rand): gen tot_vill95 = _N
bysort districtcode_lgd21 blockcode_lgd21 (rand): gen tot_vill15 = _N

local bw= 200
	local popvar = "pc91_pca_tot_p"
	gen temp_below = inrange(`popvar', 1000 - `bw', 999)
	gen temp_above = inrange(`popvar', 1000, 1000 + `bw')
	bysort pc91_district_id pc91_block_id (rand): egen vill_below95_b`bw' = total(temp_below)
	bysort pc91_district_id pc91_block_id (rand): egen vill_above95_b`bw' = total(temp_above)
		*remove own village from this
		replace vill_below95_b`bw' = vill_below95_b`bw' - temp_below
		replace vill_above95_b`bw' = vill_above95_b`bw' - temp_above
	drop temp*

	local popvar = "pc11_pca_tot_p"
	gen temp_below = inrange(`popvar', 1000 - `bw', 999)
	gen temp_above = inrange(`popvar', 1000, 1000 + `bw')
	bysort pc11_cdblock_id_num (rand): egen vill_below15_b`bw' = total(temp_below)
	bysort pc11_cdblock_id_num (rand): egen vill_above15_b`bw' = total(temp_above)
		*remove own village from this
		replace vill_below15_b`bw' = vill_below15_b`bw' - temp_below
		replace vill_above15_b`bw' = vill_above15_b`bw' - temp_above

	drop temp*

	gen delimitation_shock95_b`bw' = (vill_above95_b`bw') / (vill_above95_b`bw' + vill_below95_b`bw') 
	gen delimitation_shock15_b`bw' = (vill_above15_b`bw') / (vill_above15_b`bw' + vill_below15_b`bw') 


bysort pc91_district_id pc91_block_id (rand): egen block_population91 = total(pc91_pca_tot_p)
bysort pc01_district_id pc01_block_id (rand): egen block_population01 = total(pc01_pca_tot_p)
bysort pc11_district_id pc11_cdblock_id (rand): egen block_population11 = total(pc11_pca_tot_p)

egen blockcode_jj11_num = group(pc91_district_id pc91_block_id)
egen blockcode_lgd21_num = group(districtcode_lgd21 blockcode_lgd21)

keep shrid pc91_block_id pc01_block_id ///
	vill_below95* vill_above95* total_gp95 tot_vill95  ///
	vill_below15* vill_above15* total_gp15 tot_vill15 ///
	delimitation_shock95* delimitation_shock15* ///
	blockcode_jj11_num blockcode_lgd21_num ///
	block_population* ///
	noncompliant_district_1995 noncompliant_district_2015

duplicates drop shrid, force

label variable total_gp95 "Total GPs"
label variable total_gp15 "Total GPs"

save "$intdata/aggregate/blocklevel_analysis.dta", replace

content:
*****************************************************************************************
	*2001 amenities
	use "$rawdata/census/census2001amenities.dta", clear
	set seed 1234
	gen rand = runiform()
	
	destring state_code , gen(state_code_num)
	destring village_code, gen(village_code_num) force
	order state_code_num village_code_num, after(st_f)
	drop if missing(state_code) | missing(village_code)
	drop state_code - st_f
	bysort state_code_num village_code_num (rand): drop if _N  != 1
	destring *, replace
	
	cap drop notnumeric
	
	*see here for definitoins of variables: https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/23823, under "table columns"
	*education
	drop edu_fac - oth_sch //we will get this from SHRUG
		
	*electricity
	drop power_supl power_all // get from SHRUG
	drop dist_town  near_town pap_mag-land_fores
	drop jhum_cul - dr_wat
	
	*irrigation
	rename un_irr land_unirrigated
	rename tot_irr  land_irrigated
	destring canal_govt - oth_irr, force replace
	gen irrigated_canal = canal_govt+canal_pvt
	gen irrigated_groundwater = well_wo_el + well_w_el + tw_wo_el + tw_w_el	
	gen irrigated_tank = tank_irr
	gen irrigated_waterfall = w_fall
	gen irrigated_other = river_irr + lake_irr + oth_irr
	drop canal_govt - oth_irr
	
	drop medi_fac - hom_disp //don't use, very uncommon
	drop rang_mcw m_home cwc rang_phc fwc_cntr n_home rmp smp oth_cntr tb_cln
	gen  chc = h_cntr > 0 if !missing(h_cntr)
	gen phc = ph_cntr > 0 if !missing(ph_cntr)
	gen subcentre = phs_cnt > 0 if !missing(phs_cnt)
	gen mcw = mcw_cntr > 0 if !missing(mcw_cntr )
	drop h_cntr ph_cntr phs_cnt mcw_cntr 
	label variable mcw "Mother-Child Welfare" 
	label variable chc  "CHC" 
	label variable phc  "PHC" 
	label variable subcentre "Subcentre"
	
	gen any_tap = tap == 1 | tap == 2 if !missing(tap) 
	
	order tap, before(drnk_wat_f)
	drop drnk_wat_f - power_agr power_oth
	
	foreach var of varlist chw - mcw any_tap {
	    
		rename `var' `var'01
		
	}
	drop rand
	tempfile amenities
	save `amenities'
	
	
	*****************************************************************************************
	*2011 houselisting variables
	use "$rawdata/census/2011 houselisting.dta", clear
	set seed 1234
	gen rand = runiform()
	drop if rural == "Urban"
	drop if village_code == 0
	
	drop state district tehsil area_name
	drop rural filename
	
	rename village_code village_code_num
	rename state_code state_code_num
	
	drop district_code tehsil_code ward_code

destring pc11_state_id  , gen(state_code_num)
	merge m:1 state_code_num village_code_num using `hl2011', keep(1 3) nogen
	drop state_code_num village_code_num
	
		*standardized SHRUG vars
	merge m:1 shrid using "$rawdata/SHRUG/shrug-v1.5.samosa-pop-econ-census-dta/shrug_pc11.dta" , keep(1 3) nogen
	merge m:1 shrid using "$rawdata/SHRUG/shrug-v1.5.samosa-pop-econ-census-dta/shrug_pc01.dta" , keep(1 3) nogen
	merge m:1 shrid using "$rawdata/SHRUG/shrug-v1.5.samosa-pop-econ-census-dta/shrug_pc91.dta" , keep(1 3) nogen

	
	*****************************************************************************************
	*****************************************************************************************
	*****************************************************************************************
	*Clean up and keep only the variables of interest
	cap drop _m
	
	
	
	foreach y in "91" "01" "11" {
	
		gen ln_landarea`y' = ln(pc`y'_vd_area+1)
		gen literacy_rate`y' = pc`y'_pca_p_lit / pc`y'_pca_tot_p 
			replace literacy_rate`y' = . if literacy_rate`y' < 0 | literacy_rate`y'> 1
		gen sc_prop`y' = pc`y'_pca_p_sc / pc`y'_pca_tot_p 
		
		gen any_primary`y' = pc`y'_vd_p_sch > 0 if !missing(pc`y'_vd_p_sch)
		gen any_middle`y' = pc`y'_vd_m_sch > 0 if !missing(pc`y'_vd_m_sch)
		
		gen any_secondary`y' = pc`y'_vd_s_sch > 0 if !missing(pc`y'_vd_s_sch)
		gen any_s_secondary`y' = pc`y'_vd_s_s_sch > 0 if !missing(pc`y'_vd_s_s_sch)
		gen any_college`y' = pc`y'_vd_college > 0 if !missing(pc`y'_vd_college)
		
		label variable literacy_rate`y' "Literacy"
		label variable sc_prop`y' "SC pop"
		label variable any_primary`y' "Primary school"
		label variable any_middle`y' "Middle school"
		label variable pc`y'_vd_tar_road "Paved road"
		label variable pc`y'_vd_power_all "Electrified"
	}
	
	*housing variables
	
	gen wall_organic = wall_grass +wall_mud
	
	gen rooms_avg = (0*rooms0 + 1 *rooms1 + 2 *rooms2 + 3 * rooms3 + 4 *rooms4 + ///
				5*rooms5 + 6*rooms6 ) / 100
				
	*wall
	reg house_bad wall_grass - wall_concrete 
	gen wall_lowquality = wall_plastic + wall_grass + wall_metal + wall_mud + wall_wood
	gen wall_highquality =  wall_concrete + wall_brick  + wall_stonewmortar + wall_stonenomortar

content:
**************************************************************
	*LGD code to merge in
	use "$intdata/villagedirectory/village_analysis_cleaned.dta", clear
	set seed 1234
	gen rand = runiform()
	gen zilla_panchayat = districtname_lgd21 
	gen block_panchayat = blockname_lgd21 
	gen village_panchayat  = gp_name_lgd21 
	drop if missing(village_panchayat)
	
	bys zilla_panchayat block_panchayat village_panchayat (gp_code_lgd21 villagename rand): drop if _n != 1
	keep zilla_panchayat block_panchayat village_panchayat  ///
		districtcode_lgd21 subdistrictcode_lgd21 blockcode_lgd21 gp_code_lgd21 
	gen uid = _n
	
	tempfile lgdcode
	save `lgdcode'
	
	
	**************************************************************
	use "$intdata/financial/expenditure_schemewise.dta", clear
	set seed 1234
	gen rand = runiform()
	merge 1:1 zilla_panchayat block_panchayat village_panchayat  using `lgdcode', keep(1 3) nogen
	order districtcode_lgd21 subdistrictcode_lgd21 blockcode_lgd21  gp_code_lgd21
	bysort gp_code_lgd21 (rand): drop if _N > 1
	
	rename zilla_panchayat districtname_egs
	rename block_panchayat blockname_egs
	rename village_panchayat gpname_egs
	
	
	merge 1:m gp_code_lgd21 using "$intdata/villagedirectory/village_analysis_cleaned.dta", keep(2 3) nogen
	
	*drop the years before 2013, as there is only really data on own resource in those years
	drop spending*2010 spending*2011 spending*2012
	
	
	/*
	*For GPs that split, we need to fill in the spending for 2013-2015
		*Note that in this case, we take the spending of the parent GP since 
			at least one village will always remain in that GP. The process for doing this is:
			1/ Check whether a simple case of the 2011 GP splitting into one parent and
				some number of child GPs with spending of zero in the child GP 
				(because the child GP is an entirely new political unit). If so, take the 
				spending in the parent GP and put in the child GP (92% of cases)
			2/ If the GP splits into multiple child GP, then it is often the case
				that at least some of the child are agglomerated into existing GPs
				that had spending in the 2010-2015 period. In these cases, we need
				to figure out which the parent GP is (based on having the same name).
				We use Jaro-Winkler to figure this out. Take the highest match above
				a threshold -- if no matches are above the threshold, then we will 
				put missing values in for those villages. 
	*/
			
		*count the number of non-unique observations		
		gen temp_total_spending = 0
		foreach var of varlist spending_*_2013 spending_*_2014 spending_*_2015 {
			replace temp_total_spending = temp_total_spending + `var' if !missing(`var')
		
		}
		
		bysort gp_code_jj11 temp_total_spending (rand): gen temp = _n //count unique values
		bysort gp_code_jj11 temp (rand): gen unique_values = _N if temp == 1 & !missing(gp_code_jj11) 
		bysort gp_code_jj11 (temp rand): replace unique_values = unique_values[1] //assign # of unique observations to each village in the GP
		replace unique_values = . if missing(gp_code_jj11) // redundant, but as a check
		drop temp
		
		gen temp = temp_total_spending == 0
		bysort gp_code_jj11 (rand): egen any_zero = max(temp)
		drop temp
		
		*get jaro winkler of old and new name		
		jarowinkler gp_name_jj11 gpname_egs, gen(jaro)
			replace jaro = . if missing(gp_name_jj11) | missing(gpname_egs)
		bysort gp_code_jj11 (rand): egen jaro_max = max(jaro)
			
		*cases: 
			*1. missing gp_code_jj11
			*2. didn't change GP
method: population-threshold regression discontinuity
title: Polity Size and Local Government Performance: Evidence from India

content:
drop temp
		
		*get jaro winkler of old and new name		
		jarowinkler gp_name_jj11 gpname_egs, gen(jaro)
			replace jaro = . if missing(gp_name_jj11) | missing(gpname_egs)
		bysort gp_code_jj11 (rand): egen jaro_max = max(jaro)
			
		*cases: 
			*1. missing gp_code_jj11
			*2. didn't change GP 
			*3 only one non-zero spending value within their 2011 GP, indicating that 
			*4. changed GP AND their original GP has a jaro-winkler match of >0.85
			*5. two unique spending values, where one is zero; indicates that can take the non-zero as the correct one
			*remaining cases are non-obvious how to handle, but only 1.5% of all cases, so don't need to worry that much. Mostly ones that didn't match to EGS anyway
		cap drop temp_case_code
		gen temp_case_code = 1 if missing(gp_code_jj11)
		replace temp_case_code =2 if missing(temp_case_code) & changed_gp_jj11 ==0
		replace temp_case_code =3 if missing(temp_case_code) & unique_values == 1 & any_zero == 0
		replace temp_case_code =4 if missing(temp_case_code) & inrange(jaro_max, .85, 1) 
		replace temp_case_code =5 if missing(temp_case_code) & unique_values == 2 & any_zero == 1
		
		*case 4
		gen temp = -1 * jaro
		foreach var of varlist spending_*_2013 spending_*_2014 spending_*_2015 {	
			bysort gp_code_jj11 (temp shrid rand): replace `var' = `var'[1] if temp_case_code == 4
		}

	save `append', replace

*****************
*I. Open the LG directory and clean it up somewaht
*****************
set seed 12345
import delimited "$rawdata/lgdirectory/csv/village-directory.csv", delimiter(";") clear stringcols(_all)
gen rand = runiform()
*variable names
rename localgovernmentdirectorystatecod state_code
foreach var of varlist *inenglish {
	local newvar = subinstr("`var'", "inenglish","",.)
	rename `var' `newvar'

}
drop localbodytypecode localbodytypename

rename census2011code statecode_cen11
rename v6 districtcode_cen11
rename v9 subdistrictcode_cen11
rename v12 villagecode_cen11

rename villagecode villagecode_lgd21
rename localbodycode gp_code_lgd21
rename localbodyname gp_name_lgd21
rename v15 gp_code_cen11

drop if missing(villagename) & missing(villagecode_lgd21) & missing(villagecode_cen11) 
replace gp_code_cen11 = "000000" if lower(gp_code_cen11) ==  "null"
	
****prepare for merge****

*missing GP name in 2021 LGD -- just keep one for village code
duplicates tag villagecode_cen11, gen(dup)
gen missing_var = missing(gp_name_lgd21)
bysort villagecode_cen11: egen missing_var_total = total(missing_var)
drop if dup == 1 & missing(gp_name_lgd21) & missing_var_total == 1
drop missing_var*
drop dup

drop if villagecode_cen11 == "000000"

rename districtcode districtcode_lgd21 
rename districtname districtname_lgd21 
rename subdistrictcode subdistrictcode_lgd21 
rename subdistrictname subdistrictname_lgd21 
rename blockcode blockcode_lgd21 
rename blockname blockname_lgd21 
drop districtcode_cen11 subdistrictcode_cen11


*make all the name variables lower case
foreach var of varlist *name* {
	replace `var' = lower(trim(`var'))

}

*drop ones that are pure duplicates
bysort villagecode_cen11 gp_name_lgd21 (rand): keep if _n == 1

bysort villagecode_cen11 (rand): keep if _n == 1 //only 50 cases of this, just keep one

destring villagecode_cen11, gen(villagecode_num)
drop rand

rename state_code statecode_lgd21


save "$intdata/villagedirectory/lgdirectory2021.dta", replace
method: population-threshold regression discontinuity
title: Polity Size and Local Government Performance: Evidence from India

	destring pc01_village_id , gen(village_code_num)
	destring pc01_state_id  , gen(state_code_num)
	merge m:1 state_code_num village_code_num using `block_code01', keep(1 3) nogen

***************************************************	
*Determine which districts are the non-compliant ones in each delimitation cycle 
***************************************************
use "$rawdata/jal_jeevan/jj2011_villagedirectory_crosswalk.dta", clear

	bysort 	gp_code_jj11 : egen pop_pc91_gp_jj11	= total(pc91_pca_tot_p) if !missing(gp_code_jj11)
	gen solo_gp95 = pop_pc91_gp_jj11 == pc91_pca_tot_p if !missing(pc11_pca_tot_p)
	
	gen district = ""
	gen b = .
	gen z = .
	gen n = .
	
	bysort pc91_district_id: gen temp = _N
	levelsof pc91_district_id if temp > 50, local(levels)
	drop temp
	local i = 1
    foreach l of local levels {
			
	rdrobust pop_pc91_gp_jj11 pc91_pca_tot_p  ///
			if  statename == "uttar pradesh" & pc91_district_id == "`l'", c(1000)
		matrix A = e(b)
		matrix B = e(V)
		local z = round(A[1,1]/sqrt(B[1,1]),.01)
	
	rdrobust solo_gp95 pc91_pca_tot_p  ///
			if  statename == "uttar pradesh" & pc91_district_id == "`l'", c(1000)
		matrix A = e(b)
		
		replace z = `z' in `i'
		replace b = A[1,1] in `i'
		replace district = "`l'" in `i'
		replace n = r(N) in `i'
		
		local i = `i' + 1
	
	}

	*get list of districts that the discontinuity is not 
	gen noncompliant_district_1995 = 0
	
	gen temp = _n
	qui sum temp if !missing(district)
	local lastd = `r(max)'
	drop temp
	
	forval i = 1/`lastd' {
		
		local district = district[`i']
		local z = z[`i']
		local b = b[`i']
		
		if `z' > -1.5 & `b' < .3 {
			replace noncompliant_district_1995 = 1 if pc91_district_id == "`district'" 
		}
	}
	
	gen temp = _n
	qui sum temp if !missing(district)
	local lastd = `r(max)'
	drop temp
	
	gen t= .
	gen beta = .
	
	forval i = 1/`lastd' {
		
		local district = district[`i']
		local z = z[`i']
		local b = b[`i']
		
		replace t = `z' if pc91_district_id == "`district'" 
		replace beta = `b' if pc91_district_id == "`district'" 
	}
	
	tab noncompliant_district_1995
	
	
drop if missing(pc91_district_id)
collapse noncompliant_district_1995 beta t, by(pc91_district_id)

if `budget_per_gp' == 1 | `RunAll' == 1 {
	
	************************NREGS budget ************************

	use "$analysis_data/nregs/up_nregs.dta", clear 
	bysort gp_code_lgd21 year (villagecode_lgd21): keep if _n == 1
	
	gen expenditure_total = expenditure_labor + expenditure_material 
	gen expenditure_total_pp = expenditure_labor_pp + expenditure_material_pp
	
	bysort blockcode_lgd21 year: egen expenditure_total_max = max(expenditure_total) 
	bysort blockcode_lgd21 year: egen expenditure_total_pp_max = max(expenditure_total_pp) 
	gen expenditure_total_perc = expenditure_total / expenditure_total_max * 100
	gen expenditure_total_pp_perc = expenditure_total_pp / expenditure_total_pp_max * 100
	
	label variable expenditure_total "Total NREGS expenditure"
	label variable expenditure_total_pp "Total NREGS expenditure (per capita)"
	label variable expenditure_total_perc "Total NREGS expenditure (% of block maximum)"
	
	qui sum expenditure_total, d
	hist expenditure_total if expenditure_total < `r(p99)' ///
			, color(lavender) lcolor(navy) /// 
			graphregion(color(white)) bgcolor(white)
		graph export "$appendix_fig/nregs_expenditure_total_hist.png", replace width(800) height(600)
	
	qui sum expenditure_total_pp, d
	hist expenditure_total_pp if expenditure_total_pp < `r(p99)'	///
			, color(lavender) lcolor(navy) /// 
			graphregion(color(white)) bgcolor(white)
		graph export "$appendix_fig/nregs_expenditure_total_hist_pp.png", replace width(800) height(600)
	
	
	*as fraction of maximum within block (total), but don't display the max one
	gen nmexpenditure_total_perc = !missing(expenditure_total_perc)
	bysort nmexpenditure_total_perc blockcode_lgd21 year (expenditure_total_perc): replace nmexpenditure_total_perc = 2 if _n == _N & nmexpenditure_total_perc == 1
	hist expenditure_total_perc if nmexpenditure_total_perc !=2 ///
			, color(lavender) lcolor(navy) /// 
			graphregion(color(white)) bgcolor(white)
		graph export "$appendix_fig/nregs_expenditure_total_hist_perc.png", replace width(800) height(600)
	
	
		************************Individual program uptake ************************
	use "$analysis_data/mission_antyodaya/village_ma_2019_cleaned.dta", clear
		
	foreach var of varlist jandhan_hhs bpl_hhs abpmjay_received lpg_hhs total_hhs_pensions electricity_saubhagya pmmvy_received housing_schemes_total {
		
		bysort gp_code_lgd21: egen `var'_gp = total(`var')
	
	}
	
	bysort gp_code_lgd21: egen total_population_gp =  total(total_population)
	bysort gp_code_lgd21: egen total_hh_gp =  total(total_hh)
	
	
	bysort gp_code_lgd21 (villagecode_lgd21): keep if _n == 1
	keep gp_code_lgd21 *_gp  blockcode_lgd21
	
	egen beneficiaries_total = rowtotal(jandhan_hhs_gp - pmmvy_received_gp)
		
	gen beneficiaries_total_pp = beneficiaries_total / total_hh_gp / 8
	
	bysort blockcode_lgd21 : egen beneficiaries_total_max = max(beneficiaries_total) 
	gen beneficiaries_total_perc = beneficiaries_total / beneficiaries_total_max * 100
	
		
	label variable beneficiaries_total "Average household beneficiaries per program"
	label variable beneficiaries_total_pp "Average fraction of household beneficiaries per program"
	label variable beneficiaries_total_perc "Average household beneficiaries (% of block maximum)"
	
	qui sum beneficiaries_total, d
	hist beneficiaries_total if beneficiaries_total < `r(p99)' ///
			, color(lavender) lcolor(navy) /// 
			graphregion(color(white)) bgcolor(white)
		graph export "$appendix_fig/beneficiaries_total_hist.png", replace width(800) height(600)
	
	qui sum beneficiaries_total_pp, d
	hist beneficiaries_total_pp if beneficiaries_total_pp < `r(p99)'	///

	cd "$project_dir/Data/Input/Micro Demand Elasticities/"

*** Drop within-firm Cross-Price Elasticities	
	drop if product_i!=product_j & gvkey_i==gvkey_j
	
*** Take the Median at the firm level and across years	
	collapse (median) Elasticity_ij, by(gvkey*  firm* market)
	joinby gvkey_i gvkey_j using "$project_dir/Data/Output/Baseline/Elasticities.dta"
	sort gvkey*  firm* market year
	collapse (first) Micro=Elasticity_ij GHL=elasticity if year>1995, by(gvkey*  firm* market)	
	sort gvkey* market firm* 

*** Create "own" dummy	
	gen own=gvkey_i==gvkey_j

*** Residualize Elasticities on "own" dummy
	gen logy=ln(abs(GHL))
	gen logx=ln(abs(Micro))
	reghdfe logy logx,absorb(market own) vce(robust)
	encode market,gen(mid)
	reg logy i.own  i.mid
	predict logy_res,res
	reg logx i.own  i.mid
	predict logx_res,res
	pwcorr *res , sig bonferroni
	local rho=round(100*r(rho))
	local rho="0.`rho'"

*** Graph Options
	local options graphregion(lcolor(none)) plotregion(margin(zero) lcolor(none)) ///
		legend(ring(0) rows(10) region(lcolor(none) fcolor(none))) ylabel(,angle(horizontal))

local model "Baseline"
	
*** Load Data
	cd "$project_dir/Data/Output/`model'/"
	use "Model Data.dta",clear
	
*** Keep 2019 data
	keep if year==2021
	drop year
	
*** Solve Symmetric Model
	gen d=b-p_Phi-q_Phi
	egen q’Σq=sum(q_Phi*d)
	egen q’1=sum(q_Phi)
	egen q’q=sum(q_Phi^2)
	gen σ_bar=q’Σq/((q’1)^2-q’q)
	gen b₂=p_Phi+(1-σ_bar)*q_Phi+σ_bar*q’1
	gen d₂=b₂-p_Phi-q_Phi

*** Compute Centrality and Productivity	
	gen MC=c+delta*q_Phi
	gen logb =ln(b)
	gen logb₂=ln(b₂)
	gen logd=ln(d)
	gen logd₂=ln(d₂)
		
*** Graph Options

		graphregion(lcolor(none)) plotregion(margin(zero) lcolor(none))  xsize(7.5) ysize(5) ///

content:
*** Load Data
	cd "$project_dir/Data/Input/Micro Demand Elasticities/"
	use "Micro Demand Elasticities.dta",clear
	
*** Drop within-firm Cross-Price Elasticities	
	drop if product_i!=product_j & gvkey_i==gvkey_j
	
*** Take the Median at the firm level and across years	
	collapse (median) Elasticity_ij, by(gvkey*  firm* market)
	joinby gvkey_i gvkey_j using "$project_dir/Data/Output/Baseline/Elasticities.dta"
	sort gvkey*  firm* market year
	collapse (first) Micro=Elasticity_ij GHL=elasticity if year>1995, by(gvkey*  firm* market)	
	sort gvkey* market firm* 

*** Create "own" dummy	
	gen own=gvkey_i==gvkey_j

*** Residualize Elasticities on "own" dummy
	gen logy=ln(abs(GHL))
	gen logx=ln(abs(Micro))
	reghdfe logy logx,absorb(market own) vce(robust)
	encode market,gen(mid)
	reg logy i.own  i.mid
	predict logy_res,res
	reg logx i.own  i.mid
	predict logx_res,res
	pwcorr *res , sig bonferroni
	local rho=round(100*r(rho))
	local rho="0.`rho'"

*** Graph Options
	local options graphregion(lcolor(none)) plotregion(margin(zero) lcolor(none)) ///
		legend(ring(0) rows(10) region(lcolor(none) fcolor(none))) ylabel(,angle(horizontal))

*** Make Table		
	gsort -own market firm_i firm_j
	drop log* own gvkey* mid
	format %9.3f Micro GHL 
	
*** Save Table
	if !fileexists("$project_dir/Tables"){
		cap mkdir "$project_dir/Tables"
	}
	cd "$project_dir/Tables"
	save "Table 2.dta",replace
	browse

*** Load Data
	cd "$project_dir"
	cd Data
	cd Output
	cd "Baseline"
	use "Model Data.dta",clear
	
*** Average Over Time
	collapse (rawsum) pi_Phi w_Phi pi_W w_W pi_Pi w_Pi pi_H w_H  if gvkey>999 & year==2021, by(year)
	
*** Reshape vertically
	reshape long pi_ w_, i(year) j(model) string
	
*** Convert to Trillions (current prices)
	replace w_=w/(10^6)
	replace pi_=pi/(10^6)

*** Compute Table Stats	
	rename w_ _1
	rename pi_ _2
	gen _3=_1-_2
	gen temp=_1 if model=="W"
	egen W_W=mean(temp)
	gen _4=_1/W_W
	gen _5=_2/_1
	gen _6=_3/_1
	drop year W_W temp
	
*** Rearrange	
	reshape long _, i(model) j(statistic) 
	
*** Reshape horizontally
	reshape wide _ , i(statistic) j(model) string
	rename _* *
	
*** Format Variables and Reorder
	format %9.3f H-W
	gen Statistic="Total Surplus" if statistic==1
	replace Statistic="Aggregate Profits" if statistic==2
	replace Statistic="Consumer Surplus" if statistic==3
	replace Statistic="Total Surplus / Perfect Competition" if statistic==4
	replace Statistic="Aggregate Profit / Total Surplus" if statistic==5
	replace Statistic="Consumer Surplus / Total Surplus" if statistic==6
	drop statistic
	order Statistic Phi W Pi H
	
*** Save
	save "$project_dir/Tables/Table 3.dta",replace
	browse

	cd "$project_dir"
	cd Data
	cd Output
		
*** Load data from the various models
	local m1 "Baseline"
	local m2 "Cournot DRS"
	local m3 "Bertrand"
	local m4 "Cournot Fringe"
	local m5 "Cournot Tradable"
	local m6 "Input-Output"
	local m7 "Multi-Product"
	local m8 "Cournot XOPR"
	
*** Loop across files
	cd "Baseline"
	use "Model Data.dta",clear
	local m=1
	gen model="`m`m''"
	forval m=2/8 {
		cd ..
		cd "`m`m''"
		append using "Model Data.dta"
		replace model="`m`m''" if model==""
	}
	
*** Average Over Time
	collapse (rawsum) pi_Phi w_Phi pi_W w_W pi_Pi w_Pi pi_H w_H  if gvkey>999 & (year==1999 | year==2019), by(model year)
	
*** Compute Relevant Stats
	gen PS=100*pi_Phi/w_Phi
	gen DWL=100*(1-w_Phi/w_W)
	keep model year PS DWL
	
*** Rename
	replace model="Decreasing Returns to Scale" if model=="Cournot DRS"
	replace model="Private & Foreign Firms" if model=="Cournot Fringe"
	replace model="Tradable Industries Only" if model=="Cournot Tradable"
	replace model="Operating Costs as TVC" if model=="Cournot XOPR"
	replace model="Input-Output Linkages" if model=="Input-Output"	
	replace model="Multi-Product Firms" if model=="Multi-Product"	
	sort model
	
*** Reshape vertically
	reshape wide PS DWL, i( model) j(year) 
	order model PS* DWL*

	rename `v' v_`x'

	su obs if weosubjectcode == "`x'", meanonly

cls

import excel "${cd}\Figures 1 to 8 and table O2\Raw\WEO_April2022_data.xlsx", sheet("Sheet1") firstrow

preserve
