*creating filtered data and correlations
use "${cd}\Figures 1 to 8 and table O2\Intermediate output\merged_1.dta", replace

bysort ISO year: gen p_NGDP = GGX_NGDP / 100
bysort ISO year: gen r_GGX = rGDP * p_NGDP


bysort ISO: generate g_GGX = ((r_GGX[_n]/r_GGX[_n-1])-1)*100 //use this to define positive and negative cycles
bysort ISO: egen min_year = min(year) if r_GGX != . 
drop if min_year > year

drop if year > 2020
drop if r_GGX == . | rGDP == .

**
egen id = group(ISO)
tsset id year
tsfilter hp ct_rGDP=rGDP
tsfilter hp ct_rGGX=r_GGX

tsfilter hp ct_rGDP_post=rGDP if year>2006
tsfilter hp ct_rGGX_post=r_GGX if year>2006
tsfilter hp ct_rGDP_pre=rGDP if year<2007
tsfilter hp ct_rGGX_pre=r_GGX if year<2007

sort ISO year
egen corr_rGDP_GovtE = corr(ct_rGDP ct_rGGX), by(ISO)
egen corr_rGDP_GovtE_pre = corr(ct_rGDP_pre ct_rGGX_pre), by(ISO)
egen corr_rGDP_GovtE_post = corr(ct_rGDP_post ct_rGGX_post), by(ISO)
replace corr_rGDP_GovtE_pre=. if corr_rGDP_GovtE_pre==1 //small sample
egen corr_rGDP_GovtE_pos = corr(ct_rGDP ct_rGGX) if ct_rGDP > 0 , by(ISO)
egen corr_rGDP_GovtE_neg = corr(ct_rGDP ct_rGGX) if ct_rGDP < 0, by(ISO)

//note: ICRG data is not available due to contractual restrictions. Estimations here include only those without ICRG sourced variables. 

encode ISO, generate(code)


*declare data to be panel
xtset code year, yearly

*generate log variables of interest 
gen ln_y=ln(NGDP_R) // real gdp 
gen ln_ge=ln(NGDP_R*GGX_NGDP ) // real gov expenditure
gen ln_x=ln(x)  // Commodity ToT of exports

gen d_ge=d.ln_ge

use "${cd}\Tables 1 to 7, O1,O3,O4,O5,O6\Intermediate Output\merged_2.dta", clear

bysort ISO: egen min_year = min(year) if r_GGX != . 
drop if min_year > year

drop if year > 2020
drop if r_GGX == . | NGDP_R == .


egen id = group(ISO)
tsset id year

gen log_rGDP = log(NGDP_R)
gen log_rGGX = log(r_GGX)

gen delta_log_rGDP = d.log_rGDP
gen delta_log_rGGX = d.log_rGGX


* HP filter
tsfilter hp ct_rGDP=NGDP_R
tsfilter hp ct_rGGX=r_GGX
sort ISO year


egen corr_rGDP_GovtE = corr(ct_rGDP ct_rGGX), by(ISO)

**********************************************************************
** Regression part 
***********************************************************************
frame change default
frame copy default v3, replace
frame change v3

* Generate variables to store coefficients if they do not exist
gen constant = .
gen beta = .

* Loop through each id
forvalues i = 1/195 {
    regress delta_log_rGDP delta_log_rGGX if id == `i', vce(robust)
    matrix b = e(b)
    
    * Assuming that delta_log_rGGX is the variable of interest and it's the first and only regressor
    replace constant = b[1,2] if id == `i'
    replace beta = b[1,1] if id == `i'
}

*********************************************************
 * Results
collapse (mean) corr_rGDP_GovtE constant beta (first) Country, by(ISO)

count if corr_rGDP_GovtE > 0
count if corr_rGDP_GovtE < 0

count if beta > 0
count if beta < 0
export excel using "${cd}\Tables 1 to 7, O1,O3,O4,O5,O6\Output\table_O3.xlsx", sheet("table_O3_input") firstrow(variables) sheetmod

clear all
use "${cd}\Tables 1 to 7, O1,O3,O4,O5,O6\database_all.dta", clear


**filter database for tables 2 to 6
keep if Country=="Argentina" | Country=="Australia" | Country=="Brazil" | Country=="Canada" | ///
         Country=="Chile" | Country=="Colombia" | Country=="Costa Rica" | Country=="Ecuador" | ///
         Country=="Honduras" | Country=="Indonesia" | Country=="New Zealand" | Country=="Norway" | ///
         Country=="Russia" | Country=="South Africa" | Country=="Ukraine"


encode ISO, generate(code)

*declare data to be panel
xtset code year, yearly

*generate logs and differences
generate ln_x = ln(x)
generate ln_tot = ln(tot_2000) //
generate ln_g = ln(r_GGX)
generate ln_y = ln(NGDP_R)

generate d_ln_x = d.ln_x
generate d_ln_tot = d.ln_tot
generate d_ln_g = d.ln_g
generate d_ln_y = d.ln_y

*generate the rain and pours

gen y_x_pred = 0.08531*emde*d.ln_x + 0.0237*d.ln_x*(1-emde)
gen g_x_pred = 0.06*emde*d.ln_x - 0.123*d.ln_x*(1-emde)

*calculate average size of gov per country

bysort Country: egen g_over_y= mean( p_NGDP )
bysort Country: egen growth= mean( d_ln_y )

*calculate rains and pours 
*insert fiscal multiplier for commodity exporting countries
gen multiplier = 0.88 
gen pours = g_x_pred*multiplier*g_over_y
gen rains = y_x_pred-pours
gen total = (rains+pours)*emde + (rains-pours)*(1-emde)
gen pours_over_total= (pours/total)
gen pours_over_rain= (pours/rains)
gen rains_over_total= rains/total
gen pours_over_cycle= pours/(d_ln_y-growth)

gen rain_pos = rains if rains>0
gen rain_neg = rains if rains<0
gen pours_pos = pours if pours>0
gen pours_neg = pours if pours<0

*table 4
preserve
collapse (mean) pours_over_rain, by(Country)
export excel using "${cd}\Tables 1 to 7, O1,O3,O4,O5,O6\Output\table_4.xlsx", sheet("table_4") firstrow(variables) replace
restore
*table 5

drop if emde==0
collapse (mean) pours_over_total, by(Country)
export excel using "${cd}\Tables 1 to 7, O1,O3,O4,O5,O6\Output\table_5.xlsx", sheet("table_5") firstrow(variables) sheetmod
restore

preserve
collapse (mean) d_ln_x, by(emde year)
keep if year>=2003 & year<=2008

restore

content:
clear
set more off
set logtype text
set matsize 100


///===========================
**# Committee 
///===========================


// 98-102 committees
use "$rawCongress/committee/committees_98-102.dta", clear
gen inst=substr(var1,3,1)
keep if inst=="3"
gen time=substr(var1,8,1)
gen term_served=1 if time=="0" | time=="1"
replace term_served=2 if time=="2"
gen state=substr(var1,4,2)
destring state, replace
gen district=substr(var1,6,2)
destring district, replace
replace district=1 if district==98
gen id=substr(var1,15,5)
gen v2=substr(var1,48,3)
destring v2, replace
gen committeecode=substr(var1,51,3)
destring committeecode, replace
drop if committeecode>196
gen status=substr(var1,57,2)
gen chair=status=="11" | status=="12" | status=="13" | status=="16"
gen rank=status=="21" | status=="22" | status=="23"
gen com=1
keep if v2>=101
bysort v2 state district term_served committeecode: gen count=_n
keep if count==1
keep if term_served==1
drop if state==. | district==. | v2==. | committeecode==.
keep state district com rank chair v2 committeecode term_served
reshape wide com chair rank, i(v2 state district) j(committeecode)
compress
saveold "$createdCongress/committees_98-102_clean.dta", replace

//103-115 committess
use "$rawCongress/committee/committees_103-115.dta", clear
drop state statename cd
merge m:1 congress id using "$rawCongress/committee/members_103-115.dta", keepusing(state_po state_ic district chamberperiod) keep(master matched)
rename congress v2
keep if chamberperiod==1
drop if committeecode>196
drop if seniorpartymember>24
gen chair=seniorpartymember>=11 & seniorpartymember<=16
gen rank=seniorpartymember>=21 & seniorpartymember<=24
gen com=1
rename state_po state_abbrev
bysort v2 state_abbrev district committeecode: gen count=_n
keep if count==1
rename state_ic state

content:
drop if special=="TRUE"
*drop if party==""
drop if candidatevotes==.
drop if candidatevotes<=0
rename state_po state_abbrev
gen v2=.
replace v2=101 if year>=1988 & year<1990 & v2==.
replace v2=102 if year>=1990 & year<1992 & v2==.
replace v2=103 if year>=1992 & year<1994 & v2==.
replace v2=104 if year>=1994 & year<1996 & v2==.
replace v2=105 if year>=1996 & year<1998 & v2==.
replace v2=106 if year>=1998 & year<2000 & v2==.
replace v2=107 if year>=2000 & year<2002 & v2==.
replace v2=108 if year>=2002 & year<2004 & v2==.
replace v2=109 if year>=2004 & year<2006 & v2==.
replace v2=110 if year>=2006 & year<2008 & v2==.
replace v2=111 if year>=2008 & year<2010 & v2==.
replace v2=112 if year>=2010 & year<2012 & v2==.
replace v2=113 if year>=2012 & year<2014 & v2==.
replace v2=114 if year>=2014 & year<2016 & v2==.
replace v2=115 if year>=2016 & year<2018 & v2==.
replace v2=116 if year>=2018 & year<2020 & v2==.
bysort v2 state_abbrev district: egen max=max(totalvotes)
drop if max==0 | max==. | max==-1
drop max
bysort state_abbrev district v2: egen n_rivals=count(v2)
bysort v2 state_abbrev district: egen max=max(candidatevotes)
gen winner_candidate=candidate if candidatevotes==max
gen rep_candidate=candidate if party=="REPUBLICAN"
gen dem_candidate=candidate if party=="DEMOCRAT"
gen independent=party!="REPUBLICAN" & party!="DEMOCRAT" if candidatevotes!=.
gsort v2 state_abbrev district independent -candidatevotes
bysort v2 state_abbrev district independent: gen count=_n
replace count=. if independent==0
forvalues i=1(1)12 {
   gen minor_candidate`i'=candidate if independent==1 & count==`i'
}
gen green_candidate=candidate if party=="GREEN"
gen demshare=candidatevotes/totalvotes*100 if party=="DEMOCRAT"
gen repshare=candidatevotes/totalvotes*100 if party=="REPUBLICAN"
gen greenshare=candidatevotes/totalvotes*100 if party=="GREEN"
forvalues i=1(1)12 {
   gen min`i'share=candidatevotes/totalvotes*100 if independent==1 & count==`i'
}
drop minor_candidate12 minor_candidate11 min11share min12share count

gen winner_party=""
replace winner_party="R" if candidatevotes==max & party=="REPUBLICAN"
replace winner_party="D" if candidatevotes==max & party=="DEMOCRAT"
replace winner_party="I" if candidatevotes==max & party!="REPUBLICAN" & party!="DEMOCRAT"

foreach var of varlist winner_candidate winner_party rep_candidate dem_candidate minor_candidate* green_candidate {
	bysort v2 state_abbrev district: egen `var'_m=mode(`var')
	replace `var'=`var'_m
	drop `var'_m
}
foreach var of varlist *share {
	bysort v2 state_abbrev district: egen `var'_m=max(`var')
	replace `var'=`var'_m
	drop `var'_m
}

bysort v2 state_abbrev district: gen counter=_n
keep if counter==1
drop counter

egen check=rowtotal(demshare repshare min*share)
foreach var of varlist *share {
	replace `var'=0 if `var'==. & check>0
}
drop check

replace rep_candidate=winner_candidate if party=="REPUBLICAN" & rep_candidate=="" & winner_candidate!="" 
replace dem_candidate=winner_candidate if party=="DEMOCRAT" & dem_candidate=="" & winner_candidate!=""

version 18.0

set more off

set matsize 1000
set scheme s1color

local start_time = "$S_TIME"

********************************************************************************
* CreateSpeeches.do -- structure of this do file
*
* PART I: Reading and cleaning the data, prepare for merging
* 0. Create a file from the analysis data with ony the key information needed for the analysis in Table 8
* 1. Read and clean ICPSR Congress member codes, prepare for merging
* 2. Clean the db_matched data and prepare it for merging
* 3. Add info from cleaned_db_matched and true_icpsr to analysis data
* 4. Read speeches data set from source data (https://www.congress.gov/congressional-record/archive)
* 5. Read data on roll calls, prepare it to be matched with other data sets
* 6. Import govtrack data on bill sponsors
*
* Part II: Text analysis to classify whether green speeches mention short run costs and long-run benefits
* 7. Identify speeches with the green keywords
* 8. Creates two files with subsets of the training data, determine manually if these are green speeches
*     and whether they mention long-run benefits and short-run costs
* 9. Run the txttool command on the set of speeches that talk of either 
*     long-run benefits or short-run costs. Use discriminant analysis to verify 
*     whether the method correctly classifies speeches with cost_mention and benefit_mention
* 10. Validation on 2014 speeches
* 11. Create two ordered dictionaries, one based on the 2014 validation data set (cost_dictionary01)
*     and one based on all green speeches mentioning long-run benefits (benefit_dictionary01)
*
* Part III: Create the final data set for analysis
* 12. Create the final panel data set - 
*     Step 1: Match analysis data in year observed to speeches made in that year
*     calculate various measures of short-run cost and long-run benefit mentions
*     at the congressmember-speech-year level and the congressmember-year level
* 13. Create the final panel data set - 
*     Step 2: Match analysis data to speeches made in year-2, then procced as above
* 14. Create the final panel data set - 
*     Step 3: Append the two data sets together
********************************************************************************




**********************************************1**********************************
* 0. Create a file from the analysis data with ony the key information needed for the analysis in Table 8
********************************************************************************

keep cosponsor_other_cbp com102-com146 greenshare repshare lnpop lnarea lninc pct_age_over65 pct_black pct_for_born pct_urban urate fossil min_house power rep democrat min_house first female tenure_run age mv_bis *_miss v2 year state_abbrev district term_served
compress
save "$createdSpeeches/members_101-116_disaster_update.dta", replace



**********************************************1**********************************
* 1. Read and clean ICPSR Congress member codes, prepare for merging
* Steps 1, 2, and 3 are more cumbersome than they should be because different data sets have
* different spellings of congress-member names, different treatment of congressional 
* districts represented by multiple congress members in the same congress, and even 
* even different treatment of the same congress member who switches parties.
* One should invest in creating a proper crosswalk across all different data sets, 
* but we will leave this for some other day.
********************************************************************************

** 1.1)  Read data with ICPSR codes 
clear
import excel "$rawSpeeches/voteview/true_icpsr.xls", sheet("true_icpsr") firstrow
drop if cong<101
drop if state_name=="USA"

* rename party par

replace party_str = "I" if party == 328

* Create merging variable based on v2, state_abbrev, district
ren cong v2

gen lastname_icpsr = long_name1

* useful to identify party switchers, who have two different ICPSR codes
duplicates report v2 state_abbrev district lastname_icpsr firstname_icpsr
duplicates tag v2 state_abbrev district lastname_icpsr firstname_icpsr, gen(party_switcher)

* Create the orderno variable to deal with districts with multiple
* representatives in the same congress. They are ordered alphabetically.
sort v2 state_abbrev district lastname_icpsr firstname_icpsr
by v2 state_abbrev district: gen byte orderno=_n


gen lastname = lastname_icpsr
gen firstname = trim(firstname_icpsr)

ren v1_fix v1_fix_db

************************************
* Figure 2: Green bill sponsorship and margin of victory
************************************
version 18.0

clear



*****************
* MV BINSCATTER *
*****************

* use "$createdUpdate/analysis_data.dta", clear
use "$createdUpdate/analysis_data_short.dta", clear

* define safe district 
gen mv_bef=mv
foreach j of numlist 10 20 25 30 40 50 {
	gen safe_bef`j'=mv_bef>=`j' if mv_bef!=.
	gen unsafe_bef`j'=safe_bef`j'==0 if safe_bef`j'!=.
}

* General definition of the unsafe variable
gen unsafe0 = unsafe_bef20   // original definition of unsafe, not imposing unsafe=0 if run_next==0
gen unsafe  = unsafe_bef20
replace unsafe=0 if run_next==0   // Key modifications: redefine unsafe =0 if run_next==0

* adjust mv_bef for run_next and uncontested
replace mv_bef=mv_bef/100
replace mv_bef=0.45 if run_next==0 & mv_bef<0.45
replace uncontested=1 if mv_bef>=0.9
drop if uncontested==1

* scatter plot
global dis="dis_l1"

* First run regressions to get the regression lines.
* Districts hit by hurricane
reg cospgreen_cbp mv_bef if $dis==1
local eq = `"{&beta} = "'
local eq = `"`eq' `: display %4.2f _b[mv_bef]'"'
local eq = `"`eq' (`: display %4.2f _se[mv_bef]')"'
* Districts not hit by hurricane
reg cospgreen_cbp mv_bef if $dis==0
local eq2 = `"{&beta} = "'
local eq2 = `"`eq2' `: display %4.2f _b[mv_bef]'"'
local eq2 = `"`eq2' (`: display %4.2f _se[mv_bef]')"'

* Now calculate the dots for the bin scatter
gen mv_bef_int=round(mv_bef, 0.05)
cap drop counter
bysort v2 v1_fix $dis: gen counter=_n   // 
replace counter=. if counter!=1

* Graph for districts hit by hurricane
binscatter cospgreen_cbp mv_bef if $dis==1, nquantiles(50) msymbol(circle_hollow) mcolor(black) lcolor(black) /*
*/     xtitle("Margin of victory (share)") ytitle("N. green bills") ylabel(0 (0.5) 1.5) text(0.4 0.6 `"`eq'"') legend(off) /*
*/     graphregion(fcolor(white))  saving("$output/f2_binscatter1.gph", replace) 
graph export "$output/f2_binscatter1.eps", replace fontface(Times)
graph export "$output/f2_binscatter1.pdf", as(pdf) replace fontface(Times)
graph export "$output/f2_binscatter1.png", as(png) replace 

* Graph for districts not hit by hurricane
binscatter cospgreen_cbp mv_bef if $dis==0, nquantiles(50) msymbol(circle_hollow) mcolor(black) lcolor(black) /*
*/     xtitle("Margin of victory (share)") ytitle("N. green bills") ylabel(0 (0.5) 1.5) text(0.4 0.6 `"`eq2'"') legend(off) /*
*/     graphregion(fcolor(white)) saving("$output/f2_binscatter2.gph", replace) 
graph export "$output/f2_binscatter2.eps", replace fontface(Times)
graph export "$output/f2_binscatter2.pdf", replace fontface(Times)
graph export "$output/f2_binscatter2.png", replace

* Combine the two graphs in one
graph combine "$output/f2_binscatter1.gph" "$output/f2_binscatter2.gph", xcommon ycommon rows(1) saving("$output/f2_scatter_combined.gph", replace) graphregion(fcolor(white))
graph export "$output/f2_binscatter_combined.eps", replace fontface(Times)
graph export "$output/f2_binscatter_combined.pdf", replace fontface(Times)
graph export "$output/f2_binscatter_combined.png", replace

* Figure 3: The relation between PGI Child and the Entry Assessment (age 4-5) test score in the treatment and control group
*------------------------------------------------------------------------------*

use "${dirdata}/2_cleanData/cleanALSPAC_GxE.dta", clear
keep if window3mth == 1 // keep only 3 months of each side of the cutoff

/*
* Functional Form
* Plot to the data to visualize the realationship between G and the outcome for treat and control 
* The polygenic index (PGI) distribution is trimmed to be between -3 and +3 to avoid nonlinear overfitting of outliers
* The loop can be done for all the key stages, 
but in the paper we only have it for the entry assessment score so we only produce that figure here
*/
		
foreach outcome in ea { //ks1 ks2 ks3 ks4 
	local outcomelabel: variable label `outcome'
	local lab0 : label treat 0
	local lab1 : label treat 1

	* Bin-scatter plot of PGI over outcome spearately by treatment ("raw" evidence of GxE)
	capture drop PGI_bin* 
	capture drop meanP* 
	capture drop meanD* 
	capture drop tag*
	* control
	xtile 	PGI_bin0 = PGI, nquantiles(200),        if treat == 0
	bys 	PGI_bin0: egen meanP0 = mean(PGI)       if treat == 0
	bys 	PGI_bin0: egen meanD0 = mean(`outcome') if treat == 0
	egen 	tag0 = tag(meanP0 meanD0)               if treat == 0
	* treatment
	xtile 	PGI_bin1 = PGI, nquantiles(200),        if treat == 1
	bys 	PGI_bin1: egen meanP1 = mean(PGI)       if treat == 1
	bys 	PGI_bin1: egen meanD1 = mean(`outcome') if treat == 1
	egen 	tag1 = tag(meanP1 meanD1)               if treat == 1
		
	* twoway graph
	twoway  ///
		(lpolyci `outcome' PGI if treat==0, acolor(gs15) clcolor(gs9)) /// 		local polynomial
		(lpolyci `outcome' PGI if treat==1, acolor(gs15) clcolor(gs0)) ///
		(scatter meanD0 PGI if tag0==1, msize(vsmall) mcolor(gs9)) ///			scatter
		(scatter meanD1 PGI if tag1==1, msize(vsmall) mcolor(gs0)) ///
		if (PGI>-3 & PGI<3) & (meanD1>-3), /// cutting off the tails
		legend(label(2 "Control")  label(4 "Treated") ///
			   label(5 "Control, scatter") label(6 "Treated, scatter") /// 
			   rows(1) position(6) order(4 2)) ///
		xtitle("PGI Child") ytitle("`outcomelabel'") scheme(s1mono) xsc(r(-3 3)) xlabel(-3(1)3)
			
	graph export "${dirfigures}/PGIxTreat_`outcome'.png", replace
	drop 	PGI_bin* meanP* meanD* tag*
} // end foreach outcome

* produces a sample of MHS patients with diabetes and that develops various preventive care measures
* for this sample

local cdate = subinstr("`cdate2'"," ","_",.)


local highTemp "temp/"

	local caperPats = 1
	local tediPats = 1
	local sidrPats = 1
	local dpClinPats = 1
	local diagnosisYear = 1

	local tedniTreats = 1
	local caperTreats = 1
	local tediTreats = 1
	local sidrTreats = 1
	local ancillaryTreats = 1
	local dpClinTreats = 1
	local combineTreat = 1

local diabetesMedi = 1
	local diabetesMediPdts = 1
	local diabetesMediDprx = 1
	local mediCollapsed = 1

local combineFiles = 1





/* Diabetes */
local diabetes1 = 1 //Hemoglobin A1c testing
local diabetes2 = 1 //Urine Macroablumin
local diabetes3 = 1 //Eye exam (retinal) performed by an eye care provider
local diabetes4 = 1 //ACE/ARB Therapy
local diabetes5 = 1 //Statin Therapy

set matsize 11000
set maxvar 50000

if `diaPats' == 1 {
	capture confirm file `highTemp'diabetesPats.dta

		erase `highTemp'diabetesPats.dta

			erase `highTemp'diabetesPatsTedni.dta
			}
		local years "03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12 13"

			/*Data selection*/
			use DEID_EDI_PN DX1 DX2 DX3 DX4 DX5 DX6 DX7 DX8 using raw_data/tedni/tedni_20`year'.dta, clear

			forval d = 1/8 {
				replace DX`d'=subinstr(DX`d'," ","",.)
				}	
			
			/*Check for Diabetes*/
			gen diaPat = 0
			forval d = 1/8 { 
				replace diaPat = 1 if substr(DX`d',1,3) == "250"
				replace diaPat = 1 if inlist(substr(DX`d',1,4),"3572","3620","6480")
				replace diaPat = 1 if substr(DX`d',1,5) == "36641"
				}

gen ckd4 = 0
			forval c = 1/16 {
				replace ckd4 = 1 if substr(DX`c',1,4) == "5854"
				}
			
			gen esrd = 0
			forval c = 1/16 {
				replace esrd = 1 if inlist(substr(DX`c',1,4), "5855", "5856")
				replace esrd = 1 if inlist(substr(DX`c',1,5), "V4511", "V4512")
				}
			forval c = 1/6 {
				replace esrd = 1 if inlist(CPT_`c', "36147", "36800", "36810", "36815", "36818", "36819", "36820", "36821", "36831")
				replace esrd = 1 if inlist(CPT_`c', "36832", "36833", "90935", "90937", "90940", "90945", "90947")
				replace esrd = 1 if inrange(CPT_`c', "90957","90962")
				replace esrd = 1 if inlist(CPT_`c', "90965", "90966", "90969", "90970", "90989", "90993", "90997", "90999", "99512")
				replace esrd = 1 if inlist(substr(PROC`c',1,4),"3895","3927","3942","3943","3953","3993","3994","3995","5498")
				}
				
					
			gen kidTrans = 0
			forval c = 1/16 {
				replace kidTrans = 1 if substr(DX`c',1,4) == "V420"
				}
			forval c = 1/6 {
				replace kidTrans = 1 if inlist(CPT_`c', "50300", "50320", "50340", "50360", "50365", "50370", "50380")
				replace kidTrans = 1 if inlist(substr(PROC`c',1,4), "5561", "5569")
				}
			
			gen excludedPat = 0
			forval d = 1/16 { 
				replace excludedPat = 1 if inlist(substr(DX`d',1,3), "428", "410", "584", "369", "497") 
				replace excludedPat = 1 if inlist(substr(DX`d',1,4),"4412","5856","5854","2942")
				}
			forval c = 1/6 { //CPT1-3 are EM codes 
				replace excludedPat = 1 if inrange(CPT_`c',"33510","33528")
				replace excludedPat = 1 if inlist(substr(PROC`c',1,3), "361","497")
				}
				
			gen exPatStat = 0
			forval d = 1/16 { 
				replace exPatStat = 1 if inlist(substr(DX`d',1,2),"22","23")
				replace exPatStat = 1 if inlist(substr(DX`d',1,3),"571")
				replace exPatStat = 1 if inlist(substr(DX`d',1,4),"2385","5856","7291","7280")
				replace exPatStat = 1 if substr(DX`d',1,5) == "72888"		
				}
				
			gen yearEx = 3000
			replace yearEx = year if excludedPat==1
			gen yearExStat = 3000
			replace yearExStat = year if exPatStat==1
			
			collapse (max) diaCare1 diaCare2 diaCare3 `diaRet' `diaNeph' `diaNeuro' `diaCerebro' `diaCardio' `diaPvd' `diaMeta' nephTreat ckd4 esrd kidTrans excludedPat exPatStat (min) yearEx yearExStat, by(DEID_EDI_PN year)
			compress
			capture confirm file `highTemp'diabetesTreatsDpClin.dta
			if _rc == 0 {
				append using `highTemp'diabetesTreatsDpClin.dta
				}
			save `highTemp'diabetesTreatsDpClin.dta, replace
			}
		use `highTemp'diabetesTreatsDpClin.dta, clear
		by DEID_EDI_PN, sort: egen firstExclusion = min(yearEx)
		by DEID_EDI_PN, sort: egen firstExclusionStat = min(yearExStat)
		compress
		save `highTemp'diabetesTreatsDpClin.dta, replace
		}
	if `combineTreat' == 1 {
		use `highTemp'diabetesTreatsTedni.dta, clear
		append using `highTemp'diabetesTreatsCaper.dta
		append using `highTemp'diabetesTreatsTedi.dta
		append using `highTemp'diabetesTreatsSidr.dta
		append using `highTemp'diabetesTreatsAncil.dta
		append using `highTemp'diabetesTreatsDpClin.dta
		
		collapse (max) diaCare1 diaCare2 diaCare3 `diaRet' `diaNeph' `diaNeuro' `diaCerebro' `diaCardio' `diaPvd' `diaMeta' nephTreat ckd4 esrd kidTrans (min) firstExclusion firstExclusionStat, by(DEID_EDI_PN year)
		
		gen scoreRet = 0
		gen compRet = 0
		replace scoreRet = 1 if inlist(1,diaRet1,diaRet2,diaRet3,diaRet4,diaRet5,diaRet6)
		replace scoreRet = 2 if inlist(1,diaRet7,diaRet8,diaRet9,diaRet10)

gen mainPop = 1 if age<=75 & age>=18 & rvuL<1000 & consecPrimeMonths>=12 & year<firstExclusion & consecNotMedicareEligMonths>=12 & inlist(PN_SEX_CD, "M","F") & SPON_RACE!="Z"
	gen mainPopStat = 1 if age<=75 & age>=40 & year<firstExclusionStat & rvuL<1000 & consecPrimeMonths>=12 & consecNotMedicareEligMonths>=12 & inlist(PN_SEX_CD, "M","F") & SPON_RACE!="Z"
	replace mainPop = 0 if age<26 & PN_TYP_CD=="S"
	replace mainPopStat = 0 if age<26 & PN_TYP_CD=="S"
	
	gen active = 0
	replace active = 1 if D_MHS_POP_SECTOR_CD=="1"
	replace active = . if D_MHS_POP_SECTOR_CD=="Z"
	
	drop if year<2003
	
	encode mtf_par, generate(baseE)
	tostring(year), replace
	encode year, generate(yearE)
	destring(year), replace
	encode PG_CD, generate(payE)
	encode PN_TYP_CD, generate(sponE)
	encode PN_SEX_CD, generate(sexE)
	encode SPON_RACE, generate(raceE)
	encode D_MHS_POP_SECTOR_CD, generate(sectE)
	encode zipcode, generate(zipcodeE)
	
	egen baseYearOnOffFE = group(baseE yearE onOffPref)
	egen ageSexFE = group(age sexE)
	
	drop if DEID_EDI_PN==""
	drop if missing(year)
	drop if missing(age)

content:
***********************************************************************************

/*
Objective: This program prepares a table all ZIP codes in the U.S. along with 
	distances to the nearest Military Treatment Facility. We rely on the OMNICAD
	directory for the list of eligible MTFs; we identify the MTF zip code from 
	the DMISID files, and we calculate distances with Stata GeoNear command. We
	do this separately using the list of hospitals in 2003-2012. 
*/

***********************************************************************************
***********************************************************************************
* 0. Setup
***********************************************************************************

* Reset memory options
clear all
set more off
set mem 500m
set matsize 10000
local today = subinstr("`c(current_date)'"," ","",.)

* Install packages
ssc install geodist
ssc install geonear

* Set working directory
local mypath "/var/mhsjg/"
local mypath1 "/var/mhsjg/datawork/"
local mypath2 "/var/mhsjg/data/ORIG/decrypted/stata/"
local mypath3 "/var/mhsjg/petkunj/"

* Toggle between full sample and small random sample
local sample = "sample_"


* Toggle on/off parts of do-file
local part1 = 1
local part2 = 1
local part3 = 1
local part4 = 1
local part5 = 1

***********************************************************************************
* 1. Identify eligible MTFs
***********************************************************************************
gen year = .
save temp/Distances_to_MTFs_2003_2013_`today'.dta, replace	 

forval year = 3/13 {


if `part1' == 1 {
* Use the January 2013 OMNICAD (this is somewhat arbitrary)
* 	Using catchment facilities only

use raw_data/omnicad/a01`yr'.dta, clear

* Make a list of unique MTFs that appear as catchment facilities for any of the services
collapse (firstnm) hsscreg, by(A_WORLD N_WORLD F_WORLD O_WORLD)
rename A_WORLD CATCH1 
rename F_WORLD CATCH2
rename N_WORLD CATCH3
rename O_WORLD CATCH4
gen obs = _n          
reshape long CATCH, i(obs) j(subobs)
collapse (firstnm) hsscreg, by(CATCH)
rename CATCH dmisid

* Merge with DMISID files to associate DMIS codes w/ MTF info (including zip code)
merge 1:1 dmisid using raw_data/dmisid/dmisid_fy`yr'.dta, gen(dmisid_merge) keep(3)

* Drop closed bases
drop if factype == "INACT"

* Drop overseas and "noncat" facilities (which aren't really facilities, but just regions)
keep if usflag == "Y" & faczip != "" & faccntry == "US"

* Drop extraneous variables
collapse (firstnm) dmisnme dmisid instalnm faccity, by(faccntry facstate faczip)

merge 1:1 dmisid using raw_data/dmisid/dmisid_fy`yr'.dta, gen(dmisid_merge) keep(3)

* Drop closed bases
drop if factype == "INACT"

* Drop overseas and "noncat" facilities (which aren't really facilities, but just regions)
keep if usflag == "Y" & faczip != "" & faccntry == "US"

* Drop extraneous variables
collapse (firstnm) dmisnme dmisid instalnm faccity, by(faccntry facstate faczip)

* Clean individual MTF zipcodes
*	Zip code database is current. For zip codes that have been retired, we'll replace them with adjacent zip code.
replace faczip = "30310" if faczip == "30330"
replace faczip = "92106" if faczip == "92133"
gen ZIP = faczip
gen joinby = 1

save temp/catchment_dmisids_20`yr'.dta, replace
export excel using temp/catchment_dmisids_20`yr'.xls", replace  firstrow(var)

* 	Using MTF service areas (this allows for a longer list of eligible MTFs)
use raw_data/omnicad/a01`yr'.dta, clear

* Make a list of unique MTFs that appear as catchment facilities for any of the services
collapse (firstnm) hsscreg, by(A_BPA N_BPA F_BPA O_BPA)
rename A_BPA MTF1 
rename F_BPA MTF2
rename N_BPA MTF3
rename O_BPA MTF4
gen obs = _n          
reshape long MTF, i(obs) j(subobs)
collapse (firstnm) hsscreg, by(MTF)
rename MTF dmisid

* Merge with DMISID files to associate DMIS codes w/ MTF info (including zip code)
merge 1:1 dmisid using raw_data/dmisid_fy`yr'.dta, gen(dmisid_merge) keep(3)

* Drop closed bases
drop if inlist(faczip,"71311","78743","79489","94627","95342") > 0

* Drop overseas and "noncat" facilities (which aren't really facilities, but just regions)
keep if usflag == "Y" & faczip != ""  & faccntry == "US"

* There are up to 2 different MTFs in a single zip.
*	Collapse to zip code level
duplicates report faczip
forval i = 1/2 {
	bys faczip (dmisnme): gen dmisnme_`i' = dmisnme if _n == `i'
	bys faczip (dmisnme): gen dmisid_`i' = dmisid if _n == `i'
	bys faczip (dmisnme): gen instalnm_`i' = instalnm if _n == `i'
}
collapse (firstnm) dmisnme_1 dmisid_1 instalnm_1 dmisnme_2 dmisid_2 instalnm_2 faccity, ///
	by(faccntry facstate faczip)
	
* Clean individual MTF zipcodes
*	Zip code database is current. For zip codes that have been retired, we'll replace them with adjacent zip code.
replace faczip = "30310" if faczip == "30330"
replace faczip = "92106" if faczip == "92133"
gen ZIP = faczip
gen joinby = 1

save temp/MTF_dmisids_20`yr'.dta, replace
export excel using temp/MTF_dmisids_20`yr'.xls, replace  firstrow(var)

if `part2' == 1 {


use raw_data/zips_raw.dta

* Merge w/ list of catchment-eligible MTFs from Part 1
merge 1:1 ZIP using temp/catchment_dmisids_20`yr'.dta, gen(zipmerge)
assert zipmerge != 2 // Ensuring that all of the MTFs were matched to a zip code
keep if faczip != ""

* Prepare data for joinby with master zip code list
keep faccntry facstate faczip dmisnme dmisid instalnm faccity LAT LONG joinby
rename LAT faclat
rename LONG faclong

save temp/catchment_dmisids_20`yr'.dta, replace 

* Merge w/ list of service area MTFs from Part 1
use raw_data/zips_raw.dta, clear
merge 1:1 ZIP using temp/MTF_dmisids_20`yr'.dta, gen(zipmerge)
assert zipmerge != 2 // Ensuring that all of the MTFs were matched to a zip code
keep if faczip != ""

* Prepare data for joinby with master zip code list
keep faccntry facstate faczip dmisnme* dmisid* instalnm* faccity LAT LONG joinby
rename LAT faclat
rename LONG faclong

save temp/MTF_dmisids_20`yr'.dta, replace 

}

***********************************************************************************
* 3. Calculate distances between all zip codes and nearest MTF zip code
***********************************************************************************
if `part3' == 1 {

use raw_data/zips_raw.txt, clear

* Call geonear command to calculate distances 
* Using catchment area MTFs only
geonear ZIP LAT LONG using temp/catchment_dmisids_20`yr'.dta, ///
	neighbors(faczip faclat faclong) wide miles ellipsoid genstub(e_nid)
lab var e_nid "Zip code of nearest catchment MTF"
lab var mi_to_e_nid "Miles to nearest zip code w/ catchment MTF"

* Using service area MTFs (a superset of MTFs)
geonear ZIP LAT LONG using temp/MTF_dmisids_20`yr'.dta, ///
	neighbors(faczip faclat faclong) wide miles ellipsoid genstub(e_nid_all)
lab var e_nid_all "Zip code of nearest service area MTF"
lab var mi_to_e_nid_all "Miles to nearest zip code w/ service area MTF"


* Re-merge with MTF details
rename e_nid faczip
merge m:1 faczip using temp/catchment_dmisids_20`yr'.dta, gen(facmerge1)
rename faczip mtf_zipcode_catch
lab var mtf_zipcode_catch "Zip code of nearest catchment MTF."
rename e_nid_all faczip
merge m:1 faczip using temp/MTF_dmisids_20`yr'.dta, gen(facmerge2)
rename faczip mtf_zipcode_svc
lab var mtf_zipcode_svc "Zip code of nearest MTF with an MTF service area."

* Save results
save temp/Distances_to_MTFs_20`yr'_`today'.dta, replace
}

***********************************************************************************
* 4. Clean-up
***********************************************************************************
if `part4' == 1 {
use temp/Distances_to_MTFs_20`yr'_`today'.dta, clear
* Drop extraneous variables and rename/reorder variables
rename ZIP zipcode
lab var zipcode "Own 5-digit zipcode"
rename PO_NAME city
lab var city "City name"
rename STATE state
lab var state "State"

**# Bookmark #2
***********Create Variables to indicate which ER visits are truly emergent by **************
//create weekend cutoff variables
use temp/er_2.dta
sort DX1
egen groupid = group(DX1) if tedni==1
label var groupid "group id variable for observations with the same diagnosis code"

gen daily_date = begdate
format daily_date %td
gen weekly_date = week(daily_date) if tedni==1
gen monthly_date = month(daily_date) if tedni==1
gen week_days = dow(daily_date) if tedni==1
label var week_days "day of the week of medical visit  0-sunday to 6-saturday"

gen weekend = . if tedni==1
replace weekend=0 if week_days==1 | week_days==2 | week_days==3 | week_days==4 | week_days==5
replace weekend=1 if week_days==0 | week_days==6
label var weekend "indicator variable for if a medical visit occurs on the weekend"

sort groupid
by groupid: gen dxcount = _N if tedni==1
label var dxcount "number of observations with a particular diagnosis"

bysort groupid: egen weekendcount = total(weekend==1) if tedni==1
label var weekendcount "number of observations with a particular diagnosis that occured on the weekend"

replace weekendpercent = (weekendcount/dxcount) if tedni==1
label var weekendpercent "percent of observations of a diagnosis that occured on the weekend"

gen weekendcutoff24=0 
replace weekendcutoff24=1 if weekendpercent>=.24 //chose a cutoff close to 2/7 but .24 is relatively arbitrary 
label var weekendcutoff24 "flag for over 24% of observations with a dx occurring on weekend"
gen weekendcutoff20=0 
replace weekendcutoff20=1 if weekendpercent>=.20 //chose a cutoff close to 2/7 but .20 is relatively arbitrary 
label var weekendcutoff20 "flag for over 20% of observations with a dx occurring on weekend"

drop groupid daily_date weekly_date monthly_date week_days weekend dxcount weekendcount 
save temp/er_2.dta, replace

		erase `prime'mhsDeaths.dta
		}
	local years "03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12 13"

			keep if D_DEATH_CD=="Y"
			
			rename DEID_DOD_EDI_PN_ID DEID_EDI_PN
			gen deathDate = D_DEATH_DT
			
			keep DEID_EDI_PN deathDate
			
			capture confirm file `prime'mhsDeaths.dta

				}
			compress
			save `prime'mhsDeaths.dta, replace
			}	
		}

	drop if missing(deathDate)
	
	gen deathYear = year(deathDate)
	drop if deathYear<2002
	gen deathMonth = month(deathDate)

	replace deathMonthF = deathMonthF - 12 if deathMonthF>12
	gen deathYearF = deathYear
	replace deathYearF=deathYearF+1 if deathMonthF<4
	sort DEID_EDI_PN deathDate
	sort DEID_EDI_PN, stable
	by DEID_EDI_PN: keep if 2>_n
	save `prime'mhsDeaths.dta, replace

* The second and primary file is at the person level

/* example.do

Illustrates use of jackknife code 'jregress.ado'.
Implements methods from "Jackknife standard errors for clustered regression"
by Bruce E. Hansen

This example file uses the pre-processed data file Meng_1.dta.
The file jregress.ado needs to be in the same folder.

Five example regressions are shown. All report jackknife standard errors.

The first example calculates the regression for the model corresponding to the first column of Table 7 of the Meng, Qian, and Yared (2015), but with jackknife standard errors clustered by province, and inference (p-values and condfidence intervals) calculated by the adjusted t distribution.

The second example repeats this regression but omits clustering.

The third example repeats the first regression and displays the adjustment coefficients.

The fourth example repeats the first regression but calculates inference by the standard t distribution.

The fifth example takes the first regression and adds cluster-level fixed effects.

The sixth example adds two cluster-level dummy variable indicators to the first regression. The dummy variables fail clusterwise invertibility. The regression and standard errors are reported, but a warning message is displayed.
*/

clear all
use Meng_1, clear

drop if lgrain_pred_famdum5860==.
keep if year >= 1953
keep if year <= 1982

gen diff_pred = lgrain_pred_famdum5860 - lgrain_pred
gen Beijing = (province == "Beijing")
gen Tianjin = (province == "Tianjin")

jregress ldeath_b diff_pred lgrain_pred ltotpop lurbpop i.year, cluster(prov)

jregress ldeath_b diff_pred lgrain_pred ltotpop lurbpop i.year

jregress ldeath_b diff_pred lgrain_pred ltotpop lurbpop i.year, cluster(prov) dfdisplay

jregress ldeath_b diff_pred lgrain_pred ltotpop lurbpop i.year, cluster(prov) noadjust

jregress ldeath_b diff_pred lgrain_pred ltotpop lurbpop i.year, cluster(prov) fe 

jregress ldeath_b diff_pred lgrain_pred ltotpop lurbpop Beijing Tianjin i.year, cluster(prov)

content:
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- *
/* 

This is a Stata file, used to pre-process data to create Table 7 in Hansen (2025)
"Jackknife standard errors for clustered regression"

It takes as an input the data file province.dta from the replication file for
The Institutional Causes of China's Great Famine, 1959 - 1961 by Meng, Qian and Yared (2015), available at 
https://academic.oup.com/restud/article/82/4/1568/2607347#supplementary-data.
The data file is province.dta

The processed data are saved in the file Meng_1.dta

*/
* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- *

version 16.1
clear all
set more off

use province.dta, replace

drop if province=="Sichuan"|province=="Tibet" 	// famine era data missing for these provinces
drop if auto==1

tab year, g(ydum)
sort prov year
tsset prov year
replace ldeath_b=f.ldeath_b

tsset prov year

*Input Variables for predicting grain production
g grainpc_3ma=(l.grainpc+l2.grainpc+l3.grainpc)/3
replace grainpc_3ma= (l2.grainpc+l3.grainpc+l4.grainpc)/3 if year==1959 /*this makes sure we never use GLF grain data for the prediction later*/
replace grainpc_3ma= (l3.grainpc+l4.grainpc+l5.grainpc)/3 if year==1960
replace grainpc_3ma= (l4.grainpc+l5.grainpc+l6.grainpc)/3 if year==1961
g lgrainpc_3ma=ln(grainpc_3ma)
g grain_3ma=(l.grain+l2.grain+l3.grain)/3
g lgrain_3ma=(grain_3ma)

foreach x of varlist tem*sum pre*sum{
	replace `x'=0 if `x'==.
}
foreach x of varlist tem*sum pre*sum rurpop grain_3ma cer_*sum wheat_*sum rice_*sum{
	g `x'_exp1=`x'
	g `x'_exp2=(`x'+1)^2
}
forval x=1/12{
	g tem_pre_`x'=tem_`x'_sum_exp1*pre_`x'_sum_exp1
}
forval x=1/12{
	g tem_rurpop_`x'=tem_`x'_sum_exp1*rurpop_exp1
}
forval x=1/12{
	g pre_rurpop_`x'=pre_`x'_sum_exp1*rurpop_exp1
}
g rurpop_exp1_area=rurpop_exp1*area
g rurpop_exp12_area=rurpop_exp2*area
g area_exp2=area^2

g urb_share=urbpop/totpop 
label var urb_share "Urban Pop Share"

*Princpal Components of GLF
replace anti_right=anti_right/totpop /*normalize anti-right*/
replace anti_right_famdum5860=anti_right*famdum5860
pca sownpc_g steelpc_g messhall anti_right liberation if glf==1
predict xx, score
egen glf_pca=max(xx), by(province)
drop xx
g famine_glf_pca=glf_pca*famdum

*PREDICT PRODUCTION
/*main method*/
xi: reg grain cer_*sum* rice_*sum* wheat_*sum* *sum_exp1 *sum_exp2 tem_pre* tem*rurpop* pre*rurpop* rurpop_exp1-rurpop_exp2 area area_exp2 rurpop*area if auto==0&year!=.1959&year!=.1960&year!=.1961&year<=1982
*outreg2 using results/prod_fn.xls, replace se noast nocons
predict grain_pred

tsset prov year

content:
drop xx
g famine_glf_pca=glf_pca*famdum

*PREDICT PRODUCTION
/*main method*/
xi: reg grain cer_*sum* rice_*sum* wheat_*sum* *sum_exp1 *sum_exp2 tem_pre* tem*rurpop* pre*rurpop* rurpop_exp1-rurpop_exp2 area area_exp2 rurpop*area if auto==0&year!=.1959&year!=.1960&year!=.1961&year<=1982
*outreg2 using results/prod_fn.xls, replace se noast nocons
predict grain_pred

tsset prov year

g grain_predpc=(grain_pred*10000*1000)/(totpop*10000) /*grain is measured in tons, so we multiply by 1,000 to convert to kgs. population is measured in 10,000 people. So, we multipy by 10,000 to measure it in individuals*/
g lgrain_predpc=ln(grain_pred/totpop)
g grain_predpc_g=lgrain_predpc-l.lgrain_predpc
g lgrain_pred=ln(grain_pred)
g lgrain_pred_famdum5860=lgrain_pred*famdum5860
egen grain_pred_nat=sum(grain_pred), by(year)

*National Trends
egen grain_nat=sum(grain), by(year)
replace grain_nat=grain_nat/100
egen pop_nat=sum(totpop), by(year)
egen rpop_nat=sum(rurpop), by(year)
g rur_proc=total_buy-agrc_sell
egen nat_rur_proc=sum(rur_proc), by(year)
egen nat_yield=sum(yield), by(year)
g rur_procrate=nat_rur_proc/nat_yield

*Gov Projected Grain Production based on past production and past production growth
g grain_projpc=l2.grain_predpc+l2.grain_predpc*(((l2.grain_predpc_g+l3.grain_predpc_g+l4.grain_predpc_g)/3)^2) /* gov assumes that production grows at avg nat growth rate for 49-59*/
*Gap between Gov Projections and Realized Production
g prodgappc=(grain_projpc-grain_predpc)

*REPORTED PROCUREMENT
g ret_real=grain-grain*balance_p
g proc_real=grain*balance_p
g proc_real2=grain_pred*balance_p
g proc_realpc=(proc_real/rurpop)*1000

*RETENTION based on Predicted production and reported procurement
g ret_pred=grain_pred-proc_real2
g ret_pred_pc=(ret_pred/rurpop)*1000
g lret_pred=ln(ret_pred+5)
g lret_pred_pc=ln(ret_pred_pc+5)

keep if grain_pred!=. 
save "Meng_1", replace

g lgrain_predpc=ln(grain_pred/totpop)

egen pop_nat=sum(totpop), by(year)

egen nat_rur_proc=sum(rur_proc), by(year)
egen nat_yield=sum(yield), by(year)

g grain_projpc=l2.grain_predpc+l2.grain_predpc*(((l2.grain_predpc_g+l3.grain_predpc_g+l4.grain_predpc_g)/3)^2) /* gov assumes that production grows at avg nat growth rate for 49-59*/
*Gap between Gov Projections and Realized Production
g prodgappc=(grain_projpc-grain_predpc)

g lret_pred=ln(ret_pred+5)
g lret_pred_pc=ln(ret_pred_pc+5)

keep if grain_pred!=.

/********************************************************************

Version date: Oct 26, 2024

This .do file is part of the replication package for

Ichino, Rustichini, and Zanella (2025),
"College, cognitive ability, and socioeconomic disadvantage:
policy lessons from the UK in 1960-2004"
Review of Economic Studies

Part (A) uses Understanding Society (Usoc) raw data files waves 1-11 (years 2009-2021,
dropping interviews in 2020 and 2021 to avoid contamination of wage data with during the pandemic),
and produces clean Usoc data files with estimated wage profiles and DPV

Part (B) uses Understanding Society (Usoc) raw data files waves 1-9 (years 2009-2018),
and produces clean Usoc data files for the analyses in the paper.

Notes: the order of variables must not be changed
       (except for the order command already included in the do file)
 	   
        we code missing categories as 999999
		        inapplicable as 999998
 				proxy as 999997
 				refusal as 999992
 				don't know as 999991	
		for continuous variables, missing values are coded -999999 and

**********************************************************************/

***********************************************
*** PROGRAM FOR RECODING THE MISSING VALUES ***
***********************************************

capture program drop recode_missing
program define recode_missing
	version 15.1 // Stata version when developed this program
	
	syntax, type(string) orig(varname numeric) new(varname numeric) [origvallab]
	
	if "`type'" == "categorical" {
		recode_missing_categorical, orig(`orig') new(`new') `origvallab'
	}
	else if "`type'" == "continuous" {
		recode_missing_continuous, orig(`orig') new(`new') `origvallab'
	}
	else {
		display as error "invalid variable type"
		exit 198
	}
end

capture program drop recode_missing_categorical
program define recode_missing_categorical
	version 15.1 // Stata version when developed this program
	
	syntax, orig(varname numeric) new(varname numeric) [origvallab]
	
	* Recode missing values
	replace `new' = -`orig' + 999990 if `orig' < 0
	
	* Deal with value labels
	local vallab : value label `new'
	if "`vallab'" != "" {
		label define `vallab' 999991 "don't know" 999992 "refusal" 999997 "proxy" 999998 "inapplicable" 999999 "missing", modify
	}
	else if "`origvallab'" != "" {
		local origlab : value label `orig'
		label define `origlab' 999991 "don't know" 999992 "refusal" 999997 "proxy" 999998 "inapplicable" 999999 "missing", modify
		label values `new' `origlab'
	}
	else {
		label define `new' 999991 "don't know" 999992 "refusal" 999997 "proxy" 999998 "inapplicable" 999999 "missing"
		label values `new' `new'
	}
	
	* Tabulate the result
	di "{title:Original `orig' vs new `new'}"
	capture noisily tab `orig' `new', miss nolab
	if _rc {
		di "{title:Original variable: `orig'}"
		tab `orig', miss nolab
		di "{title:New variable: `new'}"
		tab `new', miss nolab
	}
end

capture program drop recode_missing_continuous
program define recode_missing_continuous
	version 15.1 // Stata version when developed this program
	
	syntax, orig(varname numeric) new(varname numeric)
	
	* Check the name of the new variable for missing codes does not exist
	confirm new variable `new'_miss
	
	* Check that original variable is different from new
	capture assert "`orig'" != "`new'"
	if _rc {
		display as error "in continuous case original and new variable cannot coincide"
		exit 9
	}

*** SINGLE EQUATION APPROACH

* "SINGLE" REFERS TO A STRATEGY THAT AVOIDS THE ITERATIVE PROCEDURE OF LAGAKOS ET AL.
* THIS SINGLE EQUATION APPROACH IDENTIFIES THE AGE EFFECTS (CONTROLLING FOR COHORT AND TIME)
* BY IMPOSING THE RESTRICTION THAT THE AGE EFFECT IS ZERO AFTER A CERTAIN AGE
* THIS BREAKS THE COLLINEARITY WITH COHORT AND TIME (YEAR) EFFECTS.

*** "FULLY" INTERACTED VERSION (AGE DUMMIES INTERACTED WITH GENDER AND ANY TERTIARY)

content:
sort id age

tsset id year

xtreg wage i.year ///
		   dage18-dage50 dage61-dage65 ///
		   dage18_fem-dage50_fem dage61_fem-dage65_fem ///
		   dage18_college-dage50_college dage61_college-dage65_college ///
		   dage18_college_female-dage50_college_female dage61_college_female-dage65_college_female /// 
		   dage18_hs-dage50_hs dage61_hs-dage65_hs ///
		   dage18_hs_female-dage50_hs_female dage61_hs_female-dage65_hs_female, fe
		   	   
		   
* in-sample prediction
predict wage_fit, xbu // prediction including individual effects

* individual fixed effect
predict wage_fe, u // individual fixed effect


bysort id: egen temp = mean(wage_fe)
replace wage_fe = temp if wage_fe == .
drop temp

* out-of-sample predicion of hourly wage

gen cons = _b[_cons]

forvalues a = 18(1)50 {
	gen wage_`a' = .
	gen bage`a' = .
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a']				     		   if female == 0 & college == 0 & hs == 0
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a'] + _b[dage`a'_college]  	   if female == 0 & college == 1 & hs == 0
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a'] + _b[dage`a'_hs]  	   	   if female == 0 & college == 0 & hs == 1
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a'] + _b[dage`a'_fem] 		   if female == 1 & college == 0 & hs == 0
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a'] + _b[dage`a'_fem] ///
			        + _b[dage`a'_college]  + _b[dage`a'_college_female]  if female == 1 & college == 1 & hs == 0
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a'] + _b[dage`a'_fem] ///
			        + _b[dage`a'_hs]  + _b[dage`a'_hs_female]  if female == 1 & college == 0 & hs == 1				
					
	replace wage_`a' = cons + bage`a' + wage_fe
	label var wage_`a' "predicted hourly wage at age `a'"
	drop bage`a'
}


forvalues a = 51(1)60 {
	gen wage_`a' = wage_50 // flat profile between 51 and 60
	label var wage_`a' "predicted hourly wage at age `a'"
}


forvalues a = 61(1)65 {
	gen wage_`a' = .
	gen bage`a' = .
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a']				     		   if female == 0 & college == 0 & hs == 0
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a'] + _b[dage`a'_college]  	   if female == 0 & college == 1 & hs == 0
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a'] + _b[dage`a'_hs]  	   	   if female == 0 & college == 0 & hs == 1
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a'] + _b[dage`a'_fem] 		   if female == 1 & college == 0 & hs == 0
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a'] + _b[dage`a'_fem] ///
			        + _b[dage`a'_college]  + _b[dage`a'_college_female]  if female == 1 & college == 1 & hs == 0
	replace bage`a' = _b[dage`a'] + _b[dage`a'_fem] ///
			        + _b[dage`a'_hs]  + _b[dage`a'_hs_female]  if female == 1 & college == 0 & hs == 1				
					
	replace wage_`a' = cons + bage`a' + wage_fe
	label var wage_`a' "predicted hourly wage at age `a'"
	drop bage`a'
}


forvalues a = 18(1)21 {
	replace wage_`a' = . if college == 1 // graduates enter employment at age 22
}

preserve
	keep id wage_45
	duplicates drop id, force
	sort id
	save "$edited/wage45_formerge.dta", replace

**************************************************************
*** STANTARDIZATION OF THE ELEMENTARY COGNITIVE INDICATORS ***
**************************************************************
				
* the new variables standarized by birth year will have a suffix _sty
* all other variables maintain the original name

*** Preparation of the cognitive indicators

/* LIST OF COGNITIVE INDICATORS WE WANT TO USE
c_cgwri_dv - number of correctly recalled words (immediate)
c_cgwrd_dv - number of correctly recalled words (delayed)
c_cgs7cs_dv - number of correct substrations
c_cgnssc6_dv - number of correct answers to number series
			which combines c_cgns1sc6_dv c_cgns2sc6_dv
c_cgvfc_dv - number of correct unique animal names
c_cgna_dv - number of correct answers to numeric ability problems

help_mem - help received in immediate recall test"
help_dmem - help received in delayed recall test"
aid_mem - aid used during immediate word recall"
aid_sub - aid used during serial 7 subtraction"
help_sub - aid used during subtraction test"
help_ns - aid used during number series test"
help_vf - aid used during animal names test"
help_na - aid used during numeric ability test"
*/

des c_cgwri_dv c_cgwrd_dv c_cgs7cs_dv c_cgns1sc6_dv c_cgns2sc6_dv c_cgvfc_dv c_cgna_dv
sum c_cgwri_dv c_cgwrd_dv c_cgs7cs_dv c_cgns1sc6_dv c_cgns2sc6_dv c_cgvfc_dv c_cgna_dv [aw = $weight_var]



/*
we calculate the pca ability score only for observations that have no missing
in all the cognitive and aid variables
*/


** Convert the aid variables into dummies
global prefix mem dmem sub ns vf na
global haid 
foreach p in $prefix {
	gen help_`p' = c_`p'cont3 == 1
	drop if c_`p'cont3 < 0 & c_`p'cont13 != 1
	global haid $haid help_`p'
}

* Aids used during immediate word recall
gen aid_mem = c_memaid == 1
drop if c_memaid < 0
global haid $haid aid_mem

* Aids used during serial 7 subtraction
gen aid_sub = c_sevenspap == 1
drop if c_sevenspap < 0
global haid $haid aid_sub

* Combine number series variable into one
gen c_cgnssc6_dv = c_cgns1sc6_dv
replace c_cgnssc6_dv = c_cgns2sc6_dv if c_cgnssc6_dv < 0
label var c_cgnssc6_dv "Cognitive ability: Number of correct answers to number series"

* Variables for number of correct answers, to be used for is_sum or is_pc1, non standardized
global ncor c_cgwri_dv c_cgwrd_dv c_cgs7cs_dv c_cgnssc6_dv c_cgvfc_dv c_cgna_dv

* Replace missings
foreach var of varlist $ncor {
	drop if `var' < 0
}

label var help_mem "help received in immediate recall test"
label var help_dmem "help received in delayed recall test"
label var aid_mem "aid used during immediate word recall"
label var aid_sub "aid used during serial 7 subtraction"
label var help_sub "aid used during subtraction test"
label var help_ns "aid used during number series test"

}

label var help_sub "aid used during subtraction test"

* HERE ARE THE VARIABLES TO BE STANDARDIZED AND THEN USED FOR THE ABILITY SCORES
des $ncor $haid 
sum $ncor $haid 



* STANDARDIZATION WITHIN YEAR OF EACH ELEMENTARY COGNITIVE VARIABLE

sum birthyear 
local miny = r(min)
local maxy = r(max)
di "min and max birthyear " `miny' `maxy'

foreach var of varlist 	$ncor {
	gen `var'_sty = `var'
	forvalues y = `miny'(1)`maxy' {
		qui sum `var' [aw = $weight_var] if birthyear == `y'
		local mean = r(mean)
		local sd = r(sd)
		qui replace `var'_sty = (`var' - `mean')/`sd' if birthyear == `y'
	}
			sum `var'_sty `var' [aw = $weight_var]
}
			
label var c_cgwri_dv_sty "st by birthyear: Immediate word recall: Number of correct items"

label var c_cgvfc_dv_sty  "st by birthyear: Verbal fluency: Count of correct answers"
label var c_cgna_dv_sty "st by birthyear:  Numeric ability: Count of items answered correctly"


* elementary intel scores to be used for is_sum or is_pc1, standardized by birth year
global ncor_sty c_cgwri_dv_sty c_cgwrd_dv_sty c_cgs7cs_dv_sty c_cgnssc6_dv_sty c_cgvfc_dv_sty c_cgna_dv_sty

sum $ncor_sty [aw = $weight_var]



*******************************
*** CREATE ABILITY MEASURES ***
*******************************


****************************************************************
*** 1. ABILITY SCORE BASED ON SIMPLE SUM OF ANSWERS (is_sum) ***
****************************************************************

* we will probably not use this indicator but since the code is there
* we kept it anyway because we may want to use this measure for the descriptives

* we construct it with the elementary cognitive measures and then standardize it within year


* sum of correct answers in the absence of help
gen is_sum = 0

* Whether aids were allowed during the test?
* Immediate word recall - NO
* Serial 7 subtraction 	- NO
* Number series 		- YES
* Verbal fluency 		- NA
* Numeric ability 		- YES

content:
* sum of correct answers in the absence of help
gen is_sum = 0

* Whether aids were allowed during the test?
* Immediate word recall - NO
* Serial 7 subtraction 	- NO
* Number series 		- YES
* Verbal fluency 		- NA
* Numeric ability 		- YES


* Immediate memory
replace is_sum = is_sum + c_cgwri_dv  if c_cgwri_dv  >= 0 & c_memcont3 != 1 & c_memaid != 1

* Delayed memory
replace is_sum = is_sum + c_cgwrd_dv  if c_cgwrd_dv  >= 0 & c_dmemcont3 != 1

* Serial 7 subtraction (see note below)
replace is_sum = is_sum + c_cgs7cs_dv  if c_cgs7cs_dv  >= 0 & c_subcont3 != 1 & c_sevenspap != 1

* Number series
replace is_sum = is_sum + c_cgns1sc6_dv if c_cgns1sc6_dv  >= 0 & c_nscont3 != 1
replace is_sum = is_sum + c_cgns2sc6_dv if c_cgns2sc6_dv  >= 0 & c_nscont3 != 1
* Note on serial 7 subtraction
* c_cgs7cs_dv  measures the number of correct subtractions, even if previous 
* answer was wrong; c_cgs7ca_dv  measures the number of individual answers that 
* match correct answers. For example, in a series of 5 subtraction answers 
* (39, 86, 79, 72, 65), has c_cgs7cs_dv  = 3 and c_cgs7ca_dv  = 4. Another example,
* in a series (93, 85, 77, 70, 63), c_cgs7cs_dv  = 3 and c_cgs7ca_dv  = 1. Here, I
* am only using number of correct subtraction, not correct answers.

* Verbal fluency
replace is_sum = is_sum + c_cgvfc_dv  if c_cgvfc_dv  >= 0 & c_vfcont3 != 1

* Numeric ability
replace is_sum = is_sum + c_cgna_dv  if c_cgna_dv  >= 0 & c_nacont3 != 1

* If answers to all questions were coded negative (either inapplicable, proxy, 
* or refusal), set the score to missing
replace is_sum = . if c_cgwri_dv  < 0 & c_cgwrd_dv  < 0 & c_cgs7cs_dv  < 0 & c_cgns1sc6_dv  < 0 & c_cgns2sc6_dv  < 0 & c_cgvfc_dv  < 0 & c_cgna_dv  < 0


* we bring it to mean 100 and standard deviation 15 overall, for comparison with other measuers
* note that this is an innocuous transformation
sum is_sum [aw = $weight_var] 
		local mean = r(mean)
		local sd = r(sd)
		replace is_sum = 100 + 15*(is_sum - `mean')/`sd'

label var is_sum "ability as standardized sum of correct non-aided answers"

sum is_sum [aw = $weight_var]


*** standardize is_sum within birthyear

gen is_sum_sty= is_sum
	forvalues y = `miny'(1)`maxy' {
		qui sum is_sum  [aw = $weight_var] if birthyear == `y'
		local mean = r(mean)
		local sd = r(sd)
		qui replace is_sum_sty = 100 + 15*(is_sum - `mean')/`sd' if birthyear == `y'
	}

label var is_sum_sty "ability standardized by byear: sum correct non-aid answers"

sum is_sum_sty is_sum [aw = $weight_var]

sum is_sum_sty is_sum  [aw = $weight_var]if birthyear==1959

tab birthyear, sum(is_sum)

tab birthyear, sum(is_sum_sty)




****************************************************************************
*** 2. FIRST PRINCIPAL COMPONENT OF 6 COGNITIVE ABILITY MEASURES ST'ZED ****
*** 		WITHIN YEAR AND 8 AID MEASURES NOT STANDARDIZED		        ****

****************************************************************************

des $ncor $ncor_sty $haid
sum $ncor $ncor_sty  $haid [aw = $weight_var]


*** principal component of elementary cognitive measures non standardized by birthyear 

pca $ncor $haid

predict pc1 pc2 pc3 pc4 pc5 pc6, score


* Checking if what score does is what we expect it to do *
matrix Load = e(L)
mat list Load
matrix test= Load[1...,1]
mat list test

mkmat $ncor $haid in 1/10000, matrix(Vars)

matrix PC1 = Vars * test

svmat PC1, names("PC1")

corr PC1 pc1

* So they are the same, i.e. score does exactly what we would have expected it to do

drop PC1

gen is_pc1 = pc1

		local sd = r(sd)
		replace is_pc1 = 100 + 15*(is_pc1 - `mean')/`sd'

*********************************************************

*********************************************************

* Generate year of birth for mothers and fathers
* Average age at birth taken from the ONS report
gen m_yob = birthyear - 27
gen f_yob = birthyear - 30

egen f_lustro = cut(f_yob), at(1895(5)2000)

label var m_yob "imputed mother's year of birth (avg age at birth 27)"
label var f_yob "imputed father's year of birth (avg age at birth 30)"

label var f_lustro "imputed father's birth quinquennium"

tabstat birthyear, by(f_lustro) stats(min max)


*** PARENTS' EDUCATION
preserve

*** Load the cross-wave dataset
use "$rawdata/ukhls_wx/xwavedat.dta", clear

*** Merge and combine with the information from all other waves
gen hiqual_dv = .
gen fenow = .

forvalues w = 8(-1)1 {
	local waveletter : word `w' of `c(alpha)'
	merge 1:1 pidp using "$rawdata/ukhls_w`w'/`waveletter'_indresp.dta", ///
		keepusing(`waveletter'_doby_dv `waveletter'_scend `waveletter'_feend ///
		`waveletter'_hiqual_dv `waveletter'_sex_dv `waveletter'_fenow)
	drop if _merge == 2
	drop _merge
	
	replace doby_dv = `waveletter'_doby_dv if (doby_dv < 0 | doby_dv >= 9898) & !missing(`waveletter'_doby_dv)
	replace scend_dv = `waveletter'_scend if (scend_dv <= 0 | missing(scend_dv)) & !missing(`waveletter'_scend)
	replace feend_dv = `waveletter'_feend if (feend_dv <= 0 | missing(feend_dv)) & !missing(`waveletter'_feend)
	replace hiqual_dv = `waveletter'_hiqual_dv if (hiqual_dv < 0 | missing(hiqual_dv)) & !missing(`waveletter'_hiqual_dv)
	replace sex_dv = `waveletter'_sex_dv if (sex_dv < 0 | missing(sex_dv)) & !missing(`waveletter'_sex_dv)
	replace fenow = `waveletter'_fenow if (fenow < 0 | missing(fenow)) & !missing(`waveletter'_fenow)
	
	label values hiqual_dv `waveletter'_hiqual_dv
	label values fenow `waveletter'_fenow
	
	drop `waveletter'_*
}

forvalues w = 18(-1)1 {
	local waveletter :  word `w' of `c(alpha)'
	merge 1:1 pidp using "$rawdata/bhps_w`w'/b`waveletter'_indresp.dta", ///
		keepusing(b`waveletter'_doby b`waveletter'_scend b`waveletter'_feend ///
		b`waveletter'_hiqual_dv b`waveletter'_sex b`waveletter'_fenow)
	drop if _merge == 2
	drop _merge
	
	replace doby_dv = b`waveletter'_doby if (doby_dv < 0 | doby_dv >= 9898) & !missing(b`waveletter'_doby)

/******************************************************************

Version date: Nov 22, 2025

This .do file is part of the replication package for

Ichino, Rustichini, and Zanella (2025),
"College, cognitive ability, and socioeconomic disadvantage:
policy lessons from the UK in 1960-2004"
Review of Economic Studies

It uses University Statistical Record (USR) raw data files for 1972-1993 and
produces clean USR data files for the analyses in the paper.

NOTES:

* FILE TYPE:
uh=history (one record per student)(per year) constant across years

up=personal (one record per student)(per year)
(but it should stay constant apart from marital status, possibly)
Because of this feature, in the "leavers" file that we construct below,
the personal info that changes over time is recorded only at the time of leaving the system.
For example, if someone appears as married at the moment of leaving, he/she may
not be married at enrollment and there is no way to keep track of marriage timing

ul=leaving and employment (one record per student per year) (each student should only ever have one) 
Within each year of data, a student is either in ugc_ul or in ugl_ul or in non of the two

ua=annual (multiple records per student across college years) 
ur=results (multiple records per student across high school subjects in the GCE) 
(per year) (but info stays constant over time)

* STUDENT TYPE
ug = ugc = continuing
ug = ugl = leaving
    
* GENERATING UCCA NUMBER FROM SEQUENCE NUMBER
(from usr_manual.pdf)
structure of seqnum (USR reference number) is: 
DIGITS 1-2 Year of entry (eg 85 for 1985)
DIGITS 3-8 Personal number. This is the same as the student's UCCA number if this is known.
DIGIT 9 Check digit


* NOTES ON DIFFERENCE BETWEEN UGC AND UGL FILES
There are separate files ugcYY* and uglYY*for each year YY.
This separation arises from the fact that only individuals who continue their
undergraduate education are in the ugc file, whereas individuals who finish their
undergraduate education are in the ugl files. The only exception to that seems to be
individuals who finish one undergraduate education at the university but continue
into further undergraduate education at the same university are in the ugcYYul file.

In other words:

Students in ugl leave all undergrad programs of the college they are in
(they may continue in another college, pursue graduate studies or go to work)

A person will show up in ugc_ul and ugc_ua at the same time, because he/she obtained
a degree and is therefore  in ucg_ul but continues at same university

Therefore, in the "leavers" file that we construct below,
the same student may appear in two different records if he/she attended and graduated
from two programs in different years.
There is no way to asssess whether two records belong to same person or not.

	local col = `col' + 1

tab clustro15
	sum g1_theta g2_theta g3_theta

	* Five wage ratios
	forvalues g=1(1)3 {
		sum dpv if g_theta == `g' & college == 0 [w=weight]
		local w`g'0 = r(mean)
		sum dpv if g_theta == `g' & college == 1 [w=weight]
		local w`g'1 = r(mean)
		gen r`g' = `w`g'1'/`w`g'0'
	}
	
	gen r = r1*g1_theta + r2*g2_theta + r3*g3_theta
	sum r1 r2 r3 r
			
	nl (college = theta/({gamma} + {tau}*theta) - {delta}/ln(r) - ({beta}/ln(r))*lambda_noedu) if clustro15 == `c' [pw=weight], ///
					initial(gamma 1 tau 0 beta 0 delta 0)

	matrix temp = r(table)
	local row = 1
	forvalues v = 1(1)4 {
		matrix res_theta_lambda_noedu[`row',`col'] = temp[1,`v']
		matrix res_theta_lambda_noedu[`row'+1,`col'] = temp[2,`v']
		local row = `row'+2
	}
	predict pi
	sum pi
	count if pi < 0
	count if pi > 1
	drop pi
	local col = `col' + 1
	restore
}

matrix list res_theta_b5, format(%9.3f)
matrix list res_thetab5_ses, format(%9.3f)
matrix list res_theta_lambda_noedu, format(%9.3f)



preserve
	use estimates_grid.dta, clear
	keep theta lambda
	replace theta = theta/100
	gen Gamma_theta_lambda_60 = res_theta_lambda_b5_ses[1,1] + res_theta_lambda_b5_ses[3,1]*theta
	gen Omega_theta_lambda_60 = res_theta_lambda_b5_ses[5,1] + res_theta_lambda_b5_ses[7,1]*lambda
	gen Gamma_theta_lambda_90 = res_theta_lambda_b5_ses[1,3] + res_theta_lambda_b5_ses[3,3]*theta
	gen Omega_theta_lambda_90 = res_theta_lambda_b5_ses[5,3] + res_theta_lambda_b5_ses[7,3]*lambda
		
	gen Gamma_theta_b5_60 = res_theta_b5[1,1] + res_theta_b5[3,1]*theta
	gen Omega_theta_b5_60 = res_theta_b5[5,1] + res_theta_b5[7,1]*lambda
	gen Gamma_theta_b5_90 = res_theta_b5[1,3] + res_theta_b5[3,3]*theta
	gen Omega_theta_b5_90 = res_theta_b5[5,3] + res_theta_b5[7,3]*lambda
	
	gen Gamma_thetab5_ses_60 = res_thetab5_ses[1,1] + res_thetab5_ses[3,1]*theta
	gen Omega_thetab5_ses_60 = res_thetab5_ses[5,1] + res_thetab5_ses[7,1]*lambda
	gen Gamma_thetab5_ses_90 = res_thetab5_ses[1,3] + res_thetab5_ses[3,3]*theta
	gen Omega_thetab5_ses_90 = res_thetab5_ses[5,3] + res_thetab5_ses[7,3]*lambda
	
	gen Gamma_theta_lambda_noedu_60 = res_theta_lambda_noedu[1,1] + res_theta_lambda_noedu[3,1]*theta
	gen Omega_theta_lambda_noedu_60 = res_theta_lambda_noedu[5,1] + res_theta_lambda_noedu[7,1]*lambda
	gen Gamma_theta_lambda_noedu_90 = res_theta_lambda_noedu[1,3] + res_theta_lambda_noedu[3,3]*theta
	gen Omega_theta_lambda_noedu_90 = res_theta_lambda_noedu[5,3] + res_theta_lambda_noedu[7,3]*lambda

	
	twoway  line Gamma_theta_lambda_60 theta, lcolor(gs10) lwidth(thick) || ///
		line Gamma_theta_lambda_90 theta, lcolor(black) lwidth(thick) lpattern(dash) ///
		xtitle("Ability", height(4)) ytitle("") title("Gamma, Ability vs SES+B5") ///
		xlabel(.4 "40" .6 "60" .8 "80" 1 "100" 1.2 "120" 1.4 "140" 1.6 "160", labsize(medium)) ylabel(0(1)7,grid) ///
		legend(rows(1) order(1 2) lab(1 "1960-1974") lab(2 "1990-2004") size(medium) region(lstyle(none)))

/******************************************************************

**********************************

local first = 1

	foreach par in "gamma" "tau" "delta" "beta" "alpha1" "alpha2" "alpha3" {

			local w = 0.01
		}

		}

		(hist "`par'", width(`w') freq color(gs12) lcolor(gs8) xlabel(,labsize(vlarge)) ylabel(,labsize(vlarge))) ///
		(scatteri 0 `m' 600 `m', recast(line) lcolor(red) lwidth(medthick)), title(`par', size(vhuge)) /// 
		legend(off)	
	graph export hist_`par'_`c'.pdf, replace 
	}
}

********************************************************************************

* Ronchi and Smith

*
* MASTER SCRIPT — runs the full replication package.
*
* BEFORE RUNNING:
*   1. Edit the root path in  config.do  to point to this package folder.
*   2. Open Stata, set the working directory to this  Code/  folder, then run
*      this file:   do "_master.do"
*   3. (First run only) uncomment the 00_setup.do line below to install packages.
*
* The CONFIDENTIAL section requires access to Statistics Denmark's servers.
* The PUBLIC section uses publicly available data and can be run on any machine.
********************************************************************************

clear all

version 18

* Note: user-written packages are installed to Stata's default PLUS directory
* by 00_setup.do (see below). Run that once before the first replication.

* Set to 1 to run, 0 to skip. The CONFIDENTIAL section requires Statistics
* Denmark server access. To reproduce only the public appendix figures on a
* standard desktop, set run_confidential = 0 and run_public = 1.
local run_confidential 1

- first we compress data and drop var we dont use for memory  
- we identify individuals who are hired and who separate in a given year
- add extra fertility variables at the individual level (which we will need for endog stopping rule) and lagged variables before removing 1990-1991 when I do not obs occ codes
- this gen the dta employer_employee_compressed_original

PART 2
- keep only single-manager estab-year obs e create avg values for manager variables before collapsing the data at the estb level 
- then we can drop managers and create avg values of workforce before collapsing 
- collapse data at the estab-year level

content:
********************************************************************************
* 02_birth_sample.do
* Daddy's Girl: Daughters, Managerial Decisions, and Gender Inequality
* Ronchi and Smith
*
* Identifies manager-establishment spells (filling within-spell gaps), restricts
* to the birth sample (male managers who experience a birth), and rebuilds the
* establishment-year panel with employee, earnings, and workforce-composition
* variables for these establishments.
*
* Requires variable abbreviation ON (set in _master.do).
* Paths come from config.do (run via _master.do): intermediate datasets are
* read from and written to $derived.
*********************************************************************************




*************************
/* DESCRIPTION OF DO FILE:

PART 1
- use the collapsed dta created at the end of do file 0 and keep only observations in which managers experiences at least one birth
- remerge this with individuals level variables to identify the manager and create a dta with the entire life of individuals who gives us identification, which is needed for some manager-level regressions.
- We fill some within-spell gaps using the following approach:
* Fill up the gaps in between a manager-estab spell only if manager is in the same estab during the gaps. This is fine because originally in the "filled years": 
// majority of cases no other manager was present
// where multiple managers appear, the identified manager is one of the managers almost 100% of times (these cells were deleted because we keep only single-manager estab obs)

******
PART 2
- create final dta at the estab level based on the sample of managers identified in part 1
*/
**************************



use "$derived/employer_employee_compressed_original.dta" , clear

keep id e_id f_id year d_manager d_women type youngest* n_children n_daughters n_sons e_count e_size dob_* //pstill 

bys e_id year: egen tot_mgr=total(d_manager)
gen owner=1 if type=="o"
replace owner=0 if type=="e"

save "$derived/fewvar_original.dta", replace

use "$derived/e_single_mgmt_collapse.dta", clear		
keep mgmt_estab *n_children_mgmt *n_sons_mgmt *n_daughters_mgmt e_id year

sort mgmt_estab year
by mgmt_estab : gen change_c=1 if n_children>n_children[_n-1]
by mgmt_estab: egen max_change_c=max(change_c)

save "$derived/births", replace

**********
use "$derived/births.dta", clear

keep e_id year mgmt_estab change_c max_change_c 
keep if max_change==1

merge 1:m e_id year using "$derived/fewvar_original.dta" 

sort id year
by id: egen max_merge=max(_merge)
keep if max_merge==3		//here we are keeping all id that ever worked in a mgmt_estab
drop max_merge

*now identify the managers
gen id_mgr=id if d_manager==1 & mgmt_estab!=.
bys id (id_mgr): replace id_mgr=id_mgr[_N]
sort id year
keep if id==id_mgr

save "$derived/mgr_selection.dta", replace

use "$derived/mgr_selection.dta", clear

rename mgmt_estab mgmt_estab_all
gen mgmt_estab=mgmt_estab_all if d_manager==1		//Dropping mgrs appearing in a spell as employees and never as managers


* Fill up the gaps in between a spell - do this only if manager is in the same estab during the gaps
egen gr=group(id e_id)
bys gr: egen first=min(year) if mgmt_estab!=.
bys gr (first): replace first=first[1]
sort id year

bys gr: egen last=max(year) if mgmt_estab!=.
bys gr (last): replace last=last[1]
sort id year

by id: gen change_estab=1 if e_id!=e_id[_n+1] & _n!=_N
gen y_change=year if change_estab==1
sort gr y_change
bys gr (y_change): replace y_change=y_change[1]
sort id year

bys gr: egen max_spell=max(mgmt_estab)
sort id year

egen rowmin=rowmin(y_change last)
gen mgmt_estab2020=mgmt_estab
replace mgmt_estab2020=max_spell if year>first & year<=rowmin		//this is the final manager-establishment spell version
keep if mgmt_estab2020!=.

** Keep one manager per establishment where gap-filling created overlaps (less than 10estab in total)

sort e_id year
by e_id year: gen N=_N	
by e_id: egen max_N=max(N)

* In overlaps, keep the male managers (focus of the analysis)
drop if max_N>1 & d_women==1

drop max_N N
sort e_id year
by e_id year: gen N=_N
by e_id: egen max_N=max(N)

* In remaining overlaps, keep the manager with the longer spell 
drop N
sort mgmt_estab
bys mgmt_estab: gen n=_n if max_N>1 & mgmt_estab!=.
bys mgmt_estab: egen max_n=max(n) 
bys e_id: egen max_eid_n=max(max_n)
bys id: egen max_n_id=max(n)
drop if max_n_id!=max_eid_n  

keep id e_id year mgmt_estab mgmt_estab2020 first last  
save "$derived/identif_sample.dta", replace

** Attach the identified-manager records to the full employer-employee panel - so each identified mgr-estab recovers its full set of employees
merge 1:m id year using "$derived/employer_employee_compressed_original.dta"
sort e_id year
by e_id year: egen tot_mgr=total(d_manager)
*populating the mgr-estab spell id to all employees in the same estab-year 
by e_id year: egen max_mgmt_estab2020=max(mgmt_estab2020)		// filled
by e_id year: egen max_mgmt_estab=max(mgmt_estab)				//raw
gen diff=1 if max_mgmt_estab2020!=max_mgmt_estab				//marking diff between filled and raw

by e_id: egen max_merge=max(_merge)
keep if max_merge==3	//keeping estab that contain identified managers

foreach v of varlist last first {
bys e_id year (`v'): replace `v'=`v'[1]
}

********************************************************************************
* 03_create_analysis_data.do
* Daddy's Girl: Daughters, Managerial Decisions, and Gender Inequality
* Ronchi and Smith
*
* Builds the estimation sample from the birth-sample establishment panel:
* restricts to male managers who never leave the establishment during the spell,
* defines birth variables, labor cost outcomes, renaming of long variables,
* industry groupings, and parity indicators (reg_sample -> reg_sample2).

* Requires variable abbreviation ON (set in _master.do).
* Paths come from config.do (run via _master.do); intermediates in $derived.
********************************************************************************


*identify estab that are ok to use for the reg, i.e. drop those with manager leaving the estab

use "$derived/identif_sample_merge_collapse.dta", clear

* Identify spells in which managers leave
* [PRUNE-FLAGS]: "max_flag*" in the collapse below is the gap-flag diagnostic
* group flagged in 02_birth_sample.do. Remove "max_flag*" here if you prune that
* group (keep everything else). It is carried but never used downstream.
preserve
collapse e_id mgmt_estab n_children tot_mgr*, by(mgmt_estab2020 year)
sort mgmt_estab2020 year
drop if mgmt_estab2020==.
by mgmt_estab2020: gen n_miss=year-year[_n-1] if _n!=1
by mgmt_estab2020: egen max_n_miss=max(n_miss)
*if max_n_miss>1 means that manager leave the estab during the spell

keep mgmt_estab2020 year max_n_miss 
tempfile ciccio
save `ciccio', replace
restore
merge m:1 mgmt_estab2020 year using `ciccio'
sort e_id year


********************************************************************************
keep if max_n_miss==1			//mgr never left the estab
keep if mgmt_estab2020!=.		//original beggining&end of spell
keep if wage_adj_ratio!=.			
keep if w_manager==0			//male managers only
********************************************************************************

* gen labor costs and labor costs per employee
gen tot_lc=(wage_adj_f*n_f)+(wage_adj_m*n_m)
gen log_lc_work=log(tot_lc/tot_workers)
gen log_tot_lc=log(tot_lc)

*gen birth indication - for event studies
sort mgmt_estab2020 year
by mgmt_estab2020: gen birth=1 if n_children>n_children[_n-1] & _n!=1 
by mgmt_estab2020: egen tot_birth=total(birth)

by mgmt_estab2020: gen birth_d=1 if n_daughters>n_daughters[_n-1] & _n!=1
replace birth_d=0 if birth_d==.
by mgmt_estab2020: egen tot_birth_d=total(birth_d)

by mgmt_estab2020: gen birth_s=1 if n_sons>n_sons[_n-1] & _n!=1
replace birth_s=0 if birth_s==.
by mgmt_estab2020: egen tot_birth_s=total(birth_s)

by mgmt_estab2020: egen min_any_d=min(any_d)
by mgmt_estab2020: egen max_any_d=max(any_d)
gen change_any_d=1 if min_any_d==0 & max_any_d==1
replace change_any_d=0 if min_any_d==max_any_d

by mgmt_estab2020: gen birth_1std=1 if n_daughters>0 & n_daughters[_n-1]==0

save "$derived/reg_sample.dta", replace


**************************************

use "$derived/reg_sample.dta", clear

*these event-dummies are needed to then create pre-birth characteristics. They will be used/modified later depending on the nature of the event study (baseline vs robustness)
gen event_t=0 if birth_1std==1

keep time_period participation_gap_avg
tempfile lfpr

* ---- Hours worked ----

import delimited "$oecd_data/OECD_hours.csv", clear

gen sex_num = 1 if v12 == "Female"
replace sex_num = 2 if v12 == "Male"
keep time_period obs_value sex_num
reshape wide obs_value, i(time_period) j(sex_num)
rename obs_value1 h_female
rename obs_value2 h_male
gen hours_gap = ((h_male - h_female) / h_male) * 100
keep time_period hours_gap

save `hours'

merge 1:1 time_period using `lfpr', nogen
merge 1:1 time_period using `wage', nogen

    (connected participation_gap_avg time_period, sort msize(small)) ///
