	gen dum_balanced_sample = (no_obs == `n_round') /*only the observations we have across all rounds we care about*/
	bys HHID: egen temp = total(dum_balanced_sample)
	replace dum_balanced_sample = (temp>0) //just so its not zero for round 2
	drop temp

	/* Start making moments */
	if "`r4control'" != "" {
		keep if treat_r4 == 0
		keep if dum_balanced_sample == 1
		}
	
	* migration rate moment
	reg migrant_r treat if round == 2
	mat `ests' = (_b[_cons], _b[treat])
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' mig_r2_c mig_r2_te

	reg migrant_r treat if round == 3 
	mat `ests' = (`ests', _b[_cons], _b[treat])
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' mig_r3_c mig_r3_te

	reg migrant_r treat if round == 4 
	mat `ests' = (`ests', _b[_cons], _b[treat])
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' mig_r4_c mig_r4_te

	sum migrant_r treat if inlist(round,2,3,4)
	mat `ests' = (`ests',_b[_cons])
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' mig_r234_c

	*migration income control and treatment effect (logs)
	reg logym`scaled' treat if migrant_r==1 & round==2
	mat `ests' = (`ests', _b[_cons], _b[treat])
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' logym_r2_c logym_r2_te

	*risk sharing moment
	areg logc c.logy`scaled' c.treat#c.logy`scaled' if inlist(round,4), absorb(vr_fe) cluster(village)
	mat `ests'=(`ests', _b[c.logy`scaled'], _b[c.treat#c.logy`scaled'])
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' rs_beta_r4_c rs_beta_r4_te

	*risk sharing moment of nonmigrants
	areg logc c.logy`scaled' c.treat#c.logy`scaled' if inlist(round,4) & migrant_r==0, absorb(vr_fe) cluster(village)
	mat `ests'=(`ests', _b[c.logy`scaled'], _b[c.treat#c.logy`scaled'])
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' rs_beta_r4_c_nonmig rs_beta_r4_te_nonmig

	*mean and sd of total income of migrants/nonmigrants in round 4
	sum logy`scaled' if migrant_r==1 & round==4 & treat==0
	mat `ests' = (`ests',r(mean),r(sd))
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' mean_log_inc_migrant_r4_c sd_log_inc_migrant_r4_c

	sum logy`scaled' if migrant_r==0 & treat==0 & round==4
	mat `ests' = (`ests',r(mean),r(sd))
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' mean_log_inc_nonmig_r4_c sd_log_inc_nonmig_r4_c

	*mean and sd of village income of migrants/nonmigrants in round 4
	sum logyv`scaled' if migrant_r==1 & round==4 & treat==0
	mat `ests' = (`ests',r(mean),r(sd))
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' mean_log_inc_v_mig_r4_c sd_log_inc_v_mig_r4_c

	sum logyv`scaled' if migrant_r==0 & round==4 & treat==0 
	mat `ests' = (`ests',r(mean),r(sd))
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' mean_log_inc_v_nonmig_r4_c sd_log_inc_v_nonmig_r4_c

	* mean and sd of migration income for migrants in round 4
	sum logym`scaled' if migrant_r==1 & round==4 & treat==0
	mat `ests' = (`ests',r(mean),r(sd))
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' mean_log_inc_m_mig_r4_c sd_log_inc_m_mig_r4_c

	* Add on LM for migrant income
	sum ym`scaled' if migrant_r==1 & round==4 & treat==0
	mat `ests' = (`ests',log(r(mean)),log(r(sd)))
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' lm_mean_inc_m_mig_r4_c lm_sd_inc_m_mig_r4_c

	preserve

	* Add on LM for migrant income
	sum ym`scaled' if migrant_r==1 & round==4 & treat==0
	mat `ests' = (`ests',log(r(mean)),log(r(sd)))
	local mat_lab `mat_lab' lm_mean_inc_m_mig_r4_c lm_sd_inc_m_mig_r4_c

	*migration shares + total income means + total income sds
	preserve

	keep HHID migrant_r round logy`scaled' logym`scaled' logyv`scaled' y`scaled' ym`scaled' yv`scaled' treat  //y_level
	reshape wide migrant_r logy`scaled' logym`scaled' logyv`scaled' y`scaled' ym`scaled' yv`scaled', i(HHID treat) j(round)
	cap reshape error

	cap drop logy`scaled'3 logy`scaled'5
	gen y_sd4=logy`scaled'4
	gen ym_sd4 = logym`scaled'4
	gen yv_sd4 = logyv`scaled'4

	gen y_sd4_level=y`scaled'4
	gen ym_sd4_level = ym`scaled'4
	gen yv_sd4_level = yv`scaled'4

	if "`roundkeep'" == "r2r3r4" {
		drop if migrant_r3 ==. | migrant_r4 == .
		merge m:1 migrant_r3 migrant_r4 using type_merge_`roundkeep'.dta //`type_merge'
		}
	else if "`roundkeep'" == "r2r4" {
		drop if migrant_r2 ==. | migrant_r4 == .
		merge m:1 migrant_r2 migrant_r4 using type_merge_`roundkeep'.dta //`type_merge'
		}

	assert _merge == 3
	drop _merge

	tabstat logyv`scaled'4 if treat==0, by(type) stat(mean sd)
	tabstat logym`scaled'4 if treat==0, by(type) stat(mean sd)
	tabstat logyv`scaled'4 if treat==1, by(type) stat(mean sd)
	tabstat logym`scaled'4 if treat==1, by(type) stat(mean sd)

	* Now save by type so have for matlab
	gen count = 1

	bys treat: egen total_count = total(count)
	gen share = count/total_count
	drop count total_count

	* compute log(mean) (already have mean(log))
	foreach var in y`scaled'4 ym`scaled'4 yv`scaled'4 y_sd4_level ym_sd4_level yv_sd4_level {
		replace `var' = log(`var')
		}

	sort treat type

	matrix list `ests'
	
	foreach treat in 0 1 {
		if `treat' == 0 {
			local suffix _c
			}
		else {
			local suffix _t
			}

		foreach var in share logy`scaled'4 logym`scaled'4 logyv`scaled'4 y_sd4 ym_sd4 yv_sd4 y`scaled'4 ym`scaled'4 yv`scaled'4 y_sd4_level ym_sd4_level yv_sd4_level {
			forval x=1/`n_group' {

				if `var'[4*`treat' + `x'] != . { //e.g. migration income is missing by definition for ppl who don't migrate this period, so don't include it in the matrix
					mat `ests' = (`ests',`var'[4*`treat' + `x'])
					if "`var'" == "share" {
						local mat_lab `mat_lab' mig_g`x'`suffix'
						}
					else if "`var'" == "logy`scaled'4"  {
						local mat_lab `mat_lab' income_g`x'`suffix'
						}
					else if "`var'" == "logyv`scaled'4" {
						local mat_lab `mat_lab' income_v_g`x'`suffix'

*******************************
* Table F2 ********************
* Adjusting p-values for multiple hypotheses testing
****************************************************

/* The calculation/correction uses the p-values of the 16 estimates in Table 4 as inputs:
income, schooling, height (for men or women), being in near perfect health, having any
diagnosis, smoking, mortality, hospital visits, specialized outpatient visits, days of sickleave,
disability, (ln)birth weight, prematurity, infant mortality, hospital days (child), specialized
outpatient visits (child).

*/

* using male height

* FDR-corrected: simes
qqvalue pvalues_Males, method(simes) qvalue(hochbergP)
rename hochbergP FDR_males

* Bonferroni corrected
qqvalue pvalues_Males, method(bonferroni) qvalue(hochbergP)
rename hochbergP FWER_males

* using female height 

* FDR-corrected: simes
qqvalue pvalues_Females, method(simes) qvalue(hochbergP)
rename hochbergP FDR_females

* Bonferroni corrected
qqvalue pvalues_Females, method(bonferroni) qvalue(hochbergP)
rename hochbergP FWER_females

set more off

global dir_dta "..\FIRMBANKRISK"
********************************************************************************

capture log close
qui log using "LOG\A_GenerateBankdataset", text replace

/*******************************************************************************
	Date: July 2015
	Program: this file generates BANK dataset from the raw data
	Steps taken:
	1) Generates temp dta files for TL and FX components of Bank Balance Sheet components. (VIGMTBLB)
	2) Generates temp dta files for TL and FX components of Bank Profit Loss components. (VIGMTKZ)
	3) Merges these datasets.

	Input:VIGMTBLB.dta and VIGMTKZ.dta. These are raw BANK B/S and income statement data files.
	Output: Bank02-14.dta. This a clean merged monthly BANK B/S and Income statement data.
	
*******************************************************************************/


********************BANKING SECTOR BALANCE SHEET********************************
 
use "$dir_dta\VIGMTBLB.dta", clear

*There are 2 observations (IGPKOD: T and Y)for year 5005 and month 1 for bankid with 1483. I checked and these values are same for
*year 2005 month 1 values for the bank with id 1483. So I drop these observations with year 5005.
 
drop if IGYIL==5005

*Save a temp file for the TL components.

keep if IGPKOD=="T"

foreach X of varlist IGL1-IGL51{
ren `X' `X'_T
}

save temp_IGL_T, replace

use "$dir_dta\VIGMTBLB.dta", clear

drop if IGYIL==5005

*Save a temp file for the FX components.

keep if IGPKOD=="Y"

foreach X of varlist IGL1-IGL51{
ren `X' `X'_Y
}
save temp_IGL_Y, replace

********************BANKING SECTOR PROFIT and LOSS******************************

use "$dir_dta\VIGMTKZ.dta", clear

keep if IGPKOD=="T"

foreach X of varlist IG1-IG47{
ren `X' `X'_T
}

save temp_IG_T, replace

use "$dir_dta/VIGMTKZ.dta", clear

keep if IGPKOD=="Y"

foreach X of varlist IG1-IG47{
ren `X' `X'_Y
}


* Merge Bank Balance Sheet and Profit Loss Components

joinby BANKANON IGYIL IGAY using temp_IG_T, unmatched(both)
drop _merge
method: bank-firm credit panel construction with global-financial-cycle interactions and fixed-effects regressions
title: International Spillovers and Local Credit Cycles

foreach X of varlist IG1-IG47{
ren `X' `X'_Y
}

joinby BANKANON IGYIL IGAY using temp_IG_T, unmatched(both)
drop _merge

joinby BANKANON IGYIL IGAY using temp_IGL_Y, unmatched(both)
drop _merge

joinby BANKANON IGYIL IGAY using temp_IGL_T, unmatched(both)

*Generate a monthly date variable 

ge date=ym(IGYIL, IGAY)
format date %tm

*******************RENAME and GENERATE some variables***************************

*Drop repeated bank-date observations

_pctile abs_gr_principal12_FX if FX_indexed_dum==0&FX_loan==1&gr_principal12_FX!=., percentile(5 10 25 50 75 90 95)

}

}

gen pctl_dummy=1 if abs_min_loan_grFX>=abs_pctl12_5 & FX_indexed_dum==0&FX_loan==1

replace principal12_def1=principal12 if FX_loan==0

replace principal12_def2=principal12 if pctl_dummy==1&principal12_def2==.& FX_indexed_dum==0&FX_loan==1

replace principal12_def11=principal12 if FX_indexed_dum==1&FX_loan==1
replace principal12_def11=principal12 if FX_loan==0

*Definition 2

bys loanID2 : replace principal12_def21=principal12_def21[_n-1] if pctl_dummy1==0&_n!=1& FX_indexed_dum==0&FX_loan==1

replace principal12_def21=principal12 if FX_indexed_dum==1&FX_loan==1 
replace principal12_def21=principal12 if FX_loan==0 

********************************************************************************
*Append the observations with unknown LoanID2 

append using $dir_dta/loanIDunknownWholeCR

local vrbs "principal12_def1 principal12_def2 principal12_def11 principal12_def21"

foreach X of local vrbs{
qui replace `X'=principal if loanID2==.
}

ge expflag=0
replace expflag=1 if inlist( accounting_code3dig_int,110,111,112,113)

ge impflag=0
replace impflag=1 if inlist( accounting_code3dig_int,114,115)


bysort firmid:egen min_exploan_date=min(openingdate) if expflag==1

replace min_exploan_date=aux

replace exploan_ever=1 if openingdate>=min_exploan_date   & min_exploan_date!=.

label var exploan_ever "Firm has an export loan before"

sort loanID2 date 
order date loanID2 bankid firmid FX_loan FX_indexed_dum principal principal12 principal12_def1 principal12_def2 principal12_def11 principal12_def21 int_rate int_rate_clean

keep date loanID2 bankid firmid FX_loan* FX_indexed_dum principal principal12 principal12_def1 principal12_def2 principal12_def11 principal12_def21 ///

Bank total assets with CPI*/

set more off
/*********************************************

/*******************************************************************************
	Date: Feb 16
	Program: this file merges CR dataset with Quarterly Macro, Firm and Bank B\S
	datasets.
		
	INPUTS: CollapsedCR_MFXsplit, mastermacroQ, CYCLERegs_BankQ
	
	OUTPUT: masterdataCR_Q_Cycle_FXsplit.dta - This output file is at Bank-Firm-FX Quarter level.


*******************************************************************************/


/*************************************************************
	Merge the four files
*************************************************************/

use $dir_raw/CollapsedWholeCR_FXsplit, clear 


*Transform the monthly series to the quarterly dataset by keeping the end of quarter values*
format date %10.0g
gen date1 = dofm(date)
format date1 %d
gen month=month(date1)
format date %tm
drop date1
keep if inlist(month,3,6,9,12)

*Extract year information from the data variable
ge year= yofd(dofm(date))
format year %ty

*Convert monthly date information to quarterly format
ge dateq=qofd(dofm(date))
format dateq %tq
drop date

****Add bankbankid
ren bankid bank
joinby  bank using DTA/bankbankid, unmatched(both)
ren _merge _mbank_bankid
label var _mbank_bankid "Merge between bank and bankid"

*Add quarterly Macro variables
joinby  dateq using "$dir_macro/cyclesregsdataQ", unmatched(both)
ren _merge _mCR_Macro

*Add quarterly Kfit variables
joinby  dateq using "$dir_macro/cyclesregsdataQ_Kfit", unmatched(both)
ren _merge _mCR_MacroKfit

*Add quarterly bank B/S data
joinby bankid dateq using "$dir_dta/CYCLERegs_BankQ", unmatched(both)
ren _merge _mCR_BANK

*Add yearly bank B/S data -Additioanl 
joinby bankid dateq using "$dir_dta/bank_regs_data", unmatched(both)
drop _merge

*Add yearly bank B/S data -Additioanl

drop _merge

********************************************************************************

/**************************************************************

egen panelBT=group(bankid dateq)
egen panelFY=group(firmid year)

*** Winsorize some bank varibles at %1 ***

winsor dm_Lb_capital, p(.005) ge (W1dm_Lb_capital)

content:
/*
	Program:  Generating the results in Table 12 using the  new loan issuances 
				 data. Table included in REStud  manuscript of “International 
				 Spillovers and Local Credit Cycles” by Julian di Giovanni, 
				 Şebnem Kalemli-Özcan, Mehmet Fatih Ulu and Yusuf Soner Başkaya.
*/


clear
set matsize 11000
set more off
/*********************************************
	Global directories and data 
*********************************************/

global dir_dta     "../FIRMBANKRISK"
global dir_dtaBB   "../RISKDATA"
global dir_log     "LOG"
global dir_tabs    "TABLES"
global dir_macro2  "DTA"
global data_master "WholeCR_collapsedcleanFXadjustedloans"

********************************************************************************

* Load master data file

use $dir_dta/$data_master.dta, clear

/* 
	Clean data to drop missing observations and duplicates for loans
*/

drop if openingdate==.
gen datem = mofd(openingdate)
format datem %tm

*Keep loans only at the opening month

sort loanID2 date
by loanID2: keep if _n==1

* Get rid of old monthly date variable

drop date

* Drop loans before 2003 or with 0 interest rate

drop if datem<tm(2003m1)
drop if int_rate==0


*generate dateq
ge dateq=qofd(dofm(datem))
format dateq %tq

drop datem

* Drop credit cards

drop if financed_activity=="KK"

*Collapse at Firm-bank-month level

ge INT= int_rate * principal
ge MAT= maturity_corrected * principal
ge RW = riskweight * principal

*Generate short-term (ST) dummy
ge ST = 1 if maturity<=12 
replace ST = 0 if ST == . & maturity~=.


collapse (sum) r_principal r_principal12_def21 collateral principal INT MAT RW   ,by(bankid firmid FX_loan ST dateq)

ge WAint_rate=INT/principal
ge WAmaturity=MAT/principal
ge WAriskweight=RW/principal

drop INT MAT RW
method: bank-firm credit panel construction with global-financial-cycle interactions and fixed-effects regressions
title: International Spillovers and Local Credit Cycles

content:
collapse (sum) r_principal r_principal12_def21 collateral principal INT MAT RW   ,by(bankid firmid FX_loan ST dateq)

ge WAint_rate=INT/principal
ge WAmaturity=MAT/principal
ge WAriskweight=RW/principal

drop INT MAT RW

label var ST "Short-term loan dummy: 1 if <=12 months, 0 if >12 months"


*Add quarterly Macro variables
sort dateq
merge  dateq using "$dir_macro2/cyclesregsdataQ"    /*, keep(Llog_vix_av Ldm_log_vix_avq expinf_avq)*/
drop _merge

****Add bankbankid
ren bankid bank
joinby  bank using $dir_dtaBB/bankbankid, unmatched(both)
tab _merge
tab date if _merge~=3
ren _merge _mbank_bankid
label var _mbank_bankid "Merge between bank and bankid"

*Add quarterly bank B/S data
joinby bankid dateq using "$dir_dta/CYCLERegs_BankQ", unmatched(both)
tab _merge
tab date if _merge~=3
ren _merge _mCR_BANK
label var _mCR_BANK "Merge between CR raw using BANK raw"


*Add  bank B/S data -Additioanl 
joinby bankid dateq using $dir_dta/bank_regs_data, unmatched(both)
tab _merge
drop _merge

*** Winsorize some bank varibles at %1 ***
winsor LW1Bcapital_rat, p(.005) ge (W1LW1Bcapital_rat)
winsor dm_Lb_capital, p(.005) ge (W1dm_Lb_capital)
winsor LW2BROA, p(.005) ge (W1LW2BROA)
winsor LW2CAR, p(0.025) gen(W5LW2CAR)

label var W1LW1Bcapital_rat " Lag of Bank Capital Ratio (Tot. Shrhldr's Eq./Tot. Assets)"
label var W1dm_Lb_capital " Lag of Bank Capital Ratio (Tot. Shrhldr's Eq./Tot. Assets)"
label var W1LW2BROA         " Lag of Bank ROA (Net Profit(Loss)/Tot. Asets)"    
label var W5LW2CAR          " Lag of Capital Adequacy Ratio, (Risk weighted)"

/*
	Generate interest rate and loan data to use in regressions
*/

* Winsorize loan level interest rate

winsor WAint_rate, gen(W1WAint_rate) p(.005)
label var W1WAint_rate "Loan nominal interest rate, winsorized at p(.005)"

sum W1WAint*,d

winsor WAmaturity, gen(W1WAmaturity) p(.005)
label var W1WAmaturity "Loan maturity, winsorized at p(.005)"

ge log_i = log(1+W1WAint_rate)
ge log_r = log(1+W1WAint_rate)- expinf_avq

label var log_i "Log of 1 + nominal interest rate, winsorized at p(.005)"
label var log_r "Log of 1 + real interest rate, winsorized at p(.005)"

* Rename loan variable

ge l_r_principal12_def21=log(r_principal12_def21)
ren l_r_principal12_def21 log_loan

/*
	Program:  Generating the results in Tables 15 & 16 using the new loan 
				 issuances data. Tables included in REStud manuscript of

/*
	
	Program: this program runs regressions at the LOAN level, using origination
			 date to determine the month the loan was issued. We will be using
			 repeated cross-sections. The regressions will be run with a full
			 array of fixed effects, including bank*firm*month, and we will
			 control for loan level characteristics, including 
				1) Collateral				[DEMEAND]
				2) FX
				3) Lagged VIX*Collateral [DEMEANED]
		
	Output:
		1. table15.xls: VIX interactions

*/

* Merge in needed macro data and create some lagged variables and exchange rate change

tab _merge
drop _merge

format dateq %tq

*Add  bank B/S data -Additioanl 
joinby bankid dateq using $dir_dta2/bank_regs_data, unmatched(both)

ge log_i = log(1+int_rate)
ge log_r = log(1+W1int_rate)- expinf_avm

sum log_i

use "$dir_dta/forsumstats_CRcoverage_FXdecomp",clear

bysort dateq:egen  TOT_princ=total(principal)
bysort dateq:egen  TOTAL_FX=total(principal) if FX_loan==1
bysort dateq:egen  TOT_FX_indexed=total(principal) if FX_indexed_dum==1

bysort dateq:egen  TOTAL_countFX=total(count) if FX_loan==1
bysort dateq:egen  TOT_countFX_indexed=total(count) if FX_indexed_dum==1

tostring(dateq),ge( dateqstr) usedisplayformat force
ge quarter=real(substr(dateqstr,6,6))
keep if quarter==4
drop if TOT_FX_indexed==.

ge FX_share=TOTAL_FX/TOT_princ
ge FX_indexed_share=TOT_FX_indexed/TOT_princ
ge FX_loan_share=FX_share-FX_indexed_share

ge FX_countshare=TOTAL_countFX/TOT_count
ge FX_countindexed_share=TOT_countFX_indexed/TOT_count
ge FX_countloan_share=FX_countshare-FX_countindexed_share

* Drop negative collateral/principal loans
drop if collat_princ<0

* Drop if loan principal is less than 5K
keep if r_principal12_def21>5

* Winsorize Collateral/Principal variable

ge Wat2collat_princ=collat_princ
replace  Wat2collat_princ=2 if  collat_princ>2 & collat_princ!=.

egen m_collat = mean(Wat2collat_princ), by(datem)

egen mgt0_collat = mean(Wat2collat_princ) if collat_princ>0.0001, by(datem)

*/

ge dm_collat_princVIX = dm_collat_princ*dm_Llog_vix_pa

replace secured=0 if collat_princ<1 & collat_princ!=.
label var secured "Secured, dummy(Collat/Principal>=1) "

egen panelFB = group(firmid bankid)

egen financed_activity_fe=group(financed_activity)

ge maturity_fe=.
replace maturity_fe=1  if maturity_corrected<=12
replace maturity_fe=2  if maturity_corrected>12 & maturity_corrected<=24
replace maturity_fe=3  if maturity_corrected>24 & maturity_corrected<=36

content:
/*
	Program:  Generating the main analysis results using the Bank-firm-quarter 
				 level data. Tables included in REStud  manuscript of “International 
				 Spillovers and Local Credit Cycles” by  Julian di Giovanni, 
				 Şebnem Kalemli-Özcan, Mehmet Fatih Ulu and Yusuf Soner Başkaya.
*/



set more off

/*********************************************
	Global directories and data
*********************************************/

global dir_dta  "../FIRMBANKRISK"
global dir_log  "../LOG"
global dir_tabs "../TABLES"

/*
		
	Program: this file runs the baseline OLS regressions for Turkish data using
			 VIX. Future regressions will be based on these regressions, and will
			 include some additional checks.
			 
			 Double clustering by firm and date, OLS & weighted-least squares 
			 
			 Program will written in "blocks" of programs, so that different
			 regressions can easily be turned on or off without having to edit
			 out huge parts of the program.
			 		 
			 
			 1. Only do most stringent regression with bank controls
			 2. QoQ controls, including lagged inflation, GDP growth
			 3. Look at nominal rates and loan amounts
			 4. Include policy/overnight rates in additional specifications
			 
	Input: masterdataWholeCR_Q_Cycle_FXsplit
		
*/	

* Load master data file

use $dir_dta/masterdataWholeCR_Q_Cycle_FXsplit, clear

*keep if max_u>0.99

* Rename real interest rates and real loans so easier to follow in output

ren l_r_W1WA_intrateFXTL log_r
ge log_i = log(1+l_W1WA_intrateFXTL)
ren l_W1r_principal12_def21 log_loan

*Generate domestic dummy

ge domestic=1-foreign

* Global vector of bank controls to avoid repeating in code, with renaming

ren LW1log_Btot_assets Lb_assets
ren LW1nc_liab Lb_noncore
ren LW1Bliq_rat Lb_liquidity
ren W1LW1Bcapital_rat Lb_capital
ren W1LW2BROA Lb_ROA

global bank "Lb_assets Lb_noncore Lb_liquidity Lb_capital Lb_ROA"
global pull "LrealGDPgr Lxr_usd_ch Linflation"

/*
	 Generate interation variables
*/

* Double interaction

ge dm_vix_noncore = Ldm_log_vix_avq*dm_Lb_noncore
label var dm_vix_noncore "Lag VIX*Bank noncore, demeaned"
 
ge dm_vix_FX = Ldm_log_vix_avq*FX_loan
label var dm_vix_FX "Lag VIX*FX dummy, demeaned"
method: bank-firm credit panel construction with global-financial-cycle interactions and fixed-effects regressions
title: International Spillovers and Local Credit Cycles

content:
Generate interation variables
*/

* Double interaction

ge dm_vix_noncore = Ldm_log_vix_avq*dm_Lb_noncore
label var dm_vix_noncore "Lag VIX*Bank noncore, demeaned"
 
ge dm_vix_FX = Ldm_log_vix_avq*FX_loan
label var dm_vix_FX "Lag VIX*FX dummy, demeaned"

ge vix_FX = FX_loan*Llog_vix_avq
label var vix_FX "Lag VIX*Dummy FX"

ge D_vix_noncore = D_mean_b_noncore*Llog_vix_avq
label var D_vix_noncore "Lag VIX*Dummy for Bank noncore, D = 1 for high noncore"

ge D_noncore_FX = D_mean_b_noncore*FX_loan
label var D_noncore_FX "Dummy for Bank noncore*FX dummy, D = 1 for high noncore"

ge D_vix_big7assets = D_big7_assets*Llog_vix_avq
label var D_vix_big7assets "Lag VIX*Dummy for Bank noncore, D = 1 for high assets(7 big banks)"

* Triple interaction with Bank and FX

ge D_vix_noncore_FX = Llog_vix_avq*D_mean_b_noncore*FX_loan
label var D_vix_noncore_FX "Lag VIX*Dummy Firm Log assets*Dummy for Bank noncore*FX dummy, D = 1 for large firms & high noncore"

***************
*Bank Leverage
***************
ge D_mean_b_leverage=1-D_mean_b_capital

* Generate exchange rate dummy variable

ge LD_xr_usd_ch  = 0
replace LD_xr_usd_ch = 1 if Lxr_usd_ch >0
label var LD_xr_usd_ch "Dummy for lag quarterly average TL/USD change, Depreciation=1"

* Generate exchange rate dummy based on 75% pct of xr change over sample period
ge Lp75_xr_usd_ch = 0
replace Lp75_xr_usd_ch = 1 if Lxr_usd_ch > .025381 
label var Lp75_xr_usd_ch "Dummy for lag quarterly average TL/USD change, Depreciation=1 (75th pctile)"

* Generate exchange rate dummy based on 25% pct of xr change over sample period
ge Lp25_xr_usd_ch = 0
replace Lp25_xr_usd_ch = 1 if Lxr_usd_ch < -.0325979
label var Lp25_xr_usd_ch "Dummy for lag quarterly average TL/USD change, Appreciation=1 (25th pctile)"

 
/*
	 Generate interation variables

********************************************************************************

********************************************************************************

content:
local xb2 0
local ii=0

foreach var of varlist `e(exogr)' {
	local ++ ii
	local j = floor(`ii'/200)
	local beta`var' = _b[`var']
	local xb`j' `xb`j'' + `beta`var''*`var'

}
display `j'


predict uhat,resid
sum uhat
local sigma=r(sd)
global sigma=r(sd)


 * now collapse
collapse (mean) educbar=educ (sd) sigz=uhat,by(qob yob pob)

tempfile fs
save `fs'

use ak91.dta
*use `subsample'
keep qob pob yob
* generate instruments
qui geninsts
egen cell=group(yob pob)
xtset cell
 
 
	qui merge m:1 qob pob yob using `fs'
	qui keep if _merge==3
	*xtset pob
	* generate omitted variable
	gen v = invnormal(uniform())

	* generate schooling
	gen educmean = educbar+max(-educbar+1,1.7*v)
	gen educ = rpoisson(educmean)
	
	
	* generate outcome
	
	gen epsilon = invnormal(uniform())
	gen lwklywge =  .1*educ + `xb0' + sigz/`sigma'*(v + .1*epsilon)
	forvalues ii=1/`j' {
		replace lwklywge = lwklywge + `xb`ii''
	}
	

bys qob yob pob: gen cell_count = _N
 

// reverse engineer the controls

gen sigz_normalized = sigz/${sigma}

gen control = lwklywge - 0.1*educ - sigz_normalized * (v + 0.1*epsilon)

// empty cells
replace control = 0 if control == .
replace sigz_normalized = 0 if sigz_normalized == .
 
outsheet educbar sigz_normalized control cell_count qob yob pob using "simulation_AK91_no_ZW.dat" if sigz_normalized != 0 , nonames replace

use "${PATH_IN_DATA}/formatted_data_replication.dta", clear

*Restrict dataset to Baseline-Scarce treatments
drop if Treatment_Environment!=1
drop if Treatment_Incentives==4
drop if round!=1

expand 3

*Hypo. Treatment ID
bysort subject_id: gen Treatment_Incentives_Hypo=_n
label var Treatment_Incentives_Hypo "Hypothetical Incentives"
label values Treatment_Incentives_Hypo Treatment_Incentives


* Always got 40 cents for load task
gen hypo_payoff_load_mean  = load_correct_mean * 0.4

* Get hypo payoff for decision task using real behavior under one of three incentive schemes
gen hypo_payoff_summation_mean  = .
replace hypo_payoff_summation_mean  = summation_correct_mean * 0.1 if Treatment_Incentives_Hypo ==1
replace hypo_payoff_summation_mean  = summation_correct_mean * 0.2 if Treatment_Incentives_Hypo ==2
replace hypo_payoff_summation_mean  = summation_correct_mean * 0.4 if Treatment_Incentives_Hypo ==3

** Hypothethical payoff + share
gen hypo_payoff_mean = hypo_payoff_load_mean  + hypo_payoff_summation_mean
gen hypo_payoff_share = .
replace hypo_payoff_share  = hypo_payoff_mean / 0.5 if Treatment_Incentives_Hypo ==1
replace hypo_payoff_share  = hypo_payoff_mean / 0.6 if Treatment_Incentives_Hypo ==2
replace hypo_payoff_share  = hypo_payoff_mean / 0.8 if Treatment_Incentives_Hypo ==3

gen hypo_payoff_share_table =hypo_payoff_share
replace hypo_payoff_share_table =. if Treatment_Incentives == Treatment_Incentives_Hypo


estpost tabstat hypo_payoff_share_table if Treatment_Incentives ==1 , by(Treatment_Incentives_Hypo) statistics(mean sd) columns(statistics) listwise nototal
eststo one
estpost tabstat hypo_payoff_share_table if Treatment_Incentives ==2 , by(Treatment_Incentives_Hypo) statistics(mean sd) columns(statistics) listwise nototal
eststo two

	preserve

	collapse (sum) exports, by(nipc `p')

************************************

drop loghours loghnorm realhwage logrealhwage logrealsalary 

foreach var in hours hnormal realsalary{ 

	forval y = 2002/2013{
	
		centile `var' if  year== `y' & `var'>0 & `var'!=. , c(5 95) 
		local p5 = r(c_1)
		local p95 = r(c_2)
		
		replace  `var' = `p5' if  `var' < `p5' & ( year== `y') & `var'>0 & `var'!=.
		replace  `var' = `p95' if  `var' > `p95'  & ( year== `y') & `var'>0 & `var'!=.
		
	}

gen log`var' = log(`var')
	
}

*generate hourly wages, winsorize again

gen realhwage = realsalary/hnormal

foreach var in realhwage{ 

	forval y = 2002/2013{
	
	centile `var' if  year== `y' & `var'>0 & `var'!=. , c(5 95)
		local p5 = r(c_1)
		local p95 = r(c_2)
		
		replace  `var' = `p5' if  `var' < `p5' & ( year== `y') & `var'>0 & `var'!=.
		replace  `var' = `p95' if  `var' > `p95'  & ( year== `y') & `var'>0 & `var'!=.
		
	}

gen log`var' = log(`var')
	
}

***********************************
**4. Merge in firm-level vars
***********************************

*Treatments, controls, heterogeneity

merge m:1 nipcbdp using `t4e', keep(3) keepusing( ///
	nipcbdp shock0610hs6 idshock0610* comshock0610* l1o4_shock0610hs6 l1o4_idshock0610* l1o4_comshock0610* trimshock0610hs6 ///

egen yearspre = total(same_firm * inrange(year, 2005 , 2007)), by(nss)

***Restrict to base year incumbents
keep if samp$baseyear == 1


***Restrict to full-time incumbents
egen hours2007 = total(hnormal*(year==2007)), by(nss)
keep if inrange( hours2007, 120, 200)



***********************************
**6. Main variable definitions
***********************************

*arc-percent changes 
egen baserealsalary = total(realsalary* (year==$baseyear)), by(nss)
gen arc_salary = (realsalary - baserealsalary) / (.5*(realsalary + baserealsalary))
egen baserealhwage = total(t_real_h_wage* (year==$baseyear)), by(nss)
gen arc_hwage = (t_real_h_wage - baserealhwage) / (.5*(t_real_h_wage + baserealhwage))



*make versions of variables that are missing if not at baseline firm in 
foreach var in  logrealhwage logrealsalary{
	 gen `var'_stayer = `var' if same_firm==1
}


*Inverse Hyperbolic Sine var
gen asinhsalary = asinh(12*realsalary/1000)
gen asinhhwage= asinh(realhwage)

***********************************

cap drop perm
cap drop female 
cap drop young
cap drop old
cap drop primeage

gen perm = ctype_pre == 1

gen old = age_pre > 50

**********************************************

/*
/*Build pair-level data*/
use "${path}/Aggregate Shock/Data/exports_ijpt.dta", clear
rename HS6 hs6
rename value exports
rename country id_pais

*deflators
merge m:1 year using "${path}/Aggregate Shock/Data/deflator.dta", nogen keep(1 3)

replace exports = exports * deflator

*Make weights based on full relationshup with country over entire period, WITHIN HS6 BUCKETS
*Collapse across years and products to firm-country level
collapse (sum) exports, by(nipc hs6 id_pais year)

gen cpid = id_pais*100000000 + hs6

keep if year == 2006|year == 2007| year == 2009 | year == 2010
gen t=0

replace t=1 if  year == 2006|year == 2007

merge m:1 nipc year using "${path}/Aggregate Shock/Data/firms_nace5", keep(3) nogen 
gen tempnace=NACE5
egen nace5d= mode(tempnace), by(nipc)
replace exports = 0 if exports == .
gen logexports =log(exports)
gen log2exports = log(exports+1)
collapse (mean) exports logexports log2exports (firstnm) nace5d, by(nipc hs6 id_pais t)

egen groupid = group(nipc id_pais hs6)
tsset groupid t

tsfill, full

foreach v in hs6 nipc id_pais nace5d{
	replace `v'=0 if `v'==.
	egen temp = max(`v'), by(groupid)
	replace `v' = temp if `v'==0
	drop temp
}

merge m:1 nipcbdp using Data\treatments_for_emp
keep if _merge == 3
drop _merge
keep if mainsamp

*merge on recession shocks
merge m:1 id_pais hs6 using "${path}/Aggregate Shock/Data/core_recessionshocks_hs6.dta", keep(3) nogen

merge m:1 hs4 using "{path}/Aggregate Shock/Data/p4only_shock", keep(3) nogen

merge m:1 hs4 using "{path}/Aggregate Shock/Data/p4only_shock", keep(3) nogen 

tsset groupid t

save "${path}/Aggregate Shock/replication/data_out/kmdata", replace
*/




********************************************
* Main Analysis 					       *
********************************************

*Read in origal copy for firm x destination cleaned data (original, not replication copy)
use "${path}/Aggregate Shock/Data/kmdata.dta", clear

replace log2exports = 0 if log2exports==.

replace exports = 0 if exports==.

*arc elasticities
gen ae_num = exports - L.exports
gen ae_den = exports + L.exports

gen elast = logexports - L.logexports
gen elast_alt = log2exports - L.log2exports 
gen any_exp = exports>0 & exports!=.


gen exports_init =  L.exports
keep if t==2
keep if exports_init!=.	& exports_init!=0	

bys id_pais hs6: gen order=_n

/*Winsorize Shocks*/
foreach var in m_dem6_0306   m_dem6_0610{
	summ `var' if order==1, d 
	local t1 = r(p10)
	local t2 = r(p90)
	replace `var' = `t1' if `var'<`t1' & `var'!=.
	replace `var' = `t2' if `var'>`t2' & `var'!=.
	summ `var' if order==1, d 
	local sd = r(sd)
	gen st`var' = `var'/`sd'
}


/*Plot Serial correlations for fig A4 */

foreach fp in m_dem6_0306 {
	summ `fp' if order==1
	local xpos = r(max)
	summ m_dem6_0610 if order==1
	local ypos = r(max)
	
	reg stm_dem6_0610  st`fp', cluster(hs6)
	local b = _b[st`fp']
	local b= round(`b',.001)
	local se = _se[st`fp']
	local se= round(`se',.001)
	binscatter   m_dem6_0610 `fp' if order==1, ytitle("") xtitle("") text(.02 .4 "Corr `b' (`se')", size(large))  line(none)
	graph export "${path}/Aggregate Shock/replication/output/FA4_nofe.pdf", replace

	
	reghdfe stm_dem6_0610 st`fp', absorb(hs6) cluster(hs6)
	local b = _b[st`fp']
	local b= round(`b',.001)
	local se = _se[st`fp']
	local se= round(`se',.001)
	binscatter   m_dem6_0610 `fp' if order==1, ytitle("") xtitle("") absorb(hs6) text(.02 .4 "Corr `b' (`se')", size(large)) line(none)
	graph export "${path}/Aggregate Shock/replication/output/FA4_fe.pdf", replace
}	

gen arcelast= ae_num / ae_den

*heterogenuous effect of mass layoff by OOI on wages/search time
*using various controls

*Oren Danieli
*October 2020
*September 2021 - adding fixed effects
*tables 3, A2. Figures 2, A1

cap log close
log using ${log}\02_restud2_mass_layoffs.log, replace
set more off
set matsize 1000
est clear
fdzinstall estout

// load data for the layoff exercise
use $data/liab_OOI_layoffs.dta, clear
drop if X_age < 20

* as noted in paper, restrict mass layoff analysis to workers under age 55 (exclusive)
drop if X_age > 54

* people with missing OOI as we can't use them in the analysis
drop if missing(OOI)

* drop people who did not have a job before (daily wage <1 euro)
drop tentgelt_gr
drop if tentgelt <1

gen income0 = tentgelt

*sum by worker (not worker-month observation)
preserve 
	collapse (mean) X_* year income* pre* tenure, by (persnr)
	summ X_* year income* pre*
	tab X_schule
	qui summ tenure, detail
restore

*change tenure to be 0 at median
gen demed_ten = tenure - r(p50)

*change age to be 0 at 40 
gen age40 = X_age-40

* keep the variables we want
keep persnr  tentgelt demed_ten X_frau X_schule age40 X_german ///
	year OOI betnr income* X_past_occ* pre_* part_time*

* reshape to long format
	// note: month is not 1-12.
reshape long income pre_income part_time, i(persnr year) j(month)

*separate pre trends to separate observations
expand 2, gen(pre)
replace month = - month if pre
replace income = pre_income if pre
drop pre_income

*bin by month and establishment
egen emp_month = group(betnr month)

*set month 0 to 100 to avoid negatives
replace month = month + 100

*******

*raw trend (appendix figure)

*look at the coefficient for OOI (figure)
areg rel_inc ib(100).month##c.OOI, a(emp_month) cluster(persnr)

*employment figure

*used for figure 4

cap log close
log using ${log}\04_restud2_between_gap.log, replace


set more off 
est clear
use $data\liab_OOI_cs14, clear

* sample restrictions
drop if X_past_occ_miss == 1
drop if X_age<20
drop if X_age>60
drop wgt_year_norm*
drop wgt_year2

* generate outcome
gen logw = log(tentgelt_gr)

*****
*Basic information on the between group wage gap
*****
set matsize 5000

* censoring level set based on SS max
tobit logw X_frau ib(8).X_schule c.X_age##c.X_age X_german Z_teilzeit  [pw = wgt] if !mi(OOI), ul(5.272)
eststo
tobit logw X_frau ib(8).X_schule c.X_age##c.X_age X_german Z_teilzeit  if !mi(OOI), ul(5.272)

esttab, se replace star(* 0.10 ** 0.05 *** 0.01) keep(X_frau 6.X_schule 4.X_schule X_german Z_teilzeit)
est clear
****
*using OOI coefficient from IV
******
local ooi_coef = .1732504    //coefficient from Bartik (file 06)

*tobit - offset by the OOI
gen offvar =  `ooi_coef'*OOI

tobit logw X_frau ib(8).X_schule c.X_age##c.X_age X_german Z_teilzeit [pw = wgt] if !mi(OOI), ul(5.272) offset(offvar)
eststo
tobit logw X_frau ib(8).X_schule c.X_age##c.X_age X_german Z_teilzeit if !mi(OOI), ul(5.272)offset(offvar)

esttab,se keep(X_frau 6.X_schule 4.X_schule X_german Z_teilzeit)
est clear

content:
*table of avg. commuting distance

cap log close

log using $log\07_restud2_distance.log,  replace

set more off
use $data\liab_OOI_cs14.dta, clear
drop if missing(wo_kreis)
drop if missing(OOI)

*Describe the distance between worker original location (in previous job)
*to new job location

*physical distance between two districts in miles
gen tmpa = sin((Z_ao_lat-X_wo_lat)/2*_pi/180)^2 + cos(Z_ao_lat*_pi/180)*cos(X_wo_lat*_pi/180)*sin((Z_ao_lon-X_wo_lon)/2*_pi/180)^2
gen tmpc = 2*atan2(tmpa^0.5,(1-tmpa)^0.5)
gen dist = tmpc*3959

drop tmp*

****Results Start Here****
*basic summaries - without weights, according to IAB guidelines
summ dist
by X_frau, sort : summ dist
by X_schule, sort : summ dist

*with weights
summ dist [aweight = wgt_year]
by X_frau, sort : summ dist [aweight = wgt_year]
by X_schule, sort : summ dist [aweight = wgt_year]

*histogram of distance between jobs
egen int disc_dist = cut(dist), at(0,5,20,50,100000)

tabulate disc_dist
tabulate disc_dist [aweight = wgt_year]

by X_frau, sort : tabulate disc_dist 
by X_frau, sort : tabulate disc_dist  [aweight = wgt_year]

by X_schule, sort : tabulate disc_dist  
by X_schule, sort : tabulate disc_dist [aweight = wgt_year]

content:
*Bartik-like analysis 
*Tables 6,7,A3

*Bartik by region 

cap log close
log using ${log}\11_restud2_bartik.log, replace
set more off


use $data\liab_OOI_reweight_bartik.dta , clear
drop if X_past_occ_missing == 1


*clean data, add variables
rename tentgelt wage

gen log_wage = log(wage)

*workforce ages (following CHK)
gen wfa = X_age>19 & X_age < 61
cap gen X_age2 = X_age^2

*use OOI IV
gen OOI_IV = OOI if year == 2004
replace OOI_IV = OOI2014IV if year == 2014

*region
gen int region = ao_kreis/100
replace region = floor(wo_kreis/100) if missing(region)

*top coding
gen topc = wage == 195
replace topc = 1 if (wage == 168) & year == 2004


//generate differences
sort persnr year
foreach v of varlist log_wage OOI OOI_IV wage X_age2 Z_teilzeit topc {
	by persnr: gen d_`v' = `v'[2]-`v'[1]
	label var d_`v' "Difference in `v'"
	}

gen panel_wfa =  X_age>19 & X_age < 51 if year == 2004
replace panel_wfa =  X_age>29 & X_age < 61 if year == 2014
	
bysort ind reg: egen indFE = mean(d_OOI_IV)


****RESULTS START HERE****
*reduced form
areg d_log_wage indFE d_X_age2 if year == 2004 & panel_wfa == 1 & !missing(d_OOI), absorb(ind) cluster(region)
eststo 
areg d_log_wage indFE i.X_schule X_frau X_german X_age X_age2 if year == 2004 & panel_wfa == 1 & !missing(d_OOI), absorb(ind) cluster(region)
eststo 

*first stage
areg d_OOI indFE d_X_age2 if year == 2004 & panel_wfa == 1 & !missing(d_log_wage), absorb(ind) cluster(region)
eststo 
test(indFE)
estadd scalar f1 = r(F)
estadd scalar p1 = r(p)
areg d_OOI indFE i.X_schule X_frau X_german X_age X_age2 if year == 2004 & panel_wfa == 1 & !missing(d_log_wage), absorb(ind) cluster(region)
eststo
test(indFE)
estadd scalar f2 = r(F)
estadd scalar p2 = r(p)

*2sls
qui ivregress 2sls  d_log_wage (d_OOI = indFE) d_X_age2 i.ind if year == 2004 & panel_wfa == 1, cluster(region)
eststo
estadd scalar nc = r(N_clust)

qui ivregress 2sls  d_log_wage (d_OOI = indFE) i.X_schule X_frau X_german X_age X_age2 i.ind if year == 2004 & panel_wfa == 1, cluster(region)
eststo
estadd scalar nc = r(N_clust)

*main results 
esttab, se replace star(* 0.10 ** 0.05 *** 0.01) keep(indFE d_OOI) scalars(f1 f2 p1 p2 nc)
est clear

content:
*OOI and wages by occupational training
*Oren Danieli
*October 2020

cap log close

log using ${log}\12_restud2_past_occ.log, replace


set more off
set matsize 5000
*Load data
use $data\liab_ooi_cs14, clear

drop if X_past_occ_miss == 1
drop wgt_year_norm*
drop wgt_year2


*take only labor force ages
keep if X_age <61 & X_age > 19

//Average of 4 digit occupations
//Take average income and average OOI
//Also take their average residuals after a basic Mincer regression
//Occupations with 20 or fewer observations are deleted
gen logw = log(tentgelt_gr)

qui areg OOI X_frau ib(8).X_schule c.X_age##c.X_age X_german  Z_teilzeit if !missing(logw) [pweight = wgt], a(wo_kreis)
predict resid_OOI, resid


qui areg logw X_frau ib(8).X_schule c.X_age##c.X_age X_german  Z_teilzeit [pweight = wgt] if !missing(OOI), a(wo_kreis)
predict resid_w, resid

*most common occupation
bysort past_occ: egen tmp2 = sum(wgt_year)

bysort past_occ occ: egen tmp3 = sum(wgt_year) 
bysort past_occ: egen conc1 = max(tmp3/tmp2)
summ conc1 [aw = wgt_year]

qui areg conc1 X_frau ib(8).X_schule c.X_age##c.X_age X_german  Z_teilzeit [pweight = wgt] if !missing(OOI), a(wo_kreis)
predict resid_conc1, resid


gen N = 1
collapse (mean) OOI logw resid* conc1 (rawsum) wgt N [aw = wgt] , by(past_occ)
keep if N>20
reg conc1 OOI [pw= wgt]


*bins - Figure A2


sort OOI
gen perc = sum(wgt_year)
replace perc = perc/perc[_N]

egen bin10 = cut(perc), at(0(0.1000001)1.000001)

preserve 
collapse (mean) logw resid_* OOI conc1 (rawsum) wgt N [aw=wgt],by(bin10)
list, clean
restore


drop perc bin*


*ooi by wage - Figure A3
gen contribution = resid_w*resid_OOI
sort cont
drop cont


egen totw = total(wgt)
replace wgt = wgt/totw
drop totw
label var OOI "mean outside options index (OOI) per training occupation"

content:
*mass layoffs and OOI
*do workers with high OOIs find jobs faster? 

set more off

*Stage 1:
*Find cases of panel firms with mass layoffs
*Following definition of JLS
*30% fewer workers than last year
*at least 50 workers in this establishment
********************************************************************************
use $data\observed_size, replace
	xtset idnum year
	gen JLS = (observed_size>49)&((F.observed_size-observed_size)/observed_size < -.3)
	keep if JLS
save $data\JLS_mass_layoffs, replace
********************************************************************************
*Stage 2:
*Find the ID's of workers involved in these layoffs
	// start with everyong
	use $orig\liab_lm_9314_v1_pers, replace

	// identify people at the mass layoff organizations
	gen year = year(begepi)
	merge m:1 idnum year using $data/JLS_mass_layoffs, nogen keep(master match)

	*keep workers ever worked in a firm when it had mass layoffs 
	bysort persnr: egen potential = max(JLS)
	drop if missing(potential)
		
	*find last day at firm
	bysort persnr idnum: egen last_day = max(endepi)
	*first day at firm
	bysort persnr idnum: egen first_day = min(begepi)
	*drop of less than 3 years of tenure
	gen tenure = last_day - first_day
	bysort persnr idnum: egen potential_spell = max(JLS)
	replace potential_spell = 0 if tenure < 365*3
	bysort persnr: egen potential2 = max(potential_spell)
	drop if potential2 != 1
		
	*find year of last masslayoff present
	gen year_layoff = year if JLS==1
	bysort persnr idnum: egen last_layoff_year = max(year_layoff) if potential_spell == 1

	*define layoff
	gen displaced = (year(last_day) - last_layoff_year) < 2
	bysort persnr: egen ever_displaced = max(displaced)
	drop if ever_displaced != 1
********************************************************************************
*stage 3: 
*clean data for displaced workers

//german - 
* say you're german if you are ever german
* missing in all years imputed to 1, and german_imp marked as 1
bys persnr: egen weak_german = max(german)
replace german = weak_german
	gen german_imp = missing(german)
	replace german = 1 if missing(german)
	drop weak_german

//Assert vatiables are consistent throughout time by comparing min to max	
* Gender
bys persnr: egen maxfrau = max(frau)
bys persnr: egen minfrau = min(frau)
assert maxfrau ==  minfrau
drop maxfrau minfrau
	
*Year of birth
bys persnr: egen maxgj = max(gebjahr)
bys persnr: egen mingj = min(gebjahr)
assert maxgj ==  mingj
count if missing(gebjahr)
drop maxgj mingj

//Education
* Extrapolate forward the highest education level ever reported
recode schule (5 = 3) //don't extrapolate 5 forward (because it means unsure if 4 or 6)
bysort persnr (begepi): replace schule = schule[_n - 1] if _n > 1 & ///

content:
bys persnr: egen maxgj = max(gebjahr)
bys persnr: egen mingj = min(gebjahr)
assert maxgj ==  mingj
count if missing(gebjahr)
drop maxgj mingj

//Education
* Extrapolate forward the highest education level ever reported
recode schule (5 = 3) //don't extrapolate 5 forward (because it means unsure if 4 or 6)
bysort persnr (begepi): replace schule = schule[_n - 1] if _n > 1 & ///
	!mi(schule[_n - 1]) & (mi(schule) | schule < schule[_n - 1])	
recode schule (3 = 5) //recode back to 5
recode schule (9 = 8) 

*extrapolate backward: 
gsort persnr -begepi
*complete type of high school (or no high school) backwards
by persnr: replace schule = schule[_n-1] if _n>1 & mi(schule) & (schule[_n-1]<7)
*replace 5 with 4 or 6 
by persnr: replace schule = schule[_n-1] if _n>1 & schule == 5 & (schule[_n-1] == 6 | schule[_n-1] == 4)

//family status - currently unused
*Marital status 
bysort persnr (begepi): replace famst_gr = famst_gr[_n - 1] if _n > 1 & ///
	!mi(famst_gr[_n - 1]) & mi(famst_gr) 

*kids - if you have one it's for life
*or whether in the last 5 years you didn't have one
bys persnr: egen maxkind = max(kind_gr)
bys persnr: egen maxkind_5 = max(kind_gr) 

replace kind_gr = 1 if maxkind == 1
replace kind_gr = 0 if maxkind_5 == 0 & maxkind != 1

gen age = year - gebjahr

********************************************************************************
// PAST OCCUPATION
*Defined as trainning occupation id exists, and is not currently in trainning
*Else - Take intern occupation if exist
*Else - Take first occupation, mark the number of years past 1st occupation 
*for different samples, we will define past_occ as missing depending on time pass first occ
	
	*Prepare train, first and interm occupations
	
	*by person and occupation, for training year define the # of year (first year in trainning in this occupation, second, third etc...)
	egen uyear = tag(persnr year beruf) if erwstat == 2 //tag training years by occupation
	bysort persnr beruf (begepi): gen trainoccy = sum(uyear) // cumulative # of years in trainning in this occuption
	
	*define maximum years in trainning at same occupation so far
	*Equals last year unless your occupation now has more years
	gen tot2 = trainoccy
	bysort persnr (begepi): replace tot2 = tot2[_n-1] if _n>1 & tot2[_n-1]>trainoccy
	
	*gen trainning occupation by dividing into two cases
	*1: When you have some trainning and your are in an occupation that you have
	*max trainning in, that's your trainning occ
	gen train_occ = beruf if tot2==trainoccy & tot2>0
	*2: keep your last trainning occupation as long as years of trainning haven't increased
	bysort persnr (begepi): replace train_occ = train_occ[_n-1] if tot2==tot2[_n-1]
	
	*first occ - take first non missing (if all are missing it will be missing as well)
	gen miss_occ = mi(beruf)
	bysort persnr (miss_occ year): gen first_occ = beruf[1]
	bysort persnr (miss_occ year): gen first_occ_year = year[1]

	*intern occ - similar to trainning
	egen uyear5 = tag(persnr year beruf) if erwstat == 5 // for each occupation, tag intern year
	bysort persnr beruf (begepi): gen trainoccy5 = sum(uyear5) // how many years they did internship for this occ till now
	*define maximum years in intern in occupation so far (like in trainning)
	gen tot5 = trainoccy5
	bysort persnr (begepi): replace tot5 = tot5[_n-1] if _n>1 & tot5[_n-1]>trainoccy5

	*define intern occ in 2 cases like before
	gen intern_occ = beruf if tot5==trainoccy5 & tot5>0
	bysort persnr (begepi): replace intern_occ = intern_occ[_n-1] if tot5==tot5[_n-1]
	
	*if trained take train as long as not currently in trainning (trainning in another occupation is fine)
	gen past_occ = train_occ if erwstat!=2 | train_occ != beruf
	gen past_occ_method = 1 if !mi(past_occ)

content:
gen tot5 = trainoccy5
	bysort persnr (begepi): replace tot5 = tot5[_n-1] if _n>1 & tot5[_n-1]>trainoccy5

	*define intern occ in 2 cases like before
	gen intern_occ = beruf if tot5==trainoccy5 & tot5>0
	bysort persnr (begepi): replace intern_occ = intern_occ[_n-1] if tot5==tot5[_n-1]
	
	*if trained take train as long as not currently in trainning (trainning in another occupation is fine)
	gen past_occ = train_occ if erwstat!=2 | train_occ != beruf
	gen past_occ_method = 1 if !mi(past_occ)
	*else, take intern as long as not currently in an internship (at another occ is ok)
	replace past_occ = intern_occ if past_occ == . & (erwstat != 5 | intern_occ != beruf)
	replace past_occ_method = 2 if !mi(past_occ) & mi(past_occ_method)
	*else take first occupation and mark time passed since
	replace past_occ = first_occ if past_occ == . 
	replace past_occ_method = 3 if !mi(past_occ) & mi(past_occ_method)
	gen years_from_first_occ = year - first_occ_year if past_occ_method == 3 

	*clean up
	drop intern_occ uyear* first_occ* miss_occ tot2 tot5 train*

	keep if begepi<=mdy(`month', `day', year) & endepi>=mdy(`month', `day', year)


	keep persnr idnum year

	*define number of workers in each establishment

	drop persnr
	duplicates drop

	*make sure there are no funny things

	save "H:\data\observed_size.dta", replace

********************************************************************************
*stage 1: Clean survey for each year
********************************************************************************

	}
	
********************************************************************************

********************************************************************************
do "$prog/merge_svy.do"
	set more off
	clear
	*Load all files, keep common files
	append using "H:\data\svy2014_tmp.dta" "H:\data\svy2012_tmp.dta" "H:\data\svy2004_tmp.dta" "H:\data\svy1999_tmp.dta", keep(idnum year observed_size size sales s_mng_f bpnp* ini* hrs* cmp* voc* general* hr*)

	*weights

	gen wgt_worker_year = .
	foreach y in 1999 2004 2012 2014 {
		replace wgt_year_norm = hr`y'q if year == `y'
		replace wgt_worker_year = hr`y'q*observed_size if year == `y'
		}

	replace wgt_year_norm = wgt_year_norm/tmp
	drop tmp

	bysort year: egen tmp = total(wgt_worker_year)
	replace wgt_worker_year = wgt_worker_year/tmp

********************************************************************************
*stage 3, PCA analysis
********************************************************************************
	*Load data
	*Establishment survey for years 1999, 2004, 2012, 2014
	use "$data\est_svy_merged.dta", clear

	*Missing values - replace with weighted means within years
	foreach v of varlist bpnp* ini* hrs* cmp_trn* voc_trn* general* {
		*replace values coded as missing with .
		replace `v' = . if `v' == -9 | `v' == -8
		*get weighted mean for variable by year
		bysort year: egen wgt_mn = total(`v' * wgt_year_norm) 
		*replace missing variables with mean. Drop cases where all missing (wgt_mn == 0)
		replace `v' = wgt_mn if `v' == . & wgt_mn != 0
		drop wgt_mn
	}

	*Define samples
	*3 samples of analysis: Cross section (2014), Train (change between 1999-2012), 
	*Bartik (Change between 2004-2014)
	gen cs14 = year == 2014
	gen train = (year == 1999 | year == 2012)
	gen bartik = (year == 2004 | year == 2014)

	*Loops through each sample and preform PCA
	foreach s in cs14 train bartik{
		preserve
		keep if `s' == 1
		*drop variables that are all missing 
		foreach v of varlist bpnp* ini* hrs* cmp_trn* voc_trn* general*{
			qui misstable summ `v'
			if r(N_eq_dot)> 0 & r(N_eq_dot) != .{
				di r(N_eq_dot)
				drop `v'
				di "`v' dropped"
			}
		}
		foreach c in bpnp ini hrs cmp_trn voc_trn general {
			di "*******`c'**********"
			if (!("`c'" == "cmp_trn" & "`s'" == "bartik")){ //don't run in bartik for cmp_trn because theres none
				pca `c'_* [aweight = wgt_worker_year], mine(1)
				predict `c'*
				drop `c'_*
			}
			else {
			gen cmp_trn1 = .
			}
		}
		keep idnum year wgt* bpnp* ini* hrs* cmp_trn* voc_trn* general* size sales s_mng_f observed_size
		save "$data\svy_pca_`s'.dta", replace
		restore
	}

replace unemp = 0 if missing(unemp)
bysort persnr: egen any_unemp = max(unemp)
drop unemp
	
********************************************************************************
// PAST OCCUPATION
*Defined as trainning occupation id exists, and is not currently in trainning
*Else - Take intern occupation if exist
*Else - Take first occupation, mark the number of years past 1st occupation 
*for different samples, we will define past_occ as missing depending on time pass first occ
	
	*Prepare train, first and interm occupations
	
	*by person and occupation, for training year define the # of year (first year in trainning in this occupation, second, third etc...)
	egen uyear = tag(persnr year beruf) if erwstat == 2 //tag training years by occupation
	bysort persnr beruf (begepi): gen trainoccy = sum(uyear) // cumulative # of years in trainning in this occuption
	
	*define maximum years in trainning at same occupation so far
	*Equals last year unless your occupation now has more years
	gen tot2 = trainoccy
	bysort persnr (begepi): replace tot2 = tot2[_n-1] if _n>1 & tot2[_n-1]>trainoccy
	
	*gen trainning occupation by dividing into two cases
	*1: When you have some trainning and your are in an occupation that you have
	*max trainning in, that's your trainning occ
	gen train_occ = beruf if tot2==trainoccy & tot2>0
	*2: keep your last trainning occupation as long as years of trainning haven't increased
	bysort persnr (begepi): replace train_occ = train_occ[_n-1] if tot2==tot2[_n-1]
	
	*first occ - take first non missing (if all are missing it will be missing as well)
	gen miss_occ = mi(beruf)
	bysort persnr (miss_occ year): gen first_occ = beruf[1]
	bysort persnr (miss_occ year): gen first_occ_year = year[1]

	*intern occ - similar to trainning
	egen uyear5 = tag(persnr year beruf) if erwstat == 5 // for each occupation, tag intern year
	bysort persnr beruf (begepi): gen trainoccy5 = sum(uyear5) // how many years they did internship for this occ till now
	*define maximum years in intern in occupation so far (like in trainning)
	gen tot5 = trainoccy5
	bysort persnr (begepi): replace tot5 = tot5[_n-1] if _n>1 & tot5[_n-1]>trainoccy5

	*define intern occ in 2 cases like before
	gen intern_occ = beruf if tot5==trainoccy5 & tot5>0
	bysort persnr (begepi): replace intern_occ = intern_occ[_n-1] if tot5==tot5[_n-1]

	*if trained take train as long as not currently in trainning (trainning in another occupation is fine)
	gen past_occ = train_occ if erwstat!=2 | train_occ != beruf
	gen past_occ_method = 1 if !mi(past_occ)
	*else, take intern as long as not currently in an internship (at another occ is ok)
	replace past_occ = intern_occ if past_occ == . & (erwstat != 5 | intern_occ != beruf)
	replace past_occ_method = 2 if !mi(past_occ) & mi(past_occ_method)
	*else take first occupation and mark time passed since
	replace past_occ = first_occ if past_occ == . 
	replace past_occ_method = 3 if !mi(past_occ) & mi(past_occ_method)
	gen years_from_first_occ = year - first_occ_year if past_occ_method == 3 

	*clean up
	drop intern_occ uyear* first_occ* miss_occ tot2 tot5 train*

********************************************************************************
// PAST LOCATION (district)

*If available, that's where you lived at your previous job
*Else - the location of your previous job
*Else - first location + mark time since first time observed for future filtering

*previous versions are in past_dist.do

*Stage 4 -  fill forward from fistr day to rest of the spells

*1.1 add new observation of first day, which has end date equal start date

*auxilary file to construct Bartik IV
*OD March 2023

cap log close
log using "$log\build_bartik.log",  replace
set matsize 2000
set more off 
*load data
 use "H:\data\liab_bartik.dta", clear
 drop if Z_ind_missing == 1
 drop if Z_occ_missing == 1
 

 gen int region = ao_kreis/100
 
 *rescale weights to have mean 1
 foreach y in 2004 2014 {
	qui sum wgt_year if year == `y'
	replace wgt_year = wgt_year/r(mean) if year == `y'
	}
bysort year: summ wgt_year
 
 rename ind ind3
 
 local i = "ind3"
 local u = "region"
 
		collapse (sum) wgt_year, by(`i' `u' year)
		**find employment shares by subunit in both years
		*take log difference. add 1 for bayes correction
		bysort `i' `u' (year): gen del = ln(wgt_year[2]+1)-ln(wgt_year[1]+1)
		*replace missing cells
		bysort `i' `u' (year): replace del = -ln(wgt_year[1]+1) if missing(del) & year == 2004
		
	keep if year == 2004
	
	*regress on unit and industry fixed effects
	qui reg del i.`i' i.`u' [aw = wgt_year]
	*get mean industry and occupation effect by unit
	gen tmp_u = `u'
	replace `u' = `u'[1]
	predict indFE, xb
	replace `u' = tmp_u
	
	*save shocks file (for BJH SE calculations)
	preserve
	collapse (mean) indFE, by(`i')
	save $data/bartik_shocks, replace
	restore
	
	gen tmp_i = `i'
	replace `i' = `i'[1]
	predict uFE, xb
	
	keep `u' indFE uFE wgt_year
	
	collapse (mean) indFE uFE (rawsum) wgt_year [aw = wgt_year], by(`u')
	*save
	if ("`wage'" == "1") {
		save $data/wage_Bartik_`i'_`u', replace
		}
	else {
		save $data/Bartik_`i'_`u', replace
		}
	*correlations
	sum indFE uFE [aw = wgt_year]
	corr indFE uFE [aw = wgt_year]

log close
